Тогда̀ оу҆разꙋмѣ́еши пра́вдꙋ и҆ сꙋ́дъ, и҆ и҆спра́виши всѧ̑ стєзѝ бл҃гі̑ѧ, А҆́ще бо прїи́детъ премꙋ́дрость въ твою̀ мы́сль, чꙋ́вство же твое́й дꙋшѝ добро̀ бы́ти возмни́тся. Совѣ́тъ до́бръ сохрани́тъ тѧ̀, помышле́нїе же преподо́бное соблюде́тъ тѧ̀: Да и҆зба́витъ тѧ̀ ѿ пꙋтѝ ѕла́гѡ, и҆ ѿ мꙋ́жа глаго́люща ничто́же вѣ́рнѡ. Ѽ ѡ҆ста́вльшїи пꙋти̑ пра̑выѧ, є҆́же ходи́ти въ пꙋте́хъ тмы̀! Ѽ веселя́щихся ѡ҆ ѕлы́хъ, и҆ ра́дꙋющихся ѡ҆ развраще́нїи ѕлѣ́мъ! И҆́хже стєзѝ стро́потны, и҆ кри̑ва тече́нїа и҆́хъ, Е҆́же дале́че тѧ̀ сотвори́ти ѿ пꙋтѝ пра́вагѡ, И҆ чꙋ́жда ѿ пра́веднагѡ ра́зꙋма: сы́не, да тѧ̀ не пости́гнетъ совѣ́тъ ѕлы́й, Ѡ҆ставля́ющїй оу҆че́нїе ю҆́ности, и҆ завѣ́та бж҃е́ственнагѡ забы́вшїй. Поста́ви бо при сме́рти до́мъ сво́й, и҆ при а҆́дѣ съ земны́ми дѣѧ́нїа своѧ̑. И҆ всѝ ходѧ́щїи по немꙋ̀ не возвратя́тся, нижѐ пости́гнꙋтъ сте́зь пра́выхъ: ни бо дости́гнꙋтъ лѣ́тъ жи́зни. А҆́ще бо бы́ша ходи́ли въ стєзѝ бл҃гі̑ѧ, ѡ҆брѣ́ли оу҆́бѡ бы́ша стєзѝ пра̑вы гла̑дки, бла́зи бꙋ́дꙋтъ жи́тели на землѝ, неѕло́бивіи же ѡ҆ста́нꙋтъ на не́й. Ꙗ҆́кѡ пра́вїи вселя́тся на землѝ: и҆ прпⷣбнїи ѡ҆ста́нꙋтъ на не́й. Пꙋтїѐ нечести́выхъ ѿ землѝ поги́бнꙋтъ, пребеззако́ннїи же и҆зри́нꙋтся ѿ неѧ̀. И҆ по и҆сполне́нїи паремї́й глаго́летъ сщ҃е́нникъ: Ми́ръ тѝ. И҆ дїа́конъ, Премꙋ́дрость. Чте́цъ: Да и҆спра́витсѧ моли́тва моѧ̀: Тогда̀ пра́вагѡ и҆ лѣ́вагѡ кли́росѡвъ, и҆ предстоѧ́щїй наро́дъ, ѻ҆́бѣ страны̀ во все́й цр҃кви стоя́тъ на колѣ́нахъ молѧ́щеся. И҆ по пѣ́нїи чтеца̀, пе́рвый ли́къ пое́тъ то́жде: Да и҆спра́витсѧ моли́тва моѧ̀: И҆ чте́цъ, и҆ дрꙋга́ѧ страна̀ ли́ка, и҆ предстоѧ́щїй наро́дъ, стоя́тъ на колѣ́нахъ, до́ндеже пропою́тъ. Та́же чте́цъ пое́тъ а҃ сті́хъ: Гдⷭ҇и воззва́хъ къ тебѣ̀, оу҆слы́ши мѧ̀: И҆ по пропѣ́тїи стїха̀, пое́тъ вторы́й ли́къ: Да и҆спра́витсѧ мл҃тва моѧ̀: Тогда̀ чте́цъ, и҆ пе́рвый ли́къ, и҆ тоѧ̀ страны̀ предстоѧ́щїй наро́дъ, припа́даютъ на колѣ́на. Та́же чте́цъ пое́тъ вторы́й сті́хъ: Положѝ Гдⷭ҇и, хране́нїе: И҆ пе́рвый ли́къ па́ки пое́тъ: Да и҆спра́витсѧ мл҃тва моѧ̀: И҆ чте́цъ, и҆ вторы́й ли́къ, и҆ предстоѧ́щїй наро́дъ, па́ки приклоня́ютъ кѡлѣ́на. И҆ па́ки чте́цъ пое́тъ тре́тїй сті́хъ: Не оу҆клонѝ се́рдце моѐ: И҆ вторы́й ли́къ пое́тъ: Да и҆спра́витсѧ моли́тва моѧ̀: И҆ приклоня́етъ кѡлѣ́на чте́цъ, и҆ пе́рвый ли́къ, и҆ наро́дъ. И҆ па́ки чте́цъ пое́тъ: Да и҆спра́витсѧ мл҃тва моѧ̀, ꙗ҆́кѡ кади́ло пред̾ тобо́ю: И҆ тогда̀ ѻ҆́ба ли́ка, и҆ въ цр҃кви предстоѧ́щїй ве́сь наро́дъ, припа́даютъ на кѡлѣ́на, и҆ стоя́тъ, до́ндеже чте́цъ пое́тъ, и҆ воста́вше доспѣва́ютъ на кли́росѣ: Воздѣѧ́нїе рꙋкꙋ̀ мое́ю же́ртва вече́рнѧѧ. И҆ по и҆сполне́нїи твори́мъ покло́ны г҃. А҆́ще пра́здникъ Ѡ҆брѣ́тенїа честны́ѧ Главы̀, и҆лѝ ст҃ы́хъ м҃ Мꙋ́ченикѡвъ, Тогда̀ по сконча́нїи, Да и҆спра́витсѧ зрѝ мл҃тва моѧ̀: А҆́бїе ст҃ы̑мъ врато́мъ ѿве́рзтымъ, Пое́мъ прокі́менъ, а҆пⷭ҇лъ, а҆ллилꙋ́їа, є҆ѵⷢ҇лїе, и҆ про́чее по ѻ҆бы́чаю. Кромѣ́ же пра́здника, по Да и҆спра́витсѧ: Дїа́конъ є҆ктенїю̀, и҆ сщ҃е́нникъ мл҃твы приле́жныѧ: Мы́ же твори́мъ покло́ны г҃. И҆ про́чее послѣ́дованїе Преждеѡсщ҃е́нныхъ, по чи́нꙋ ꙗ҆́коже въ слꙋже́бникахъ и҆з̾ѧви́ся. Вѣ́дати подоба́етъ, зрѝ Ꙗ҆́кѡ по происхожде́нїи ст҃ы́хъ дарѡ́въ и҆сполня́емꙋ, Ны́нѣ си́лы нб҃ныѧ: Твори́мъ покло́ны трѝ, непокрове́ни сꙋ́ще. Вѣ́стно же бꙋ́ди, ꙗ҆́кѡ є҆гда̀ бж҃твенныѧ прено́сѧтсѧ Та̑йны, всѝ лю́дїе поклоне́нїе бг҃оподо́бное, и҆ пѣ́вцы зрѝ ни́цъ па́дше, Хрⷭ҇тꙋ̀ Бг҃ꙋ въ Та́йнахъ Сꙋ́щемꙋ, твора́тъ: поне́же соверше́ннѡ прѣѡсщ҃е́нны сꙋ́ть. Кїнонї́къ: Вкꙋси́те и҆ ви́дите, ꙗ҆́кѡ бл҃гъ Гдⷭ҇ь. А҆ллилꙋ́їа, три́жды. Дїа́конъ: Пристꙋпи́те. Мы́ же покло́нъ є҆ди́нъ: И҆ пое́мъ, Бл҃гословлю̀ Гдⷭ҇а на всѧ́кое вре́мѧ, хвала̀ є҆гѡ̀ во оу҆стнѣ́хъ мои́хъ: А҆ллилꙋ́їа, три́жды. По возглаше́нїи же ѿ Їере́ѧ, Всегда̀, ны́нѣ и҆ при́снѡ: Ли́къ: Бл҃годари́мъ тѧ̀ Хрⷭ҇тѐ Бж҃е на́шъ: А҆ллилꙋ́їа, три́жды. По заамво́нной же моли́твѣ: Бꙋ́ди и҆́мѧ Гдⷭ҇не: И҆ мета́нїа г҃. Бл҃гословлю̀ Гдⷭ҇а на всѧ́кое вре́мѧ: И҆ подае́тся на́мъ а҆нтї́дѡръ: И҆ соверше́нный ѿпꙋ́стъ. Сїѐ послѣ́дованїе быва́етъ во всю̀ м҃-цꙋ, Преждесщ҃е́ннѣй сꙋ́щей.
items.english_text: For the Lord gives wisdom, and from His face come knowledge and understanding; and He stores up salvation for the upright, and protects their course, that He may preserve the paths of ordinances, and He will guard the way of those who reverence Him. Then shalt thou understand righteousness and judgment, and shalt direct all good paths; for if wisdom enters into thy mind, and knowledge seems good unto thy soul, good counsel shall preserve thee, and holy understanding shall guard thee: that it may deliver thee from the evil way, and from the man who speaks nothing faithful. O you who have forsaken the upright paths to walk in the ways of darkness! O you who delight in evils, and rejoice in wicked perversity! Whose paths are crooked, and their courses winding: to make thee far from the upright path, and an alien from righteous understanding. My son, let not evil counsel overtake thee, which forsakes the instruction of youth, and has forgotten the divine covenant; for it has set its house near death, and its paths near Hades with the earthborn. And all who walk in it shall not return, neither shall they overtake the paths of the upright; for they shall not attain unto the years of life. For had they walked in good paths, they would have found smooth upright paths; the good shall be dwellers upon the earth, and the innocent shall remain upon it. For the upright shall dwell upon the earth, and the holy shall remain upon it; but the paths of the ungodly shall perish from the earth, and the lawless shall be cast out from it.

Вѣ́стно же бꙋ́ди, ꙗ҆́кѡ є҆гда̀ бж҃твенныѧ прено́сѧтсѧ Та̑йны, всѝ лю́дїе поклоне́нїе бг҃оподо́бное, и҆ пѣ́вцы зрѝ ни́цъ па́дше, Хрⷭ҇тꙋ̀ Бг҃ꙋ въ Та́йнахъ Сꙋ́щемꙋ, твора́тъ: поне́же соверше́ннѡ прѣѡсщ҃е́нны сꙋ́ть. Кїнонї́къ: Вкꙋси́те и҆ ви́дите, ꙗ҆́кѡ бл҃гъ Гдⷭ҇ь. А҆ллилꙋ́їа, три́жды. Дїа́конъ: Пристꙋпи́те. Мы́ же покло́нъ є҆ди́нъ: И҆ пое́мъ, Бл҃гословлю̀ Гдⷭ҇а на всѧ́кое вре́мѧ, хвала̀ є҆гѡ̀ во оу҆стнѣ́хъ мои́хъ: А҆ллилꙋ́їа, три́жды. По возглаше́нїи же ѿ Їере́ѧ, Всегда̀, ны́нѣ и҆ при́снѡ: Ли́къ: Бл҃годари́мъ тѧ̀ Хрⷭ҇тѐ Бж҃е на́шъ: А҆ллилꙋ́їа, три́жды. По заамво́нной же моли́твѣ: Бꙋ́ди и҆́мѧ Гдⷭ҇не: И҆ мета́нїа г҃. Бл҃гословлю̀ Гдⷭ҇а на всѧ́кое вре́мѧ: И҆ подае́тся на́мъ а҆нтї́дѡръ: И҆ соверше́нный ѿпꙋ́стъ. Сїѐ послѣ́дованїе быва́етъ во всю̀ м҃-цꙋ, Преждесщ҃е́ннѣй сꙋ́щей.

items.slavonic_text: Среда̀ а҃ седми́цы А҆ и҆́деже нѣ́сть Преждесщ҃е́нныхъ, пое́тся на вече́рни стїхи̑ры на ѕ҃: подо́бенъ: въ Трїѡ́ди, и҆ въ Мине́и. Сла́ва, и҆ ны́нѣ, Бг҃оро́диченъ, по гла́сꙋ Мине́и. На стїхо́внѣ, въ Трїѡ́ди самогла́сенъ днѐ два́жды: и҆ Мч҃ниченъ, и҆́же є҆́сть на Гдⷭ҇и воззва́хъ: Сла́ва, и҆ ны́нѣ, Бг҃оро́диченъ, тогѡ́же гла́са. И҆ ѻ҆бы́чное конча́нїе. Входѧ́ще же въ трапе́зꙋ, ꙗ҆ди́мъ сꙋхоѧде́нїе, пїе́мъ и҆ со́къ съ ме́домъ. Въ четверто́къ же тоѧ̀ седми́цы трапе́зы не преставля́емъ, но быва́емъ постѧ́щеся да́же до пятка̀: тогда́ бо ꙗ҆ди́мъ входѧ́ще въ трапе́зꙋ. Въ сре́дꙋ пе́рвыѧ седми́цы ст҃а́гѡ вели́кагѡ поста̀ на повече́рїи. Нача́ло ꙗ҆́коже въ мимоше́дшихъ дне́хъ, и҆ пое́мъ настоя́щїй вели́кїй Канѡ́нъ преподо́бнагѡ Ѻ҆ц҃а̀ на́шегѡ А҆ндре́а Кри́тскагѡ, І҆ерⷭ҇ли́мскагѡ. Твори́мъ же на ко́емждо тропарѣ̀ мета́нїа г҃, гл҃юще и҆ стї́хъ: Поми́лꙋй мѧ̀ Бж҃е, поми́лꙋй мѧ̀. Пѣ́снь а҃. Гла́съ ѕ҃. І҆рмо́съ по два́жды. Помо́щникъ и҆ покрови́тель: Ѿ ю҆́ности Хрⷭ҇тѐ, за́пѡвѣди твоѧ̑ престꙋпи́хъ, всестра́стнѡ небрегі́й, оу҆ны́нїемъ преидо́хъ житїѐ, тѣ́мже зовꙋ́ти Сп҃се: понѐ на коне́цъ спаси́ мѧ. Пове́ржена мѧ̀ Сп҃се, пред̾ враты̑ твои́ми, понѐ на ста́рость не ѿри́ни менѐ ко а҆́дꙋ тща̀, но пре́жде конца̀, ꙗ҆́кѡ Человѣколю́бецъ, да́ждь мѝ прегрѣше́нїй ѡ҆ставле́нїе. Бога́тство моѐ Сп҃се, и҆знꙋри́хъ въ блꙋдѣ̀, пꙋ́стъ є҆́смь плодо́въ бл҃гочести́выхъ, а҆́лченъ же зовꙋ̀: Ѻ҆́ч҃е щедро́тъ, предвари́въ ты́ мѧ оу҆ще́дри. Въ разбо́йники впады́й а҆́зъ є҆́смь, помышле́ньми мои́ми, ве́сь ѿ ни́хъ оу҆язви́хся ны́нѣ, и҆ и҆спо́лнися ра́нъ: но са́мъ мѝ предста́въ, Хрⷭ҇тѐ Сп҃се и҆сцѣлѝ. Сщ҃е́нникъ мѧ̀ предви́дѣвъ ми́мѡ и҆́де, и҆ леѵї́тъ ви́дѧ въ лю́тыхъ на́га пре́зрѣ: но и҆з̾ Мр҃і́и возсїя́вый І҆и҃се, ты̀ предста́въ оу҆ще́дри мѧ̀. Преподо́бныѧ: Ты́ ми да́ждь свѣтоза́рнꙋю бл҃года́ть ѿ бж҃е́ственнагѡ свы́ше промышле́нїѧ и҆збѣжа́ти страсте́й ѡ҆мраче́нїа, и҆ пѣ́ти оу҆се́рднѡ твоегѡ̀, Мр҃і́е, житїѧ̀ кра̑снаѧ и҆справле́нїа. Сла́ва, Трⷪ҇ченъ: Преевꙋ́щнаѧ Тро́йце, во Е҆ди́ницѣ покланѧ́емаѧ, возмѝ бре́мѧ ѿ менѐ тѧ́жкое грѣхо́вное, и҆ ꙗ҆́кѡ бл҃гоꙋтро́бна да́ждь мѝ сле́зы оу҆миле́нїѧ. И҆ ны́нѣ, Бг҃оро́диченъ: Бц҃е, наде́жде и҆ предста́тельство тебѐ пою́щихъ, возмѝ бре́мѧ ѿ менѐ тѧ́жкое грѣхо́вное, и҆ ꙗ҆́кѡ Влⷣчца чⷭ҇таѧ, ка́ющася прїими́ мѧ.

На стїхо́внѣ, въ Трїѡ́ди самогла́сенъ днѐ два́жды: и҆ Мч҃ниченъ, и҆́же є҆́сть на Гдⷭ҇и воззва́хъ: Сла́ва, и҆ ны́нѣ, Бг҃оро́диченъ, тогѡ́же гла́са. И҆ ѻ҆бы́чное конча́нїе. Входѧ́ще же въ трапе́зꙋ, ꙗ҆ди́мъ сꙋхоѧде́нїе, пїе́мъ и҆ со́къ съ ме́домъ. Въ четверто́къ же тоѧ̀ седми́цы трапе́зы не преставля́емъ, но быва́емъ постѧ́щеся да́же до пятка̀: тогда́ бо ꙗ҆ди́мъ входѧ́ще въ трапе́зꙋ. Въ сре́дꙋ пе́рвыѧ седми́цы ст҃а́гѡ вели́кагѡ поста̀ на повече́рїи. Нача́ло ꙗ҆́коже въ мимоше́дшихъ дне́хъ, и҆ пое́мъ настоя́щїй вели́кїй Канѡ́нъ преподо́бнагѡ Ѻ҆ц҃а̀ на́шегѡ А҆ндре́а Кри́тскагѡ, І҆ерⷭ҇ли́мскагѡ. Твори́мъ же на ко́емждо тропарѣ̀ мета́нїа г҃, гл҃юще и҆ стї́хъ: Поми́лꙋй мѧ̀ Бж҃е, поми́лꙋй мѧ̀. Пѣ́снь а҃. Гла́съ ѕ҃. І҆рмо́съ по два́жды. Помо́щникъ и҆ покрови́тель: Ѿ ю҆́ности Хрⷭ҇тѐ, за́пѡвѣди твоѧ̑ престꙋпи́хъ, всестра́стнѡ небрегі́й, оу҆ны́нїемъ преидо́хъ житїѐ, тѣ́мже зовꙋ́ти Сп҃се: понѐ на коне́цъ спаси́ мѧ. Пове́ржена мѧ̀ Сп҃се, пред̾ враты̑ твои́ми, понѐ на ста́рость не ѿри́ни менѐ ко а҆́дꙋ тща̀, но пре́жде конца̀, ꙗ҆́кѡ Человѣколю́бецъ, да́ждь мѝ прегрѣше́нїй ѡ҆ставле́нїе. Бога́тство моѐ Сп҃се, и҆знꙋри́хъ въ блꙋдѣ̀, пꙋ́стъ є҆́смь плодо́въ бл҃гочести́выхъ, а҆́лченъ же зовꙋ̀: Ѻ҆́ч҃е щедро́тъ, предвари́въ ты́ мѧ оу҆ще́дри. Въ разбо́йники впады́й а҆́зъ є҆́смь, помышле́ньми мои́ми, ве́сь ѿ ни́хъ оу҆язви́хся ны́нѣ, и҆ и҆спо́лнися ра́нъ: но са́мъ мѝ предста́въ, Хрⷭ҇тѐ Сп҃се и҆сцѣлѝ. Сщ҃е́нникъ мѧ̀ предви́дѣвъ ми́мѡ и҆́де, и҆ леѵї́тъ ви́дѧ въ лю́тыхъ на́га пре́зрѣ: но и҆з̾ Мр҃і́и возсїя́вый І҆и҃се, ты̀ предста́въ оу҆ще́дри мѧ̀. Преподо́бныѧ: Ты́ ми да́ждь свѣтоза́рнꙋю бл҃года́ть ѿ бж҃е́ственнагѡ свы́ше промышле́нїѧ и҆збѣжа́ти страсте́й ѡ҆мраче́нїа, и҆ пѣ́ти оу҆се́рднѡ твоегѡ̀, Мр҃і́е, житїѧ̀ кра̑снаѧ и҆справле́нїа. Сла́ва, Трⷪ҇ченъ: Преевꙋ́щнаѧ Тро́йце, во Е҆ди́ницѣ покланѧ́емаѧ, возмѝ бре́мѧ ѿ менѐ тѧ́жкое грѣхо́вное, и҆ ꙗ҆́кѡ бл҃гоꙋтро́бна да́ждь мѝ сле́зы оу҆миле́нїѧ. И҆ ны́нѣ, Бг҃оро́диченъ: Бц҃е, наде́жде и҆ предста́тельство тебѐ пою́щихъ, возмѝ бре́мѧ ѿ менѐ тѧ́жкое грѣхо́вное, и҆ ꙗ҆́кѡ Влⷣчца чⷭ҇таѧ, ка́ющася прїими́ мѧ.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* I am he who fell among thieves in my thoughts; all of me has now been wounded by them, and is filled with sores; but do Thou Thyself, standing by, O Christ Savior, heal me!

Въ разбо́йники впады́й а҆́зъ є҆́смь, помышле́ньми мои́ми, ве́сь ѿ ни́хъ оу҆язви́хся ны́нѣ, и҆ и҆спо́лнися ра́нъ: но са́мъ мѝ предста́въ, Хрⷭ҇тѐ Сп҃се и҆сцѣлѝ. Сщ҃е́нникъ мѧ̀ предви́дѣвъ ми́мѡ и҆́де, и҆ леѵї́тъ ви́дѧ въ лю́тыхъ на́га пре́зрѣ: но и҆з̾ Мр҃і́и возсїя́вый І҆и҃се, ты̀ предста́въ оу҆ще́дри мѧ̀. Преподо́бныѧ: Ты́ ми да́ждь свѣтоза́рнꙋю бл҃года́ть ѿ бж҃е́ственнагѡ свы́ше промышле́нїѧ и҆збѣжа́ти страсте́й ѡ҆мраче́нїа, и҆ пѣ́ти оу҆се́рднѡ твоегѡ̀, Мр҃і́е, житїѧ̀ кра̑снаѧ и҆справле́нїа. Сла́ва, Трⷪ҇ченъ: Преевꙋ́щнаѧ Тро́йце, во Е҆ди́ницѣ покланѧ́емаѧ, возмѝ бре́мѧ ѿ менѐ тѧ́жкое грѣхо́вное, и҆ ꙗ҆́кѡ бл҃гоꙋтро́бна да́ждь мѝ сле́зы оу҆миле́нїѧ. И҆ ны́нѣ, Бг҃оро́диченъ: Бц҃е, наде́жде и҆ предста́тельство тебѐ пою́щихъ, возмѝ бре́мѧ ѿ менѐ тѧ́жкое грѣхо́вное, и҆ ꙗ҆́кѡ Влⷣчца чⷭ҇таѧ, ка́ющася прїими́ мѧ.
items.english_text: O Trinity above all essence, worshipped in Unity: take from me the heavy burden of sin, and as Thou art compassionate, give me tears of compunction!

provenance.verbatim_source: O Trinity above all essence, worshipped in Unity: take from me the heavy burden of sin, and as Thou art compassionate, give me tears of compunction!

items.slavonic_text: Среда̀ а҃ седми́цы А҆ и҆́деже нѣ́сть Преждесщ҃е́нныхъ, пое́тся на вече́рни стїхи̑ры на ѕ҃: подо́бенъ: въ Трїѡ́ди, и҆ въ Мине́и. Сла́ва, и҆ ны́нѣ, Бг҃оро́диченъ, по гла́сꙋ Мине́и. Входѧ́ще же въ трапе́зꙋ, ꙗ҆ди́мъ сꙋхоѧде́нїе, пїе́мъ и҆ со́къ съ ме́домъ. Въ четверто́къ же тоѧ̀ седми́цы трапе́зы не преставля́емъ, но быва́емъ постѧ́щеся да́же до пятка̀: тогда́ бо ꙗ҆ди́мъ входѧ́ще въ трапе́зꙋ. Нача́ло ꙗ҆́коже въ мимоше́дшихъ дне́хъ, и҆ пое́мъ настоя́щїй вели́кїй Канѡ́нъ преподо́бнагѡ Ѻ҆ц҃а̀ на́шегѡ А҆ндре́а Кри́тскагѡ, І҆ерⷭ҇ли́мскагѡ. Твори́мъ же на ко́емждо тропарѣ̀ мета́нїа г҃, гл҃юще и҆ стї́хъ: Поми́лꙋй мѧ̀ Бж҃е, поми́лꙋй мѧ̀. Пѣ́снь а҃. Гла́съ ѕ҃. І҆рмо́съ по два́жды. Помо́щникъ и҆ покрови́тель: Ѿ ю҆́ности Хрⷭ҇тѐ, за́пѡвѣди твоѧ̑ престꙋпи́хъ, всестра́стнѡ небрегі́й, оу҆ны́нїемъ преидо́хъ житїѐ, тѣ́мже зовꙋ́ти Сп҃се: понѐ на коне́цъ спаси́ мѧ. Сщ҃е́нникъ мѧ̀ предви́дѣвъ ми́мѡ и҆́де, и҆ леѵї́тъ ви́дѧ въ лю́тыхъ на́га пре́зрѣ: но и҆з̾ Мр҃і́и возсїя́вый І҆и҃се, ты̀ предста́въ оу҆ще́дри мѧ̀. items.english_text: O Mother of God, the hope and protection of those who hymn thee: take from me the heavy burden of sin, and as pure Sovereign Lady, receive me in repentance!

provenance.verbatim_source: O Mother of God, the hope and protection of those who hymn thee: take from me the heavy burden of sin, and as pure Sovereign Lady, receive me in repentance!

items.office: Wednesday of the First Week of the Holy and Great Fast at Great Compline
items.season_or_tone: FIRST WEEK OF THE GREAT FAST
items.day_or_date: Wednesday of the First Week of the Holy and Great Fast at Great Compline
items.slavonic_text: Пѣ́снь в҃. І҆рмо́съ: Вонмѝ нб҃о, и҆ возглаго́лю, * и҆ воспою̀ Хрⷭ҇та̀, ѿ Дв҃ы пло́тїю прише́дшаго.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* *Ode 2, Tone 6. Heirmos: "Give ear, O heaven, and I will speak":*[^324] I have slipped away, as David, in wantonness, and have been defiled; but wash me also, O Savior, with tears.

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Ode 2, Tone 6. Heirmos: "Give ear, O heaven, and I will speak":*[^324]
*Troparion:*
I have slipped away, as David, in wantonness, and have been defiled; but wash me also, O Savior, with tears.

items.office: Wednesday of the First Week of the Holy and Great Fast at Great Compline
items.season_or_tone: FIRST WEEK OF THE GREAT FAST
items.day_or_date: Wednesday of the First Week of the Holy and Great Fast at Great Compline
items.slavonic_text: Ни сле́зъ, нижѐ покаѧ́нїѧ и҆́мамъ, нижѐ ᲂу҆миле́нїѧ: * са́мъ мѝ сїа̑ Сп҃се, ꙗ҆́кѡ Бг҃ъ да́рꙋй.
items.english_text: Neither tears nor repentance have I, nor compunction; do Thou Thyself, O Savior, as God, grant these unto me.

provenance.verbatim_source: Neither tears nor repentance have I, nor compunction; do Thou Thyself, O Savior, as God, grant these unto me.

items.office: Wednesday of the First Week of the Holy and Great Fast at Great Compline
items.season_or_tone: FIRST WEEK OF THE GREAT FAST
items.day_or_date: Wednesday of the First Week of the Holy and Great Fast at Great Compline
items.slavonic_text: Две́рь твою̀ не затвори́ мнѣ̀ тогда̀, Гдⷭ҇и, Гдⷭ҇и: * но ѿве́рзи мѝ сїю̀ ка́ющемꙋсѧ тебѣ̀.
items.english_text: I have lost my first-created beauty and my comeliness, and now I lie naked and ashamed.

provenance.verbatim_source: I have lost my first-created beauty and my comeliness, and now I lie naked and ashamed.

items.office: Wednesday of the First Week of the Holy and Great Fast at Great Compline
items.season_or_tone: FIRST WEEK OF THE GREAT FAST
items.day_or_date: Wednesday of the First Week of the Holy and Great Fast at Great Compline
items.slavonic_text: Человѣколю́бче хотя́й всѣ̑мъ спасти́сѧ, * ты̀ воззови́ мѧ, и҆ прїимѝ ꙗ҆́кѡ бл҃гъ ка́ющагосѧ.
items.english_text: Shut not Thy door against me then, O Lord, O Lord; but open it unto me as I repent before Thee.

provenance.verbatim_source: Shut not Thy door against me then, O Lord, O Lord; but open it unto me as I repent before Thee.

items.office: Wednesday of the First Week of the Holy and Great Fast at Great Compline
items.season_or_tone: FIRST WEEK OF THE GREAT FAST
items.day_or_date: Wednesday of the First Week of the Holy and Great Fast at Great Compline
items.slavonic_text: І҆рмо́съ: Ви́дите ви́дите, ꙗ҆́кѡ а҆́зъ є҆́смь Бг҃ъ, * ма́ннꙋ ѡ҆дожди́вый, и҆ во́дꙋ и҆зъ ка́мене и҆сточи́вый дре́вле въ пꙋсты́ни лю́демъ мои̑мъ, * десни́цею є҆ди́ною, и҆ крѣ́постїю мое́ю.
items.english_text: Give ear unto the sighing of my soul, and receive the drops of mine eyes, O Savior, and save me!

provenance.verbatim_source: Give ear unto the sighing of my soul, and receive the drops of mine eyes, O Savior, and save me!

items.office: Wednesday of the First Week of the Holy and Great Fast at Great Compline
items.season_or_tone: FIRST WEEK OF THE GREAT FAST
items.day_or_date: Wednesday of the First Week of the Holy and Great Fast at Great Compline
items.slavonic_text: Комꙋ̀ ᲂу҆подо́биласѧ є҆сѝ многогрѣ́шнаѧ дꙋшѐ; * то́кмѡ пе́рвомꙋ Каі́нꙋ, и҆ Ламе́хꙋ ѻ҆́номꙋ, * каменокꙋ́шнаѧ тѣ́ло ѕлодѣ́йствы, и҆ ᲂу҆би́вшаѧ ᲂу҆́мъ безслове́сными стремле́ньми.
items.english_text: O Lover of mankind, Who desirest that all be saved, do Thou recall me, and receive me as good, who repent.

provenance.verbatim_source: O Lover of mankind, Who desirest that all be saved, do Thou recall me, and receive me as good, who repent.

items.office: Wednesday of the First Week of the Holy and Great Fast at Great Compline
items.season_or_tone: FIRST WEEK OF THE GREAT FAST
items.day_or_date: Wednesday of the First Week of the Holy and Great Fast at Great Compline
items.slavonic_text: Всѧ̑ пре́жде зако́на прете́кши, ѽ дꙋшѐ! * Си́ѳꙋ не ᲂу҆подо́биласѧ є҆сѝ, ни Е҆нѡ́са подража́ла є҆сѝ, * ни Е҆нѡ́ха преложе́нїемъ, ни Нѡ́ѧ: * но ꙗ҆ви́ласѧ є҆сѝ ᲂу҆бо́га пра́ведныхъ жи́зни.
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* O Most Pure Virgin Theotokos, alone all-hymned, pray fervently that we may be saved.

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Theotokion:*
O Most Pure Virgin Theotokos, alone all-hymned, pray fervently that we may be saved.

items.office: Wednesday of the First Week of the Holy and Great Fast at Great Compline
items.season_or_tone: FIRST WEEK OF THE GREAT FAST
items.day_or_date: Wednesday of the First Week of the Holy and Great Fast at Great Compline
items.slavonic_text: Преподо́бныѧ: Всѣ́мъ ᲂу҆се́рдїемъ, и҆ любо́вїю притекла̀ є҆сѝ Хрⷭ҇тꙋ̀, * пе́рвый грѣха̀ пꙋ́ть ѿвра́щши, * и҆ въ пꙋсты́нѧхъ непроходи́мыхъ пита́ющисѧ, * и҆ тогѡ̀ чи́стѣ соверша́ющи бж҃е́ственныѧ за́пѡвѣди.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* "See, see, that I am God": give ear, O my soul, unto the Lord crying aloud, and depart from thy former sin, and fear Him as incorruptible, and as Judge and God.

provenance.verbatim_source:

"See, see, that I am God": give ear, O my soul, unto the Lord crying aloud, and depart from thy former sin, and fear Him as incorruptible, and as Judge and God.

items.office: Wednesday of the First Week of the Holy and Great Fast at Great Compline
items.season_or_tone: FIRST WEEK OF THE GREAT FAST
items.day_or_date: Wednesday of the First Week of the Holy and Great Fast at Great Compline
items.slavonic_text: И҆ ны́нѣ: Бг҃оро́диченъ. Пречⷭ҇таѧ Влⷣчце, Бг҃ороди́тельнице, * наде́ждо къ тебѣ̀ притека́ющихъ, и҆ приста́нище сꙋ́щихъ въ бꙋ́ри, * млⷭ҇тиваго и҆ Созда́телѧ и҆ Сн҃а твоегѡ̀ * ᲂу҆ми́лостиви и҆ мнѣ̀ мл҃твами твои́ми.
items.english_text: Unto whom hast thou become like, O most sinful soul? Only unto the first Cain, and unto that Lamech, having stoned the body with evil deeds, and slain the mind by irrational strivings.

provenance.verbatim_source: Unto whom hast thou become like, O most sinful soul? Only unto the first Cain, and unto that Lamech, having stoned the body with evil deeds, and slain the mind by irrational strivings.

items.office: Wednesday of the First Week of the Holy and Great Fast at Great Compline
items.season_or_tone: FIRST WEEK OF THE GREAT FAST
items.day_or_date: Wednesday of the First Week of the Holy and Great Fast at Great Compline
items.slavonic_text: Пѣ́снь г҃. І҆рмо́съ: Оу҆твердѝ Гдⷭ҇и на ка́мени: Бл҃гослове́нїѧ Си́мова не наслѣ́довала є҆сѝ дꙋшѐ ѻ҆каѧ́ннаѧ: * ни простра́нное ᲂу҆держа́нїе ꙗ҆́коже І҆а́феѳъ, ꙗ҆ви́ласѧ є҆сѝ на землѝ ѡ҆ставле́нїе.
items.english_text: Having outrun all who lived before the Law, O soul! Unto Seth thou hast not become like, nor hast thou imitated Enos, nor Enoch by translation, nor Noah; but thou hast shown thyself destitute of the life of the righteous.

provenance.verbatim_source: Having outrun all who lived before the Law, O soul! Unto Seth thou hast not become like, nor hast thou imitated Enos, nor Enoch by translation, nor Noah; but thou hast shown thyself destitute of the life of the righteous.

items.english_text: Thou alone hast opened the sluices of the wrath of thy God, O my soul, and hast drowned all thy flesh, as the earth, and thy deeds and life, and hast remained outside the ark of salvation.

items.slavonic_text: Пѣ́снь г҃. І҆рмо́съ: Оу҆твердѝ Гдⷭ҇и на ка́мени: Бл҃гослове́нїѧ Си́мова не наслѣ́довала є҆сѝ дꙋшѐ ѻ҆каѧ́ннаѧ: * ни простра́нное ᲂу҆держа́нїе ꙗ҆́коже І҆а́феѳъ, ꙗ҆ви́ласѧ є҆сѝ на землѝ ѡ҆ставле́нїе.
items.english_text: O Most Pure Sovereign Lady, Birthgiver of God, hope of those who run unto thee, and haven of those in tempest: make Thy merciful Son, the Creator, gracious unto me also by thy prayers.

provenance.verbatim_source: O Most Pure Sovereign Lady, Birthgiver of God, hope of those who run unto thee, and haven of those in tempest: make Thy merciful Son, the Creator, gracious unto me also by thy prayers.

items.slavonic_text: Пѣ́снь г҃. І҆рмо́съ: Оу҆твердѝ Гдⷭ҇и на ка́мени: Бл҃гослове́нїѧ Си́мова не наслѣ́довала є҆сѝ дꙋшѐ ѻ҆каѧ́ннаѧ: * ни простра́нное ᲂу҆держа́нїе ꙗ҆́коже І҆а́феѳъ, ꙗ҆ви́ласѧ є҆сѝ на землѝ ѡ҆ставле́нїе.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* *Ode 3, Tone 6. Heirmos: "Establish, O Lord, upon the rock":* Thou hast not inherited the blessing of Shem, O wretched soul, nor a spacious possession like Japhs; thou hast appeared on earth as an abandonment.

items.office: Wednesday of the First Week of the Holy and Great Fast at Great Compline
items.season_or_tone: FIRST WEEK OF THE GREAT FAST
items.day_or_date: Wednesday of the First Week of the Holy and Great Fast at Great Compline
items.slavonic_text: Ѡ҆ землѝ Харра́нъ, и҆зы́ди ѿ грѣха̀ дꙋшѐ моѧ̀, * грѧдѝ къ зе́млю точа́щꙋю присноживо́тное нетлѣ́нїе, * є҆́же А҆враа́мъ наслѣ́дствова.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* From the land of Haran, depart from sin, O my soul; come into the land pouring forth ever-living incorruption, which Abraham inherited.

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*

items.office: Wednesday of the First Week of the Holy and Great Fast at Great Compline
items.season_or_tone: FIRST WEEK OF THE GREAT FAST
items.day_or_date: Wednesday of the First Week of the Holy and Great Fast at Great Compline
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆ дꙋ́ба Мамврі́йскагѡ ᲂу҆чреди́въ патрїа́рхъ а҆́гг҃лы, * наслѣ́дствова по ста́рости ѡ҆бѣтова́нїѧ лови́твꙋ.
items.english_text: Thou hast heard of Abraham, O my soul, who of old left the land of his fathers and became a pilgrim; imitate his purpose.

provenance.verbatim_source: Thou hast heard of Abraham, O my soul, who of old left the land of his fathers and became a pilgrim; imitate his purpose.

items.office: Wednesday of the First Week of the Holy and Great Fast at Great Compline
items.season_or_tone: FIRST WEEK OF THE GREAT FAST
items.day_or_date: Wednesday of the First Week of the Holy and Great Fast at Great Compline
items.slavonic_text: І҆сма́ила слы́шала є҆сѝ, трезви́сѧ дꙋшѐ моѧ̀, * и҆згна́на ꙗ҆́кѡ раби́нино ѿрожде́нїе, * ви́ждь, да не ка́кѡ подо́бно что̀ постра́ждеши ласкосе́рдствꙋющи.
items.english_text: At the oak of Mamre the Patriarch entertained the Angels, and inherited in old age the prize of promise.

provenance.verbatim_source: At the oak of Mamre the Patriarch entertained the Angels, and inherited in old age the prize of promise.

items.office: Wednesday of the First Week of the Holy and Great Fast at Great Compline
items.season_or_tone: FIRST WEEK OF THE GREAT FAST
items.day_or_date: Wednesday of the First Week of the Holy and Great Fast at Great Compline
items.slavonic_text: Содержи́мь є҆́смь бꙋ́рею, и҆ треволне́нїемъ согрѣше́нїй, * но сама́ мѧ мт҃и ны́нѣ спасѝ, * и҆ къ приста́нищꙋ бж҃е́ственнагѡ покаѧ́нїѧ возведѝ.
items.english_text: Understanding Isaac, O my wretched soul, as a new sacrifice, mystically offered as a whole burnt-offering unto the Lord, imitate his purpose.

provenance.verbatim_source: Understanding Isaac, O my wretched soul, as a new sacrifice, mystically offered as a whole burnt-offering unto the Lord, imitate his purpose.

items.office: Wednesday of the First Week of the Holy and Great Fast at Great Compline
items.season_or_tone: FIRST WEEK OF THE GREAT FAST
items.day_or_date: Wednesday of the First Week of the Holy and Great Fast at Great Compline
items.slavonic_text: Ра́бское моле́нїе и҆ ны́нѣ преподо́бнаѧ прине́сши * ко бл҃гоꙋтро́бнѣй моли́твами твои́ми Бцⷣѣ, * ѿве́рзи мѝ бж҃твенныѧ вхо́ды.
items.english_text: Thou hast heard of Ishmael, be sober, O my soul, driven out as the offspring of a bondwoman; take heed, lest thou suffer anything similar through wanton indulgence.

provenance.verbatim_source: Thou hast heard of Ishmael, be sober, O my soul, driven out as the offspring of a bondwoman; take heed, lest thou suffer anything similar through wanton indulgence.

items.office: Wednesday of the First Week of the Holy and Great Fast at Great Compline
items.season_or_tone: FIRST WEEK OF THE GREAT FAST
items.day_or_date: Wednesday of the First Week of the Holy and Great Fast at Great Compline
items.slavonic_text: Сла́ва, Трⷪ҇ченъ:
items.english_text: *Refrain:* Venerable Mother Mary, pray unto God for us.

provenance.verbatim_source: *Refrain:* Venerable Mother Mary, pray unto God for us.

items.office: Wednesday of the First Week of the Holy and Great Fast at Great Compline
items.season_or_tone: FIRST WEEK OF THE GREAT FAST
items.day_or_date: Wednesday of the First Week of the Holy and Great Fast at Great Compline
items.slavonic_text: Тро́йце проста́ѧ, несозда́ннаѧ, безна́чальное Е҆стество̀, * въ Тро́йцѣ пѣва́емаѧ ѵ҆поста́сей, * спасѝ ны̀ вѣ́рою покланѧ́ющыѧсѧ держа́вѣ твое́й.
items.english_text: I am held fast by tempest and the surging billow of transgressions; but do thou thyself, O mother, save me now, and lead me unto the haven of divine repentance!

provenance.verbatim_source: I am held fast by tempest and the surging billow of transgressions; but do thou thyself, O mother, save me now, and lead me unto the haven of divine repentance!

items.office: Wednesday of the First Week of the Holy and Great Fast at Great Compline
items.season_or_tone: FIRST WEEK OF THE GREAT FAST
items.day_or_date: Wednesday of the First Week of the Holy and Great Fast at Great Compline
items.slavonic_text: Ѡ҆ Ѻ҆ц҃а̀ безлѣ́тна Сн҃а, * въ лѣ́то Бг҃ороди́тельнице неискꙋзомꙋ́жнѡ родила̀ є҆сѝ, * стра́нное чꙋ́до, пребы́вши Дв҃а дои́щи.
items.english_text: Having offered a servant's supplication also now, O venerable one, unto the compassionate Mother of God by thy prayers, open unto me the divine entrances!

provenance.verbatim_source: Having offered a servant's supplication also now, O venerable one, unto the compassionate Mother of God by thy prayers, open unto me the divine entrances!

items.office: Wednesday of the First Week of the Holy and Great Fast at Great Compline
items.season_or_tone: FIRST WEEK OF THE GREAT FAST
items.day_or_date: Wednesday of the First Week of the Holy and Great Fast at Great Compline
items.slavonic_text: Тѣ́ло ѡ҆скверни́сѧ, дꙋ́хъ ѡ҆кала́сѧ, весь и҆стрꙋпи́хсѧ: * но ꙗ҆́кѡ вра́чь Хрⷭ҇тѐ, ѻ҆боѧ̀ покаа́нїемъ мои́мъ ᲂу҆врачꙋ́й, * ѡ҆мы́й, ѡ҆чи́сти, покажѝ Сп҃се мо́й, па́че снѣ́га чистѣ́йша.
items.english_text: O simple, uncreated Trinity, unoriginate Nature, praised in a Trinity of Persons: save us who worship Thy dominion in faith!

provenance.verbatim_source: O simple, uncreated Trinity, unoriginate Nature, praised in a Trinity of Persons: save us who worship Thy dominion in faith!

items.office: Wednesday of the First Week of the Holy and Great Fast at Great Compline
items.season_or_tone: FIRST WEEK OF THE GREAT FAST
items.day_or_date: Wednesday of the First Week of the Holy and Great Fast at Great Compline
items.slavonic_text: Содѣ́лалъ є҆сѝ спасе́нїе посредѣ̀ землѝ Ще́дре, да спасе́мсѧ, * во́лею на дре́вѣ распѧ́лсѧ є҆сѝ, * Е҆де́мъ затворе́нный ѿве́рзесѧ, * гѡ́рнѧѧ и҆ до́льнѧѧ тва́рь, ꙗ҆зы́цы всѝ спасе́ни покланѧ́ютсѧ тебѣ̀.
items.english_text: The timeless Son of the Father, in time, O Birthgiver of God, without knowing man thou didst bear, a marvelous wonder, remaining a Virgin nursing a Child!

provenance.verbatim_source: The timeless Son of the Father, in time, O Birthgiver of God, without knowing man thou didst bear, a marvelous wonder, remaining a Virgin nursing a Child!

items.office: Wednesday of the First Week of the Holy and Great Fast at Great Compline
items.season_or_tone: FIRST WEEK OF THE GREAT FAST
items.day_or_date: Wednesday of the First Week of the Holy and Great Fast at Great Compline
items.slavonic_text: Да бꙋ́детъ мѝ кꙋпѣ́ль, кро́вь и҆зъ ре́бръ твои́хъ, * вкꙋ́пѣ и҆ питїѐ, и҆сточи́вшее во́дꙋ ѡ҆ставле́нїѧ, * да ѻ҆боюдꙋ̀ ѡ҆чища́юсѧ, помазꙋ́ѧсѧ и҆ пїѧ̀: * ꙗ҆́кѡ помаза́нїе и҆ питїѐ Сло́ве, живото́чнаѧ твоѧ̑ словеса̀.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* *Ode 4, Tone 6. Heirmos: "The prophet heard":*[^325] My body is defiled, my spirit is soiled, I am all wounded; but as Physician, O Christ, heal both by my repentance; wash me, cleanse me, show me, O my Savior, purer than snow!

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Ode 4, Tone 6. Heirmos: "The prophet heard":*[^325]
*Troparion:*
My body is defiled, my spirit is soiled, I am all wounded; but as Physician, O Christ, heal both by my repentance; wash me, cleanse me, show me, O my Savior, purer than snow!

items.office: Wednesday of the First Week of the Holy and Great Fast at Great Compline
items.season_or_tone: FIRST WEEK OF THE GREAT FAST
items.day_or_date: Wednesday of the First Week of the Holy and Great Fast at Great Compline
items.slavonic_text: На́гъ є҆́смь черто́га, на́гъ є҆́смь и҆ бра́ка, * кꙋ́пнѡ и҆ ве́чери, свѣти́льникъ ᲂу҆гасѐ, ꙗ҆́кѡ безєле́йный, * черто́гъ заключи́сѧ мнѣ̀ спѧ́щꙋ, ве́черѧ снѣде́сѧ, * а҆́зъ же по рꙋкꙋ̀ и҆ ногꙋ̀ свѧ́занъ, во́нъ низве́рженъ є҆́смь.
items.english_text: Thy Body and Thy Blood, when crucified for all, hast Thou laid down, O Word: Thy Body, that Thou mightest renew me; Thy Blood, that Thou mightest wash me; and Thy spirit hast Thou delivered up, that Thou mightest bring me, O Christ, unto Thy Father!

provenance.verbatim_source: Thy Body and Thy Blood, when crucified for all, hast Thou laid down, O Word: Thy Body, that Thou mightest renew me; Thy Blood, that Thou mightest wash me; and Thy spirit hast Thou delivered up, that Thou mightest bring me, O Christ, unto Thy Father!

items.office: Wednesday of the First Week of the Holy and Great Fast at Great Compline
items.season_or_tone: FIRST WEEK OF THE GREAT FAST
items.day_or_date: Wednesday of the First Week of the Holy and Great Fast at Great Compline
items.slavonic_text: На́гъ є҆́смь черто́га, на́гъ є҆́смь и҆ бра́ка, * кꙋ́пнѡ и҆ ве́чери, свѣти́льникъ ᲂу҆гасѐ, ꙗ҆́кѡ безєле́йный, * черто́гъ заключи́сѧ мнѣ̀ спѧ́щꙋ, ве́черѧ снѣде́сѧ, * а҆́зъ же по рꙋкꙋ̀ и҆ ногꙋ̀ свѧ́занъ, во́нъ низве́рженъ є҆́смь.
items.english_text: Thou hast wrought salvation in the midst of the earth, O Compassionate One, that we might be saved; willingly wast Thou crucified upon the Tree; Eden that was shut was opened; the creation above and below, all the nations being saved, worship Thee.

provenance.verbatim_source: Thou hast wrought salvation in the midst of the earth, O Compassionate One, that we might be saved; willingly wast Thou crucified upon the Tree; Eden that was shut was opened; the creation above and below, all the nations being saved, worship Thee.

items.office: Wednesday of the First Week of the Holy and Great Fast at Great Compline
items.season_or_tone: FIRST WEEK OF THE GREAT FAST
items.day_or_date: Wednesday of the First Week of the Holy and Great Fast at Great Compline
items.slavonic_text: На́гъ є҆́смь черто́га, на́гъ є҆́смь и҆ бра́ка, * кꙋ́пнѡ и҆ ве́чери, свѣти́льникъ ᲂу҆гасѐ, ꙗ҆́кѡ безєле́йный, * черто́гъ заключи́сѧ мнѣ̀ спѧ́щꙋ, ве́черѧ снѣде́сѧ, * а҆́зъ же по рꙋкꙋ̀ и҆ ногꙋ̀ свѧ́занъ, во́нъ низве́рженъ є҆́смь.
items.english_text: Let the Blood from Thy side be a font for me, together with the drink that poured forth the water of remission, that I may be cleansed by both, anointing myself and drinking, as anointing and drink, O Word, Thy life-flowing words!

provenance.verbatim_source: Let the Blood from Thy side be a font for me, together with the drink that poured forth the water of remission, that I may be cleansed by both, anointing myself and drinking, as anointing and drink, O Word, Thy life-flowing words!

items.office: Wednesday of the First Week of the Holy and Great Fast at Great Compline
items.season_or_tone: FIRST WEEK OF THE GREAT FAST
items.day_or_date: Wednesday of the First Week of the Holy and Great Fast at Great Compline
items.slavonic_text: На́гъ є҆́смь черто́га, на́гъ є҆́смь и҆ бра́ка, * кꙋ́пнѡ и҆ ве́чери, свѣти́льникъ ᲂу҆гасѐ, ꙗ҆́кѡ безєле́йный, * черто́гъ заключи́сѧ мнѣ̀ спѧ́щꙋ, ве́черѧ снѣде́сѧ, * а҆́зъ же по рꙋкꙋ̀ и҆ ногꙋ̀ свѧ́занъ, во́нъ низве́рженъ є҆́смь.
items.english_text: The Church has gained a chalice, Thy life-bearing side, from which it poured forth for us two streams of remission and knowledge, as a figure of the Old and New Covenants together, O our Savior!

provenance.verbatim_source: The Church has gained a chalice, Thy life-bearing side, from which it poured forth for us two streams of remission and knowledge, as a figure of the Old and New Covenants together, O our Savior!

items.office: Wednesday of the First Week of the Holy and Great Fast at Great Compline
items.season_or_tone: FIRST WEEK OF THE GREAT FAST
items.day_or_date: Wednesday of the First Week of the Holy and Great Fast at Great Compline
items.slavonic_text: На́гъ є҆́смь черто́га, на́гъ є҆́смь и҆ бра́ка, * кꙋ́пнѡ и҆ ве́чери, свѣти́льникъ ᲂу҆гасѐ, ꙗ҆́кѡ безєле́йный, * черто́гъ заключи́сѧ мнѣ̀ спѧ́щꙋ, ве́черѧ снѣде́сѧ, * а҆́зъ же по рꙋкꙋ̀ и҆ ногꙋ̀ свѧ́занъ, во́нъ низве́рженъ є҆́смь.
items.english_text: I am destitute of the bridal chamber, I am destitute of the marriage, and together of the supper; the lamp is quenched as having no oil; the bridal chamber is shut while I sleep, the supper is consumed; and I, bound hand and foot, am cast out!

provenance.verbatim_source: I am destitute of the bridal chamber, I am destitute of the marriage, and together of the supper; the lamp is quenched as having no oil; the bridal chamber is shut while I sleep, the supper is consumed; and I, bound hand and foot, am cast out!

items.office: Wednesday of the First Week of the Holy and Great Fast at Great Compline
items.season_or_tone: FIRST WEEK OF THE GREAT FAST
items.day_or_date: Wednesday of the First Week of the Holy and Great Fast at Great Compline
items.slavonic_text: И҆ ны́нѣ, Бг҃оро́диченъ: И҆ ражда́еши, и҆ дѣ́вствꙋеши, и҆ пребыва́еши ѻ҆боюдꙋ̀ є҆стество́мъ Дв҃а, * Рожде́йсѧ ѡ҆бновлѧ́етъ зако́ны є҆стества̀, ᲂу҆тро́ба же ражда́етъ неражда́ющаѧ. * Бг҃ъ и҆дѣ́же хо́щетъ, побѣжда́етсѧ є҆стества̀ чи́нъ, твори́тъ бо, є҆ли́ка хо́щетъ.
items.english_text: Indivisible in essence, unconfused in Persons, I theologize Thee, O Trinity, One Godhead, as consubstantial and co-enthroned; I cry aloud unto Thee the great hymn, thrice-chanted in the highest!

provenance.verbatim_source: Indivisible in essence, unconfused in Persons, I theologize Thee, O Trinity, One Godhead, as consubstantial and co-enthroned; I cry aloud unto Thee the great hymn, thrice-chanted in the highest!

items.office: Wednesday of the First Week of the Holy and Great Fast at Great Compline
items.season_or_tone: FIRST WEEK OF THE GREAT FAST
items.day_or_date: Wednesday of the First Week of the Holy and Great Fast at Great Compline
items.slavonic_text: ꙗ҆́кѡ тѧ́жкїй нра́вомъ, фараѡ́нꙋ го́рькомꙋ бы́хъ Влⷣко, * І҆аннѝ, и҆ І҆амврѝ, дꙋше́ю и҆ тѣ́ломъ, * и҆ погруже́нъ ᲂу҆мо́мъ: но помози́ ми.
items.english_text: Both thou bearest and remainest a virgin, and in both thou abidest a Virgin by nature; He that is born renews the laws of nature, and the womb that bore not brings forth. Where God wills, the order of nature is overcome; for He does whatever He pleases.

provenance.verbatim_source: Both thou bearest and remainest a virgin, and in both thou abidest a Virgin by nature; He that is born renews the laws of nature, and the womb that bore not brings forth. Where God wills, the order of nature is overcome; for He does whatever He pleases.

items.office: Wednesday of the First Week of the Holy and Great Fast at Great Compline
items.season_or_tone: FIRST WEEK OF THE GREAT FAST
items.day_or_date: Wednesday of the First Week of the Holy and Great Fast at Great Compline
items.slavonic_text: Ка́ломъ смѣси́хсѧ ѻ҆каѧ́нный ᲂу҆мо́мъ, * ѡ҆мы́й мѧ̀ Влⷣко, ба́нею мои́хъ сле́зъ, молю́ тѧ, * пло́ти моеѧ̀ ѻ҆де́ждꙋ ᲂу҆бѣли́въ ꙗ҆́кѡ снѣ́гъ.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* *Ode 5, Tone 6. Heirmos: "From night early morning":*[^326] Being heavy in disposition, I have become unto bitter Pharaoh, O Master, like Jannes and Jambres in soul and body, and submerged in mind; but help me!

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Ode 5, Tone 6. Heirmos: "From night early morning":*[^326]
*Troparion:*
Being heavy in disposition, I have become unto bitter Pharaoh, O Master, like Jannes and Jambres in soul and body, and submerged in mind; but help me!

items.office: Wednesday of the First Week of the Holy and Great Fast at Great Compline
items.season_or_tone: FIRST WEEK OF THE GREAT FAST
items.day_or_date: Wednesday of the First Week of the Holy and Great Fast at Great Compline
items.slavonic_text: Пощадѝ, пощадѝ Гдⷭ҇и, созда́нїе твоѐ, * согрѣши́хъ, ѡ҆сла́би мѝ, * ꙗ҆́кѡ є҆стество́мъ чи́стый са́мъ сы́й є҆ди́нъ, * и҆ и҆́нъ ра́звѣ тебѐ никто́же є҆́сть кромѣ̀ скве́рны.
items.english_text: I have been defiled with mire, wretched in mind; wash me, O Master, in the bath of my tears, I pray Thee, making the garment of my flesh white as snow!

provenance.verbatim_source: I have been defiled with mire, wretched in mind; wash me, O Master, in the bath of my tears, I pray Thee, making the garment of my flesh white as snow!

items.office: Wednesday of the First Week of the Holy and Great Fast at Great Compline
items.season_or_tone: FIRST WEEK OF THE GREAT FAST
items.day_or_date: Wednesday of the First Week of the Holy and Great Fast at Great Compline
items.slavonic_text: Преподо́бныѧ: Стрꙋи̑ І҆ѻрда́нскїѧ преше́дши, ѡ҆брѣла̀ є҆сѝ поко́й безболѣ́зненный, * пло́ти сла́сти и҆збѣжа́вши, * є҆́яже и҆ на́съ и҆змѝ твои́ми мл҃твами Преподо́бнаѧ.
items.english_text: If I examine my deeds, O Savior, I see myself exceeding every man in sins; for with deliberate knowledge I have sinned, not in ignorance.

provenance.verbatim_source: If I examine my deeds, O Savior, I see myself exceeding every man in sins; for with deliberate knowledge I have sinned, not in ignorance.

items.slavonic_text: И҆ ны́нѣ: Бг҃оро́диченъ: И҆зъ тебѐ ѡ҆блече́сѧ въ моѐ смѣше́нїе, * нетлѣ́ннаѧ безмꙋ́жнаѧ Мт҃и Дв҃о, * Бг҃ъ созда́вый вѣ́ки, и҆ соединѝ себѣ̀ человѣ́ческое є҆стество̀.
items.english_text: Spare, spare, O Lord, Thy creation; I have sinned, remit unto me; for Thou alone art pure by nature, and none other besides Thee is without defilement.

provenance.verbatim_source: Spare, spare, O Lord, Thy creation; I have sinned, remit unto me; for Thou alone art pure by nature, and none other besides Thee is without defilement.

items.slavonic_text: Воста́ни и҆ покорѝ, ꙗ҆́кѡ І҆исꙋ́съ А҆мали́ка, плотскїѧ стра̑сти, * и҆ Гаваѡни́ты, ле̑стныѧ по́мыслы при́снѡ побѣжда́ющи.
items.english_text: For my sake, being God, Thou didst take form in me; Thou didst show forth miracles, healing lepers, and strengthening the paralytic; Thou didst stop the flow of the woman with an issue of blood, O Savior, by the touching of Thy hem.

items.slavonic_text: ꙗ҆́кѡ спа́слъ є҆сѝ Петра̀, возопи́вша спасѝ, * предвари́въ мѧ̀ Сп҃се ѿ ѕвѣ́ра и҆зба́ви, * просте́ръ твою̀ рꙋ́кꙋ, и҆ возведѝ и҆зъ глꙋбины̀ грѣхо́вныѧ.
items.english_text: *Refrain:* Venerable Mother Mary, pray unto God for us.

provenance.verbatim_source: *Refrain:* Venerable Mother Mary, pray unto God for us.

items.english_text: Having crossed the streams of the Jordan, thou didst find painless rest, having escaped the pleasures of the flesh; from which deliver us also by thy prayers, O venerable one!

provenance.verbatim_source: Having crossed the streams of the Jordan, thou didst find painless rest, having escaped the pleasures of the flesh; from which deliver us also by thy prayers, O venerable one!

items.slavonic_text: Приста́нище тѧ̀ всѣ́мъ ᲂу҆ти́шное, Влⷣко, Влⷣко Хрⷭ҇тѐ: * но ѿ незаходи́мыхъ глꙋби́нъ грѣха̀, и҆ ѿча́ѧнїѧ мѧ̀ предвари́въ и҆зба́ви.
items.english_text: As Thou didst save Peter when he cried out "Save me!", prevent me, O Savior, and deliver me from the beast, stretching out Thy hand, and lead me up from the depths of sin!

provenance.verbatim_source: As Thou didst save Peter when he cried out "Save me!", prevent me, O Savior, and deliver me from the beast, stretching out Thy hand, and lead me up from the depths of sin!

items.slavonic_text: Приста́нище тѧ̀ всѣ́мъ ᲂу҆ти́шное, Влⷣко, Влⷣко Хрⷭ҇тѐ: * но ѿ незаходи́мыхъ глꙋби́нъ грѣха̀, и҆ ѿча́ѧнїѧ мѧ̀ предвари́въ и҆зба́ви.
items.english_text: I know Thee as a tranquil haven unto all, O Master, Master Christ; but prevent me and deliver me from the impenetrable depths of sin and despair!

provenance.verbatim_source: I know Thee as a tranquil haven unto all, O Master, Master Christ; but prevent me and deliver me from the impenetrable depths of sin and despair!

items.season_or_tone: FIRST WEEK OF THE GREAT FAST
items.day_or_date: Wednesday of the First Week of the Holy and Great Fast at Great Compline
items.slavonic_text: И҆ ны́нѣ: Бг҃оро́диченъ: Оу҆тро́ба твоѧ̀ Бг҃а на́мъ родѝ, воѡбраже́на по на́мъ: * є҆го́же, ꙗ҆́кѡ Созда́телѧ всѣ́хъ, * молѝ Бцⷣе, да моли́твами твои́ми ѡ҆правди́мсѧ.
items.english_text: "I am the Trinity, simple, indivisible, divided in Persons, and I am the Unity united in nature," says the Father, and the Son, and the Divine Spirit.

provenance.verbatim_source: "I am the Trinity, simple, indivisible, divided in Persons, and I am the Unity united in nature," says the Father, and the Son, and the Divine Spirit.

items.office: Wednesday of the First Week of the Holy and Great Fast at Great Compline
items.season_or_tone: FIRST WEEK OF THE GREAT FAST
items.day_or_date: Wednesday of the First Week of the Holy and Great Fast at Great Compline
items.slavonic_text: Пѣ́снь з҃. І҆рмо́съ: Согрѣши́хомъ, беззако́нновахомъ:
items.english_text: Thy womb bore God for us, fashioned in our likeness; Him, as the Creator of all, do thou implore, O Mother of God, that by thy prayers we may be justified.

provenance.verbatim_source: Thy womb bore God for us, fashioned in our likeness; Him, as the Creator of all, do thou implore, O Mother of God, that by thy prayers we may be justified.

items.office: Wednesday of the First Week of the Holy and Great Fast at Great Compline
items.season_or_tone: FIRST WEEK OF THE GREAT FAST
items.day_or_date: Wednesday of the First Week of the Holy and Great Fast at Great Compline
items.slavonic_text: Манассі́ева собрала̀ є҆сѝ согрѣше́нїѧ и҆зволе́нїемъ, * поста́вльши ꙗ҆́кѡ ме́рзости стра̑сти, * и҆ ᲂу҆мно́живши дꙋшѐ негодова́нїе: * но тогѡ̀ покаѧ́нїю ревнꙋ́ющи те́плѣ, стѧжѝ ᲂу҆миле́нїе.
items.english_text: *Kontakion, Tone 6:* My soul, my soul, arise, why sleepest thou? The end draws near, and thou shalt be confounded; awake therefore, that Christ God may spare thee, Who is everywhere present and fills all things!

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Kontakion, Tone 6:*
My soul, my soul, arise, why sleepest thou? The end draws near, and thou shalt be confounded; awake therefore, that Christ God may spare thee, Who is everywhere present and fills all things!

items.season_or_tone: FIRST WEEK OF THE GREAT FAST

items.slavonic_text: А҆хаа́бовымъ поревнова́ла є҆сѝ скве́рнамъ, дꙋшѐ моѧ̀, ᲂу҆вы̀ мнѣ̀, * была̀ є҆сѝ плотски́хъ скве́рнъ пребыва́лище, * и҆ сосꙋ́дъ сра́мленъ страсте́й: * но и҆зъ глꙋбины̀ твоеѧ̀ воздохнѝ, и҆ глаго́ли Бг҃ꙋ грѣхѝ твоѧ̑.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* *Ode 7, Tone 6. Heirmos: "We have sinned, we have committed iniquity":*[^327] Thou hast gathered the sins of Manasseh by deliberate choice, setting up the passions as abominations, and increasing indignation, O soul; but emulating his repentance warmly, acquire compunction!

items.season_or_tone: FIRST WEEK OF THE GREAT FAST
items.day_or_date: Wednesday of the First Week of the Holy and Great Fast at Great Compline
items.slavonic_text: Попалѝ И҆лїа̀ и҆ногда̀ два́щи пѧтьдесѧ́тъ І҆езаве́линыхъ, * є҆гда̀ стꙋ́дныѧ проро́ки погꙋбѝ, во ѡ҆бличе́нїе А҆хаа́вово: * но бѣ́гай подража́нїѧ двою̀ дꙋшѐ, и҆ ᲂу҆крѣплѧ́йсѧ.
items.english_text: Thou hast rivalled the defilements of Ahab, O my soul, woe is me, thou hast been a dwelling-place of carnal abominations, and a shameful vessel of passions; but groan from thy depths, and confess thy sins unto God!

provenance.verbatim_source: Thou hast rivalled the defilements of Ahab, O my soul, woe is me, thou hast been a dwelling-place of carnal abominations, and a shameful vessel of passions; but groan from thy depths, and confess thy sins unto God!

items.office: Wednesday of the First Week of the Holy and Great Fast at Great Compline
items.season_or_tone: FIRST WEEK OF THE GREAT FAST
items.day_or_date: Wednesday of the First Week of the Holy and Great Fast at Great Compline
items.slavonic_text: И҆ ны́нѣ: Бг҃оро́диченъ: Пое́мъ тѧ̀, бл҃гослови́мъ тѧ̀, покланѧ́емсѧ тѝ Бг҃ороди́тельнице: * ꙗ҆́кѡ нераздѣ́льныѧ Тро́йцы, породи́ла є҆сѝ Е҆ди́наго Хрⷭ҇та̀ Бг҃а, * и҆ сама̀ ѿве́рзла є҆сѝ на́мъ сꙋ́щымъ на землѝ нбⷭ҇наѧ.
items.english_text: Heaven was shut against thee, O soul, and a famine from God overtook thee, when thou didst not submit unto the words of Elijah the Tishbite, even as Ahab of old; but become like the widow of Zarephath, feed the prophet's soul!

provenance.verbatim_source: Heaven was shut against thee, O soul, and a famine from God overtook thee, when thou didst not submit unto the words of Elijah the Tishbite, even as Ahab of old; but become like the widow of Zarephath, feed the prophet's soul!

items.office: Wednesday of the First Week of the Holy and Great Fast at Great Compline
items.season_or_tone: FIRST WEEK OF THE GREAT FAST
items.day_or_date: Wednesday of the First Week of the Holy and Great Fast at Great Compline
items.slavonic_text: Правосꙋ́де Сп҃се поми́лꙋй, * и҆ и҆зба́ви мѧ̀ ѻ҆гнѧ̀, и҆ преще́нїѧ, є҆́же и҆́мамъ на сꙋдѣ̀ пра́веднѡ претерпѣ́ти: * ѡ҆сла́би мѝ пре́жде конца̀, добродѣ́телїю и҆ покаѧ́нїемъ.
items.english_text: Elijah once burned twice fifty of Jezebel's men, when he destroyed the shameful prophets, unto the rebuke of Ahab; but flee imitation of both of them, O soul, and be strengthened!

provenance.verbatim_source: Elijah once burned twice fifty of Jezebel's men, when he destroyed the shameful prophets, unto the rebuke of Ahab; but flee imitation of both of them, O soul, and be strengthened!

items.office: Wednesday of the First Week of the Holy and Great Fast at Great Compline
items.season_or_tone: FIRST WEEK OF THE GREAT FAST
items.day_or_date: Wednesday of the First Week of the Holy and Great Fast at Great Compline
items.slavonic_text: Гное́нїе, Сп҃се, и҆сцѣлѝ смире́нныѧ моеѧ̀ дꙋшѝ: * Е҆ди́не врачꙋ̀, пла́стырь мнѣ̀ наложѝ, * и҆ є҆ле́й и҆ вїно̀, дѣла̀ покаѧ́нїѧ, ᲂу҆миле́нїе со слеза́ми.
items.english_text: O simple, undivided Trinity, consubstantial, and one Nature, Lights and Light, and three Holies; and the one Holy is praised as God the Trinity; but hymn, O soul, and glorify Life and Lives, the God of all!

provenance.verbatim_source: O simple, undivided Trinity, consubstantial, and one Nature, Lights and Light, and three Holies; and the one Holy is praised as God the Trinity; but hymn, O soul, and glorify Life and Lives, the God of all!

items.season_or_tone: FIRST WEEK OF THE GREAT FAST
items.day_or_date: Wednesday of the First Week of the Holy and Great Fast at Great Compline
items.slavonic_text: Сла́ва, Трⷪ҇ченъ: Безнача́льне Ѻ҆́ч҃е, Сн҃е собезнача́льный, * Оу҆тѣ́шителю бл҃гі́й, Дх҃е пра́вый: * Сло́ва Бж҃їѧ Роди́телю, Ѻ҆ц҃а̀ безнача́льна Сло́ве, * Дх҃е живы́й, и҆ зижда́й, Тро́йце Е҆ди́нице поми́лꙋй мѧ̀.
items.english_text: We hymn thee, we bless thee, we worship thee, O Birthgiver of God; for thou didst bear One of the undivided Trinity, Christ God, and thou thyself hast opened heavenly things unto us who dwell upon earth.

provenance.verbatim_source: We hymn thee, we bless thee, we worship thee, O Birthgiver of God; for thou didst bear One of the undivided Trinity, Christ God, and thou thyself hast opened heavenly things unto us who dwell upon earth.

items.slavonic_text: Сла́ва, Трⷪ҇ченъ: Безнача́льне Ѻ҆́ч҃е, Сн҃е собезнача́льный, * Оу҆тѣ́шителю бл҃гі́й, Дх҃е пра́вый: * Сло́ва Бж҃їѧ Роди́телю, Ѻ҆ц҃а̀ безнача́льна Сло́ве, * Дх҃е живы́й, и҆ зижда́й, Тро́йце Е҆ди́нице поми́лꙋй мѧ̀.
items.english_text: Unoriginate Father, co-unoriginate Son, good Comforter, upright Spirit: Begetter of the Word of God, Word of the unoriginate Father, living and creating Spirit: Trinity, Unity, have mercy on me!

provenance.verbatim_source: Unoriginate Father, co-unoriginate Son, good Comforter, upright Spirit: Begetter of the Word of God, Word of the unoriginate Father, living and creating Spirit: Trinity, Unity, have mercy on me!

items.season_or_tone: FIRST WEEK OF THE GREAT FAST

items.slavonic_text: Пѣ́снь ѳ҃. І҆рмо́съ: Безсѣ́меннагѡ зача́тїѧ:
items.english_text: As from the dipping of crimson dye, O Most Pure One, within thy womb was woven the spiritual purple robe of Emmanuel, His flesh; therefore as truly the Mother of God do we venerate thee.

provenance.verbatim_source: As from the dipping of crimson dye, O Most Pure One, within thy womb was woven the spiritual purple robe of Emmanuel, His flesh; therefore as truly the Mother of God do we venerate thee.

items.office: Wednesday of the First Week of the Holy and Great Fast at Great Compline
items.season_or_tone: FIRST WEEK OF THE GREAT FAST
items.day_or_date: Wednesday of the First Week of the Holy and Great Fast at Great Compline
items.slavonic_text: Недꙋ́ги и҆сцѣлѧ́ѧ, ни́щымъ бл҃говѣствова́ше, * Хрїсто́съ Сло́во, вре́дныѧ ᲂу҆врачева̀, * съ мытари̑ ꙗ҆дѧ́ше, со грѣ́шники бесѣ́доваше, * І҆аі́ровы дще́ре дꙋ́шꙋ предъᲂу҆ме́ршꙋю возвратѝ ѡ҆сѧза́нїемъ рꙋкѝ.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* *Ode 9, Tone 6. Heirmos: "Seedless conception":*[^328] Healing diseases, Christ the Word preached good tidings unto the poor; He cured the maimed, He ate with publicans, He conversed with sinners; the soul of the daughter of Jairus, which was dead beforehand, He brought back by the touch of His hand.

items.office: Wednesday of the First Week of the Holy and Great Fast at Great Compline
items.season_or_tone: FIRST WEEK OF THE GREAT FAST
items.day_or_date: Wednesday of the First Week of the Holy and Great Fast at Great Compline
items.slavonic_text: Закхе́й мыта́рь бѣ̀, но ѻ҆ба́че спаса́шесѧ, * и҆ фарісе́й Сі́мѡнъ соблажнѧ́шесѧ, * и҆ блꙋдни́ца прїима́ше ѡ҆стави́тєльнаѧ разрѣшє́нїа, * ѿ И҆мꙋ́щагѡ крѣ́пость ѡ҆ставля́ти грѣхѝ: * ю҆́же дꙋшѐ потщи́сѧ подража́ти.
items.english_text: The publican was saved, and the harlot was made chaste, but the Pharisee boasting was condemned: the one saying "Cleanse me!", the other "Have mercy on me!", but the last boasting cried: "God, I thank Thee!", and other foolish words.

provenance.verbatim_source: The publican was saved, and the harlot was made chaste, but the Pharisee boasting was condemned: the one saying "Cleanse me!", the other "Have mercy on me!", but the last boasting cried: "God, I thank Thee!", and other foolish words.

items.office: Wednesday of the First Week of the Holy and Great Fast at Great Compline
items.season_or_tone: FIRST WEEK OF THE GREAT FAST
items.day_or_date: Wednesday of the First Week of the Holy and Great Fast at Great Compline
items.slavonic_text: Гра́ды, и҆̀мже дадѐ Хрїсто́съ бл҃говѣ́стїе, дꙋшѐ моѧ̀ ᲂу҆вѣ́дала є҆сѝ, * ка́кѡ про́клѧти бы́ша, ᲂу҆бо́йсѧ ᲂу҆каза́нїѧ, * да не бꙋ́деши ꙗ҆́коже ѻ҆́ны, и҆́хже Содо́млѧнѡмъ Влⷣка ᲂу҆подо́бивъ, * да́же до а҆́да ѡ҆сꙋдѝ.
items.english_text: Zacchaeus was a publican, yet nevertheless he was saved; and Simon the Pharisee was offended, while the harlot received the absolving remission of sins from Him Who had power to forgive sins; whom, O soul, make haste to imitate!

provenance.verbatim_source: Zacchaeus was a publican, yet nevertheless he was saved; and Simon the Pharisee was offended, while the harlot received the absolving remission of sins from Him Who had power to forgive sins; whom, O soul, make haste to imitate!

items.office: Wednesday of the First Week of the Holy and Great Fast at Great Compline
items.season_or_tone: FIRST WEEK OF THE GREAT FAST
items.day_or_date: Wednesday of the First Week of the Holy and Great Fast at Great Compline
items.slavonic_text: Сла́ва, Трⷪ҇ченъ: Ѻ҆ц҃а̀ просла́вимъ, Сн҃а превознесе́мъ, * бж҃е́ственномꙋ Дх҃ꙋ вѣ́рнѡ поклони́мсѧ, * Тро́йцѣ нераздѣ́льнѣй, Е҆ди́ницѣ по сꙋществꙋ̀, * ꙗ҆́кѡ свѣ́тꙋ и҆ свѣ́тѡмъ, и҆ животꙋ̀ и҆ животѡ́мъ, * животворѧ́щемꙋ и҆ просвѣща́ющемꙋ концы̀.
items.english_text: Unto the harlot, O my wretched soul, thou hast not been zealous, who having taken the alabaster jar of myrrh, with tears anointed the feet of the Savior, and wiped them with her hair, of Him Who tore up the handwriting of her ancient transgressions.

provenance.verbatim_source: Unto the harlot, O my wretched soul, thou hast not been zealous, who having taken the alabaster jar of myrrh, with tears anointed the feet of the Savior, and wiped them with her hair, of Him Who tore up the handwriting of her ancient transgressions.

items.office: Wednesday of the First Week of the Holy and Great Fast at Great Compline
items.season_or_tone: FIRST WEEK OF THE GREAT FAST
items.day_or_date: Wednesday of the First Week of the Holy and Great Fast at Great Compline
items.slavonic_text: Преподо́бне Ѻ҆́ч҃е А҆ндре́е молѝ Бг҃а ѡ҆ на́съ. А҆ндре́е честны́й, и҆ Ѻ҆́ч҃е требл҃же́ннѣйшїй, па́стырю Кри́тскїй, * не преста́й молѧ́сѧ ѡ҆ воспѣва́ющихъ тѧ̀, * да и҆зба́вимсѧ всѝ гнѣ́ва, и҆ ско́рби, и҆ тлѣ́нїѧ, * и҆ прегрѣше́нїй безмѣ́рныхъ, чтꙋ́щїи твою̀ па́мѧть вѣ́рнѡ.
items.english_text: Thou hast learned, O my soul, how the cities unto which Christ gave the gospel were accursed; fear the warning, lest thou become as they, whom the Master compared unto the Sodomites and condemned even unto Hades!

provenance.verbatim_source: Thou hast learned, O my soul, how the cities unto which Christ gave the gospel were accursed; fear the warning, lest thou become as they, whom the Master compared unto the Sodomites and condemned even unto Hades!

items.office: Wednesday of the First Week of the Holy and Great Fast at Great Compline
items.season_or_tone: FIRST WEEK OF THE GREAT FAST
items.day_or_date: Wednesday of the First Week of the Holy and Great Fast at Great Compline
items.slavonic_text: Та́же пое́мъ ѻ҆́ба ли́ка: Безсѣ́меннагѡ зача́тїѧ: Подо́бнѣ и҆ про́чее послѣ́дованїе повече́рїа.
items.english_text: Lest thou appear worse through despair, O my soul, having heard of the faith of the Canaanite woman, whose daughter was healed by the word of God: "O Son of David, save me also!", cry aloud from the depth of thy heart, even as she unto Christ!

provenance.verbatim_source: Lest thou appear worse through despair, O my soul, having heard of the faith of the Canaanite woman, whose daughter was healed by the word of God: "O Son of David, save me also!", cry aloud from the depth of thy heart, even as she unto Christ!

items.office: Wednesday of the First Week of the Holy and Great Fast at Great Compline
items.season_or_tone: FIRST WEEK OF THE GREAT FAST
items.day_or_date: Wednesday of the First Week of the Holy and Great Fast at Great Compline
items.slavonic_text: Та́же пое́мъ ѻ҆́ба ли́ка: Безсѣ́меннагѡ зача́тїѧ: Подо́бнѣ и҆ про́чее послѣ́дованїе повече́рїа.
items.english_text: Let us glorify the Father, let us exalt the Son, let us faithfully worship the Divine Spirit: undivided Trinity, Unity according to essence, as Light and Lights, and Life and Lives, giving life and illuminating the ends of the earth!

provenance.verbatim_source: Let us glorify the Father, let us exalt the Son, let us faithfully worship the Divine Spirit: undivided Trinity, Unity according to essence, as Light and Lights, and Life and Lives, giving life and illuminating the ends of the earth!

items.office: Wednesday of the First Week of the Holy and Great Fast at Great Compline
items.season_or_tone: FIRST WEEK OF THE GREAT FAST
items.day_or_date: Wednesday of the First Week of the Holy and Great Fast at Great Compline
items.slavonic_text: Та́же пое́мъ ѻ҆́ба ли́ка: Безсѣ́меннагѡ зача́тїѧ: Подо́бнѣ и҆ про́чее послѣ́дованїе повече́рїа.
items.english_text: Preserve thy city, O Most Pure Birthgiver of God; for reigning faithfully in thee, in thee it is also established, and conquering through thee, it overcomes every temptation, and takes captive the warriors, and directs obedience.

provenance.verbatim_source: Preserve thy city, O Most Pure Birthgiver of God; for reigning faithfully in thee, in thee it is also established, and conquering through thee, it overcomes every temptation, and takes captive the warriors, and directs obedience.

items.english_text: Honorable Andrew, thrice-blessed Father, Pastor of Crete: cease not to pray for those who hymn thee, that we all may be delivered from wrath, and sorrow, and corruption, and measureless transgressions, who faithfully honor thy memory!

items.office: Thursday of the First Week of the Holy Fast at Matins
items.season_or_tone: FIRST WEEK OF THE GREAT FAST
items.day_or_date: Thursday of the First Week of the Holy Fast at Matins
items.slavonic_text: По в҃-мъ стїхосло́вїи сѣда́ленъ, гла́съ в҃. Подо́бенъ: Оу҆мꙋдри́вый па́че: Свѣти̑ла въ концѣ́хъ ᲂу҆ченикѝ показа́вый проповѣ́данїемъ, Сло́ве Бж҃їй, * сердца̀ на́ша просвѣтѝ свѣ́томъ добродѣ́телей, * и҆ посто́мъ ѡ҆чи́сти, даѧ̀ покаѧ́нїе ѡ҆браще́нїѧ рабѡ́мъ твои̑мъ, * во є҆́же сла́вити тѧ̀ Сп҃се, є҆ди́не сы́й пребл҃гі́й.
items.english_text: O Word of God, Who didst show forth the disciples as luminaries throughout the ends of the earth by their preaching: illuminate our hearts with the light of virtues, and cleanse them through fasting, granting the repentance of conversion unto Thy servants, that we may glorify Thee, O Savior, Who alone art all-good!

provenance.verbatim_source: O Word of God, Who didst show forth the disciples as luminaries throughout the ends of the earth by their preaching: illuminate our hearts with the light of virtues, and cleanse them through fasting, granting the repentance of conversion unto Thy servants, that we may glorify Thee, O Savior, Who alone art all-good!

items.office: Thursday of the First Week of the Holy Fast at Matins
items.season_or_tone: FIRST WEEK OF THE GREAT FAST
items.day_or_date: Thursday of the First Week of the Holy Fast at Matins
items.slavonic_text: По г҃-мъ стїхосло́вїи сѣда́ленъ, гла́съ є҃. Подо́бенъ: Свѣтлѣ́йшаѧ Херꙋві́мъ: Свѣтлѣ́йшее добродѣ́телей, сожи́тельницꙋ и҆́стиннꙋю воздержа́нїе, * мо́лимъ тѧ̀, а҆́пⷭ҇льскаѧ двоенадесѧ́тице, * моли́сѧ ми́рнѡ на́мъ соверши́ти, и҆ прїѧ́ти плоды̀ спасе́нїѧ: * вы́ бо вои́стиннꙋ земны̑мъ є҆стѐ держа́ва, и҆ прибѣ́жище дꙋша́мъ на́шымъ.
items.english_text: O Mother of God, despise me not who need thy protection; for in thee has my soul hoped, have mercy on me!

provenance.verbatim_source: O Mother of God, despise me not who need thy protection; for in thee has my soul hoped, have mercy on me!

items.office: Thursday of the First Week of the Holy Fast at Matins
items.season_or_tone: FIRST WEEK OF THE GREAT FAST
items.day_or_date: Thursday of the First Week of the Holy Fast at Matins
items.slavonic_text: Канѡ́нъ въ Мине́и. И҆ трипѣ́снецъ гдї́на І҆ѡ́сифа. И҆ стїхосло́витсѧ пѣ́снь ѱалти́ри.
items.english_text: True abstinence, the brightest companion of virtues, do we implore thee, O apostolic twelve, pray that we may peacefully accomplish it, and receive the fruits of salvation; for ye are truly the bulwark of those on earth, and the refuge of our souls!

provenance.verbatim_source: True abstinence, the brightest companion of virtues, do we implore thee, O apostolic twelve, pray that we may peacefully accomplish it, and receive the fruits of salvation; for ye are truly the bulwark of those on earth, and the refuge of our souls!

items.office: Thursday of the First Week of the Holy Fast at Matins
items.season_or_tone: FIRST WEEK OF THE GREAT FAST
items.day_or_date: Thursday of the First Week of the Holy Fast at Matins
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆́дицею мѧ̀ сла́сти прельсти́въ льсти́вый, * плѣ́нника восхи́ти: * но мі́рꙋ а҆по́столи сло́вомъ ᲂу҆лови́вшїи, * ѿ тогѡ̀ мѧ̀ ѕло́бы и҆зба́вите.
items.english_text: Brighter than the Cherubim, higher than the heavens, all-hymned Mother of God, confessing thee in truth, we sinners have salvation, and find protection in temptations; therefore cease not to pray for us, the bulwark and refuge of our souls!

provenance.verbatim_source: Brighter than the Cherubim, higher than the heavens, all-hymned Mother of God, confessing thee in truth, we sinners have salvation, and find protection in temptations; therefore cease not to pray for us, the bulwark and refuge of our souls!

items.office: Thursday of the First Week of the Holy Fast at Matins
items.season_or_tone: FIRST WEEK OF THE GREAT FAST
items.day_or_date: Thursday of the First Week of the Holy Fast at Matins
items.slavonic_text: Бг҃оро́диченъ: Воззову̀ въ нощѝ и҆ во днѝ ѡ҆скорблѧ́емь къ тебѣ̀, * и҆ спасу́сѧ и҆ сла́сти прейдꙋ̀, * стѣно̀ и҆ по́моще, твое́ю Дв҃о си́лою ѡ҆гражда́емый.
items.english_text: *Ode 4, Tone 2. Heirmos: "Thou hast come from the Virgin":* Receiving the rays of abstinence, shine forth, O my soul, and flee the darkening of sin, so that the light of forgiveness may shine upon thee through the Holy Spirit.

provenance.verbatim_source:

items.slavonic_text: Бг҃оро́диченъ: Воззову̀ въ нощѝ и҆ во днѝ ѡ҆скорблѧ́емь къ тебѣ̀, * и҆ спасу́сѧ и҆ сла́сти прейдꙋ̀, * стѣно̀ и҆ по́моще, твое́ю Дв҃о си́лою ѡ҆гражда́емый.
items.english_text: Ensnaring me with the hook of pleasure, the deceiver took me captive; but O Apostles, who caught the world with the word, deliver me from his malice!

provenance.verbatim_source: Ensnaring me with the hook of pleasure, the deceiver took me captive; but O Apostles, who caught the world with the word, deliver me from his malice!

items.day_or_date: Thursday of the First Week of the Holy Fast at Matins
items.slavonic_text: Бг҃оро́диченъ: Воззову̀ въ нощѝ и҆ во днѝ ѡ҆скорблѧ́емь къ тебѣ̀, * и҆ спасу́сѧ и҆ сла́сти прейдꙋ̀, * стѣно̀ и҆ по́моще, твое́ю Дв҃о си́лою ѡ҆гражда́емый.
items.english_text: Ye appeared as the rays of the Sun of glory, O glorious Apostles, driving away the darkness of deception; illuminate me also, who am darkened by every malice!

items.english_text: *Theotokion:* I will cry aloud unto thee in night and in day when afflicted, and I shall be saved and pass beyond pleasures, being protected by thy power, O Virgin, my wall and help!

items.season_or_tone: FIRST WEEK OF THE GREAT FAST
items.day_or_date: Thursday of the First Week of the Holy Fast at Matins
items.slavonic_text: И҆́ный, гдї́на Ѳео́дѡра. Гла́съ є҃. І҆рмо́съ: Дѣла̀ смотре́нїѧ твоегѡ̀ Гдⷭ҇и:
items.english_text: *Another [canon], by Lord Theodore, Tone 5. Heirmos: "The works of Thy dispensation, O Lord":*[^330] Being apostles of the Sun of righteousness, all-radiant luminaries, ye enlighten the earthly world, driving away the gloom of deception.

items.office: Thursday of the First Week of the Holy Fast at Matins
items.season_or_tone: FIRST WEEK OF THE GREAT FAST
items.day_or_date: Thursday of the First Week of the Holy Fast at Matins
items.slavonic_text: Сл҃нца пра́вды сꙋ́ще а҆по́столи, * свѣти̑ла всесвѣ́тлаѧ, * просвѣща́ете земны́й мі́ръ, * мра́къ пре́лести ѿгонѧ́ще.
items.english_text: Being the Spirit-moved lyre of the Savior, O Apostles, ye became known on earth, singing unto us a sweet-sounding hymn, and turning the world unto God.

provenance.verbatim_source: Being the Spirit-moved lyre of the Savior, O Apostles, ye became known on earth, singing unto us a sweet-sounding hymn, and turning the world unto God.

items.office: Thursday of the First Week of the Holy Fast at Matins
items.season_or_tone: FIRST WEEK OF THE GREAT FAST
items.day_or_date: Thursday of the First Week of the Holy Fast at Matins
items.slavonic_text: Сла́ва, Трⷪ҇ченъ: Тро́ицꙋ во є҆ди́нственномъ Сꙋществѣ̀ сла́вѧще, * є҆ди́наго Гдⷭ҇а Бг҃а воспои́мъ, * нерожде́нна Ѻ҆ц҃а̀, * Сн҃а рожде́ннаго, и҆ Дх҃а живꙋ́щаго.
items.english_text: Glorifying the Trinity in one Essence, let us hymn the one Lord God: the unbegotten Father, the begotten Son, and the living Spirit.

provenance.verbatim_source: Glorifying the Trinity in one Essence, let us hymn the one Lord God: the unbegotten Father, the begotten Son, and the living Spirit.
