items.day_or_date: Synaxarion.*[^687]
items.slavonic_text: Сті́хъ: Бг҃ъ же Цр҃ь на́шъ, пре́жде вѣ́ка содѣ́ла спасе́нїе посредѣ̀ землѝ.
items.english_text: The establishment of the Church, the dominion of kings, the boast and salvation of monastics, art thou, O all-honorable Cross; therefore bowing down in worship before thee, both in heart and soul we are enlightened today by the divine grace of Him Who was nailed upon thee, and destroyed the dominion of the deceiver, and abolished the curse.

provenance.verbatim_source: The establishment of the Church, the dominion of kings, the boast and salvation of monastics, art thou, O all-honorable Cross; therefore bowing down in worship before thee, both in heart and soul we are enlightened today by the divine grace of Him Who was nailed upon thee, and destroyed the dominion of the deceiver, and abolished the curse.

items.season_or_tone: FIRST WEEK OF THE GREAT FAST
items.day_or_date: Synaxarion.*[^687]
items.slavonic_text: Є҆гда́ же начина́емъ пѣ́ти: Сла́ва въ вы́шнихъ: Тогда̀ прїи́детъ І҆ере́й ѡ҆болче́нъ во всѧ̑ сщ҃енни́ческїѧ ѻ҆де́жды, (и҆лѝ а҆́ще гдѣ̀ бꙋ́детъ старѣ́й, то ѿ первѣ́йшагѡ въ свои́хъ и҆́мъ мѣ́стѣхъ до́лжно є҆́сть семꙋ̀ бы́ти). И҆ взе́мъ кади́льницꙋ, кади́тъ ст҃ꙋю трапе́зꙋ, и҆ честный крⷭ҇тъ, та́же поде́млетъ є҆го̀ на ді́скосѣ, со храни́льницею на главꙋ̀
items.english_text: The Lord of all taught by a parable to flee the haughty mind of the wicked Pharisees; and He instructed all not to think more highly of oneself than one ought to think, having Himself become a pattern and an image, even unto crucifixion and death, having emptied Himself; giving thanks therefore with the publican, let us say: O God Who didst suffer for us and didst remain impassible, deliver us from passions, and save our souls!

provenance.verbatim_source: The Lord of all taught by a parable to flee the haughty mind of the wicked Pharisees; and He instructed all not to think more highly of oneself than one ought to think, having Himself become a pattern and an image, even unto crucifixion and death, having emptied Himself; giving thanks therefore with the publican, let us say: O God Who didst suffer for us and didst remain impassible, deliver us from passions, and save our souls!

items.day_or_date: Synaxarion.*[^687]
items.slavonic_text: Сла́ва, гла́съ и҃: Дне́сь Неприкоснове́нный сꙋщество́мъ, * прикоснове́нъ мнѣ̀ быва́етъ и҆ стра́ждетъ Стрⷭ҇ти, * свобожда́ѧй мѧ̀ ѿ страсте́й, * свѣ́тъ подава́ѧй слѣпы́мъ, * ѿ беззако́нныхъ ᲂу҆сте́нъ ѡ҆плева́етсѧ, * и҆ дае́тъ плещѝ за плѣне́ныѧ на ра́ны, * сегѡ̀ Чⷭ҇таѧ Дв҃а и҆ Мт҃и на крⷭ҇тѣ̀ зрѧ́щи, * болѣ́зненнѡ вѣща́ше: * ᲂу҆вы́ мнѣ̀ Ча́до моѐ! что̀ сїѐ сотвори́лъ є҆сѝ; * Кра́сный добро́тою па́че всѣ́хъ человѣ́къ, * бездыха́нный, беззра́чный ꙗ҆влѧ́ешисѧ, * не и҆мѣ́ѧ ви́да, нижѐ добро́ты; * ᲂу҆вы́ мнѣ̀ мо́й Свѣ́те! * не могꙋ̀ спѧ́ща зрѣ́ти тѧ̀, * ᲂу҆тро́бою ᲂу҆ѧзвля́юсѧ, * и҆ лю́тое ѻ҆рꙋ́жїе се́рдце моѐ прохо́дитъ, * воспѣва́ю твоѧ̑ Стрⷭ҇ти, * покланѧ́юся бл҃гоꙋтро́бїю твоемꙋ̀: * Долготерпѣли́ве сла́ва тебѣ́.
items.english_text: *And they begin to bow down in worship: if anywhere in a monastery, the Abbot, or another presiding among the clergy; likewise also the other priests, bowing down before the precious Cross twice; the seniors kiss it first, and after kissing they bow down again once; likewise do the other priests on the right side and on the left; likewise the brethren also come two by two, bowing down according to their rank. And while the brethren bow down in worship, we sing these Idiomela, Tone 2:*[^703]

items.day_or_date: Synaxarion.*[^687]
items.slavonic_text: И҆ ны́нѣ, гла́съ то́йже. Дне́сь проро́ческое и҆спо́лнисѧ сло́во: * се́ бо покланѧ́емсѧ на мѣ́сто, и҆де́же стоѧ́стѣ но́зѣ твоѝ Гдⷭ҇и, * и҆ дре́ва спасе́нїа вкꙋси́вше, * грѣхо́вныхъ страсте́й свобо́дꙋ ᲂу҆лꙋчи́хомъ, * моли́твами Бцⷣы є҆ди́не человѣколю́бче.
items.english_text: Come, ye faithful, let us bow down in worship before the life-creating Tree, whereon Christ, the King of glory, having voluntarily stretched out His hands, lifted us up unto the first blessedness, whom the enemy of old had stolen away through pleasure and caused to be banished from God; come, ye faithful, let us bow down in worship before the Tree, through which we were accounted worthy to shatter the heads of invisible enemies; come, all ye families of the nations, let us honor the Cross of the Lord with songs: Rejoice, O Cross, complete redemption of fallen Adam! In thee our most faithful rulers boast, as by thy power they mightily subdue the Ismaelite people; thee now with fear we Christians kiss, glorifying God Who was nailed upon thee, saying: O Lord Who wast nailed thereon, have mercy on us, as Thou art good and the Lover of mankind!

items.english_text: Today the Master of creation and Lord of glory is nailed upon the Cross, and is pierced in His side, tasting gall and vinegar, the Sweetness of the Church; He is crowned with a crown of thorns, Who covers the heaven with clouds; He is clothed with a garment of mockery, and is buffeted by an earthly hand: He Who with His hand created man; He is beaten upon His shoulders, Who cloths the heaven with clouds; He receives spitting and wounds, reproaches and buffetings; and all things He endures for the sake of me, the condemned, my Redeemer and God, that He may save the world from deception, as the Tender-hearted One.

items.english_text: Today He Who is untouchable in essence becomes touchable unto me and suffers Passions, Who frees me from passions; He Who gives light unto the blind is spat upon by lawless lips, and gives His back unto wounds for the sake of captives; beholding Him upon the Cross, the Pure Virgin and Mother cried out sorrowfully: Woe is me, my Child! What is this that Thou hast done? Thou Who art fair in beauty beyond all men appearest breathless, formless, having neither form nor beauty; woe is me, my Light! I cannot look upon Thee sleeping; I am wounded in my womb, and a cruel sword piercs my heart; I hymn Thy Passions, I bow down before Thy tender-heartedness: O Longsuffering One, glory to Thee!

items.english_text: Today the prophetic word has been fulfilled; for lo, we bow down in worship at the place where Thy feet stood, O Lord; and having tasted of the tree of salvation, we have obtained freedom from sinful passions, through the intercessions of the Theotokos, O Thou Who alone lovest mankind.

items.slavonic_text: Гдⷭ҇и, на крⷭ҇тѣ̀ во́лею просте́рлъ є҆сѝ дла́ни твоѧ̑, * семꙋ̀ ᲂу҆миле́нїемъ се́рдца поклони́тисѧ и҆ на́съ сподо́би, * просвѣще́нныхъ до́брѣ посто́мъ и҆ моли́твами, * и҆ воздержа́нїемъ и҆ бл҃готворе́нїемъ, * ꙗ҆́кѡ бл҃гъ и҆ чл҃вѣколю́бецъ.
items.english_text: O Lord, Who of Thine own will didst stretch out Thy palms upon the Cross, account us also worthy to bow down in worship before it with compunction of heart, having been well enlightened by fasting and prayers, by self-control and good works, as Thou art good and the Lover of mankind.

items.english_text: O Lord, according to the multitude of Thy compassions, cleanse the multitude of my sins, O All-Merciful One, and account me worthy with pure soul to see and to kiss Thy Cross during the present week of self-control, as Thou art the Lover of mankind.

items.section: At the Praises, we set 8 verses, and sing 4 Resurrectional stichera of the Octoechos, and 3 Prosomoia of the Triodion, repeating the first, Tone 4. Podoben: "As one valiant among martyrs" (Ꙗ҆́кѡ до́блѧ):*[^698]
items.season_or_tone: FIRST WEEK OF THE GREAT FAST
items.day_or_date: On the Third Sunday of the Great Fast, at Vespers
items.slavonic_text: Ве́лїе чꙋ́до, * дре́во ви́дитсѧ, на не́мже Хрїсто́съ во́лею распѧ́тсѧ пло́тїю: * покланѧ́етсѧ мі́ръ, и҆ просвѣща́емь взыва́етъ: * Ѽ крⷭ҇та̀ си́ло, * и҆ зри́мый де́мѡны пали́тъ, * и҆ воѡбража́емь си́хъ палѧ̀ ꙗ҆влѧ́етсѧ! * ᲂу҆блажа́ю тѧ̀ пречⷭ҇тое дре́во, * почита́ю и҆ покланѧ́юсѧ со стра́хомъ, * и҆ Бг҃а сла́влю, * тобо́ю дарова́вшаго мнѣ̀ жи́знь безконе́чнꙋю.
items.english_text: *Another sticheron of Lord Theodore, Tone 3. Podoben: "A great wonder" (Ве́лїе чꙋ́до):*[^710] A great wonder, the Tree is beheld whereon Christ was of His own will crucified in the flesh; the world bows down in worship, and being enlightened cries aloud: O power of the Cross! Even when seen, it consumes demons, and being depicted, it appears consuming them! I call thee blessed, O most pure Tree, I honor and bow down in worship before thee with fear, and I glorify God, Who through thee has granted me endless life.

items.slavonic_text: Сла́ва, и҆ ны́нѣ, Бг҃оро́диченъ, гла́съ то́йже.: Нбⷭ҇наѧ пою́тъ тѧ̀, ѡ҆бра́дованнаѧ Мт҃и безневѣ́стнаѧ: * и҆ мы̀ славосло́вимъ неизслѣ́дованное твоѐ Ржⷭ҇тво̀, * Бцⷣе, молѝ спасти́сѧ дꙋша́мъ на́шымъ.

items.slavonic_text: Сла́ва, и҆ ны́нѣ, Бг҃оро́диченъ, гла́съ то́йже.: Нбⷭ҇наѧ пою́тъ тѧ̀, ѡ҆бра́дованнаѧ Мт҃и безневѣ́стнаѧ: * и҆ мы̀ славосло́вимъ неизслѣ́дованное твоѐ Ржⷭ҇тво̀, * Бцⷣе, молѝ спасти́сѧ дꙋша́мъ на́шымъ.
items.english_text: I dare not gaze with mine eyes into heaven, wretch that I am, because of my wicked deeds; but like the publican groaning, I cry unto Thee: O God, cleanse me a sinner, and deliver me from the hypocrisy of the Pharisees, as Thou alone art tender-hearted!

items.english_text: O martyrs of the Lord, every place do ye sanctify, and every disease do ye heal; and now pray ye, we entreat, that our souls may be delivered from the snares of the enemy.

provenance.verbatim_source: O martyrs of the Lord, every place do ye sanctify, and every disease do ye heal; and now pray ye, we entreat, that our souls may be delivered from the snares of the enemy.

items.slavonic_text: Сла́ва, и҆ ны́нѣ, Бг҃оро́диченъ, гла́съ то́йже.: Нбⷭ҇наѧ пою́тъ тѧ̀, ѡ҆бра́дованнаѧ Мт҃и безневѣ́стнаѧ: * и҆ мы̀ славосло́вимъ неизслѣ́дованное твоѐ Ржⷭ҇тво̀, * Бцⷣе, молѝ спасти́сѧ дꙋша́мъ на́шымъ.
items.english_text: The heavenly hosts sing of thee, O joyful Mother unwedded, and we glorify thine unsearchable childbearing, O Mother of God; pray that our souls may be saved!

provenance.verbatim_source: The heavenly hosts sing of thee, O joyful Mother unwedded, and we glorify thine unsearchable childbearing, O Mother of God; pray that our souls may be saved!

items.office: On Monday of the Fourth Week of the Great Fast
items.season_or_tone: FOURTH WEEK OF THE GREAT FAST
items.day_or_date: On Monday of the Fourth Week of the Great Fast
items.slavonic_text: Всечⷭ҇тно́мꙋ вѣ́рнїи поклони́мсѧ дре́вꙋ, * на не́мже Творе́цъ всѣ́хъ вознесе́сѧ, * предлежи́тъ ѡ҆свѧща́ѧ пристꙋпа́ющыѧ дꙋше́ю и҆ тѣ́ломъ, * скве́рнꙋ ѡ҆чища́ѧ грѣха̀ постѧ́щихсѧ вѣ́рнѡ, * и҆ воспѣва́ющихъ всегда̀ Хрⷭ҇та̀, * є҆ди́наго бл҃годѣ́телѧ.
items.english_text: Let us, the faithful, bow down in worship before the all-honorable Tree whereon the Creator of all was lifted up; it is set forth, sanctifying those who draw near in soul and body, cleansing the defilement of sin from those who fast faithfully, and who ever praise Christ, the only Benefactor.

provenance.verbatim_source: Let us, the faithful, bow down in worship before the all-honorable Tree whereon the Creator of all was lifted up; it is set forth, sanctifying those who draw near in soul and body, cleansing the defilement of sin from those who fast faithfully, and who ever praise Christ, the only Benefactor.

items.office: On Monday of the Fourth Week of the Great Fast
items.season_or_tone: FOURTH WEEK OF THE GREAT FAST
items.day_or_date: On Monday of the Fourth Week of the Great Fast
items.slavonic_text: По г҃-мъ же стїхосло́вїи сѣда́ленъ, гла́съ г҃. Подо́бенъ: Красотѣ̀ дѣ́вства: Преполови́вше ны́нѣ воздержа́нїе, * и҆ на поклоне́нїе Хрⷭ҇тѐ предвари́вше живоно́снагѡ твоегѡ̀ крⷭ҇та̀, * припа́дающе вопїе́мъ тѝ: * ве́лїй є҆сѝ Чл҃вѣколю́бче, * и҆ ве́лїѧ дѣла̀ твоѧ̑, * ꙗ҆́кѡ ꙗ҆ви́лъ є҆сѝ крⷭ҇тъ тво́й чⷭ҇тный, * є҆мꙋ́же со стра́хомъ покланѧ́ющесѧ взыва́емъ: * сла́ва кра́йнемꙋ бл҃гоꙋтро́бїю твоемꙋ̀.
items.english_text: The Word of the Father came down upon the earth, and an Angel of light cried unto the Theotokos: Rejoice, O blessed one, who alone hast preserved the chamber, having received the conception of the pre-eternal God and Lord, that as God He may save the human race from deception!

provenance.verbatim_source: The Word of the Father came down upon the earth, and an Angel of light cried unto the Theotokos: Rejoice, O blessed one, who alone hast preserved the chamber, having received the conception of the pre-eternal God and Lord, that as God He may save the human race from deception!

items.office: On Monday of the Fourth Week of the Great Fast
items.season_or_tone: FOURTH WEEK OF THE GREAT FAST
items.day_or_date: On Monday of the Fourth Week of the Great Fast
items.slavonic_text: Канѡ́нъ Мине́и, и҆ настоѧ́щїй трипѣ́снецъ, и҆ стїхосло́витсѧ пѣ́снь. Пе́снь ѕ҃, гла́съ и҃. І҆рмо́съ: Колесницегони́телѧ фараѡ́на:
items.english_text: Having now reached the midpoint of self-control, and having anticipated the veneration of Thy life-bearing Cross, O Christ, falling down before Thee we cry aloud: Great art Thou, O Lover of mankind, and great are Thy works, in that Thou hast shown forth Thy precious Cross, before which bowing down in worship with fear we cry out: Glory to Thy boundless tender-heartedness!

provenance.verbatim_source: Having now reached the midpoint of self-control, and having anticipated the veneration of Thy life-bearing Cross, O Christ, falling down before Thee we cry aloud: Great art Thou, O Lover of mankind, and great are Thy works, in that Thou hast shown forth Thy precious Cross, before which bowing down in worship with fear we cry out: Glory to Thy boundless tender-heartedness!

items.office: On Monday of the Fourth Week of the Great Fast
items.season_or_tone: FOURTH WEEK OF THE GREAT FAST
items.day_or_date: On Monday of the Fourth Week of the Great Fast
items.slavonic_text: Свѣтоно́сное крⷭ҇та̀ поклоне́нїе всѣ́мъ ꙗ҆ви́сѧ, * со́лнечнꙋю зарю̀ спасе́нїѧ и҆спꙋща́ющее, * и҆ всѣ́хъ ѡ҆зарѧ́ющее страсте́й ѡ҆мраче́нїемъ ѡ҆держи́мыхъ: * стеце́мсѧ се́й чи́стѣ ѡ҆блобыза́ти.
items.english_text: As an uncultivated vine, O Virgin, thou hast blossomed forth the most fair Cluster, which pours out for us saving wine that gladdens the souls and bodies of all; therefore, calling thee blessed as the cause of good things, we ever cry out unto thee with the Angel: Rejoice, O full of grace!

provenance.verbatim_source: As an uncultivated vine, O Virgin, thou hast blossomed forth the most fair Cluster, which pours out for us saving wine that gladdens the souls and bodies of all; therefore, calling thee blessed as the cause of good things, we ever cry out unto thee with the Angel: Rejoice, O full of grace!

items.english_text: *Ode 6, Tone 8. Heirmos: "The charioteer of Pharaoh" (Колесницегони́телѧ фараѡ́на):*[^715] The radiant veneration of the Cross has appeared unto all, sending forth the sun-like ray of salvation, and illumining all who are held fast in the darkness of passions: let us hasten to embrace it in purity!

provenance.verbatim_source:

items.office: On Monday of the Fourth Week of the Great Fast
items.season_or_tone: FOURTH WEEK OF THE GREAT FAST
items.day_or_date: On Monday of the Fourth Week of the Great Fast
items.slavonic_text: Поста̀ ѡ҆чи́стившесѧ бл҃года́тїю, чи́стымъ ᲂу҆мо́мъ, Чи́стомꙋ Е҆ди́номꙋ, прїиди́те, возопїи́мъ гла́сомъ бл҃годарє́нїѧ: ты̀ кро́вь твою̀ Сло́ве за ны̀ всѧ̑ да́лъ є҆сѝ, ты̀ и҆ крⷭ҇то́мъ ѡ҆свѧща́еши ны̀.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Having cleansed ourselves by the grace of the Fast, with a pure mind unto the Only Pure One, come, let us cry aloud with a voice of thanksgiving: Thou, O Word, hast given Thy Blood for us all, and by the Cross Thou dost sanctify us.[^716]

provenance.verbatim_source:

Having cleansed ourselves by the grace of the Fast, with a pure mind unto the Only Pure One, come, let us cry aloud with a voice of thanksgiving: Thou, O Word, hast given Thy Blood for us all, and by the Cross Thou dost sanctify us.[^716]

items.office: On Monday of the Fourth Week of the Great Fast
items.season_or_tone: FOURTH WEEK OF THE GREAT FAST
items.day_or_date: On Monday of the Fourth Week of the Great Fast
items.slavonic_text: Запе́нсѧ прило́ги ѕмі́иными, паде́нїемъ ᲂу҆жа́снымъ всегда̀ лежꙋ̀, Сп҃се, паде́нїе первозда́ннагѡ Стрⷭ҇тїю твое́ю и҆ крⷭ҇то́мъ и҆спра́вивый, и҆спра́ви, и҆ наста́ви къ хотѣ́нїй твои́хъ и҆сполне́нїю.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Tripped up by the assaults of the serpent, I ever lie in an awful fall, O Savior; Who by Thy Passion and Cross didst right the fall of the first-fashioned man, right Thou me, and guide me unto the fulfillment of Thy desires.

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*
Tripped up by the assaults of the serpent, I ever lie in an awful fall, O Savior; Who by Thy Passion and Cross didst right the fall of the first-fashioned man, right Thou me, and guide me unto the fulfillment of Thy desires.

items.office: On Monday of the Fourth Week of the Great Fast
items.season_or_tone: FOURTH WEEK OF THE GREAT FAST
items.day_or_date: On Monday of the Fourth Week of the Great Fast
items.slavonic_text: Бг҃оро́диченъ: Предстоѧ́щи крⷭ҇тꙋ̀ твоемꙋ̀ Гдⷭ҇и, Неискꙋсобра́чнаѧ, и҆ твоѧ̑ ꙗ҆́звы зрѧ́щи Влⷣко, ᲂу҆ѧзвлѧ́ема гла́ше: ᲂу҆вы̀ мнѣ̀ Ча́до, болѣ́зни и҆збѣ́гши въ Ржⷭ҇твѣ̀ твое́мъ, ны́нѣ болѣ́зненнѡ ᲂу҆ѧзвлѧ́юсѧ.
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* Standing before Thy Cross, O Lord, the Maiden who knew not wedlock, beholding Thy wounds, O Master, was wounded and said: Woe is me, O Child! Having escaped pangs at Thy Nativity, now am I painfully wounded.

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Theotokion:*

items.office: On Monday of the Fourth Week of the Great Fast
items.season_or_tone: FOURTH WEEK OF THE GREAT FAST
items.day_or_date: On Monday of the Fourth Week of the Great Fast
items.slavonic_text: Седми́ца ст҃а́ѧ сїѧ̀ и҆ свѣтоно́снаѧ крⷭ҇тъ всечⷭ҇тны́й предлага́етъ мі́рови: прїиди́те, поклони́мсѧ, стра́хомъ же и҆ любо́вїю дꙋ́шы просвѣти́вше, на не́мъ пригвозди́вшагосѧ Хрⷭ҇та̀ въ пѣ́снехъ сла́вѧще.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* This holy and radiant week sets forth the all-honorable Cross unto the world: come, let us bow down in worship, having enlightened our souls with fear and love, glorifying in hymns Christ Who was nailed upon it.

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*
This holy and radiant week sets forth the all-honorable Cross unto the world: come, let us bow down in worship, having enlightened our souls with fear and love, glorifying in hymns Christ Who was nailed upon it.

items.office: On Monday of the Fourth Week of the Great Fast
items.season_or_tone: FOURTH WEEK OF THE GREAT FAST
items.day_or_date: On Monday of the Fourth Week of the Great Fast
items.slavonic_text: Крⷭ҇тꙋ̀ твоемꙋ̀ всѝ покланѧ́емсѧ Хрⷭ҇тѐ, предпровожде́нїе творѧ́ще Воскрⷭ҇нїѧ твоегѡ̀: пое́мъ гвѡ́здїѧ твоѧ̑, чти́мъ и҆ копїѐ твоѐ, ᲂу҆стна́ма и҆ ѻ҆чи́ма, дꙋше́ю же и҆ тѣ́ломъ са́ми ѡ҆чища́еми.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Before Thy Cross we all bow down in worship, O Christ, celebrating the foretaste of Thy Resurrection; we sing of Thy nails, and we honor Thy spear, with lips and eyes, being ourselves purified in soul and body.

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*
Before Thy Cross we all bow down in worship, O Christ, celebrating the foretaste of Thy Resurrection; we sing of Thy nails, and we honor Thy spear, with lips and eyes, being ourselves purified in soul and body.

items.office: On Monday of the Fourth Week of the Great Fast
items.season_or_tone: FOURTH WEEK OF THE GREAT FAST
items.day_or_date: On Monday of the Fourth Week of the Great Fast
items.slavonic_text: И҆ ны́нѣ: Бг҃оро́диченъ: Пое́мъ тѧ̀ Дв҃о Бцⷣе Чⷭ҇таѧ, Херꙋві́мскꙋю колесни́цꙋ, и҆з̾ неѧ́же Бг҃ъ роди́сѧ: ты́ бо є҆ди́на была̀ є҆сѝ и҆сто́чникъ нетлѣ́нїѧ, и҆сточа́ющїй всѣ̑мъ жи́знь, и҆з̾ негѡ́же почерпа́юще и҆сцѣле́нїе прїе́млемъ.
items.english_text: O Trinity sung in one Essence, O Father, Son, with the Holy Spirit, unoriginate, ever-existing, uncreated Godhead, Source of light and of life: unto Thee do all of us men bow down in worship, Who hast brought all things into being.

provenance.verbatim_source: O Trinity sung in one Essence, O Father, Son, with the Holy Spirit, unoriginate, ever-existing, uncreated Godhead, Source of light and of life: unto Thee do all of us men bow down in worship, Who hast brought all things into being.

items.office: On Monday of the Fourth Week of the Great Fast
items.season_or_tone: FOURTH WEEK OF THE GREAT FAST
items.day_or_date: On Monday of the Fourth Week of the Great Fast
items.slavonic_text: І҆рмо́съ: Пои́мъ Гдⷭ҇ви, сотво́ршемꙋ ди̑внаѧ чꙋдеса̀ въ чермнѣ́мъ мо́ри: по́нтомъ бо покры̀ проти̑вныѧ, и҆ спасѐ І҆и҃лѧ, томꙋ̀ є҆ди́номꙋ пои́мъ, ꙗ҆́кѡ просла́висѧ.
items.english_text: We sing of thee, O Virgin, pure Theotokos, the Cherubic chariot from whom God was born; for thou alone hast been the fountain of incorruption, pouring forth life unto all, from which we draw and receive healing.

provenance.verbatim_source: We sing of thee, O Virgin, pure Theotokos, the Cherubic chariot from whom God was born; for thou alone hast been the fountain of incorruption, pouring forth life unto all, from which we draw and receive healing.

items.office: On Monday of the Fourth Week of the Great Fast
items.season_or_tone: FOURTH WEEK OF THE GREAT FAST
items.day_or_date: On Monday of the Fourth Week of the Great Fast
items.slavonic_text: На горѣ̀ дре́вле тебѐ Мѡѷсе́й проѡбразѝ, рꙋ́цѣ возвы́сивъ, и҆ А҆мали́ка побѣжда́ѧ, крⷭ҇те всечⷭ҇тный, є҆мꙋ́же кла́нѧющесѧ дне́сь, побѣжда́емъ де́мѡнѡвъ и҆ноплеме́нныѧ полкѝ, и҆ вѣ́рою пое́мъ: сщ҃е́нницы бл҃гвите, лю́дїе превозноси́те во всѧ̑ вѣ́ки.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Having reached the midpoint of the forty-stage stadium of the Fast,[^718] come, let us go in love with Christ unto the divine Passion, that having been crucified together with Him, we may be partakers of His Resurrection.

provenance.verbatim_source:

Having reached the midpoint of the forty-stage stadium of the Fast,[^718] come, let us go in love with Christ unto the divine Passion, that having been crucified together with Him, we may be partakers of His Resurrection.

items.slavonic_text: Страстьмѝ преклоне́нна, врагѝ запина́ема, ѻ҆бы́чаемъ лꙋка́вымъ влеко́ма, ᲂу҆ще́дри Бл҃гоꙋтро́бне, твои́мъ крⷭ҇то́мъ защитѝ, ꙗ҆́кѡ да пою̀ невкло́ннымъ се́рдцемъ: Ѻ҆́троцы бл҃гослови́те, Свѧще́нницы воспо́йте, лю́дїе превозноси́те во всѧ̑ вѣ́ки.
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* Painfully groaning, crying out with motherly anguish, and unable to endure the grief from within, thou didst gaze upon the Cross at the One born from thy womb, O Child, crying aloud: What sight is this? How art Thou suffering, Who art by nature impassible, wishing by all means to deliver the human race from corruption?

items.slavonic_text: Бг҃оро́диченъ: Болѣ́зненнѡ стена́щи, мт҃рски восклица́ющи, и҆ ѿ внꙋ́треннихъ ско́рби не терпѧ́щи, на крⷭ҇тъ взира́ла є҆сѝ къ Рожде́нномꙋ и҆з̾ твоегѡ̀ чре́ва, Ча́до, вопїю́щи: что̀ видѣ́нїе сїѐ; ка́кѡ стра́ждеши, є҆стество́мъ Безстра́стный, всѧ́кѡ хотѧ̀ ро́дъ человѣ́ческїй ѿ тлѝ свободи́ти;
items.english_text: *Troparion:* *Another [Canon], Heirmos: The angels unceasingly:*[^721] Beholding the Cross of Christ set forth in church, come, brethren, let us bow down in worship having approached with fear and faith, crying aloud unto it: Thou hast blossomed forth life unto men, O light-bearer!

items.slavonic_text: И҆́ный. І҆рмо́съ: А҆́ггли немо́лчнѡ: Въ цр҃кви предложе́ный крⷭ҇тъ Хрⷭ҇то́въ ви́дѧще, стра́хомъ и҆ вѣ́рою бра́тїе прише́дше поклони́мсѧ, томꙋ̀ вопїю́ще: ты̀ жи́знь процвѣ́лъ є҆сѝ человѣ́кѡмъ, свѣтоно́сне.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Triumphant in battles, heaven has shown thee unto us as the life-creating Cross: an unconquerable weapon unto kings, the overthrow of enemies, the horn of the churches,[^722] and the salvation of the faithful.

provenance.verbatim_source:

items.slavonic_text: И҆ ны́нѣ: Бг҃оро́диченъ: Ра́дꙋйсѧ две́ре непроходи́маѧ: ра́дꙋйсѧ кꙋпино̀ неопали́маѧ: ра́дꙋйсѧ рꙋ́чко злата́ѧ: ра́дꙋйсѧ горо̀ несѣко́маѧ; ра́дꙋйсѧ Бцⷣе, ᲂу҆пова́нїе первѣ́йшое, и҆ стѣно̀ на тѧ̀ надѣ́ющымсѧ.
items.english_text: I glorify the Holy Father, and I honor the Holy Son, and I sing of the Holy Spirit: the simple consubstantial Trinity, God in each of These, Lights and Light, proceeding as from a single sun.

provenance.verbatim_source: I glorify the Holy Father, and I honor the Holy Son, and I sing of the Holy Spirit: the simple consubstantial Trinity, God in each of These, Lights and Light, proceeding as from a single sun.

items.slavonic_text: Хва́лимъ, бл҃гослови́мъ, покланѧ́емсѧ Гдⷭ҇ви: І҆рмо́съ: А҆́ггли немо́лчнѡ въ вы́шнихъ сла́вимаго Бг҃а, нб҃са̀ нб҃съ, землѧ̀, и҆ го́ры, и҆ хо́лми, и҆ глꙋбина̀, и҆ ве́сь ро́дъ человѣ́ческїй, пѣ́сньми того̀ ꙗ҆́кѡ Созда́телѧ, и҆ И҆зба́вителѧ бл҃гвите, и҆ превозноси́те во всѧ̑ вѣ́ки.
items.english_text: Rejoice, impassable gate! Rejoice, unburnt bush! Rejoice, golden jar! Rejoice, mountain unhewn; rejoice, O Theotokos, first hope and wall unto them that trust in thee!

items.slavonic_text: Поще́нїѧ водо́ю вѣ́рнїи ѡ҆чи́стившесѧ, и҆ дꙋше́ю и҆ мы́слїю, животода́тельное и҆ бж҃е́ственное дре́во ѡ҆блобыза́имъ: предлежи́тъ бо ꙗ҆́вѣ всѣ̑мъ, и҆сточа́ѧ бж҃е́ственное ѡ҆ставле́нїе, и҆ свѣ́тъ нбⷭ҇ный, и҆ жи́знь и҆ и҆́стинное ра́дованїе.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Having reached the midpoint of the Fast, let us take courage in spirit toward what is to come with youthful vigor,[^723] running well with God, O brethren, so that we may also with joy behold the Pascha, when Christ has arisen!

items.slavonic_text: Сꙋдїю̀ тѧ̀ всѣ̑мъ стра́шна, грѧдꙋ́ща во сла́вѣ Бж҃ества̀, всѣ́хъ сокрове́наѧ ѡ҆бличи́ти тогда̀ хотѧ́ща Гдⷭ҇и, тѣ́мже тебѣ̀ зовꙋ̀ Бж҃е: согрѣши́хъ, простѝ, не ѡ҆бличѝ моѧ̑ мнѡ́гаѧ и҆ лю̑таѧ согрѣше́нїѧ.

items.slavonic_text: И҆́ный. І҆рмо́съ: На Сїна́йстѣй горѣ̀: На мѣ́стѣ, и҆де́же но́зѣ стоѧ́стѣ [тебѣ̀] Влⷣки и҆ Бг҃а, поклони́мсѧ всѝ дне́сь крⷭ҇тꙋ̀ всечⷭ҇тно́мꙋ, ꙗ҆́коже Дв҃дъ взыва́етъ бг҃оглаго́ливѣйшїй: и҆́бо всѧ̑ Содержа́й го́рстїю, на се́мъ вознесе́сѧ.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Ye that dwell on earth, approach, pure through the Fast, and beholding the all-honorable Cross set forth today, bow down in worship with fear and faith; rejoice and be exceedingly glad, drawing sanctification for your souls.

items.slavonic_text: Сла́ва Трⷪ҇ченъ: Сꙋщество́мъ Е҆ди́ница є҆́сть несѣко́ма, пребж҃е́ственнаѧ Трⷪ҇ца, соединя́ема є҆стество́мъ, дѣ́литсѧ ли́цы сво́йственнѡ: несѣко́ма бо сѣче́тсѧ, є҆ди́но сꙋ́щи тро́итсѧ, сїѧ̀ Ѻ҆ц҃ъ є҆́сть, Сн҃ъ, и҆ Дх҃ъ живы́й, соблюда́ющаѧ всѧ̑.
items.english_text: The transcendent Trinity is in essence an indivisible Unity, joined by nature, properly divided into Persons; for indivisibly It is divided, and being One It is threefold: This is the Father, the Son, and the living Spirit, Who preserves all things.

items.slavonic_text: Сла́ва тебѣ̀ Бж҃е на́шъ, сла́ва тебѣ̀. Бл҃годарнꙋю хвалꙋ̀ принесе́мъ Бг҃ꙋ всѝ лю́дїе, ꙗ҆́кѡ ви́дѧще ны́нѣ ѡ҆блобыза́емъ всечⷭ҇ты́й крⷭ҇тъ, разꙋмѣ́йте ᲂу҆́бо и҆ покара́йтесѧ въ се́мъ де́мѡни: ꙗ҆зы́цы ва́рварстїи разꙋмѣ́йте, и҆ покара́йтесѧ, ꙗ҆́кѡ съ на́ми Бг҃ъ.
items.english_text: Who has ever heard of a childbearing Virgin, and a Mother without a husband? O Mary, thou dost work a wonder! But tell me, how? Search not into the depth of my divine childbearing; this is entirely true, surpassing the comprehension of the human mind.

items.english_text: Thou hast shown humility to be the preeminent way of exaltation, O Christ, having emptied Thyself and taken the form of a servant; Thou didst not give ear unto the vainglorious prayer of the Pharisee, but didst receive the contrite groaning of the Publican as an unblemished sacrifice in the highest; therefore do I also cry aloud unto Thee: Cleanse, O God, cleanse, O my Savior, and save me!

items.english_text: Thus says the Lord Sabaoth: As I have said, so will it be, and as I have purposed, so will it stand: [25] to destroy the Assyrians upon My land, and upon My mountains; and they will be for a trampling down, and their yoke will be taken away from them, and their glory will be taken away from their shoulders. [26] This is the purpose which the Lord has purposed upon the whole earth, and this is the hand stretched out over all the nations of the earth. [27] For what God the Holy One has purposed, who will bring to naught? And His high hand, who will turn it aside? [28] In the year that King Ahaz died, this word came to pass: [29] Rejoice not, all ye of alien race, because the yoke of him that smote you is broken; for out of the serpent's seed will come forth the offspring of asps, and from their offspring will come forth flying serpents. [30] And the poor will feed by Him, and needy men will rest in peace; and He will destroy thy seed with famine, and will kill thy remnant. [31] Howl, ye gates of cities! Let the cities cry out in confusion, all ye of alien race! For smoke is coming from the north, and there is none that will stand. [32] And what will the kings of the nations answer? That the Lord has founded Zion, and through Him the humble among His people will be saved.

Подо́бенъ: Что́ ва́съ нарече́мъ: Въ сре́днихъ дне́хъ воздержа́нїѧ, преходѧ́ще дне́сь си́лою крⷭ҇тною, на се́мъ возне́сшагосѧ посредѣ̀ землѝ, Сп҃са и҆ Бг҃а славосло́вимъ, вопїю́ще: зри́тели на́съ покажѝ Стрⷭ҇те́мъ твои̑мъ Влⷣко, и҆ чⷭ҇тна́гѡ Воскрⷭ҇нїѧ, да́рꙋѧ на́мъ ѡ҆чище́нїе и҆ ве́лїю ми́лость.
items.english_text: Passing today through the middle days of self-control by the power of the Cross, we glorify Christ our Savior and God Who was lifted up upon it in the midst of the earth, crying aloud: Show us to be beholders of Thy Passions, O Master, and of Thy venerable Resurrection, granting us cleansing and great mercy!

items.english_text: Let us humble the passions of the flesh by laying aside food and turning away from pleasures, and let us faithfully embrace the wood of the Cross; for it is seen manifestly set forth for veneration, and it sanctifies all things with divine grace; and let us cry aloud unto the Lord: We thank Thee, O Tenderhearted One, Who by this dost save our souls!

items.slavonic_text: Бытїѧ̀ чте́нїе. Глава̀ и҃. Речѐ Гдⷭ҇ь Бг҃ъ: размы́сливъ, не приложꙋ̀ ктомꙋ̀ прокля́ти зе́млю за дѣла̀ человѣ́ческаѧ: занѐ прилежи́тъ помышле́нїе человѣ́кꙋ прилѣ́жнѡ на ѕла̑ѧ ѿ ю҆́ности є҆гѡ̀, не приложꙋ̀ ᲂу҆́бо ктомꙋ̀ порази́ти всѧ́кꙋю пло́ть живꙋ́щꙋю, ꙗ҆́коже сотвори́хъ. Во всѧ̑ дни̑ землѝ сѣ́ѧтва и҆ жа́тва, зима̀ и҆ зно́й, лѣ́то и҆ весна̀, де́нь и҆ но́щь [22] не преста́нꙋтъ. [Глава ѳ: 1] И҆ бл҃гословѝ Бг҃ъ Нѡ́а, и҆ сн҃ы є҆гѡ̀, и҆ речѐ и҆̀мъ: расти́теся, и҆ мно́житеся, и҆ напо́лните зе́млю, и҆ ѡ҆облада́йте є҆́ю. [2] И҆ стра́хъ и҆ тре́петъ ва́шъ бꙋ́детъ на всѣ́хъ ѕвѣ́рехъ земны́хъ,
items.english_text: Now bowing down in worship before the Cross, let us all cry aloud: Rejoice, Tree of Life! Rejoice, holy scepter of Christ! Rejoice, eternal glory of men! Rejoice, boast of kings! Rejoice, stronghold of the faith! Rejoice, unconquerable weapon! Rejoice, driving away of enemies! Rejoice, radiant illumination saving the world! Rejoice, great glory of martyrs! Rejoice, strength of the righteous! Rejoice, splendor of angels! Rejoice, all-honorable!

items.slavonic_text: Мч҃ениченъ: Мꙋ́ченицы Гдⷭ҇ни, моли́те Бг҃а на́шего, и҆ и҆спроси́те дꙋша́мъ на́шымъ мно́жество щедро́тъ, и҆ ѡ҆чище́нїе мно́гихъ прегрѣше́нїй, мо́лимсѧ.
items.english_text: A righteous son is born unto life, but the pursuit of the ungodly leads to death. [20] Perverse ways are an abomination unto the Lord, but acceptable unto Him are all they that are blameless in their ways. [21] He that unrighteously strikes hands will not be unpunished of evil; but he that sows righteousness receives a sure reward. [22] As a golden ring in a swine's snout, so is beauty to a woman without discretion. [23] The desire of the righteous is entirely good, but the hope of the ungodly perishes. [24] There are some who by scattering their own make it greater, and there are some who gathering what is not theirs are diminished. [25] Every sincere soul is blessed, but an angry man is uncomely. [26] He that hoards grain leaves it to the nations, and he that sells grain sparingly is cursed by the people; but the blessing of the Lord is upon the head of him that gives. [27] He that devises good things seeks good favor; but evils will overtake him that seeks them. [28] He that trusts in his riches, he will fall; but he that takes up the cause of the righteous, he will shine forth. [29] He that heeds not his own house will inherit the wind, and the fool will be servant to the wise. [30] From the fruit of righteousness grows the tree of life, but the souls of the lawless are taken away before their time. [31] If the righteous scarcely be saved, where will the ungodly and the sinner appear? [Chapter 12:1] He that loves instruction loves discernment, but he that hates reproof is foolish. [2] Better is he that has found favor from the Lord God, but a man who is a transgressor will be passed over in silence. [3] A man will not be established by wickedness, but the roots of the righteous will not be removed. [4] A virtuous woman is a crown unto her husband, but as a worm in wood, so does an evil woman destroy a man. [5] The thoughts of the righteous are judgments, but the ungodly manage deceit. [6] The words of the ungodly lie in wait for blood, but the mouth of the upright will deliver them.

items.english_text: The vainglorious Pharisee became abominable by boasting, and the humble-minded Publican was justified by praying in silence; therefore, my soul, seeing the difference between both, embrace and kiss humble-mindedness; for Christ has promised to give grace unto the humble, as He is the Lover of mankind.

items.slavonic_text: По г҃-мъ стїхосло́вїи сѣда́ленъ, гла́съ то́йже. Подо́бенъ: Ꙗ҆́кѡ нача́тки: Ꙗ҆́коже жи́знь тва́ри, тво́й крⷭ҇тъ предлежа́щїй, вселе́ннаѧ цѣлꙋ́етъ, Гдⷭ҇и, и҆ покланѧ́ющисѧ зове́тъ тѝ: тогѡ̀ дѣ́йствомъ, въ ми́рѣ глꙋбо́цѣ пою́щыѧ, и҆ воспѣва́ющыѧ тѧ̀ воздержа́нїемъ соблюдѝ, многоми́лостиве.
items.english_text: Having enlightened our souls by self-control, let us bow down in worship before the saving Cross upon which Christ was nailed, and let us cry aloud unto Him: Rejoice, sweetness of them that fast, and sure helper; rejoice, destroyer of passions, fellow-warrior of the faithful; rejoice, blessed Wood!

items.slavonic_text: Бг҃оро́диченъ, гла́съ то́йже: Ра́дꙋйсѧ, А҆́гг҃ломъ ра́дость мі́ра прїи́мшаѧ: ра́дꙋйсѧ, ро́ждшаѧ Творца̀ твоего̀ и҆ Гдⷭ҇а, ра́дꙋйсѧ, сподо́бльшаѧсѧ бы́ти Мт҃и Бж҃їа.
items.english_text: *Theotokion, Podoben:* As an unshakable foundation of the faith and an honorable gift unto our souls, we faithful magnify the Theotokos in hymns: Rejoice, thou who in thy womb didst contain the Rock of Life; rejoice, hope of the ends of the earth, helper of the afflicted; rejoice, Bride unwedded!

items.english_text: As the life of creation, the inhabited earth kisses Thy Cross set forth, O Lord, and bowing down in worship it cries unto Thee: By its operation, keep in profound peace them that sing of Thee and that praise Thee in self-control, O Many-Merciful One!

items.english_text: *Troparion:* Who will not weep aloud for thee? Who will not mourn for thee, O my soul, that desirest evil things and seekest not good things with love, ever despising the righteous Judge Who is longsuffering toward thee?

items.slavonic_text: Кто̀ не возрыда́етъ тѧ̀; кто̀ не воспла́четъ тѧ̀ дꙋшѐ, жела́ющꙋю лꙋка́ваѧ, и҆ не взыска́ющꙋю любо́вїю бл҃ги́хъ, пра́веднаго Сꙋдїю̀ презира́ющꙋю при́снѡ, долготерпѧ́щаго на тебѣ̀;
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* Having become flesh without change, O Virgin, thou didst bear Christ; Whom do thou fervently pray to transform from fleshly passions them that bow down before the Cross which He endured in the flesh.

items.slavonic_text: И҆́ный, гла́съ то́йже. І҆рмо́съ: Ви́дите: Ви́дите ви́дите, ꙗ҆́кѡ а҆́зъ є҆́смь Бг҃ъ, вселе́ннѣй крⷭ҇тъ мо́й подаѧ́й ѻ҆рꙋ́жїе спасе́нїѧ, во є҆́же ны́нѣ поклони́тисѧ є҆мꙋ̀: ꙗ҆́кѡ да цѣлꙋ́ющїи є҆го̀ ᲂу҆пражнѧ́ютъ вра́жїѧ кова́рства.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Great art Thou, O Lord, Many-Merciful, for Thou hast granted us now to bow down before Thy life-creating Cross, where Thy hands and feet were nailed, and upon which the Blood was poured forth from Thy most pure side, welling forth life unto us.

items.slavonic_text: Трⷪ҇ченъ: Пресоверше́ннаѧ Е҆ди́нице, пребж҃е́ственнаѧ, трїѷпоста́снаѧ, нерожде́нне Ѻ҆́ч҃е, и҆ Сн҃е є҆диноро́дне, Дш҃е ѿ Ѻ҆ц҃а̀ и҆сходѧ́й, Сн҃омъ же ꙗ҆влѧ́ѧйсѧ, Сꙋщество̀ є҆ди́но и҆ є҆стество̀, Гдⷭ҇тво, Црⷭ҇тво, спасѝ всѣ́хъ на́съ.
items.english_text: All-perfect Unity, transcendent in Godhead, in three Hypostases, unbegotten Father, and only-begotten Son, Spirit proceeding from the Father and made manifest through the Son: one Essence and Nature, Lordship, Kingdom, save us all!

items.slavonic_text: Бг҃оро́диченъ: Неизглаго́ланное чꙋ́до твоегѡ̀ Ржⷭ҇тва̀ Мт҃и Дв҃о: ка́кѡ бо и҆ ражда́еши, и҆ чиста̀ є҆сѝ въ то́мже; ка́кѡ Ѻ҆троча̀ ражда́еши, и҆ не вѣ́си и҆скꙋ́са мꙋ́жеска ѿню́дъ; ꙗ҆́коже вѣ́сть па́че є҆стества̀, ѿ менѐ новолѣ́пнѡ Сло́во Бж҃їе ро́ждшееся.
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* Unutterable is the wonder of thy Nativity, O Virgin Mother! For how dost thou both give birth, and yet remain pure therein? How dost thou bear an Infant, and knowest not a man at all? As the Word of God, newly born from me, knows above nature.

items.slavonic_text: Бл҃гослови́мъ Ѻ҆ц҃а̀, и҆ Сн҃а, и҆ ст҃а́гѡ Дх҃а, Гдⷭ҇а. Е҆ди́нъ Бг҃ъ ᲂу҆́бѡ Трⷪ҇ца, ни Ѻ҆ц҃ꙋ̀ и҆зстꙋпи́вшꙋ въ сн҃о́вство, нижѐ Сн҃ꙋ премѣни́вшꙋся во и҆схожде́нїе: но сво́йственнаѧ, и҆ ѻ҆́бое, свѣ́тъ, Бг҃а, трѝ сла́влю во вѣ́ки.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* One God is the Trinity: neither has the Father passed into Sonship, nor has the Son changed into procession; but as distinct Persons, yet Both, Light, God, I glorify the Three unto all ages.

provenance.verbatim_source:

items.slavonic_text: Сла́ва тебѣ̀ Бж҃е на́шъ, сла́ва тебѣ̀. Слѣпа́го ѿ рождества̀ ѡ҆чи́стилъ є҆сѝ сло́вомъ, ѡ҆слѣпле̑нныѧ моѧ̑ серде̑чныѧ ѻ҆́чи па́ки ѿве́рзи, да ᲂу҆зрю̀ свѣ́тъ повелѣ́нїй твои́хъ Хрⷭ҇тѐ во вѣ́ки.
items.english_text: Thou alone dost incorruptibly give birth, thou alone dost nurse an Infant without wedlock, thou alone dost bear thy Creator and Master; though both Mother and handmaid, we sing of thee, O Virgin Mother, unto all ages.

items.english_text: *Troparion:* Thou didst heal by a word the man born blind;[^751] open again my blinded eyes of the heart, that I may behold the light of Thy commandments, O Christ, unto all ages.

items.english_text: As Thy Ewe-lamb stood beside the Cross, O Jesus, beholding her Shepherd and Master, she wept bitterly, and her womb was moved within her concerning Thee, O Christ, and she cried aloud: What strange sight is this?[^756] O Life, how diest Thou?

items.slavonic_text: На стїхо́внѣ самогла́сенъ днѐ, два́жды, гла́съ и҃: Велерѣ́чивагѡ Фарїсе́а, ѿ возноше́нїя помышля́ющи дꙋшѐ моѧ̀ ѡ҆сꙋжде́нїе, и҆ смиренномꙋ́драгѡ мытаря̀, и҆сповѣ́данїемъ прегрѣше́нїй, позна́вши ѡ҆правда́нїе: бл҃га́гѡ ᲂу҆́бѡ ѿложи́ти потщи́ся ѿ добродѣ́тели дерзнове́нїе: ѕла́гѡ же прїя́ти, ꙗ҆̀же согрѣши́ла є҆сѝ, и҆сповѣда́нїе, воздви́гнися, не смири́тельнꙋю себѣ̀ приложа́ющи мѣростра́стїемъ высотꙋ̀, ѿ Хрⷭ҇та̀ и҆мꙋ́щагѡ ве́лїю ми́лость.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* As Thou didst save Manasseh when he repented, O God,[^757] save me also who repent bitterly with tears, and turn not away Thy servant; for I have turned aside my soul, like that Israel of old, living all my days in fornication.

items.english_text: Reflecting, O my soul, upon the condemnation of the vainglorious Pharisee due to his haughtiness, and recognizing the justification of the humble-minded Publican through the confession of offenses: make haste to lay aside the bold confidence derived from virtue as though it were good, and arise to accept the confession of the evil things thou hast sinned, not adding haughtiness unto thyself through passion, from Christ Who has great mercy!

items.preceding_stichos: Verse:* Bless our God, ye nations!

items.english_text: O Lord my God, I will glorify Thee, I will sing praise unto Thy Name; for Thou hast done marvelous things, even Thine ancient and true counsel. So be it, O Lord! For Thou hast made cities a heap of dust, even strong cities, so that their foundations should fall: the city of the ungodly shall never be built. Therefore shall the poor people bless Thee, and the cities of wronged men shall praise Thee. For Thou hast been a helper unto every humble city, and a shelter unto them that faint through want; Thou shalt deliver them from evil men, a shelter of them that thirst, and the spirit of wronged men. As faint-hearted men thirsting in Zion, even so shalt Thou deliver them from ungodly men to whom Thou didst deliver us. And the Lord of hosts shall make a feast for all the nations: upon this mountain they shall drink joy, they shall drink wine; they shall be anointed with myrrh upon this mountain. Give all these things unto the nations; for this is the counsel upon all the nations. Death swallowed up having prevailed; and again the Lord God has taken away every tear from every face: He has taken away the reproach of His people from all the earth, for the mouth of the Lord has spoken [these things]. And in that day they shall say: Lo, our God, on Whom we have hoped, and He will save us; this is the Lord, we have waited for Him, and we have rejoiced and been glad in our salvation.[^761]

Подо́бенъ: Всѐ ѿло́жше: Посредѣ̀ землѝ претерпѣ́лъ є҆сѝ крⷭ҇тъ и҆ Стрⷭ҇ть Ще́дре, * всѣ̑мъ безстра́стїе и҆ и҆збавле́нїе подаѧ̀, * преполовле́нїемъ дне́сь посто́въ: * сегѡ̀ ра́ди всѝ въ поклоне́нїе тогѡ̀ предлага́емъ, * и҆ ра́достнѡ ѡ҆блобыза́емъ, * ви́дѣти твоѧ̑ Стрⷭ҇ти, и҆ живоно́сное Воскрⷭ҇нїе, * просвѣще́ни бж҃е́ственными добродѣ́тельми, * Сло́ве Бж҃їй, да сподо́бимсѧ всѝ, * є҆ди́не Многомлⷭ҇тиве.
items.english_text: In the midst of the earth Thou didst endure the Cross and Passion, O Compassionate One, granting dispassion and deliverance unto all at this mid-point of the fast; therefore we all set it forth for veneration and joyfully kiss it, that, enlightened by divine virtues, we all may be accounted worthy, O Word of God, to behold Thy Passion and Thy life-bearing Resurrection, O only Abundantly Merciful One.

Подо́бенъ: Дре́вле Мѡѷсе́й: Вто́же дре́вле Мѡѷсе́й прошкра́жь дла́ньма свои́ма, * побѣжда́ше А҆мали́ка, * вели́кїй крⷭ҇тъ дне́сь, * пред̾ ѻ҆чи́ма на́шима зрѧ́ще лю́дїе предлежи́мый стра́шнѡ, * прикосне́мсѧ чистото́ю, ᲂу҆мо́мъ же и҆ ᲂу҆стна́ма: * на не́мъ бо Хрⷭ҇то́съ вознесе́сѧ ᲂу҆мертви́вый сме́рть, * и҆ таковы́ѧ бл҃года́ти всѝ сподо́бившесѧ, * пѣ́сньми бг҃одꙋхнове́нными всѣ́хъ Сп҃са пѣсносло́вѧще, * мо́лимсѧ дости́гнꙋти и҆ са́мое спаси́тельное Воскрⷭ҇нїе.
items.english_text: Thou wast stretched out dead upon the Cross and pierced with a spear, and given gall to drink, O Long-suffering One, Who by the hand of Moses didst turn the waters of Marah into sweetness; therefore I pray Thee and entreat Thee: drive away the most bitter passions from my mind, and sweetening my intellect with the honey of repentance, show me forth as a venerator of Thy precious Passion.

items.slavonic_text: Держа́ва непобори́маѧ хрⷭ҇тїа́нѡмъ на́мъ даде́ся крⷭ҇тъ тво́й Сп҃се на́шъ, * И҆́мже и҆ноплеме́нныхъ ꙗ҆зы́кѡвъ побѣжда́ютсѧ мно́жества, * и҆ ми́ръ Цр҃кви твое́й Хрⷭ҇тѐ ѡ҆сѣнѧ́етъ, * правосла́вѧщей до́брѣ, * є҆го́же ны́нѣ цѣлꙋ́юще, тебѣ̀ те́плѣ взыва́емъ: * ча́сти сподо́би и҆ на́съ ст҃ы́хъ твои́хъ.
items.english_text: That great Cross which of old Moses prefigured by stretching forth his hands, overcoming Amalek, we people today, beholding it fearfully set forth before our eyes, let us touch it with purity, both in mind and with lips; for upon it Christ was lifted up, putting death to death, and having all been accounted worthy of such grace, praising the Savior of all with divinely inspired hymns, we pray that we may attain also unto His saving Resurrection itself.

items.slavonic_text: Слеза́ми ѡ҆чи́стивше дꙋше́внаѧ чꙋ́вства, * и҆ посто́мъ ѡ҆чи́стившесѧ, * прїиди́те поклони́мсѧ крⷭ҇тномꙋ дре́вꙋ, * и҆́мже ᲂу҆пражнѧ́ютсѧ дꙋшетлѣ́нныѧ пло́ти воздержа́нїемъ взыгра̑нїа, * Распе́ншемꙋсѧ зовꙋ́ще: * твоегѡ̀ Сп҃се, сподо́би тридне́внагѡ Воста́нїа поклони́тисѧ сїѧ́нїю.
items.english_text: Having cleansed the senses of the soul with tears, and having purified ourselves by fasting, come, let us bow down before the Tree of the Cross, whereby the soul-corrupting uprisings of the flesh are brought to naught through self-restraint, crying unto Him Who was crucified: Account us worthy, O Savior, to bow down before the radiant brightness of Thy three-day Arising!

items.english_text: Today the Master of creation and the Lord of glory is nailed to the Cross and pierced in the side; He Who is the Sweetness of the Church tastes gall and vinegar; He Who covers the heavens with clouds is compassed with a crown of thorns; He is clothed in a garment of mockery and smitten with a hand of clay, He Who fashioned man with His hand; He Who covers the heavens with clouds is beaten upon His shoulders; He receives spitting and wounds, reproaches and buffetings, and endures all things for the sake of me, the condemned one, my Deliverer and God, that He might save the world from deception, in that He is tenderhearted!

items.english_text: God spoke unto Noah and unto his sons with him, saying: Lo, I establish My covenant with you, and with your seed after you; and with every living soul that is with you, of the birds, and of the cattle, and with all the wild beasts of the earth, as many as [are] with you, of all that went out of the ark. And I will establish My covenant with you; and all flesh shall die no more by the water of a flood, and there shall be no more a flood of waters to destroy the whole earth. And the Lord God said unto Noah: This is the token of the covenant which I give between Me and you, and between every living soul that is with you, unto perpetual generations: I do set My bow in the cloud, and it shall be for a token of an [everlasting] covenant between Me and the earth. And it shall come to pass, when I bring clouds over the earth, that My bow shall appear in the cloud; and I will remember My covenant which is between Me and you, and between every living soul in all flesh; and the water shall no more become a flood to destroy all flesh. And My bow shall be in the cloud, and I will look upon it, that I may remember the everlasting covenant between Me and the earth, and between every living soul in all flesh that is upon the earth. And God said unto Noah: This is the token of the covenant which I have established between Me and all flesh that is upon the earth.[^770]

items.english_text: The mouth of the prudent is praised by a man; but the fainthearted is held in derision. Better is a man in dishonor serving himself, than he that confers honor upon himself and lacks bread. A righteous man has compassion upon the lives of his beasts; but the tender mercies of the wicked are cruel. He that tills his land shall be filled with bread; but they that pursue vanity are void of understanding. He that finds sweetness in tarrying at wine shall leave dishonor in his own strongholds. The desires of the ungodly are evil, but the roots of the godly are in strong places. Through the sin of his lips a sinner falls into snares, but the righteous man escapes from them. He that looks gently shall obtain mercy; but he that contends in the gates will grieve souls. From the fruits of the mouth a man's soul shall be filled with good things, and the recompense of his lips shall be given unto him. The ways of fools are right before them, but the wise man listens to counsel. A fool presently declares his sin, but a prudent man conceals his own dishonor. A righteous man proclaims the open truth, but a deceitful witness is unjust. There are some who, speaking, wound like swords, but the tongues of the wise heal. True lips establish testimony, but a hasty witness has an unjust tongue. Deceit is in the heart of him that plots evil, but they that desire peace shall rejoice. Nothing unjust is pleasing unto the righteous, but the ungodly shall be filled with evil. Lying lips are an abomination unto the Lord, but he that acts faithfully is acceptable unto Him.[^772]

items.slavonic_text: въ свои́хъ тверды́няхъ ѡ҆ста́витъ безче́стїе. * Жела́нїа нечести́выхъ ѕла̀, * коре́нїе же бл҃гочести́выхъ въ тве́рдостехъ. * За грѣ́хъ ᲂу҆сте́нъ впа́даетъ въ сѣ̑ти грѣ́шникъ: * и҆збѣга́етъ же ѿ ни́хъ пра́ведникъ. * Сматрѧ́ѧй кро́ткѡ, поми́лованъ бꙋ́детъ: * а҆ срѣта́ѧй во вратѣ́хъ, ѡ҆скорби́тъ дꙋшы. * Ѿ плодѡ́въ ᲂу҆́стъ дꙋша̀ мꙋ́жа напо́лнитсѧ бл҃ги́хъ: * воздаѧ́нїе же ᲂу҆сте́нъ є҆гѡ̀ возда́стсѧ є҆мꙋ̀. * Пꙋтїѐ безꙋ́мныхъ пра́ви пред̾ ни́ми: * послꙋ́шаетъ совѣ́тѡвъ мꙋ́дрый. * Безꙋ́мный а҆́бїе и҆сповѣ́сть грѣ́хъ сво́й: * кры́етъ же своѐ безче́стїе хи́трый. * Ꙗ҆вле́ннꙋю вѣ́рꙋ возвѣща́етъ пра́ведный: * свидѣ́тель же непра́ведныхъ льсти́въ. * Сꙋ́ть, и҆̀же глаго́люще, ᲂу҆язвлѧ́ютъ а҆́ки мечѝ: * ꙗ҆зы́цы же премꙋ́дрыхъ и҆сцѣлѧ́ютъ. * Оу҆стнѣ̀ и҆́стинны и҆справлѧ́ютъ свидѣ́тельство: * свидѣ́тель же ско́ръ ꙗ҆зы́къ и҆́мать непра́веденъ. * Ле́сть въ се́рдцѣ кꙋю́щагѡ ѕла̑ѧ: * хотѧ́щїи же ми́ра возвеселѧ́тсѧ. * Ничто́же непра́ведное ᲂу҆го́дно є҆́сть пра́ведному: * нечести́вїи же и҆спо́лнѧтсѧ ѕлы́хъ. * Ме́рзость Гдⷭ҇ви ᲂу҆стнѣ̀ лжи̑ви: * творѧ́й же вѣ́рнѡ прїѧ́тенъ є҆мꙋ̀.

items.english_text: Surpassing the Publican in offenses, I do not emulate his repentance; and having acquired none of the righteous deeds of the Pharisee, I imitate his haughtiness; but O Christ our God, Who by the transcendence of Thy humility didst cast down demonic pride upon the Cross: alienate me from the malice of the former and from the madness of the latter, establishing the good purpose of them both within my soul, and save me!

items.slavonic_text: Сла́ва, и҆ ны́нѣ: самогла́сенъ, гла́съ є҃: Зрѧ́щи тѧ̀ тва́рь всѧ̀ на крⷭ҇тѣ̀ на́га ви́сѧща, * Содѣ́телѧ и҆ Зижди́телѧ всѣ́хъ, * и҆змѣнѧ́шесѧ стра́хомъ и҆ рыда́ше: * сл҃нце же свѣ́тъ ѡ҆мрачѝ, и҆ землѧ̀ колеба́шесѧ, * ка́менїе же разсѣда́шесѧ, и҆ хра́ма свѣ́тлость раздира́шесѧ, * ме́ртвїи воста́ша ѿ грѡ́бѡвъ, * и҆ а҆́ггльскїѧ Си́лы ᲂу҆жасо́шасѧ глаго́люще: * Ѽ чꙋдесѐ! * Сꙋдїа̀ сꙋ́дитсѧ, и҆ стра́ждетъ хотѧ̀, * за спасенїе мі́ра и҆ ѡ҆бновле́нїе.
items.english_text: Beholding Thee hanging naked upon the Cross, the Author and Creator of all, all creation changed with fear and lamented; the sun darkened its light and the earth quaked, the rocks were split and the radiant veil of the temple was rent in twain; the dead arose from the graves, and the angelic Hosts were struck with dread, crying aloud: O the wonder! The Judge is judged and willingly suffers for the salvation and renewal of the world!

items.english_text: Sanctifying the time of fasting, the divine and most honorable Cross lies forth for veneration; let us draw near with a pure conscience, let us draw forth sanctification and enlightenment, and with fear let us cry aloud: O Lover of mankind, our Savior, glory to Thy tenderhearted compassion! *(Twice)*

items.slavonic_text: Сла́ва тебѣ̀ Бж҃е на́шъ, сла́ва тебѣ̀. Грѧды́й прикоснꙋ́тисѧ тебѣ̀ живоно́сный крⷭ҇те, * ᲂу҆жаса́юсѧ ꙗ҆зы́комъ и҆ мы́слїю, прови́дѧ, * ꙗ҆́кѡ на тебѣ̀ и҆злїѧ́сѧ Гдⷭ҇а моегѡ̀ бж҃е́ственнаѧ кро́вь.
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* The angelic ranks sing of thee, blessed all-hymned Theotokos and Virgin; with them we the human race now glorify thee as unwedded bride.

provenance.verbatim_source:

items.slavonic_text: Сѣда́льны, гла́съ ѕ҃. Самогла́сны: Дне́сь проро́ческое и҆спо́лнисѧ сло́во: * Сѐ бо покланѧ́емсѧ на мѣ́сто, и҆дѣ́же стоѧ́стѣ но́зѣ твоѝ Гдⷭ҇и, * и҆ дре́ва спасе́нїа вкꙋси́вше, * грѣхо́вныхъ страсте́й свобо́дꙋ ᲂу҆лꙋчи́хомъ, * моли́твами Бцⷣы, є҆ди́не человѣколю́бче.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Coming to touch thee, O life-bearing Cross, I am filled with dread in tongue and mind, perceiving that upon thee the divine blood of my Lord was poured out.

provenance.verbatim_source:

items.slavonic_text: Сла́ва: Крⷭ҇тъ тво́й Гдⷭ҇и, ѡ҆ст҃и́сѧ, * въ не́мъ бо быва́ютъ и҆сцѣле́нїа болѧ́щымъ во грѣсѣ́хъ, * и҆́мже тебѣ̀ припа́даемъ, поми́лꙋй на́съ.
items.english_text: *Heirmos:* *Establish, O Lord, Thy Church, which Thou hast acquired by the power of Thy Cross, whereby Thou didst conquer the enemy, and hast enlightened the universe.*

items.slavonic_text: Пѣ́снь д҃. І҆рмо́съ: Сѣдѧ́й во сла́вѣ: Воѡбража́ѧ зна́менїе крⷭ҇та̀, рꙋ́цѣ простира́ше премѣне́нїемъ, * внꙋ́чата дре́вле І҆а́кѡвъ сла́вный бл҃гословлѧ́ѧ, * и҆ зна́менꙋѧ сп҃си́тельное бл҃гослове́нїе, * на всѣ́хъ на́съ приходѧ́щее.
items.english_text: Today the prophetic word is fulfilled: For lo, we bow down at the place where Thy feet stood, O Lord; and having tasted of the Tree of salvation, we have obtained freedom from sinful passions, through the intercessions of the Theotokos, O only Lover of mankind!

provenance.verbatim_source: Today the prophetic word is fulfilled: For lo, we bow down at the place where Thy feet stood, O Lord; and having tasted of the Tree of salvation, we have obtained freedom from sinful passions, through the intercessions of the Theotokos, O only Lover of mankind!

items.slavonic_text: Спаси́тельное тѧ̀ ѻ҆рꙋ́жїе, непобѣди́мꙋю побѣ́дꙋ, * ра́дости зна́менїе, и҆́мже сме́рть ᲂу҆мертви́сѧ, ѡ҆б̾и́мемъ, * сла́вою ᲂу҆краша́ющесѧ на тебѣ̀ Пригвозди́вшагѡсѧ, * крⷭ҇тѐ всечⷭ҇тный.
items.english_text: Thy Cross, O Lord, is sanctified, for in it healings take place for them that are sick in sins; falling down before it, we cry unto Thee: Have mercy upon us!

provenance.verbatim_source: Thy Cross, O Lord, is sanctified, for in it healings take place for them that are sick in sins; falling down before it, we cry unto Thee: Have mercy upon us!

items.slavonic_text: Бг҃оро́диченъ: Ви́димый мно́ю, неви́димь бы́лъ є҆сѝ а҆́гглѡмъ непристꙋ́пный, * І҆и҃се Сп҃се мо́й, пло́ть ѿ менѐ заимова́вый, * и҆ ны́нѣ зрѧ́щи тѧ̀ на дре́вѣ пригвожде́на, * рыда́ю, Хрⷭ҇то́ва Мт҃и глаго́лаше.
items.english_text: No sooner was the Tree of Thy Cross set up, O Christ, than the foundations of death were shaken, O Lord; for whom Hades swallowed with greed, it let go in trembling; Thou hast shown forth Thy salvation unto us, O Holy One, and we glorify Thee, O Savior God: have mercy upon us!

items.slavonic_text: Пѣ́снь є҃. І҆рмо́съ: Оу҆жасо́шасѧ: Ме́ртвъ бы́лъ є҆сѝ на крⷭ҇тѣ̀ пригвожда́емь, * всѣ̑мъ сы́й жи́знь и҆ спасенїе: * сегѡ̀ ᲂу҆́бѡ да́рꙋй, ѡ҆чище́нною дꙋше́ю Сп҃се, на́мъ ѡ҆б̾ѧ́ти, * и҆ твоѧ̑ Стрⷭ҇ти сп҃си̑тельныѧ ви́дѣти ра́дꙋющымсѧ.
items.english_text: *Ode 5. Heirmos: "All things were astounded" (Оу҆жасо́шасѧ):*[^788] Thou wast made dead being nailed upon the Cross, Who art the life and salvation of all; grant unto us therefore, O Savior, with purified soul to embrace it, and rejoicing to behold Thy saving Passion.

items.slavonic_text: Предстоѧ́тъ чи́нове тебѣ̀ безпло́тныхъ трепе́щꙋще, * дре́во живогода́тельное: * на тебѣ́ бо чⷭ҇тнꙋ́ю кро́вь свою̀ Хрⷭ҇то́съ и҆злїѧ̀, * лꙋча̀ и҆спꙋща́ѧ и҆здале́ча, * вѣ̑рнымъ носѧ̀ па́гꙋбꙋ безконе́чнꙋю.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* The ranks of bodiless angels stand before thee trembling, O lifegiving Tree; for upon thee Christ poured forth His precious blood, flashing rays afar, bringing endless destruction upon the demons.[^789]

items.english_text: *Troparion:* Wounded by the weapon of the enemy, heal me with Thy blood, O Word, and with the spear speedily tear up the handwriting of my sins, O Savior, as I cry unto Thee: Inscribe me in the books of the saved, in that Thou art tenderhearted!

items.slavonic_text: Бг҃оро́диченъ: Гро́здъ зрѣ́лый, ка́кѡ на дре́вѣ ѡ҆бвѣ́сился є҆сѝ; * Со́лнце сла́вы, ка́кѡ вза́лсѧ є҆сѝ, * сїѧ́нїе со́лнца ѡ҆мрача́ѧ Сп҃се Стрⷭ҇тїю твое́ю; * ро́ждшаѧ тѧ̀ А҆́гница, дре́вле вопїѧ́ше тѝ, мл҃трски восклица́ющи.
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* O ripe cluster, how art Thou suspended upon the Tree? O Sun of glory, how art Thou eclipsed, darkening the light of the sun by Thy Passion, O Savior? the Ewe-lamb who bore Thee of old cried unto Thee, crying aloud with maternal sorrow.

items.english_text: *Ode 6. Heirmos: "Prefiguring the three-day burial" (Возопѝ, прошбража́ѧ):*[^790] Being set up, thou didst shake the dwelling of Hades, but hast become an unshakable confirmation unto the faithful, a sure shelter, O all-honorable Cross of the Lord!

Idiomelon:*[^791] No longer does the flaming sword guard the gate of Eden, for upon it has come a marvelous bond, the Tree of the Cross; the sting of death and the victory of Hades have been driven away, for Thou didst appear, O my Savior, crying unto them in Hades: Enter ye again into Paradise!

items.slavonic_text: І҆́косъ: Трѝ крⷭ҇ты̀ водрꙋзѝ на Голго́ѳѣ Пїла́тъ, * два̀ разбо́йникѡвъ, и҆ є҆ди́нъ Жизнода́вца, * є҆го́же ви́дѣ а҆́дъ, и҆ речѐ сꙋ́щымъ до́лѣ: * Ѽ слꙋгѝ моѝ, и҆ си̑лы моѧ̑! * кто̀ водрꙋзи́въ гво́здїе въ се́рдце моѐ, * древя́нымъ мѧ̀ копїе́мъ внеза́пꙋ прободѐ; * и҆ растерза́юсѧ, внꙋ́тренними мои́ми болю̀, ᲂу҆тро́бою ᲂу҆ѧзвлѧ́юсѧ, * чꙋ́вства моѧ̑ смꙋща́ютъ дꙋ́хъ мо́й, * и҆ понꙋжда́юсѧ и҆зры́гати А҆да́ма, и҆ сꙋ́щыѧ ѿ А҆да́ма, дре́вомъ да̑нныѧ мѝ: * дре́во бо сїѧ̑ вво́дитъ па́ки въ ра́й.
items.english_text: *Ikos:*[^792] Pilate set up three crosses upon Golgotha, two of the robbers, and one of the Giver of life; whom Hades beheld and said unto them below: O my servants and my powers! Who has driven nails into my heart, and suddenly pierced me with a wooden spear? And I am torn asunder, I am in pain within my inward parts, my bowels are wounded, my senses trouble my spirit, and I am compelled to cast forth Adam and them that came from Adam, who were given unto me through a tree; for a Tree leads these again into Paradise!

items.slavonic_text: Пѣ́снь з҃. І҆рмо́съ: Не послꙋжи́ша тва́ри: Сѣки́ра, ю҆́же Є҆лїссе́й взѧ̀ ѿ І҆ѻрда́на Хрⷭ҇тѐ, * крⷭ҇тъ ꙗ҆влѧ́ше, * и҆́мже и҆з̾ глꙋбины̀ сꙋетїа ꙗ҆зы́ки и҆звле́клъ є҆сѝ, * воспѣва́ющыѧ: * Ѻ҆ц҃е́въ Гдⷭ҇ь и҆ Бг҃ъ бл҃гослове́нъ є҆сѝ.

items.english_text: *Troparion:* Heavenly things rejoice with earthly things at the veneration of thy Cross; for through thee, O all-powerful one, a union was made for angels and men, crying aloud: Blessed art Thou, O Lord God!

items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́кѡ кѷпари́съ милосе́рдїе, * ꙗ҆́кѡ ке́дръ же вѣ́рꙋ бл҃гово́ннꙋю, * ꙗ҆́кѡ пе́вка и҆́стиннꙋю любо́вь приносѧ́ще, * Гдⷭ҇ню крⷭ҇тꙋ̀ поклони́мсѧ, * на не́мъ сла́вѧще И҆зба́вителѧ пригвозди́вшагосѧ.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Bringing compassion like cypress, fragrant faith like cedar, and true love like pine, let us bow down before the Cross of the Lord, glorifying upon it the Deliverer Who was nailed thereon.

items.slavonic_text: Бг҃оро́диченъ: Не поколеба́въ нб҃наѧ, во ᲂу҆тро́бꙋ твою̀ Бг҃ъ всели́сѧ, * Гра́де Бж҃їй и҆збра́нный: * на крⷭ҇тѣ́ же ви́сѧ, тва́рь поколеба̀, * Є҆го́же молѝ на недви́жимомъ ка́мени Є҆гѡ̀, * мнѣ̀ соблюсти́сѧ.
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* Without shaking the heavens, God took up His abode within thy womb, O chosen City of God; but hanging upon the Cross He shook creation; pray Him that I may be kept upon His immovable rock.

І҆рмо́съ: Ѻ҆́троки бл҃гочести̑выѧ: Просте́рлъ є҆сѝ рꙋ́цѣ на дре́вѣ, * рꙋкѝ не겮держи̑мыѧ разрѣша́ѧ грѣ́хъ: * копїе́мъ же проколо́лсѧ є҆сѝ, * си́мъ борца̀ ᲂу҆ѧзвлѧ́ѧ Гдⷭ҇и: * же́лчи же вкꙋси́лъ є҆сѝ, сла́стнꙋю ѕло́бꙋ и҆зима́ѧ, * ѻ҆́цтомъ напои́лсѧ є҆сѝ, всѣ́хъ Весе́лїе.
items.english_text: *Ode 8. Heirmos: "The pious youths" (Ѻ҆́троки бл҃гочести̑выѧ):*[^794] Thou didst stretch forth Thy hands upon the Tree, loosing the sin of unrestrained hands; and Thou wast pierced with a spear, wounding the adversary thereby, O Lord; Thou didst taste gall, taking away sensual malice, and wast given vinegar to drink, O Gladness of all!

items.english_text: *Troparion:* Drawing near with pure mind and bright conscience, let us bow down: the precious and holy Tree lies forth, whereby Christ brought about dishonorable death, placing the highest honor upon them that were grievously dishonored by transgression.

items.slavonic_text: Дре́вомъ грѣха̀ ᲂу҆мертви́хсѧ, * и҆ вкꙋше́нїемъ сла́стнымъ погребо́хсѧ, * ѡ҆живѝ мѧ Гдⷭ҇и, воздви́гни мѧ̀ лежа́щаго, * покло́нника ꙗ҆вѝ Стрⷭ҇те́й твои́хъ, * и҆ прича́стника воста́нїа бж҃е́ственнагѡ, * и҆ наслѣ́дника возлюби́вшихъ тѧ̀.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* By the tree of sin I was put to death, and by sensual tasting I was buried; revive me, O Lord, raise me up as I lie, show me forth as a venerator of Thy Passions, a partaker of Thy divine Resurrection, and an heir of them that love Thee!

items.slavonic_text: Бг҃оро́диченъ: Вознесе́на тѧ̀ ви́дѧщи, * ни добро́ты въ стра́сти, ни ви́да и҆мꙋ́ща: * є҆го́же воплоще́нна разꙋмѣ́хъ, краснѣ́йша па́че сынѡ́въ человѣ́ческихъ, * тѧ̀ Е҆диноро́дный Сн҃е, * всечи́стаѧ вопїѧ́ше Дв҃а: покажѝ твою̀ сла́вꙋ, всѣ́хъ спасенїе.
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* Beholding Thee lifted up, having neither beauty nor form in Thy Passion, Whom when incarnate I knew to be fairer than the sons of men, Thee, O Only-begotten Son, the all-pure Virgin cried aloud: Show forth Thy glory, the salvation of all!

І҆рмо́съ: За зако́ны ѻ҆те́ческїѧ: Въ полꙋ́дни распе́ншꙋсѧ тебѣ̀ посредѣ̀ землѝ во́лею, * мі́рскїѧ концы̀ и҆з̾ среды̀ горта́ни ѕмі́евы и҆сто́рглъ є҆сѝ Ще́дре, * тѣ́мже въ сре́днюю седми́цꙋ бж҃е́ственныхъ посто́въ, * покланѧ́ющесѧ сла́вимъ чⷭ҇тный крⷭ҇тъ тво́й, * Гдⷭ҇а по́йте, вопїю́ще, и҆ превозноси́те во вѣ́ки.

items.slavonic_text: Ра́дости зна́менїе, ѻ҆рꙋ́жїе нерꙋши́мое, * Цр҃кве стѣ́но̀, мч҃нкѡвъ похвало̀, * а҆пⷭ҇лѡвъ ᲂу҆краше́нїе, а҆рхїере́євъ ᲂу҆твержде́нїе, * ᲂу҆крѣпи́въ и҆знемо́гшꙋю мою̀ дꙋ́шꙋ, * поклони́тисѧ сподо́би и҆ пѣ́ти тебѣ̀ вопїю́ща: * Гдⷭ҇а по́йте дѣла̀, и҆ превозноси́те во всѧ̑ вѣ́ки.
items.english_text: When Thou wast willingly crucified in the midst of the earth at midday, O Compassionate One, Thou didst snatch the ends of the world out of the serpent's maw; therefore, in this middle week of the divine fasts, we bow down and glorify Thy precious Cross, crying aloud: Sing unto the Lord, and exalt Him above all forever!

items.slavonic_text: Рыда́ю и҆ пла́чꙋ, * є҆гда̀ во ᲂу҆мѣ̀ мое́мъ прїимꙋ̀ сꙋди́ще немꙋ́тное, Долготерпѣли́ве, * ѡ҆сꙋжде́нъ сы́й, тѣ́мже пощадѝ мѧ, * и҆ ѡ҆тѧгче́нное бре́мѧ дꙋшѝ моеѧ̀ ѡ҆блегчѝ, да ра́дꙋѧсѧ зовꙋ̀: * Гдⷭ҇а по́йте дѣла̀, и҆ превозноси́те во всѧ̑ вѣ́ки.

items.slavonic_text: Бл҃гослови́мъ Ѻ҆ц҃а̀, и҆ Сн҃а, и҆ ст҃а́го Дх҃а, Гдⷭ҇а. Е҆ди́но въ тре́хъ начерта́нїихъ сꙋщество̀ сла́вѧ, * не слива́ю є҆диноли́чнѡ тре́хъ, * нижѐ пресѣка́ю зра́ка, Ѻ҆ц҃а̀, и҆ Сн҃а, со Дх҃омъ: * є҆ди́нъ бо над̾ всѣ́ми Бг҃ъ въ Трⷪ҇цѣ.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* This tripartite and great Cross, though small to the sight, is broader than the heavens by its power, ever leading men unto God; whereby let us bless Christ forever!

items.slavonic_text: І҆рмо́съ: Рꙋ́цѣ въ ро́въ ве́рженый львѡ́въ, * и҆ногда̀ вели́кїй во прⷪ҇ро́цѣхъ, * крⷭ҇тоѡбра́знѡ просте́ркъ Данїи́лъ, * неврежде́нъ ѿ си́хъ снѣ́ди спасе́ся, * бл҃гословѧ̀ Хрⷭ҇та̀ Бг҃а во вѣ́ки.
items.english_text: Glorifying one Essence in three hypostases, I do not merge the three into one person, nor do I divide the form: the Father, and the Son, with the Spirit; for one is God over all in Trinity.

items.slavonic_text: Го́ры сла́дость, хо́лми ра́дованїе, любо́вїю и҆ска́пайте: * древа́ же по́льскаѧ, лїва́нстїи ке́дри ликꙋ́йте, * поклоне́нїемъ дне́сь живоно́снагѡ крⷭ҇та̀, * прⷪ҇ро́цы, мꙋ́ченицы, а҆пⷭ҇ли, * и҆ пра́ведныхъ дꙋ́си взыгра́йте.
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* Thou alone among mothers hast been shown forth, O Virgin Bride of God Mary, who without a husband gavest birth unto the Savior Christ, preserving the seal of purity; thee do we men bless forever!

items.slavonic_text: Бг҃оро́диченъ: Манове́нїемъ твои́мъ коле́блеши ви́димый мі́ръ, * распина́емый, пребыва́еши же ви́симый, * Бцⷣа пла́чꙋщи глаго́лаше, * страстна́ѧ ᲂу҆мышле́нїа, первозда́ннагѡ Хрⷭ҇тѐ, потреби́ти хотѧ̀, * и҆ и҆сцѣли́ти тогѡ̀ сокрꙋше́нїе бл҃гостїю.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Let this all-holy Tree be honored, which the prophet of old cried out to put into the bread of Christ, by the Israelites who crucified Him, Whom we exalt above all unto all ages.[^797]

items.slavonic_text: И҆́ный. І҆рмо́съ: Недоꙋмѣ́етъ всѧ́къ: Є҆лїссе́й дре́вле и҆з̾ рѣкѝ сѣ́чиво влекі́й, * дре́вомъ тѧ̀ крⷭ҇те, живогода́тельное дре́во воѡбража́ше: * и҆́мже и҆звлечѐ и҆з̾ глꙋбины̀ Хрⷭ҇то́съ ꙗ҆зы́ки і҆́дѡльскагѡ бѣсова́нїа, * на тебѣ́ пригвозди́всѧ: * тѣ́мже покланѧ́ющесѧ тебѣ̀, держа́вꙋ є҆гѡ̀ сла́вимъ.
items.english_text: *Heirmos:* *Cast into the pit of lions, Daniel, once great among the prophets, stretching forth his hands crosswise, was preserved unhurt from being devoured by them, blessing Christ our God forever.*

Heirmos: "Let every earthborn mortal" (Всѧ́къ земноро́дный):*[^798] With a spear Thou openest Thy side, spreading forth unto me a fountain of forgiveness; and Thou wast nailed upon the Tree, setting aside condemnation through a Tree, in the midst of the earth, O Lover of mankind; which we now kiss at the mid-point of the fast, singing of Thy goodness.

items.english_text: Elisha of old, drawing the iron axe-head out of the river, prefigured thee, O Cross, the lifegiving Tree, through wood; whereby Christ, having been nailed upon thee, drew the nations out of the depth of demonic idolatry; therefore, bowing down before thee, we glorify His dominion.

items.slavonic_text: Со́лнечныѧ лꙋчы̀ Сп҃се, преложи́шасѧ ко тмꙋ̀, твои́мъ распѧ́тїемъ: * ѡ҆сїѧ́нїе же лꙋны̀ ᲂу҆га́се: * и҆ стїхі́и тре́петомъ и҆змѣнѧ́хꙋсѧ всѧ̑, тѣ́мже вопїю́ ти: * и҆змѣне́на мно́ю страсте́й помышлє́нїѧ моѧ̑, Сло́ве, * твое́ю десни́цею премѣни́въ просвѣтѝ, и҆ спасѝ мѧ̀.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* The sun's rays, O Savior, were turned into darkness by Thy Crucifixion, and the shining of the moon was quenched, and the elements were all changed with trembling; therefore I cry unto Thee: Having transformed and enlightened by Thy right hand my passionate thoughts changed by me, O Word, save me!

items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́звою твое́ю и҆сцѣлѝ дꙋшѝ моеѧ̀ стра̑сти, * ре́бръ твои́хъ провожде́нїемъ ᲂу҆ста́ви болѣ́зненнаѧ провождє́нїѧ вѣ́кѡвъ: * гвоздьми́ твои́ми Хрⷭ҇тѐ, и҆згвоздѝ сла̑стнаѧ и҆ стра̑стнаѧ похотѣ̑нїѧ, * пода́й ми безстра́стнѡ Стрⷭ҇те́мъ твои̑мъ чⷭ҇тны̑мъ поклони́тисѧ, и҆ Воскрⷭ҇нїю.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* By Thy wound heal the passions of my soul; by the piercing of Thy side stay the painful piercings of the ages; with Thy nails, O Christ, nail through my lustful and passionate desires; grant me without passion to bow down before Thy precious Sufferings and Resurrection!

items.slavonic_text: Бг҃оро́диченъ: Кра́снаго добро́тою, родила́ тѧ кра́снаѧ Ѻ҆трокови́ца, * є҆го́же зрѧ́щи ни добро́ты въ страда́нїи, * нижѐ ви́да и҆мꙋ́ща, Сп҃се, рыда́ющи гла́ше: * дивлю́сѧ па́че ᲂу҆ма̀ Сн҃е мо́й, твоемꙋ̀ смире́нїю, * и҆́мже спаса́еши смири́вшеесѧ є҆стество̀ человѣ́ческое.
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* The fair Maiden gave birth unto Thee Who art fair in beauty; Whom beholding in suffering having neither form nor beauty, O Savior, weeping she said: Beyond understanding, O my Son, I marvel at Thy humility, whereby Thou savest humbled human nature!

items.slavonic_text: Сла́ва тебѣ̀ Бж҃е на́шъ, сла́ва тебѣ̀. Ски́петре бж҃е́ственный цр҃кве крⷭ҇те, * во́инства мꙋ́жество, во ᲂу҆пова́нїи твое́мъ ра́тники побѣжда́емъ: * побѣ̑ды при́снѡ тебѣ̀ кла́нѧющымсѧ на ва́рвары пода́ждь на́мъ.
items.english_text: In three Persons, in one Essence, I bow down before Thee, O Holy Godhead: the Father, and the Son, with the Holy Spirit: one Principle, one Kingdom, holding dominion over all!

provenance.verbatim_source: In three Persons, in one Essence, I bow down before Thee, O Holy Godhead: the Father, and the Son, with the Holy Spirit: one Principle, one Kingdom, holding dominion over all!

items.slavonic_text: І҆рмо́съ: Ѡ҆ Мт҃и Дв҃о, и҆ Бцⷣе нело́жнаѧ, ро́ждшаѧ безсѣ́меннѡ Хрⷭ҇та̀ Бг҃а на́шего, на крⷭ҇тъ возне́сшагосѧ пло́тїю: * тѧ̀ вѣ́рнїи всѝ досто́йнѡ съ ни́мъ ны́нѣ велича́емъ.
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* Thou hast been shown forth, O Virgin, as the great mountain in which Christ took up His abode, as divine David cries out, through whom we have been lifted up unto heaven, adopted as sons by the Spirit, O All-blessed Lady![^801]

items.english_text: *Troparion:* Divine scepter of the Church, O Cross, courage of the army! In reliance upon thee we vanquish the warriors; grant victories over the barbarians unto us who ever bow down before thee!

items.slavonic_text: На стїхо́внѣ самогла́сенъ днѐ два́жды. Гла́съ и҃: Поще́нїѧ пꙋ́ть преполови́вше, ведꙋ́щїй ко крⷭ҇тꙋ̀ твоемꙋ̀ честно́мꙋ, * тво́й де́нь ви́дѣти, є҆го́же ви́дѣ Ѣ҆враа́мъ, и҆ возра́довасѧ, * ꙗ҆́кѡ и҆з̾ гро́ба хо́лма жи́ва І҆саа́ка прїе́мъ, * бл҃говолѝ и҆ на́съ вѣ́рою и҆зба́вившихсѧ ѿ врага̀, * и҆ ве́чери причасти́тисѧ та́йнѣй, въ ми́рѣ зовꙋ́щихъ: * Просвѣще́нїе и҆ Сп҃си́телю на́шъ, сла́ва тебѣ̀.

items.slavonic_text: Мч҃ениченъ: Мч҃еницы Хрⷭ҇то́вы непобѣди́мїи, * побѣди́вше пре́лесть си́лою крⷭ҇тною, воспрїѧ́сте бл҃года́ть вѣ́чныѧ жи́зни, * мꙋчи́телей преще́нїѧ не ᲂу҆боѧ́стесѧ, мꙋ́ками ᲂу҆раня́еми весели́теся: * и҆ ны́нѣ кро́ви ва́шѧ бы́ша и҆сцѣле́нїа дꙋ́шъ на́шихъ, * моли́те спасти́сѧ дꙋша́мъ на́шымъ.
items.english_text: Having reached the mid-point of the path of fasting, which leads unto Thy precious Cross, that we may behold Thy day, which Abraham saw and rejoiced, as he received Isaac alive as from the hill of the grave: be well-pleased also that we, having been delivered by faith from the enemy, may partake of the mystical supper, crying in peace: O our Enlightenment and Savior, glory to Thee![^806]

items.slavonic_text: И҆ ны́нѣ: па́ки то́йже.
items.english_text: Invincible martyrs of Christ, having conquered deception by the power of the Cross, ye received the grace of eternal life! Ye feared not the threats of the tormentors; being wounded by tortures, ye rejoiced! And now your blood has become healings for our souls: pray that our souls may be saved!

items.slavonic_text: На ѕ҃-мъ часѣ̀ тропа́рь проро́чества, гла́съ ѕ҃: Крⷭ҇тꙋ̀ твоемꙋ̀ покланѧ́емсѧ Влⷣко, и҆ ст҃о́е Воскрⷭ҇нїе твоѐ сла́вимъ.
items.english_text: Having crossed the midst of the deep of abstinence, let us receive the haven of salvation, the time of Thy voluntary Passion, O Lord; but in that Thou art tenderhearted and compassionate, vouchsafe us also to behold in peace the day of Thy glorious Resurrection, O Lover of mankind!

items.slavonic_text: Проро́чества И҆са́їина чте́нїе. Глава̀ к҃з. [к҃ѕ:к҃а–к҃з:ѕ҃] Сѐ Гдⷭ҇ь ѿ ст҃а́гѡ (мѣ́ста) нахо́дитъ гнѣ́въ на живꙋ́щыѧ на землѝ, и҆ ѿкры́етъ земля̀ кро́вь свою̀, и҆ не покры́етъ и҆збїе́нныхъ. Въ то́й де́нь наведе́тъ Гдⷭ҇ь ме́чь ст҃ы́й, и҆ вели́кїй, и҆ крѣ́пкїй на драко́нта ѕмі́ѧ бѣжа́ща, на драко́нта ѕмі́а лꙋка́ваго: и҆ ᲂу҆бїе́тъ драко́нта сꙋ́щаго въ мо́ри. Въ то́й де́нь вїногра́дъ до́брый, жела́нїе пѣ́ти над̾ ни́мъ. А҆́зъ гра́дъ крѣ́пкїй, гра́дъ вою́емый, всꙋ́е напою̀ є҆го̀: плѣне́нъ бо бꙋ́детъ но́щїю, въ де́нь же паде́тсѧ стѣна̀ є҆гѡ̀, нѣ́сть тогѡ̀, и҆́же не во́зметъ є҆гѡ̀. Кто́ мѧ приста́витъ стрещѝ сте́блїе на ни́вѣ; ра́ди вражды̀ сеѧ̀ ѿри́нꙋхъ и҆̀: ᲂу҆́бо сегѡ̀ ра́ди сотворѝ Гдⷭ҇ь Бг҃ъ всѧ̑, є҆ли̑ка совѣща̀: И҆ сгорѣ́хъ, возопїю́тъ живꙋ́щїи въ не́мъ: сотвори́мъ ми́ръ є҆мꙋ̀, сотвори́мъ ми́ръ. Приходѧ́щаѧ ча̑да Ꙗ҆́кѡвля: прозя́бнетъ и҆ процвѣте́тъ
items.english_text: *The Veneration of the Cross takes place at the Sixth Hour, at which we sing the prescribed Sunday stichera, idiomela, Tone 2: "Come, ye faithful," and the rest. And the dismissal.*[^807]

[к҃ѕ:к҃а–к҃з:ѕ҃] Сѐ Гдⷭ҇ь ѿ ст҃а́гѡ (мѣ́ста) нахо́дитъ гнѣ́въ на живꙋ́щыѧ на землѝ, и҆ ѿкры́етъ земля̀ кро́вь свою̀, и҆ не покры́етъ и҆збїе́нныхъ. Въ то́й де́нь наведе́тъ Гдⷭ҇ь ме́чь ст҃ы́й, и҆ вели́кїй, и҆ крѣ́пкїй на драко́нта ѕмі́ѧ бѣжа́ща, на драко́нта ѕмі́а лꙋка́ваго: и҆ ᲂу҆бїе́тъ драко́нта сꙋ́щаго въ мо́ри. Въ то́й де́нь вїногра́дъ до́брый, жела́нїе пѣ́ти над̾ ни́мъ. А҆́зъ гра́дъ крѣ́пкїй, гра́дъ вою́емый, всꙋ́е напою̀ є҆го̀: плѣне́нъ бо бꙋ́детъ но́щїю, въ де́нь же паде́тсѧ стѣна̀ є҆гѡ̀, нѣ́сть тогѡ̀, и҆́же не во́зметъ є҆гѡ̀. Кто́ мѧ приста́витъ стрещѝ сте́блїе на ни́вѣ; ра́ди вражды̀ сеѧ̀ ѿри́нꙋхъ и҆̀: ᲂу҆́бо сегѡ̀ ра́ди сотворѝ Гдⷭ҇ь Бг҃ъ всѧ̑, є҆ли̑ка совѣща̀: И҆ сгорѣ́хъ, возопїю́тъ живꙋ́щїи въ не́мъ: сотвори́мъ ми́ръ є҆мꙋ̀, сотвори́мъ ми́ръ. items.english_text: Behold, the Lord comes forth from His holy place to bring wrath upon the inhabitants of the earth; and the earth shall disclose her blood, and shall not cover her slain. In that day the Lord shall bring His holy, and great, and strong sword upon the dragon, the fleeing serpent, upon the dragon, the crooked serpent; and He shall slay the dragon that is in the sea. In that day there is a fair vineyard, a desire to sing over it: I am a strong city, a besieged city; in vain shall I water it, for it shall be taken by night, and by day its wall shall fall; there is none who shall not take it. Who will set me to watch the stubble in the field? By reason of this enmity I have cast it away; therefore, the Lord God hath done all things whatsoever He purposed. And I am burnt up; those who dwell in it shall cry aloud: Let us make peace with Him, let us make peace! The children of Jacob that come shall sprout and blossom;

Сва́рѧсѧ и҆ ᲂу҆корѧ́ѧ ѿпꙋсти́тъ ѧ̀: и҆ не ты́ ли бы́лъ є҆сѝ помышля́ѧ дꙋ́хомъ жесто́кимъ, ᲂу҆би́ти ѧ҆̀ дꙋ́хомъ ꙗ҆́рости; Сегѡ̀ ра́ди ѿи́метсѧ беззако́нїе І҆а́кѡвле, и҆ сїѐ є҆́сть бл҃гослове́нїе є҆гѡ̀, є҆гда̀ ѿимꙋ̀ грѣ́хъ є҆гѡ̀, є҆гда̀ положа́тъ всѐ ка́менїе тре́бищъ сокрꙋше́но, а҆́ки пра́хъ дро́бный: и҆ не пребꙋ́дꙋтъ древеса̀ и҆́хъ, и҆ кꙋмі́ры и҆́хъ бꙋ́дꙋтъ посѣ́чени, а҆́ки дꙋбра́ва дале́че.
items.english_text: Israel shall blossom, and the world shall be filled with his fruit. Hath He smitten him as He smote those that smote him? And as he slew, shall he likewise be slain? Contending and reproaching, He will send them away: and wast thou not meditating with a harsh spirit, to slay them with a spirit of wrath? Therefore shall the iniquity of Jacob be taken away, and this is his blessing, when I take away his sin, when they make all the stones of the altars broken in pieces, as fine dust; and their trees shall not remain, and their idols shall be cut down, like a grove far away.

items.slavonic_text: И҆́нъ, гла́съ є҃: Въ та́йнѣ добродѣ́тели дѣ́лающїи, * дх҃ѡ́внаѧ воздаѧ́нїѧ ча́ющїи, * не посредѣ̀ то́ржищъ и҆ распꙋ́тїй ꙗ҆вля́ютъ сїѧ̑, * но внꙋ́трь се́рдца но́сятъ па́че: * и҆ всѣ́хъ Ви́дай быва́ємаѧ въ та́йнѣ, мздо̀ воздержа́нїѧ подае́тъ на́мъ. * По́стъ соверша́имъ, не сѣ́тꙋюще ли́цы, * но въ клѣ́техъ дꙋ́шъ на́шихъ молѧ́щеся, непреста́ннѡ возопїи́мъ: * О҆́тче на́шъ, и҆́же є҆сѝ на нб҃сѣ́хъ, * не введѝ на́съ во и҆скꙋше́нїе, мо́лимсѧ, * но и҆зба́ви на́съ ѿ лꙋка́вагѡ.

items.slavonic_text: Мч҃ениченъ: Несы́тною любо́вїю дꙋшѝ, Хрⷭ҇та̀ не ѿверго́стеся ст҃і́и мч҃еницы, * и҆́же разли́чныѧ ра́ны страсте́й претерпѣ́вше, * мꙋчи́телей де́рзость низложи́сте, * непрекло́ннꙋ и҆ невреди́мꙋ вѣ́рꙋ сохра́нше, * на нб҃са̀ предста́вистеся, * тѣ́мже и҆ дерзнове́нїе полꙋчи́вше къ немꙋ̀, * проси́те дарова́ти ми́ръ мі́рови, * и҆ дꙋша́мъ на́шымъ ве́лїю ми́лость.
items.english_text: Fasting, the mediator of good things, hath now brought in its mid-point, having pleased God by the days that are past, and setting forth benefit by those that remain; for the intensifying of good works produces greater beneficence; therefore, pleasing Christ the Giver of all good things, we cry aloud: O Thou Who didst fast for our sake and didst endure the Crucifixion, make us worthy without condemnation to partake also of Thy divine Pascha, having lived in peace, and worthily glorifying Thee together with the Father and the Spirit!

items.english_text: Those who practice virtues in secret, looking for spiritual rewards, do not display them in the midst of marketplaces and crossroads, but rather carry them within the heart; and He Who sees all things that are done in secret grants us the reward of abstinence. Let us accomplish the fast, not disfiguring our faces with gloomy countenance, but praying in the secret chambers of our souls, let us unceasingly cry aloud: Our Father Who art in heaven, lead us not into temptation, we pray, but deliver us from the evil one!

items.slavonic_text: А҆по́столѡвъ похвало̀ крⷭ҇те, * є҆го́же ѡ҆крꙋжа́ютъ Нача̑ла, Си̑лы, А҆рха́гг҃ли, * покланя́ющыѧся тебѣ̀ ѿ всѧ́кагѡ вре́да спаса́й, * и҆ бж҃е́ственное по́прище воздержа́нїѧ на́съ сподо́би до́брѣ соверша́ющыя, * Де́нь Сп҃си́тельный дости́гнꙋти, * и҆́мже и҆ спаса́емся.
items.english_text: Let us all wash our souls with the water of fasting, and approaching the precious and lifegiving Cross of the Lord, let us bow down in faith, drawing forth divine enlightenment, and now acquiring eternal salvation, peace, and great mercy!

items.slavonic_text: Сла́ва, и҆ ны́нѣ: самогла́сенъ, гла́съ и҃: Дне́сь Неприкоснове́нный Сꙋщество́мъ, прикоснове́нъ мнѣ̀ быва́етъ, * и҆ стра́ждетъ Стра̑сти, свобожда́ѧй мѧ̀ ѿ страсте́й, * свѣ́тъ подава́ѧй слѣпы̑мъ, ѿ беззако́нныхъ ᲂу҆сте́нъ ѡ҆плева́етсѧ, * и҆ дае́тъ плещѝ за плѣне́нныя на ра̑ны, * сегѡ̀ Чⷭ҇таѧ Дв҃а и҆ Мт҃и на крⷭ҇тѣ̀ зрѧ́щи, болѣ́зненнѡ вѣща́ше: * ᲂу҆вы́ мнѣ̀, Ча́до моѐ, что̀ сїѐ сотвори́лъ є҆сѝ; * кра́сный добро́тою па́че всѣ́хъ человѣ́къ, * бездыха́нный, беззра́чный ꙗ҆вля́ешися, не и҆мѣ́ѧ ви́да, нижѐ добро́ты: * ᲂу҆вы́ мнѣ̀ мо́й Свѣ́те, не могꙋ̀ спя́ща зрѣ́ти тя̀, * ᲂу҆тро́бою ᲂу҆язвля́юся, и҆ лю́тое ѻ҆рꙋ́жїе се́рдце моѐ прохо́дитъ, * воспѣва́ю твоя̑ Стра̑сти, покланя́юся бл҃гоꙋтро́бїю твоемꙋ̀: * Долготерпѣли́ве сла́ва тебѣ̀.
items.english_text: Today bowing down before the Cross of the Lord, let us cry aloud: Rejoice, O Tree of life, destroyer of Hades! Rejoice, joy of the world and consumer of corruption! Rejoice, driving away demons by thy power, establishment of the faithful, unbreakable weapon: preserve and sanctify those who kiss thee, we pray!

items.slavonic_text: Бытїѧ̀ чте́нїе. Глава̀ ѳ҃. [ѳ҃:п҃і–і҃:а҃] Бы́ша сы́нове Нѡ́евы и҆зше́дшїи и҆з̾ ковче́га, Си́мъ, Ха́мъ, І҆а́федъ: Ха́мъ же бѧ́ше ѻ҆те́цъ Ханаа́нь. Трїѐ сі́и сꙋ́ть сы́нове Нѡ́евы, ѿ си́хъ разсѣ́ѧшася по все́й землѝ. И҆ нача́тъ Нѡ́е человѣ́къ дѣ́латель (бы́ти) землѝ, и҆ насадѝ вїногра́дъ: И҆ и҆спѝ ѿ вїна̀, и҆ ᲂу҆пи́ся, и҆ ѡ҆бнажи́ся въ домꙋ̀ свое́мъ. И҆ ви́дѣ Ха́мъ ѻ҆те́цъ Ханаа́нь наготꙋ̀ ѻ҆тца̀ своегѡ̀, и҆ и҆зше́дъ во́нъ повѣ́да ѻ҆бѣ́ма бра́тома свои́ма. items.english_text: Today He Who is untouchable in Essence becomes touchable unto me, and suffers passions, He Who frees me from passions; He Who gives light unto the blind is spat upon by lawless lips, and gives His back unto stripes for the sake of captives! Beholding Him upon the Cross, the Pure Virgin and Mother spoke in pain: Woe is me, O my Child, what is this that Thou hast done? Thou Who art fair in beauty beyond all the sons of men appearest breathless, formless, having neither form nor beauty! Woe is me, O my Light! I cannot bear to behold Thee sleeping; I am wounded in my bowels, and a cruel sword passes through my heart! I hymn Thy Passions, I bow down before Thy tenderhearted compassion: O Long-suffering One, glory to Thee!
