items.english_text: O Lover of mankind, Who desirest all to be saved, do Thou recall me and receive me who repent, as Thou art good!

provenance.verbatim_source: O Lover of mankind, Who desirest all to be saved, do Thou recall me and receive me who repent, as Thou art good!

items.office: On Thursday of the Fifth Week of the Great Fast
items.season_or_tone: FOURTH WEEK OF THE GREAT FAST
items.day_or_date: On Thursday of the Fifth Week of the Great Fast
items.english_text: Give ear unto the sighings of my soul, and receive the drops from mine eyes, O Savior, and save me!

provenance.verbatim_source: Give ear unto the sighings of my soul, and receive the drops from mine eyes, O Savior, and save me!

items.office: On Thursday of the Fifth Week of the Great Fast
items.season_or_tone: FOURTH WEEK OF THE GREAT FAST
items.day_or_date: On Thursday of the Fifth Week of the Great Fast
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* All-immaculate Virgin Theotokos, alone all-hymned, pray fervently that we may be saved!

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Theotokion:*  
All-immaculate Virgin Theotokos, alone all-hymned, pray fervently that we may be saved!

items.office: On Thursday of the Fifth Week of the Great Fast
items.season_or_tone: FOURTH WEEK OF THE GREAT FAST
items.day_or_date: On Thursday of the Fifth Week of the Great Fast
items.english_text: See, see that I am God, Who rained manna, and made water gush from the rock of old in the wilderness for My people, by My right hand alone and by My might!

provenance.verbatim_source: See, see that I am God, Who rained manna, and made water gush from the rock of old in the wilderness for My people, by My right hand alone and by My might!

items.office: On Thursday of the Fifth Week of the Great Fast
items.season_or_tone: FOURTH WEEK OF THE GREAT FAST
items.day_or_date: On Thursday of the Fifth Week of the Great Fast
items.english_text: "See, see that I am God": give ear, O my soul, unto the Lord crying aloud; and depart from thy former sin, and fear Him as incorruptible, and as Judge and God!

provenance.verbatim_source: "See, see that I am God": give ear, O my soul, unto the Lord crying aloud; and depart from thy former sin, and fear Him as incorruptible, and as Judge and God!

items.office: On Thursday of the Fifth Week of the Great Fast
items.season_or_tone: FOURTH WEEK OF THE GREAT FAST
items.day_or_date: On Thursday of the Fifth Week of the Great Fast
items.english_text: Unto whom hast thou become like, O much-sinning soul? Only unto the first Cain, and unto that Lamech, having stoned the body with evil deeds, and killed the mind with irrational impulses!

provenance.verbatim_source: Unto whom hast thou become like, O much-sinning soul? Only unto the first Cain, and unto that Lamech, having stoned the body with evil deeds, and killed the mind with irrational impulses!

items.office: On Thursday of the Fifth Week of the Great Fast
items.season_or_tone: FOURTH WEEK OF THE GREAT FAST
items.day_or_date: On Thursday of the Fifth Week of the Great Fast
items.english_text: Passing through all that were before the Law, O soul, thou hast not resembled Seth, nor imitated Enos, nor Enoch by translation, nor Noah; but hast been shown destitute of the life of the righteous.[^1058]

provenance.verbatim_source: Passing through all that were before the Law, O soul, thou hast not resembled Seth, nor imitated Enos, nor Enoch by translation, nor Noah; but hast been shown destitute of the life of the righteous.[^1058]

items.office: On Thursday of the Fifth Week of the Great Fast
items.season_or_tone: FOURTH WEEK OF THE GREAT FAST
items.day_or_date: On Thursday of the Fifth Week of the Great Fast
items.english_text: Thou alone, O my soul, hast opened the floodgates of the wrath of thy God, and hast drowned all thy flesh, deeds, and life as the earth, and hast remained outside the saving ark!

provenance.verbatim_source: Thou alone, O my soul, hast opened the floodgates of the wrath of thy God, and hast drowned all thy flesh, deeds, and life as the earth, and hast remained outside the saving ark!

items.office: On Thursday of the Fifth Week of the Great Fast
items.season_or_tone: FOURTH WEEK OF THE GREAT FAST
items.day_or_date: On Thursday of the Fifth Week of the Great Fast
items.english_text: "I have slain a man unto my wound, and a young man unto my hurt," cried Lamech weeping; but thou, O my soul, tremblest not, having sullied thy flesh and defiled thy mind![^1059]

provenance.verbatim_source: "I have slain a man unto my wound, and a young man unto my hurt," cried Lamech weeping; but thou, O my soul, tremblest not, having sullied thy flesh and defiled thy mind![^1059]

items.office: On Thursday of the Fifth Week of the Great Fast
items.season_or_tone: FOURTH WEEK OF THE GREAT FAST
items.day_or_date: On Thursday of the Fifth Week of the Great Fast
items.english_text: O how have I rivaled Lamech, the former murderer: having slain the soul as a man, the mind as a young man, and as a brother mine own body, like Cain the murderer, by pleasure-seeking impulses!

provenance.verbatim_source: O how have I rivaled Lamech, the former murderer: having slain the soul as a man, the mind as a young man, and as a brother mine own body, like Cain the murderer, by pleasure-seeking impulses!

items.office: On Thursday of the Fifth Week of the Great Fast
items.season_or_tone: FOURTH WEEK OF THE GREAT FAST
items.day_or_date: On Thursday of the Fifth Week of the Great Fast
items.english_text: Thou didst devise to build a tower, O soul, and to establish a fortress by thy lusts, had not the Fashioner confounded thy counsels and dashed thy contrivances to the earth!

provenance.verbatim_source: Thou didst devise to build a tower, O soul, and to establish a fortress by thy lusts, had not the Fashioner confounded thy counsels and dashed thy contrivances to the earth!

items.office: On Thursday of the Fifth Week of the Great Fast
items.season_or_tone: FOURTH WEEK OF THE GREAT FAST
items.day_or_date: On Thursday of the Fifth Week of the Great Fast
items.english_text: I am wounded, I am pierced: behold, the arrows of the enemy have pierced my soul and body! Behold, ulcers, putrefactions, and dark spots cry aloud, the wounds of my willful passions!

provenance.verbatim_source: I am wounded, I am pierced: behold, the arrows of the enemy have pierced my soul and body! Behold, ulcers, putrefactions, and dark spots cry aloud, the wounds of my willful passions!

items.office: On Thursday of the Fifth Week of the Great Fast
items.season_or_tone: FOURTH WEEK OF THE GREAT FAST
items.day_or_date: On Thursday of the Fifth Week of the Great Fast
items.english_text: The Lord once rained down fire from the Lord upon angering iniquity, consuming the Sodomites; but thou, O soul, hast kindled the fire of Gehenna, in which thou shalt be burned!

provenance.verbatim_source: The Lord once rained down fire from the Lord upon angering iniquity, consuming the Sodomites; but thou, O soul, hast kindled the fire of Gehenna, in which thou shalt be burned!

items.office: On Thursday of the Fifth Week of the Great Fast
items.season_or_tone: FOURTH WEEK OF THE GREAT FAST
items.day_or_date: On Thursday of the Fifth Week of the Great Fast
items.english_text: Understand and see that I am God, Who searches hearts and tests thoughts, Who reproves deeds, burns up sins, and judges the orphan, the humble, and the poor!

provenance.verbatim_source: Understand and see that I am God, Who searches hearts and tests thoughts, Who reproves deeds, burns up sins, and judges the orphan, the humble, and the poor!

items.office: On Thursday of the Fifth Week of the Great Fast
items.season_or_tone: FOURTH WEEK OF THE GREAT FAST
items.day_or_date: On Thursday of the Fifth Week of the Great Fast
items.english_text: Thou didst stretch forth thy hands unto the merciful God, Mary, when submerged in the abyss of evils; and as unto Peter He lovingly stretched forth His divine hand, in every way seeking thy conversion.

provenance.verbatim_source: Thou didst stretch forth thy hands unto the merciful God, Mary, when submerged in the abyss of evils; and as unto Peter He lovingly stretched forth His divine hand, in every way seeking thy conversion.

items.office: On Thursday of the Fifth Week of the Great Fast
items.season_or_tone: FOURTH WEEK OF THE GREAT FAST
items.day_or_date: On Thursday of the Fifth Week of the Great Fast
items.english_text: With all fervor and love didst thou hasten unto Christ, having turned away from the former way of sin, feeding thyself in untrodden wildernesses, and purely fulfilling His divine commandments.

provenance.verbatim_source: With all fervor and love didst thou hasten unto Christ, having turned away from the former way of sin, feeding thyself in untrodden wildernesses, and purely fulfilling His divine commandments.

items.office: On Thursday of the Fifth Week of the Great Fast
items.season_or_tone: FOURTH WEEK OF THE GREAT FAST
items.day_or_date: On Thursday of the Fifth Week of the Great Fast
items.english_text: We see, we see the love of mankind, O soul, of God and Master: therefore before the end let us fall down before Him with tears, crying aloud: By the prayers of Andrew, O Savior, have mercy on us!

provenance.verbatim_source: We see, we see the love of mankind, O soul, of God and Master: therefore before the end let us fall down before Him with tears, crying aloud: By the prayers of Andrew, O Savior, have mercy on us!

items.office: On Thursday of the Fifth Week of the Great Fast
items.season_or_tone: FOURTH WEEK OF THE GREAT FAST
items.day_or_date: On Thursday of the Fifth Week of the Great Fast
items.english_text: O Beginningless, Uncreated Trinity, Undivided Unity: receive me repenting, save me who have sinned; I am Thy creation, despise me not, but spare me, and deliver me from the condemnation of fire!

provenance.verbatim_source: O Beginningless, Uncreated Trinity, Undivided Unity: receive me repenting, save me who have sinned; I am Thy creation, despise me not, but spare me, and deliver me from the condemnation of fire!

items.office: On Thursday of the Fifth Week of the Great Fast
items.season_or_tone: FOURTH WEEK OF THE GREAT FAST
items.day_or_date: On Thursday of the Fifth Week of the Great Fast
items.english_text: O All-immaculate Sovereign Lady, Parent of God, hope of those who flee unto thee, and haven of those who are in storm: by thy prayers make the merciful Creator and thy Son propitious unto me!

provenance.verbatim_source: O All-immaculate Sovereign Lady, Parent of God, hope of those who flee unto thee, and haven of those who are in storm: by thy prayers make the merciful Creator and thy Son propitious unto me!

items.office: On Thursday of the Fifth Week of the Great Fast
items.season_or_tone: FOURTH WEEK OF THE GREAT FAST
items.day_or_date: On Thursday of the Fifth Week of the Great Fast
items.english_text: *Ode 3. Heirmos:*[^1060] Upon the immovable rock of Thy commandments, O Christ, establish my mind!

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Ode 3. Heirmos:*[^1060]  
Upon the immovable rock of Thy commandments, O Christ, establish my mind!

items.office: On Thursday of the Fifth Week of the Great Fast
items.season_or_tone: FOURTH WEEK OF THE GREAT FAST
items.day_or_date: On Thursday of the Fifth Week of the Great Fast
items.english_text: The Lord once rained down fire from the Lord, burning up the land of Sodom aforetime.[^1061]

provenance.verbatim_source: The Lord once rained down fire from the Lord, burning up the land of Sodom aforetime.[^1061]

items.office: On Thursday of the Fifth Week of the Great Fast
items.season_or_tone: FOURTH WEEK OF THE GREAT FAST
items.day_or_date: On Thursday of the Fifth Week of the Great Fast
items.english_text: Flee for safety to the mountain, O soul, like Lot of old, and make haste into Zoar!

provenance.verbatim_source: Flee for safety to the mountain, O soul, like Lot of old, and make haste into Zoar!

items.office: On Thursday of the Fifth Week of the Great Fast
items.season_or_tone: FOURTH WEEK OF THE GREAT FAST
items.day_or_date: On Thursday of the Fifth Week of the Great Fast
items.english_text: Flee the conflagration, O soul! Flee the burning of Sodom! Flee the destruction of the divine flame!

provenance.verbatim_source: Flee the conflagration, O soul! Flee the burning of Sodom! Flee the destruction of the divine flame!

items.office: On Thursday of the Fifth Week of the Great Fast
items.season_or_tone: FOURTH WEEK OF THE GREAT FAST
items.day_or_date: On Thursday of the Fifth Week of the Great Fast
items.english_text: I confess unto Thee, O Savior: I have sinned, I have sinned against Thee! But remit, forgive me, as Thou art tender-hearted!

provenance.verbatim_source: I confess unto Thee, O Savior: I have sinned, I have sinned against Thee! But remit, forgive me, as Thou art tender-hearted!

items.office: On Thursday of the Fifth Week of the Great Fast
items.season_or_tone: FOURTH WEEK OF THE GREAT FAST
items.day_or_date: On Thursday of the Fifth Week of the Great Fast
items.english_text: I alone have sinned against Thee, I have sinned more than all, O Christ Savior: despise me not!

provenance.verbatim_source: I alone have sinned against Thee, I have sinned more than all, O Christ Savior: despise me not!

items.office: On Thursday of the Fifth Week of the Great Fast
items.season_or_tone: FOURTH WEEK OF THE GREAT FAST
items.day_or_date: On Thursday of the Fifth Week of the Great Fast
items.english_text: Thou art the Good Shepherd: seek me, the lamb, and despise me not who have gone astray!

provenance.verbatim_source: Thou art the Good Shepherd: seek me, the lamb, and despise me not who have gone astray!

items.office: On Thursday of the Fifth Week of the Great Fast
items.season_or_tone: FOURTH WEEK OF THE GREAT FAST
items.day_or_date: On Thursday of the Fifth Week of the Great Fast
items.english_text: Thou art sweet Jesus, Thou art my Creator: in Thee, O Savior, shall I be justified!

provenance.verbatim_source: Thou art sweet Jesus, Thou art my Creator: in Thee, O Savior, shall I be justified!

items.office: On Thursday of the Fifth Week of the Great Fast
items.season_or_tone: FOURTH WEEK OF THE GREAT FAST
items.day_or_date: On Thursday of the Fifth Week of the Great Fast
items.english_text: O Trinity, Unity, O God! Save us from deception, temptations, and adversities!

provenance.verbatim_source: O Trinity, Unity, O God! Save us from deception, temptations, and adversities!

items.office: On Thursday of the Fifth Week of the Great Fast
items.season_or_tone: FOURTH WEEK OF THE GREAT FAST
items.day_or_date: On Thursday of the Fifth Week of the Great Fast
items.english_text: Rejoice, O womb that received God! Rejoice, O throne of the Lord! Rejoice, O Mother of our Life!

provenance.verbatim_source: Rejoice, O womb that received God! Rejoice, O throne of the Lord! Rejoice, O Mother of our Life!

items.office: On Thursday of the Fifth Week of the Great Fast
items.season_or_tone: FOURTH WEEK OF THE GREAT FAST
items.day_or_date: On Thursday of the Fifth Week of the Great Fast
items.english_text: *Ode 3 (continued):* *Another Heirmos:*[^1062]

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Ode 3 (continued):*  
*Another Heirmos:*[^1062]

items.office: On Thursday of the Fifth Week of the Great Fast
items.season_or_tone: FOURTH WEEK OF THE GREAT FAST
items.day_or_date: On Thursday of the Fifth Week of the Great Fast
items.english_text: Establish, O Lord, upon the rock of Thy commandments my shaken heart, for Thou alone art holy and the Lord!

provenance.verbatim_source: Establish, O Lord, upon the rock of Thy commandments my shaken heart, for Thou alone art holy and the Lord!

items.office: On Thursday of the Fifth Week of the Great Fast
items.season_or_tone: FOURTH WEEK OF THE GREAT FAST
items.day_or_date: On Thursday of the Fifth Week of the Great Fast
items.english_text: I have acquired Thee as the Fountain of life, the Destroyer of death, and I cry unto Thee from my heart before the end: I have sinned, cleanse, save me![^1063]

provenance.verbatim_source: I have acquired Thee as the Fountain of life, the Destroyer of death, and I cry unto Thee from my heart before the end: I have sinned, cleanse, save me![^1063]

items.office: On Thursday of the Fifth Week of the Great Fast
items.season_or_tone: FOURTH WEEK OF THE GREAT FAST
items.day_or_date: On Thursday of the Fifth Week of the Great Fast
items.english_text: I have imitated those who lived in fornication in the time of Noah, O Savior, inheriting their condemnation of being submerged in the flood.

provenance.verbatim_source: I have imitated those who lived in fornication in the time of Noah, O Savior, inheriting their condemnation of being submerged in the flood.

items.office: On Thursday of the Fifth Week of the Great Fast
items.season_or_tone: FOURTH WEEK OF THE GREAT FAST
items.day_or_date: On Thursday of the Fifth Week of the Great Fast
items.english_text: I have sinned, O Lord, I have sinned against Thee, cleanse me; for there is none among men who has sinned, whom I have not surpassed by my transgressions!

provenance.verbatim_source: I have sinned, O Lord, I have sinned against Thee, cleanse me; for there is none among men who has sinned, whom I have not surpassed by my transgressions!

items.office: On Thursday of the Fifth Week of the Great Fast
items.season_or_tone: FOURTH WEEK OF THE GREAT FAST
items.day_or_date: On Thursday of the Fifth Week of the Great Fast
items.english_text: Having imitated that Ham, the scorner of his father, O soul, thou hast not covered the shame of thy neighbor, walking backward with averted face!

provenance.verbatim_source: Having imitated that Ham, the scorner of his father, O soul, thou hast not covered the shame of thy neighbor, walking backward with averted face!

items.office: On Thursday of the Fifth Week of the Great Fast
items.season_or_tone: FOURTH WEEK OF THE GREAT FAST
items.day_or_date: On Thursday of the Fifth Week of the Great Fast
items.english_text: The blessing of Shem thou hast not inherited, O wretched soul, nor hast thou possessed a spacious domain on the earth of forgiveness, like Japhs!

provenance.verbatim_source: The blessing of Shem thou hast not inherited, O wretched soul, nor hast thou possessed a spacious domain on the earth of forgiveness, like Japhs!

items.office: On Thursday of the Fifth Week of the Great Fast
items.season_or_tone: FOURTH WEEK OF THE GREAT FAST
items.day_or_date: On Thursday of the Fifth Week of the Great Fast
items.english_text: From the land of Haran depart from sin, O my soul: come into the land welling forth ever-living incorruption, which Abraham inherited!

provenance.verbatim_source: From the land of Haran depart from sin, O my soul: come into the land welling forth ever-living incorruption, which Abraham inherited!

items.office: On Thursday of the Fifth Week of the Great Fast
items.season_or_tone: FOURTH WEEK OF THE GREAT FAST
items.day_or_date: On Thursday of the Fifth Week of the Great Fast
items.english_text: Thou hast heard of Abraham, O my soul, who of old left the land of his fatherland and became a sojourner: imitate his deliberate choice!

provenance.verbatim_source: Thou hast heard of Abraham, O my soul, who of old left the land of his fatherland and became a sojourner: imitate his deliberate choice!

items.office: On Thursday of the Fifth Week of the Great Fast
items.season_or_tone: FOURTH WEEK OF THE GREAT FAST
items.day_or_date: On Thursday of the Fifth Week of the Great Fast
items.english_text: Having entertained the angels at the oak of Mamre, the patriarch inherited in old age the prize of the promise.

provenance.verbatim_source: Having entertained the angels at the oak of Mamre, the patriarch inherited in old age the prize of the promise.

items.office: On Thursday of the Fifth Week of the Great Fast
items.season_or_tone: FOURTH WEEK OF THE GREAT FAST
items.day_or_date: On Thursday of the Fifth Week of the Great Fast
items.english_text: Understanding Isaac, O my wretched soul, as a new sacrifice mystically offered as a whole burnt offering unto the Lord, imitate his deliberate choice!

provenance.verbatim_source: Understanding Isaac, O my wretched soul, as a new sacrifice mystically offered as a whole burnt offering unto the Lord, imitate his deliberate choice!

items.office: On Thursday of the Fifth Week of the Great Fast
items.season_or_tone: FOURTH WEEK OF THE GREAT FAST
items.day_or_date: On Thursday of the Fifth Week of the Great Fast
items.english_text: Thou hast heard of Ishmael, cast out as the offspring of a bondwoman: be sober, O my soul; take heed lest thou suffer anything like unto him through wanton indulgence!

provenance.verbatim_source: Thou hast heard of Ishmael, cast out as the offspring of a bondwoman: be sober, O my soul; take heed lest thou suffer anything like unto him through wanton indulgence!

items.office: On Thursday of the Fifth Week of the Great Fast
items.season_or_tone: FOURTH WEEK OF THE GREAT FAST
items.day_or_date: On Thursday of the Fifth Week of the Great Fast
items.english_text: Thou hast become like unto Hagar the Egyptian of old, O soul, having enslaved thyself by deliberate choice and given birth to a new Ishmael: insolence!

provenance.verbatim_source: Thou hast become like unto Hagar the Egyptian of old, O soul, having enslaved thyself by deliberate choice and given birth to a new Ishmael: insolence!

items.office: On Thursday of the Fifth Week of the Great Fast
items.season_or_tone: FOURTH WEEK OF THE GREAT FAST
items.day_or_date: On Thursday of the Fifth Week of the Great Fast
items.english_text: Thou hast understood the ladder of Jacob, O my soul, shown from earth unto heaven: why hast thou not held fast to the firm step of piety?

provenance.verbatim_source: Thou hast understood the ladder of Jacob, O my soul, shown from earth unto heaven: why hast thou not held fast to the firm step of piety?

items.office: On Thursday of the Fifth Week of the Great Fast
items.season_or_tone: FOURTH WEEK OF THE GREAT FAST
items.day_or_date: On Thursday of the Fifth Week of the Great Fast
items.english_text: Imitate the priest of God and solitary king, the likeness of Christ in the world of life among men!

provenance.verbatim_source: Imitate the priest of God and solitary king, the likeness of Christ in the world of life among men!

items.office: On Thursday of the Fifth Week of the Great Fast
items.season_or_tone: FOURTH WEEK OF THE GREAT FAST
items.day_or_date: On Thursday of the Fifth Week of the Great Fast
items.english_text: Become not a pillar of salt, O soul, by turning back: let the Sodomite image terrify thee; save thyself high up in Zoar!

provenance.verbatim_source: Become not a pillar of salt, O soul, by turning back: let the Sodomite image terrify thee; save thyself high up in Zoar!

items.office: On Thursday of the Fifth Week of the Great Fast
items.season_or_tone: FOURTH WEEK OF THE GREAT FAST
items.day_or_date: On Thursday of the Fifth Week of the Great Fast
items.slavonic_text: Поми́лꙋй Гдⷭ҇и, поми́лꙋй мѧ̀, вопїю́ ти, * є҆гда̀ прїи́деши со а҆́гг҃лы твои́ми, * возда́ти всѣ̑мъ по достоѧ́нїю дѣѧ́нїй.
items.english_text: Fleeing from the burning like Lot, flee, O my soul, from sin; flee from Sodom and Gomorrah; flee from the flame of every irrational desire!

provenance.verbatim_source: Fleeing from the burning like Lot, flee, O my soul, from sin; flee from Sodom and Gomorrah; flee from the flame of every irrational desire!

items.office: On Thursday of the Fifth Week of the Great Fast
items.season_or_tone: FOURTH WEEK OF THE GREAT FAST
items.day_or_date: On Thursday of the Fifth Week of the Great Fast
items.slavonic_text: Моле́нїе Влⷣко, тебѐ пою́щихъ не ѿве́ржи, * но ᲂу҆ще́дри человѣколю́бче, * и҆ пода́ждь вѣ́рою просѧ́щымъ ѡ҆ставле́нїе.
items.english_text: Have mercy, O Lord, have mercy upon me, I cry unto Thee, when Thou shalt come with Thine angels to render unto all according to the worth of their deeds!

provenance.verbatim_source: Have mercy, O Lord, have mercy upon me, I cry unto Thee, when Thou shalt come with Thine angels to render unto all according to the worth of their deeds!

items.office: On Thursday of the Fifth Week of the Great Fast
items.season_or_tone: FOURTH WEEK OF THE GREAT FAST
items.day_or_date: On Thursday of the Fifth Week of the Great Fast
items.slavonic_text: Марїи: Ѡ҆держи́мъ є҆́смь бꙋ́рею, и҆ треволне́нїемъ согрѣше́нїй: * но сама́ мѧ мт҃и ны́нѣ спасѝ, * и҆ къ приста́нищꙋ бж҃е́ственнагѡ покаѧ́нїа возведѝ.
items.english_text: Cast not away the supplication of those who hymn Thee, O Master, but show compassion, O Lover of mankind, and grant forgiveness unto those who ask in faith!

provenance.verbatim_source: Cast not away the supplication of those who hymn Thee, O Master, but show compassion, O Lover of mankind, and grant forgiveness unto those who ask in faith!

items.office: On Thursday of the Fifth Week of the Great Fast
items.season_or_tone: FOURTH WEEK OF THE GREAT FAST
items.day_or_date: On Thursday of the Fifth Week of the Great Fast
items.slavonic_text: А҆ндре́ю: Твои́ми моли́твами да́рꙋй и҆ мнѣ̀ ѡ҆ставле́нїе долго́въ, * ѡ҆ А҆ндре́е, кри́тскїй предсѣда́телю! * покаѧ́нїа бо та́инникъ преизря́дный.
items.english_text: I am possessed by storm and the surge of transgressions; but do thou thyself now save me, O mother, and lead me unto the haven of divine repentance!

provenance.verbatim_source: I am possessed by storm and the surge of transgressions; but do thou thyself now save me, O mother, and lead me unto the haven of divine repentance!

items.office: On Thursday of the Fifth Week of the Great Fast
items.season_or_tone: FOURTH WEEK OF THE GREAT FAST
items.day_or_date: On Thursday of the Fifth Week of the Great Fast
items.slavonic_text: И҆ ны́нѣ: Бг҃оро́диченъ: Ѿ Ѻ҆ц҃а̀ безлѣ́тна Сн҃а, въ лѣ́то Бг҃ороди́тельнице неискꙋсомꙋ́жнѡ родила̀ є҆сѝ, * стра́нное чꙋ́до, пребы́вши Дѣ́ва доѧ́щи.
items.english_text: Having offered servile supplication even now, O venerable one, unto the tenderhearted Mother of God through thy prayers, open unto me the divine entrances!

provenance.verbatim_source: Having offered servile supplication even now, O venerable one, unto the tenderhearted Mother of God through thy prayers, open unto me the divine entrances!

items.office: On Thursday of the Fifth Week of the Great Fast
items.season_or_tone: FOURTH WEEK OF THE GREAT FAST
items.day_or_date: On Thursday of the Fifth Week of the Great Fast
items.slavonic_text: Сѣда́ленъ, гдї́на І҆ѡ́сифа, гла́съ и҃. Подо́бенъ: Воскре́слъ є҆сѝ ѿ гро́ба: Свѣти́ла бг҃озра́чнаѧ, Сп҃совы а҆пⷭ҇ли, * просвѣти́те на́съ во тмѣ̀ житїа̀, * ꙗ҆́кѡ да во днѝ ны́нѣ бл҃гообра́знѡ хо́димъ, * свѣ́томъ воздержа́нїа нощны́хъ страсте́й ѿбѣга́юще, * и҆ свѣ̑тлыѧ Стрⷭ҇ти Хрⷭ҇то́вы ᲂу҆́зримъ ра́дꙋющесѧ.
items.english_text: By thy prayers grant unto me also the remission of debts, O Andrew, president of Crete, for thou art an eminent initiate of the mysteries of repentance!

provenance.verbatim_source: By thy prayers grant unto me also the remission of debts, O Andrew, president of Crete, for thou art an eminent initiate of the mysteries of repentance!

items.office: On Thursday of the Fifth Week of the Great Fast
items.season_or_tone: FOURTH WEEK OF THE GREAT FAST
items.day_or_date: On Thursday of the Fifth Week of the Great Fast
items.slavonic_text: === LEAF p362 === (Printed Folio 358) Въ четверто́къ є҃ седми́цы ст҃а́гѡ вели́кагѡ поста̀ [тн҃и]
items.english_text: O simple, uncreated Trinity, beginningless nature, hymned in a Trinity of hypostases: save us who worship Thy dominion in faith!

provenance.verbatim_source: O simple, uncreated Trinity, beginningless nature, hymned in a Trinity of hypostases: save us who worship Thy dominion in faith!

items.office: On Thursday of the Fifth Week of the Great Fast
items.season_or_tone: FOURTH WEEK OF THE GREAT FAST
items.day_or_date: On Thursday of the Fifth Week of the Great Fast
items.slavonic_text: И҆ ны́нѣ, Бг҃оро́диченъ. Подо́бенъ: Непостижи́магѡ Бг҃а Сн҃а и҆ Сло́во, * несказа́ннѡ па́че ᲂу҆ма̀ и҆з̾ тебѐ ро́ждшеесѧ, * молѝ Бцⷣе со а҆по́столы, ми́ръ вселе́ннѣй чи́стый пода́ти, * и҆ согрѣше́ній да́ти на́мъ пре́жде конца̀ проще́нїе, * и҆ црⷭ҇твїа нбⷭ҇нагѡ кра́йнїѧ ра́ди бл҃гости, сподо́бити рабы̑ твоѧ̑.
items.english_text: O Mother of God, who without knowing man hast given birth in time unto the timeless Son from the Father: a strange wonder, having remained a virgin while nursing!

provenance.verbatim_source: O Mother of God, who without knowing man hast given birth in time unto the timeless Son from the Father: a strange wonder, having remained a virgin while nursing!

items.office: On Thursday of the Fifth Week of the Great Fast
items.season_or_tone: FOURTH WEEK OF THE GREAT FAST
items.day_or_date: On Thursday of the Fifth Week of the Great Fast
items.slavonic_text: Та́же трипѣ́снецъ, без̾ покло́нѡвъ. Пѣ́снь д҃. Гла́съ и҃. Їрмо́съ: Оу҆слы́шахъ Гдⷭ҇и смотре́нїа твоегѡ̀ та́инство, * разꙋмѣ́хъ дѣла̀ твоѧ̑, * и҆ просла́вихъ твоѐ Бж҃ество̀.
items.english_text: *Heirmos:* Establish, O Lord, upon the rock...

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Heirmos:*  
Establish, O Lord, upon the rock...

items.office: On Thursday of the Fifth Week of the Great Fast
items.season_or_tone: FOURTH WEEK OF THE GREAT FAST
items.day_or_date: On Thursday of the Fifth Week of the Great Fast
items.slavonic_text: Воздержа́нїемъ пожи́вше просвѣще́ннїи Хрⷭ҇то́вы а҆пⷭ҇ли, * воздержа́нїа вре́мѧ на́мъ хода́тайствы бж҃твенными ᲂу҆тиша́ютъ.
items.english_text: *Sessional Hymn, by Lord Joseph, Tone 8, Podoben: "Thou hast risen from the tomb" (Воскре́слъ є҆сѝ ѿ гро́ба):*[^1064] O radiant luminaries, apostles of the Savior, enlighten us in the darkness of life, that we may now walk becomingly as in the day, fleeing by the light of temperance from nocturnal passions, and may behold with joy the radiant Passions of Christ!

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Sessional Hymn, by Lord Joseph, Tone 8, Podoben: "Thou hast risen from the tomb" (Воскре́слъ є҆сѝ ѿ гро́ба):*[^1064]  
O radiant luminaries, apostles of the Savior, enlighten us in the darkness of life, that we may now walk becomingly as in the day, fleeing by the light of temperance from nocturnal passions, and may behold with joy the radiant Passions of Christ!

items.office: On Thursday of the Fifth Week of the Great Fast
items.season_or_tone: FOURTH WEEK OF THE GREAT FAST
items.day_or_date: On Thursday of the Fifth Week of the Great Fast
items.slavonic_text: Ѡ҆дожде́нїемъ дх҃о́внымъ всю̀ подсѡ́лнечнꙋю напо́йсте, * сꙋ́шꙋ ѿгна́вше многобо́жїа, всебл҃же́ннїи.
items.english_text: O God-chosen twelve-fold choir of the Apostles, offer now supplication unto Christ, that all who perform their prayers in compunction *At Matins (continued):*

provenance.verbatim_source:
O God-chosen twelve-fold choir of the Apostles, offer now supplication unto Christ, that all who perform their prayers in compunction...
*At Matins (continued):*

items.office: On Thursday of the Fifth Week of the Great Fast
items.season_or_tone: FOURTH WEEK OF THE GREAT FAST
items.day_or_date: On Thursday of the Fifth Week of the Great Fast
items.english_text: ...may pass through the course of the Fast, zealously practicing virtues, so that we may thus come beforehand to behold the glorious Resurrection of Christ God, offering glory and praise!

provenance.verbatim_source: ...may pass through the course of the Fast, zealously practicing virtues, so that we may thus come beforehand to behold the glorious Resurrection of Christ God, offering glory and praise!

items.office: On Thursday of the Fifth Week of the Great Fast
items.season_or_tone: FOURTH WEEK OF THE GREAT FAST
items.day_or_date: On Thursday of the Fifth Week of the Great Fast
items.english_text: O Mother of God, together with the Apostles, entreat the incomprehensible Son and Word of God, Who was ineffably born of thee beyond comprehension, to grant pure peace unto the universe, and before the end to grant us forgiveness of transgressions, and for the sake of His extreme goodness, to make Thy servants worthy of the Heavenly Kingdom!

provenance.verbatim_source: O Mother of God, together with the Apostles, entreat the incomprehensible Son and Word of God, Who was ineffably born of thee beyond comprehension, to grant pure peace unto the universe, and before the end to grant us forgiveness of transgressions, and for the sake of His extreme goodness, to make Thy servants worthy of the Heavenly Kingdom!

items.office: On Thursday of the Fifth Week of the Great Fast
items.season_or_tone: FOURTH WEEK OF THE GREAT FAST
items.day_or_date: On Thursday of the Fifth Week of the Great Fast
items.english_text: *Then the Triodion, without prostrations.*[^1067]

provenance.verbatim_source: *Then the Triodion, without prostrations.*[^1067]

items.office: On Thursday of the Fifth Week of the Great Fast
items.season_or_tone: FOURTH WEEK OF THE GREAT FAST
items.day_or_date: On Thursday of the Fifth Week of the Great Fast
items.english_text: *Ode 4, Tone 8. Heirmos:*[^1068] I have heard, O Lord, the mystery of Thy dispensation; I have understood Thy works, and I have glorified Thy Divinity!

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Ode 4, Tone 8. Heirmos:*[^1068]  
I have heard, O Lord, the mystery of Thy dispensation; I have understood Thy works, and I have glorified Thy Divinity!

items.office: On Thursday of the Fifth Week of the Great Fast
items.season_or_tone: FOURTH WEEK OF THE GREAT FAST
items.day_or_date: On Thursday of the Fifth Week of the Great Fast
items.english_text: Having lived in self-mastery, the enlightened apostles of Christ calm for us the season of fasting through their divine intercessions.

provenance.verbatim_source: Having lived in self-mastery, the enlightened apostles of Christ calm for us the season of fasting through their divine intercessions.

items.office: On Thursday of the Fifth Week of the Great Fast
items.season_or_tone: FOURTH WEEK OF THE GREAT FAST
items.day_or_date: On Thursday of the Fifth Week of the Great Fast
items.english_text: A twelve-stringed instrument, the divine choir of the disciples, sang a saving song, confounding evil voices.[^1069]

provenance.verbatim_source: A twelve-stringed instrument, the divine choir of the disciples, sang a saving song, confounding evil voices.[^1069]

items.office: On Thursday of the Fifth Week of the Great Fast
items.season_or_tone: FOURTH WEEK OF THE GREAT FAST
items.day_or_date: On Thursday of the Fifth Week of the Great Fast
items.english_text: With spiritual rain ye have watered the whole world under the sun, having driven away the drought of polytheism, O all-blessed ones!

provenance.verbatim_source: With spiritual rain ye have watered the whole world under the sun, having driven away the drought of polytheism, O all-blessed ones!

items.office: On Thursday of the Fifth Week of the Great Fast
items.season_or_tone: FOURTH WEEK OF THE GREAT FAST
items.day_or_date: On Thursday of the Fifth Week of the Great Fast
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* Save me who have humbled myself, having lived in high-mindedness, O all-pure Virgin, who gavest birth unto Him Who hath exalted our humbled nature!

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Theotokion:*  
Save me who have humbled myself, having lived in high-mindedness, O all-pure Virgin, who gavest birth unto Him Who hath exalted our humbled nature!

items.office: On Thursday of the Fifth Week of the Great Fast
items.season_or_tone: FOURTH WEEK OF THE GREAT FAST
items.day_or_date: On Thursday of the Fifth Week of the Great Fast
items.english_text: O all-honorable assembly of the Apostles, praying unto the Creator of all: ask that He have mercy upon us who praise you!

provenance.verbatim_source: O all-honorable assembly of the Apostles, praying unto the Creator of all: ask that He have mercy upon us who praise you!

items.office: On Thursday of the Fifth Week of the Great Fast
items.season_or_tone: FOURTH WEEK OF THE GREAT FAST
items.day_or_date: On Thursday of the Fifth Week of the Great Fast
items.english_text: Being husbandmen of Christ, O apostles, who have cultivated the whole world by the divine word, ye ever bring forth fruits unto Him.

provenance.verbatim_source: Being husbandmen of Christ, O apostles, who have cultivated the whole world by the divine word, ye ever bring forth fruits unto Him.

items.office: On Thursday of the Fifth Week of the Great Fast
items.season_or_tone: FOURTH WEEK OF THE GREAT FAST
items.day_or_date: On Thursday of the Fifth Week of the Great Fast
items.english_text: Ye became the vineyard of Christ, truly beloved, for ye have poured forth spiritual wine unto the world, O apostles!

provenance.verbatim_source: Ye became the vineyard of Christ, truly beloved, for ye have poured forth spiritual wine unto the world, O apostles!

items.office: On Thursday of the Fifth Week of the Great Fast
items.season_or_tone: FOURTH WEEK OF THE GREAT FAST
items.day_or_date: On Thursday of the Fifth Week of the Great Fast
items.english_text: O transcendentally-originate, co-equal, all-powerful Holy Trinity, Father, Word, and Holy Spirit, God, Light and Life: preserve Thy flock!

provenance.verbatim_source: O transcendentally-originate, co-equal, all-powerful Holy Trinity, Father, Word, and Holy Spirit, God, Light and Life: preserve Thy flock!

items.office: On Thursday of the Fifth Week of the Great Fast
items.season_or_tone: FOURTH WEEK OF THE GREAT FAST
items.day_or_date: On Thursday of the Fifth Week of the Great Fast
items.english_text: Rejoice, O fiery-visaged Throne! Rejoice, O light-bearing Lampstand! Rejoice, O Mountain of sanctification, Ark of life, Holy of holies Tabernacle!

provenance.verbatim_source: Rejoice, O fiery-visaged Throne! Rejoice, O light-bearing Lampstand! Rejoice, O Mountain of sanctification, Ark of life, Holy of holies Tabernacle!

items.office: On Thursday of the Fifth Week of the Great Fast
items.season_or_tone: FOURTH WEEK OF THE GREAT FAST
items.day_or_date: On Thursday of the Fifth Week of the Great Fast
items.english_text: *Ode 4 of the Great Canon. Another Heirmos:*[^1071] The prophet heard of Thy coming, O Lord, and was afraid: that Thou wast to be born of a Virgin and appear unto men, and he said: I have heard the report of Thee and was afraid: glory to Thy power, O Lord!

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Ode 4 of the Great Canon. Another Heirmos:*[^1071]  
The prophet heard of Thy coming, O Lord, and was afraid: that Thou wast to be born of a Virgin and appear unto men, and he said: I have heard the report of Thee and was afraid: glory to Thy power, O Lord!

items.office: On Thursday of the Fifth Week of the Great Fast
items.season_or_tone: FOURTH WEEK OF THE GREAT FAST
items.day_or_date: On Thursday of the Fifth Week of the Great Fast
items.english_text: Despise not Thy works, abandon not Thy creation, O Righteous Judge, even though I alone have sinned as a man more than any man, O Lover of mankind; yet as Lord of all, Thou hast authority to forgive sins!

provenance.verbatim_source: Despise not Thy works, abandon not Thy creation, O Righteous Judge, even though I alone have sinned as a man more than any man, O Lover of mankind; yet as Lord of all, Thou hast authority to forgive sins!

items.office: On Thursday of the Fifth Week of the Great Fast
items.season_or_tone: FOURTH WEEK OF THE GREAT FAST
items.day_or_date: On Thursday of the Fifth Week of the Great Fast
items.english_text: The end is drawing near, O soul, it is drawing near, and thou dost not care, nor dost thou prepare; the time is growing short, arise: the Judge is near at the doors! Like a dream, like a flower, the time of life runs on; why do we trouble ourselves in vain?

provenance.verbatim_source: The end is drawing near, O soul, it is drawing near, and thou dost not care, nor dost thou prepare; the time is growing short, arise: the Judge is near at the doors! Like a dream, like a flower, the time of life runs on; why do we trouble ourselves in vain?

items.office: On Thursday of the Fifth Week of the Great Fast
items.season_or_tone: FOURTH WEEK OF THE GREAT FAST
items.day_or_date: On Thursday of the Fifth Week of the Great Fast
items.english_text: Awake, O my soul! Consider thy deeds which thou hast committed; bring them before thy face, and shed a drop of thy tears; speak with boldness of thy deeds and thoughts unto Christ, and be justified!

provenance.verbatim_source: Awake, O my soul! Consider thy deeds which thou hast committed; bring them before thy face, and shed a drop of thy tears; speak with boldness of thy deeds and thoughts unto Christ, and be justified!

items.office: On Thursday of the Fifth Week of the Great Fast
items.season_or_tone: FOURTH WEEK OF THE GREAT FAST
items.day_or_date: On Thursday of the Fifth Week of the Great Fast
items.english_text: There has been no sin in life, nor deed, nor wickedness, which I have not committed, O Savior, having sinned in mind and word, in deliberate choice and intention, in thought and deed, as no one else ever has!

provenance.verbatim_source: There has been no sin in life, nor deed, nor wickedness, which I have not committed, O Savior, having sinned in mind and word, in deliberate choice and intention, in thought and deed, as no one else ever has!

items.office: On Thursday of the Fifth Week of the Great Fast
items.season_or_tone: FOURTH WEEK OF THE GREAT FAST
items.day_or_date: On Thursday of the Fifth Week of the Great Fast
items.english_text: Therefore am I condemned, therefore am I convicted, wretched that I am, by mine own conscience, than which nothing in the world is more compelling: O Judge, my Redeemer and Knower of hearts, spare and deliver, and save me, Thy servant!

provenance.verbatim_source: Therefore am I condemned, therefore am I convicted, wretched that I am, by mine own conscience, than which nothing in the world is more compelling: O Judge, my Redeemer and Knower of hearts, spare and deliver, and save me, Thy servant!

items.office: On Thursday of the Fifth Week of the Great Fast
items.season_or_tone: FOURTH WEEK OF THE GREAT FAST
items.day_or_date: On Thursday of the Fifth Week of the Great Fast
items.english_text: The ladder which the great one among the patriarchs saw of old is a pattern, O my soul, of practical ascent and of noetic elevation; if then thou desirest to live in practice, in knowledge, and in contemplation, be renewed![^1072]

provenance.verbatim_source: The ladder which the great one among the patriarchs saw of old is a pattern, O my soul, of practical ascent and of noetic elevation; if then thou desirest to live in practice, in knowledge, and in contemplation, be renewed![^1072]

items.office: On Thursday of the Fifth Week of the Great Fast
items.season_or_tone: FOURTH WEEK OF THE GREAT FAST
items.day_or_date: On Thursday of the Fifth Week of the Great Fast
items.english_text: The patriarch endured the heat of the day for the sake of privation, and bore the frost of the night, daily making provision, pasturing, laboring, and serving, that he might obtain two wives.

provenance.verbatim_source: The patriarch endured the heat of the day for the sake of privation, and bore the frost of the night, daily making provision, pasturing, laboring, and serving, that he might obtain two wives.

items.office: On Thursday of the Fifth Week of the Great Fast
items.season_or_tone: FOURTH WEEK OF THE GREAT FAST
items.day_or_date: On Thursday of the Fifth Week of the Great Fast
items.english_text: Understand the two wives to mean practice and contemplation in knowledge: Leah as practice, since she had many children, and Rachel as knowledge, since she was acquired with much labor; for without labors, O soul, neither practice nor contemplation will succeed!

provenance.verbatim_source: Understand the two wives to mean practice and contemplation in knowledge: Leah as practice, since she had many children, and Rachel as knowledge, since she was acquired with much labor; for without labors, O soul, neither practice nor contemplation will succeed!

items.office: On Thursday of the Fifth Week of the Great Fast
items.season_or_tone: FOURTH WEEK OF THE GREAT FAST
items.day_or_date: On Thursday of the Fifth Week of the Great Fast
items.english_text: Watch, O my soul, excel as of old the great one among the patriarchs, that thou mayest acquire practice with knowledge, that thou mayest be a mind seeing God, and reach the unwaning darkness in vision, and be a great merchant!

provenance.verbatim_source: Watch, O my soul, excel as of old the great one among the patriarchs, that thou mayest acquire practice with knowledge, that thou mayest be a mind seeing God, and reach the unwaning darkness in vision, and be a great merchant!

items.office: On Thursday of the Fifth Week of the Great Fast
items.season_or_tone: FOURTH WEEK OF THE GREAT FAST
items.day_or_date: On Thursday of the Fifth Week of the Great Fast
items.english_text: Having begotten the twelve patriarchs, the great one among the patriarchs mystically established for thee, O my soul, a ladder of active ascent, having wisely set his children as foundations and his steps as an ascent![^1073]

provenance.verbatim_source: Having begotten the twelve patriarchs, the great one among the patriarchs mystically established for thee, O my soul, a ladder of active ascent, having wisely set his children as foundations and his steps as an ascent![^1073]

items.office: On Thursday of the Fifth Week of the Great Fast
items.season_or_tone: FOURTH WEEK OF THE GREAT FAST
items.day_or_date: On Thursday of the Fifth Week of the Great Fast
items.english_text: Thou hast imitated hated Esau, O soul, and hast surrendered to thy seducer the birthright of the first beauty, and hast fallen away from the paternal prayer, and twice hast thou slipped, wretched one, in practice and in knowledge: therefore repent now!

provenance.verbatim_source: Thou hast imitated hated Esau, O soul, and hast surrendered to thy seducer the birthright of the first beauty, and hast fallen away from the paternal prayer, and twice hast thou slipped, wretched one, in practice and in knowledge: therefore repent now!

items.office: On Thursday of the Fifth Week of the Great Fast
items.season_or_tone: FOURTH WEEK OF THE GREAT FAST
items.day_or_date: On Thursday of the Fifth Week of the Great Fast
items.english_text: Esau was called Edom because of his extreme frenzy for women; for burning ever with intemperance and defiled by pleasures, he was named Edom, which is interpreted as the inflamed burning of a sin-loving soul.

provenance.verbatim_source: Esau was called Edom because of his extreme frenzy for women; for burning ever with intemperance and defiled by pleasures, he was named Edom, which is interpreted as the inflamed burning of a sin-loving soul.

items.office: On Thursday of the Fifth Week of the Great Fast
items.season_or_tone: FOURTH WEEK OF THE GREAT FAST
items.day_or_date: On Thursday of the Fifth Week of the Great Fast
items.english_text: Having heard of Job on the dungheap who was justified, O my soul, thou hast not emulated his courage, nor hast thou possessed a steadfast purpose in all that thou knowest and wherewith thou hast been tempted, but thou hast shown thyself impatient![^1074]

provenance.verbatim_source: Having heard of Job on the dungheap who was justified, O my soul, thou hast not emulated his courage, nor hast thou possessed a steadfast purpose in all that thou knowest and wherewith thou hast been tempted, but thou hast shown thyself impatient![^1074]

items.office: On Thursday of the Fifth Week of the Great Fast
items.season_or_tone: FOURTH WEEK OF THE GREAT FAST
items.day_or_date: On Thursday of the Fifth Week of the Great Fast
items.english_text: He who was before upon a throne is now naked and festering on a dungheap; he who had many children and was glorious is suddenly childless and homeless: for he accounted the dungheap as a palace, and his sores as pearls!

provenance.verbatim_source: He who was before upon a throne is now naked and festering on a dungheap; he who had many children and was glorious is suddenly childless and homeless: for he accounted the dungheap as a palace, and his sores as pearls!

items.office: On Thursday of the Fifth Week of the Great Fast
items.season_or_tone: FOURTH WEEK OF THE GREAT FAST
items.day_or_date: On Thursday of the Fifth Week of the Great Fast
items.english_text: Clothed in royal dignity, with a crown and purple, a man of great possessions and righteous, abounding in wealth and herds, suddenly grew poor and was deprived of his wealth and the glory of his kingdom.

provenance.verbatim_source: Clothed in royal dignity, with a crown and purple, a man of great possessions and righteous, abounding in wealth and herds, suddenly grew poor and was deprived of his wealth and the glory of his kingdom.

items.office: On Thursday of the Fifth Week of the Great Fast
items.season_or_tone: FOURTH WEEK OF THE GREAT FAST
items.day_or_date: On Thursday of the Fifth Week of the Great Fast
items.english_text: If that man was righteous and blameless more than all, yet did not escape the hunter's snare and net: what wilt thou do, O wretched soul, that lovest sin, if something unexpected should come upon thee?

provenance.verbatim_source: If that man was righteous and blameless more than all, yet did not escape the hunter's snare and net: what wilt thou do, O wretched soul, that lovest sin, if something unexpected should come upon thee?

items.office: On Thursday of the Fifth Week of the Great Fast
items.season_or_tone: FOURTH WEEK OF THE GREAT FAST
items.day_or_date: On Thursday of the Fifth Week of the Great Fast
items.english_text: The body is defiled, the spirit is soiled, and I am wholly covered with sores: but as a physician, O Christ, heal both by my repentance; wash, cleanse, and show me forth, O my Savior, whiter than snow!

provenance.verbatim_source: The body is defiled, the spirit is soiled, and I am wholly covered with sores: but as a physician, O Christ, heal both by my repentance; wash, cleanse, and show me forth, O my Savior, whiter than snow!

items.office: On Thursday of the Fifth Week of the Great Fast
items.season_or_tone: FOURTH WEEK OF THE GREAT FAST
items.day_or_date: On Thursday of the Fifth Week of the Great Fast
items.english_text: Being crucified for all, Thou didst offer Thy Body and Blood, O Word: Thy Body, that Thou mightest renew me; Thy Blood, that Thou mightest wash me; and Thou didst surrender Thy Spirit, O Christ, that Thou mightest bring me unto Thy Father!

provenance.verbatim_source: Being crucified for all, Thou didst offer Thy Body and Blood, O Word: Thy Body, that Thou mightest renew me; Thy Blood, that Thou mightest wash me; and Thou didst surrender Thy Spirit, O Christ, that Thou mightest bring me unto Thy Father!

items.office: On Thursday of the Fifth Week of the Great Fast
items.season_or_tone: FOURTH WEEK OF THE GREAT FAST
items.day_or_date: On Thursday of the Fifth Week of the Great Fast
items.english_text: Thou hast wrought salvation in the midst of the earth, O Compassionate One, that we might be saved: willingly wast Thou crucified upon the Tree; Eden that was shut was opened; the things above and the things below, and all the saved nations worship Thee!

provenance.verbatim_source: Thou hast wrought salvation in the midst of the earth, O Compassionate One, that we might be saved: willingly wast Thou crucified upon the Tree; Eden that was shut was opened; the things above and the things below, and all the saved nations worship Thee!

items.office: On Thursday of the Fifth Week of the Great Fast
items.season_or_tone: FOURTH WEEK OF THE GREAT FAST
items.day_or_date: On Thursday of the Fifth Week of the Great Fast
items.english_text: May the Blood from Thy side be a font for me, and the water that flowed forth a drink of forgiveness together, that I may be cleansed on both sides, anointed and drinking, as an anointing and drink, O Word, Thy life-flowing words![^1075]

provenance.verbatim_source: May the Blood from Thy side be a font for me, and the water that flowed forth a drink of forgiveness together, that I may be cleansed on both sides, anointed and drinking, as an anointing and drink, O Word, Thy life-flowing words![^1075]

items.office: On Thursday of the Fifth Week of the Great Fast
items.season_or_tone: FOURTH WEEK OF THE GREAT FAST
items.day_or_date: On Thursday of the Fifth Week of the Great Fast
items.english_text: I am naked of the bridal chamber, I am naked of the marriage, and together of the banquet: the lamp is extinguished, as having no oil; the bridal chamber is shut while I slept; the supper has been eaten; and I, bound hand and foot, am cast outside!

provenance.verbatim_source: I am naked of the bridal chamber, I am naked of the marriage, and together of the banquet: the lamp is extinguished, as having no oil; the bridal chamber is shut while I slept; the supper has been eaten; and I, bound hand and foot, am cast outside!

items.office: On Thursday of the Fifth Week of the Great Fast
items.season_or_tone: FOURTH WEEK OF THE GREAT FAST
items.day_or_date: On Thursday of the Fifth Week of the Great Fast
items.english_text: The Church has acquired as a chalice Thy life-bearing side, from which it poured forth for us two-fold streams of forgiveness and knowledge, in the image of the Old and the New, the two Covenants together, O our Savior!

provenance.verbatim_source: The Church has acquired as a chalice Thy life-bearing side, from which it poured forth for us two-fold streams of forgiveness and knowledge, in the image of the Old and the New, the two Covenants together, O our Savior!

items.office: On Thursday of the Fifth Week of the Great Fast
items.season_or_tone: FOURTH WEEK OF THE GREAT FAST
items.day_or_date: On Thursday of the Fifth Week of the Great Fast
items.english_text: The time of my life is short, and filled with pain and wickedness: but receive me in repentance, and summon me unto knowledge, that I may not become the possession nor the food of the stranger: do Thou Thyself have compassion on me, O Savior!

provenance.verbatim_source: The time of my life is short, and filled with pain and wickedness: but receive me in repentance, and summon me unto knowledge, that I may not become the possession nor the food of the stranger: do Thou Thyself have compassion on me, O Savior!

items.office: On Thursday of the Fifth Week of the Great Fast
items.season_or_tone: FOURTH WEEK OF THE GREAT FAST
items.day_or_date: On Thursday of the Fifth Week of the Great Fast
items.english_text: I am high-spoken now, and also hard of heart, in vain and to no purpose: condemn me not with the Pharisee; but rather grant me the humility of the Publican, O only Compassionate One, Righteous Judge, and number me with him!

provenance.verbatim_source: I am high-spoken now, and also hard of heart, in vain and to no purpose: condemn me not with the Pharisee; but rather grant me the humility of the Publican, O only Compassionate One, Righteous Judge, and number me with him!

items.office: On Thursday of the Fifth Week of the Great Fast
items.season_or_tone: FOURTH WEEK OF THE GREAT FAST
items.day_or_date: On Thursday of the Fifth Week of the Great Fast
items.english_text: I have sinned, having outraged the vessel of my flesh, I know it, O Compassionate One: but receive me in repentance, and summon me unto knowledge, that I may not become the possession nor the food of the stranger: do Thou Thyself have compassion on me, O Savior!

provenance.verbatim_source: I have sinned, having outraged the vessel of my flesh, I know it, O Compassionate One: but receive me in repentance, and summon me unto knowledge, that I may not become the possession nor the food of the stranger: do Thou Thyself have compassion on me, O Savior!

items.office: On Thursday of the Fifth Week of the Great Fast
items.season_or_tone: FOURTH WEEK OF THE GREAT FAST
items.day_or_date: On Thursday of the Fifth Week of the Great Fast
items.english_text: I have become an idol unto myself by passions, harming my soul, O Compassionate One: but receive me in repentance, and summon me unto knowledge, that I may not become the possession nor the food of the stranger: do Thou Thyself have compassion on me, O Savior!

provenance.verbatim_source: I have become an idol unto myself by passions, harming my soul, O Compassionate One: but receive me in repentance, and summon me unto knowledge, that I may not become the possession nor the food of the stranger: do Thou Thyself have compassion on me, O Savior!

items.office: On Thursday of the Fifth Week of the Great Fast
items.season_or_tone: FOURTH WEEK OF THE GREAT FAST
items.day_or_date: On Thursday of the Fifth Week of the Great Fast
items.english_text: I did not listen to Thy voice, I disobeyed Thy Scripture, O Lawgiver: but receive me in repentance, and summon me unto knowledge, that I may not become the possession nor the food of the stranger: do Thou Thyself have compassion on me, O Savior!

provenance.verbatim_source: I did not listen to Thy voice, I disobeyed Thy Scripture, O Lawgiver: but receive me in repentance, and summon me unto knowledge, that I may not become the possession nor the food of the stranger: do Thou Thyself have compassion on me, O Savior!

items.office: On Thursday of the Fifth Week of the Great Fast
items.season_or_tone: FOURTH WEEK OF THE GREAT FAST
items.day_or_date: On Thursday of the Fifth Week of the Great Fast
items.english_text: Passing thy life in the flesh like the bodiless powers, O venerable one, thou hast truly received great grace with God; intercede faithfully for those who honor thee: therefore we pray thee, deliver us also from all adversities by thy prayers!

provenance.verbatim_source: Passing thy life in the flesh like the bodiless powers, O venerable one, thou hast truly received great grace with God; intercede faithfully for those who honor thee: therefore we pray thee, deliver us also from all adversities by thy prayers!

items.office: On Thursday of the Fifth Week of the Great Fast
items.season_or_tone: FOURTH WEEK OF THE GREAT FAST
items.day_or_date: On Thursday of the Fifth Week of the Great Fast
items.english_text: Having been dragged down into the depth of great iniquities, thou wast not held fast; but with a higher thought thou didst hasten unto the highest virtue by deeds openly, having marvelously amazed the angelic nature, O Mary!

provenance.verbatim_source: Having been dragged down into the depth of great iniquities, thou wast not held fast; but with a higher thought thou didst hasten unto the highest virtue by deeds openly, having marvelously amazed the angelic nature, O Mary!

items.office: On Thursday of the Fifth Week of the Great Fast
items.season_or_tone: FOURTH WEEK OF THE GREAT FAST
items.day_or_date: On Thursday of the Fifth Week of the Great Fast
items.english_text: O Andrew, paternal boast, cease not to pray with thy supplications, standing before the all-divine Trinity, that we may be delivered from torment, who with love invoke thee as a divine advocate, O all-blessed one, the ornament of Crete!

provenance.verbatim_source: O Andrew, paternal boast, cease not to pray with thy supplications, standing before the all-divine Trinity, that we may be delivered from torment, who with love invoke thee as a divine advocate, O all-blessed one, the ornament of Crete!

items.office: On Thursday of the Fifth Week of the Great Fast
items.season_or_tone: FOURTH WEEK OF THE GREAT FAST
items.day_or_date: On Thursday of the Fifth Week of the Great Fast
items.english_text: Undivided in essence, unconfused in persons, I theologize Thee, the one Trinitarian Godhead, as of one kingship and co-enthroned; I cry unto Thee the great hymn, sung thrice in the highest!

provenance.verbatim_source: Undivided in essence, unconfused in persons, I theologize Thee, the one Trinitarian Godhead, as of one kingship and co-enthroned; I cry unto Thee the great hymn, sung thrice in the highest!

items.office: On Thursday of the Fifth Week of the Great Fast
items.season_or_tone: FOURTH WEEK OF THE GREAT FAST
items.day_or_date: On Thursday of the Fifth Week of the Great Fast
items.english_text: Thou both givest birth and remainest a virgin, and abidest in both manners a Virgin by nature: He Who is born renews the laws of nature, and the womb gives birth without having conceived: for where God wills, the order of nature is overcome; for He does whatsoever He wills!

provenance.verbatim_source: Thou both givest birth and remainest a virgin, and abidest in both manners a Virgin by nature: He Who is born renews the laws of nature, and the womb gives birth without having conceived: for where God wills, the order of nature is overcome; for He does whatsoever He wills!

items.office: On Thursday of the Fifth Week of the Great Fast
items.season_or_tone: FOURTH WEEK OF THE GREAT FAST
items.day_or_date: On Thursday of the Fifth Week of the Great Fast
items.english_text: *Ode 5. Heirmos:*[^1077] Rising early from the night, O Lover of mankind, enlighten me, I pray Thee, and guide me in Thy commandments, and teach me, O Savior, to do Thy will!

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Ode 5. Heirmos:*[^1077]  
Rising early from the night, O Lover of mankind, enlighten me, I pray Thee, and guide me in Thy commandments, and teach me, O Savior, to do Thy will!

items.office: On Thursday of the Fifth Week of the Great Fast
items.season_or_tone: FOURTH WEEK OF THE GREAT FAST
items.day_or_date: On Thursday of the Fifth Week of the Great Fast
items.english_text: In the night have I passed my life continually, for the night of sin was unto me darkness and thick gloom; but show me forth as a son of the day, O Savior!

provenance.verbatim_source: In the night have I passed my life continually, for the night of sin was unto me darkness and thick gloom; but show me forth as a son of the day, O Savior!

items.office: On Thursday of the Fifth Week of the Great Fast
items.season_or_tone: FOURTH WEEK OF THE GREAT FAST
items.day_or_date: On Thursday of the Fifth Week of the Great Fast
items.english_text: Imitating Reuben, wretched that I am, I have committed an unlawful and transgressing counsel against the most high God, having defiled my bed as he did his father's![^1078]

provenance.verbatim_source: Imitating Reuben, wretched that I am, I have committed an unlawful and transgressing counsel against the most high God, having defiled my bed as he did his father's![^1078]

items.office: On Thursday of the Fifth Week of the Great Fast
items.season_or_tone: FOURTH WEEK OF THE GREAT FAST
items.day_or_date: On Thursday of the Fifth Week of the Great Fast
items.english_text: I confess unto Thee, O Christ the King: I have sinned, I have sinned, like the brothers of old who sold Joseph, the fruit of purity and chastity!

provenance.verbatim_source: I confess unto Thee, O Christ the King: I have sinned, I have sinned, like the brothers of old who sold Joseph, the fruit of purity and chastity!

items.office: On Thursday of the Fifth Week of the Great Fast
items.season_or_tone: FOURTH WEEK OF THE GREAT FAST
items.day_or_date: On Thursday of the Fifth Week of the Great Fast
items.english_text: By his kinsmen was the righteous soul bound, the sweet one was sold into slavery, as a type of the Lord: but thou, O soul, hast wholly sold thyself by thine evil deeds!

provenance.verbatim_source: By his kinsmen was the righteous soul bound, the sweet one was sold into slavery, as a type of the Lord: but thou, O soul, hast wholly sold thyself by thine evil deeds!

items.office: On Thursday of the Fifth Week of the Great Fast
items.season_or_tone: FOURTH WEEK OF THE GREAT FAST
items.day_or_date: On Thursday of the Fifth Week of the Great Fast
items.english_text: Imitate the righteous and chaste mind of Joseph, O wretched and untried soul, and do not be defiled by continually breaking the law with irrational desires!

provenance.verbatim_source: Imitate the righteous and chaste mind of Joseph, O wretched and untried soul, and do not be defiled by continually breaking the law with irrational desires!

items.office: On Thursday of the Fifth Week of the Great Fast
items.season_or_tone: FOURTH WEEK OF THE GREAT FAST
items.day_or_date: On Thursday of the Fifth Week of the Great Fast
items.english_text: Even though Joseph dwelt in a pit of old, O Master and Lord, yet it was as a type of Thy burial and resurrection; but what such thing shall I ever offer unto Thee?

provenance.verbatim_source: Even though Joseph dwelt in a pit of old, O Master and Lord, yet it was as a type of Thy burial and resurrection; but what such thing shall I ever offer unto Thee?

items.office: On Thursday of the Fifth Week of the Great Fast
items.season_or_tone: FOURTH WEEK OF THE GREAT FAST
items.day_or_date: On Thursday of the Fifth Week of the Great Fast
items.english_text: Thou hast heard, O soul, of the ark of Moses, borne by the waters and the waves of the river, as if in a bridal chamber, fleeing from the deed of the bitter Pharaonic decree of old!

provenance.verbatim_source: Thou hast heard, O soul, of the ark of Moses, borne by the waters and the waves of the river, as if in a bridal chamber, fleeing from the deed of the bitter Pharaonic decree of old!

items.office: On Thursday of the Fifth Week of the Great Fast
items.season_or_tone: FOURTH WEEK OF THE GREAT FAST
items.day_or_date: On Thursday of the Fifth Week of the Great Fast
items.english_text: If thou hast heard of the midwives who of old killed the immature male child, O wretched soul, which is the practice of chastity: now, like great Moses, suckle wisdom![^1079]

provenance.verbatim_source: If thou hast heard of the midwives who of old killed the immature male child, O wretched soul, which is the practice of chastity: now, like great Moses, suckle wisdom![^1079]

items.office: On Thursday of the Fifth Week of the Great Fast
items.season_or_tone: FOURTH WEEK OF THE GREAT FAST
items.day_or_date: On Thursday of the Fifth Week of the Great Fast
items.english_text: Like great Moses who struck the Egyptian, thou hast not slain the mind wounded by sin, O wretched soul; and how, tell me, wilt thou dwell in the wilderness of passions through repentance?

provenance.verbatim_source: Like great Moses who struck the Egyptian, thou hast not slain the mind wounded by sin, O wretched soul; and how, tell me, wilt thou dwell in the wilderness of passions through repentance?

items.office: On Thursday of the Fifth Week of the Great Fast
items.season_or_tone: FOURTH WEEK OF THE GREAT FAST
items.day_or_date: On Thursday of the Fifth Week of the Great Fast
items.english_text: Great Moses dwelt in the wilderness: come then, imitate his life, that in the bush of the Divine Epiphany, O soul, thou mayest also be in contemplation!

provenance.verbatim_source: Great Moses dwelt in the wilderness: come then, imitate his life, that in the bush of the Divine Epiphany, O soul, thou mayest also be in contemplation!

items.office: On Thursday of the Fifth Week of the Great Fast
items.season_or_tone: FOURTH WEEK OF THE GREAT FAST
items.day_or_date: On Thursday of the Fifth Week of the Great Fast
items.english_text: Picture to thyself the rod of Moses, O soul, striking the sea and solidifying the deep, as a type of the divine Cross, through which thou also canst accomplish great things!

provenance.verbatim_source: Picture to thyself the rod of Moses, O soul, striking the sea and solidifying the deep, as a type of the divine Cross, through which thou also canst accomplish great things!

items.office: On Thursday of the Fifth Week of the Great Fast
items.season_or_tone: FOURTH WEEK OF THE GREAT FAST
items.day_or_date: On Thursday of the Fifth Week of the Great Fast
items.english_text: Aaron offered unto God a blameless and unbeguiling fire; but Hophni and Phinehas, like thee, O soul, offered unto God a strange, defiled life!

provenance.verbatim_source: Aaron offered unto God a blameless and unbeguiling fire; but Hophni and Phinehas, like thee, O soul, offered unto God a strange, defiled life!

items.office: On Thursday of the Fifth Week of the Great Fast
items.season_or_tone: FOURTH WEEK OF THE GREAT FAST
items.day_or_date: On Thursday of the Fifth Week of the Great Fast
items.english_text: Like Pharaoh bitter and hard in disposition, have I become, O Master, Jannes and Jambres in soul and body, and submerged in mind: but do Thou help me!

provenance.verbatim_source: Like Pharaoh bitter and hard in disposition, have I become, O Master, Jannes and Jambres in soul and body, and submerged in mind: but do Thou help me!

items.office: On Thursday of the Fifth Week of the Great Fast
items.season_or_tone: FOURTH WEEK OF THE GREAT FAST
items.day_or_date: On Thursday of the Fifth Week of the Great Fast
items.english_text: Wretched that I am, I have mingled with mire in my mind: wash me, O Master, in the bath of my tears, I pray Thee, making the garment of my flesh whiter than snow!

provenance.verbatim_source: Wretched that I am, I have mingled with mire in my mind: wash me, O Master, in the bath of my tears, I pray Thee, making the garment of my flesh whiter than snow!

items.office: On Thursday of the Fifth Week of the Great Fast
items.season_or_tone: FOURTH WEEK OF THE GREAT FAST
items.day_or_date: On Thursday of the Fifth Week of the Great Fast
items.english_text: If I examine my deeds, O Savior, I see that I have surpassed every man in sins, for I have sinned consciously with deliberate thought, not in ignorance!

provenance.verbatim_source: If I examine my deeds, O Savior, I see that I have surpassed every man in sins, for I have sinned consciously with deliberate thought, not in ignorance!

items.office: On Thursday of the Fifth Week of the Great Fast
items.season_or_tone: FOURTH WEEK OF THE GREAT FAST
items.day_or_date: On Thursday of the Fifth Week of the Great Fast
items.english_text: Spare, spare Thy creation, O Lord: I have sinned, forgive me, for Thou alone art pure by nature, and none other besides Thee is without defilement!

provenance.verbatim_source: Spare, spare Thy creation, O Lord: I have sinned, forgive me, for Thou alone art pure by nature, and none other besides Thee is without defilement!

items.day_or_date: On Thursday of the Fifth Week of the Great Fast
items.english_text: Being God, Thou didst take form in me for my sake; Thou hast shown forth wonders, healing lepers, and strengthening the paralytic: Thou didst stop the flow of blood of the woman with the issue of blood, O Savior, by the touch of Thy garments![^1080]

items.english_text: Imitate the woman with the issue of blood, O wretched soul: hasten, lay hold of the hem of Christ's garment, that thou mayest be delivered from afflictions, and hear from Him: Thy faith has saved thee!

items.day_or_date: On Thursday of the Fifth Week of the Great Fast
items.english_text: Imitate the bowed woman, O soul: come, fall down at the feet of Jesus, that He may straighten thee, and that thou mayest walk uprightly in the paths of the Lord!

items.day_or_date: On Thursday of the Fifth Week of the Great Fast
items.english_text: Even though Thou art a deep well, O Master, pour forth water for me from Thy most pure veins, that like the Samaritan woman, drinking I may thirst no more, for Thou pourest forth the streams of life!

provenance.verbatim_source: Even though Thou art a deep well, O Master, pour forth water for me from Thy most pure veins, that like the Samaritan woman, drinking I may thirst no more, for Thou pourest forth the streams of life!

items.season_or_tone: FOURTH WEEK OF THE GREAT FAST
items.day_or_date: On Thursday of the Fifth Week of the Great Fast
items.english_text: May my tears be as Siloam unto me, O Master and Lord, that I also may wash the pupils of my heart, and see Thee noetically, the pre-eternal Light![^1081]

items.season_or_tone: FOURTH WEEK OF THE GREAT FAST
items.day_or_date: On Thursday of the Fifth Week of the Great Fast
items.english_text: With incomparable desire, O all-wealthy one, having desired to worship the Life-bearing Wood, thou wast deemed worthy of thy desire: make me worthy also to obtain the glory on high!

provenance.verbatim_source: With incomparable desire, O all-wealthy one, having desired to worship the Life-bearing Wood, thou wast deemed worthy of thy desire: make me worthy also to obtain the glory on high!

items.season_or_tone: FOURTH WEEK OF THE GREAT FAST
items.day_or_date: On Thursday of the Fifth Week of the Great Fast
items.english_text: Having crossed the stream of the Jordan, thou didst find painless rest, having escaped the pleasures of the flesh; from which deliver us also by thy prayers, O venerable one!

provenance.verbatim_source: Having crossed the stream of the Jordan, thou didst find painless rest, having escaped the pleasures of the flesh; from which deliver us also by thy prayers, O venerable one!

items.day_or_date: On Thursday of the Fifth Week of the Great Fast
items.english_text: As an eminent pastor, O all-wise Andrew, being chosen, with great love and fear I pray thee: by thy prayers may I obtain salvation and eternal life!

items.english_text: Thee, the Trinity, we glorify, the one God: Holy, Holy, Holy art Thou, O Father, Son, and Spirit, simple Essence, Unity ever worshipped!

items.day_or_date: On Thursday of the Fifth Week of the Great Fast

items.english_text: The tears of mine eyes and sighs from the depth I offer in purity, O Savior, while my heart cries: O God, I have sinned against Thee, cleanse me!

items.english_text: Thou hast turned away from thy Lord, O soul, like Dathan and Abiram; but spare, cry out from the lowest hell, lest the chasm of the earth cover thee!

items.english_text: Like a heifer that has grown wild, O soul, thou hast become like Ephraim: as a gazelle from the snares, preserve thy life, having winged thy mind with practice and contemplation!

items.english_text: Let the hand of Moses convince us, O soul, how God can whiten and cleanse a leprous life; and despair not of thyself, even if thou art leprous![^1082]

items.english_text: On this day, according to ancient tradition, we chant the office of the Great Canon. This, truly the greatest of all canons, was excellently and artfully composed and written by our father among the saints, Andrew, Archbishop of Crete, who is also called "of Jerusalem." He originated from Damascus, and at the fourteenth year of his age, having devoted himself to grammatical training, and having mastered the complete cycle of liberal education, he arrived in Jerusalem, where he passed through the monastic life, living venerably and God-pleasingly in quietude and unperturbed living. He also left to the Church of God many other writings profitable for life, discourses and canons, showing himself and appearing particularly valiant in festival celebrations. Together with many others, he also composed the present Great Canon *At Matins (continued):*

provenance.verbatim_source: On this day, according to ancient tradition, we chant the office of the Great Canon. This, truly the greatest of all canons, was excellently and artfully composed and written by our father among the saints, Andrew, Archbishop of Crete, who is also called "of Jerusalem." He originated from Damascus, and at the fourteenth year of his age, having devoted himself to grammatical training, and having mastered the complete cycle of liberal education, he arrived in Jerusalem, where he passed through the monastic life, living venerably and God-pleasingly in quietude and unperturbed living. He also left to the Church of God many other writings profitable for life, discourses and canons, showing himself and appearing particularly valiant in festival celebrations. Together with many others, he also composed the present Great Canon...

items.slavonic_text: === LEAF p371 === (Printed Folio 367) Оу҆́тро [тѯз]
items.english_text: ...having boundless compunction; for having recorded and compiled every narrative of the Old and New Testaments, he composed the present sweet hymnody, clearly from Adam even unto Christ's very Ascension and the apostolic preaching.[^1086] He thereby rouses every soul to emulate and imitate according to its power whatever good stories are told, and to flee whatever evil things, and continually run unto God through repentance, tears, confession, and other clear pleasing of God. Yet it is so vast and sweet-sounding that it is able to soften even the hardest soul and awaken it unto noble vigilance, if only it be sung with a contrite heart and fitting attentiveness. He composed this also at the time when the great Sophronius, Patriarch of Jerusalem, wrote the Life of St. Mary of Egypt. For this Life also offers boundless compunction and grants great consolation unto those who have transgressed and are sinning, if only they wish to depart from evils. They were appointed to be sung and read on the present day for the following reason: because the Holy Forty Days is drawing near to its end, lest men, having grown slothful toward spiritual labors, neglectfully forget themselves and entirely cease from chastity. The great Andrew, therefore, like an instructor, by the narratives of the Great Canon recounted the virtue of great men and again the turning away from evil, as if one might say: he prepares those who labor most valiantly and bravely stretch forward unto what lies ahead. And the holy Sophronius, by his supernatural discourse, causes men to become chaste once more, raises them unto God, and urges them neither to fall down nor despair, even if they have at times been overtaken by certain transgressions. For how great is God's love for mankind and mercy toward those who whole-souledly choose to turn away from their former transgressions, the narrative concerning the Egyptian woman shows forth. It is called the Great Canon, as one might say, both because of these thoughts and recollections—for its composer is worthy of this, having composed them excellently—and because, while other canons contain about thirty troparia or a few more, this one reaches two hundred and fifty, each one dripping with ineffable sweetness. Fittingly and appropriately, therefore, this Great Canon acquired great compunction, for which reason it was appointed unto the Great Forty Days. This excellent and Great Canon, and the discourse on the venerable Mary, the same father of ours Andrew first brought unto the city of Constantine, when he came to assist, being sent by Patriarch Theodore of Jerusalem unto the Sixth Council. For having then contended excellently against the Monothelites, while still remaining among the monastics, he was enrolled in the clergy of the Church in the city of Constantine; then he was ordained deacon and appointed curator of orphans therein. And a little while later having become Archbishop of Crete, afterward, having reached near a place called Hieros toward Mytilene, he departed unto the Lord, having well shared in his see. By his prayers, O God, have mercy upon us.
