items.slavonic_text: оу҆миле́ніе неисче́тно и҆мѣ́я: * вся́кꙋю бо Ве́тхагѡ и҆ Но́вагѡ Завѣ́та повѣ́сть списа́въ, и҆ собра́въ, * настоя́щее сочинѝ сладкопѣ́ніе, * ѿ А҆да́ма ꙗ҆́вѣ, да́же и҆ до самогѡ̀ Хрⷭ҇то́ва вознесе́нїя, и҆ а҆пⷭ҇льскїя про́повѣди. * Подвиза́етъ оу҆́бѡ си́мъ вся́кꙋю дꙋ́шꙋ, * є҆ли́кимъ оу҆́бѡ бл҃ги́мъ повѣ́сти ревнова́ти, и҆ подража́ти по си́лѣ: * є҆ли́кихъ же ѕлы́хъ ѿбѣга́ти, * и҆ при́нѡ къ Бг҃ꙋ востека́ти покаѧ́нїемъ, слеза́ми, и҆ и҆сповѣ́данїемъ, * и҆ и҆ны́мъ ꙗ҆́вѣ бл҃гоꙋгожде́нїемъ. * Ѡ҆ба́че толи́кѡ є҆́сть широ́кїй, и҆ сладкогла́сный, * ꙗ҆́кѡ и҆ самꙋ̀ жесточа́йшꙋю дꙋ́шꙋ дово́ленъ оу҆мягчи́ти, * и҆ къ бо́дрости бл҃го́й воздви́гнꙋти, * а҆́ще то́чїю съ сокрꙋше́нымъ се́рдцемъ и҆ внима́нїемъ подо́бнымъ пое́тся. * Сотвори́ же сего̀, є҆гда̀ и҆ патрїа́рхъ і҆ерл҃мскїй вели́кїй Софро́нїй, Е҆гѵ́птѧныни Марїи житїѐ списа̀. * Оу҆миле́нїе бо и҆ сїѐ житїѐ предлага́етъ безчи́сленно, * и҆ мно́гое прегрѣши́вшымъ и҆ согрѣша́ющымъ оу҆тѣше́нїе даетъ, * а҆́ще то́чїю ѕлы́хъ ѿстꙋпи́ти хотя́тъ. * Оу҆чини́шася же и҆ въ настоя́щїй де́нь пѣ́тися и҆ прочита́тися, сицевы́я ра́ди вины̀: * поне́же бо къ концꙋ̀ приближа́ется ст҃а́я Четыредеся́тница, * да не человѣ́цы лѣ́ниви бы́вше къ дх҃о́внымъ подвигѡ́мъ, * небре́жнѡ забꙋ́дꙋтся, * и҆ є҆́же цѣломꙋ́дрствовати є҆ди́ною во всѣ́хъ преста́нꙋтъ. * Вели́кїй оу҆́бѡ А҆ндре́й, ꙗ҆́коже нѣ́кїй наказа́тель, * повѣ́стьми Вели́кагѡ Канѡ́на, * вели́кихъ мꙋже́й гла̀ добродѣ́тель, * и҆ ѕлы́хъ па́ки ѿвраще́нїе, * ꙗ҆́кѡ а҆́ще кто̀ ре́клъ бы: * до́блѣйшихъ трꙋжда́ющихся предꙋстро́итъ, * и҆ мꙋ́жественнѣ къ пре́днимъ простира́тися. * Сщ҃е́нный же Сѡфро́нїй преесте́ственнымъ свои́мъ сло́вомъ, * цѣломꙋ́дрены и҆ па́ки бы́ти твори́тъ, * и҆ къ Бг҃ꙋ воздви́жетъ, * и҆ не низпа́дати нижѐ ѿчая́тися, * а҆́ще и҆ногда̀ нѣ́кими прегрѣше́ньми ꙗ҆́ти бы́ша. * Е҆ли́кѡ бо Бж҃їе человѣколю́бїе и҆ ми́лость, * вседꙋ́шнѡ ѿ пе́рвыхъ прегрѣше́нїй ѿврати́тися произво́ляющимъ, * є҆́же ѡ҆ Е҆гѵ́птѧныни повѣда́нїе представля́етъ. * Гл҃ется же Вели́кїй Канѡ́нъ, не́гли а҆́ще кто̀ ре́клъ бы, и҆ по тѣ́мъ мы́слемъ и҆ воспоминанове́нїемъ: * подо́бичъ бо є҆́сть сегѡ̀ тво́рецъ, * и҆зра́днѡ та̀ сложи́въ, * и҆ ꙗ҆́кѡ про́чихъ канѡ́нѡвъ по три́десяти и҆ ма́лѡ что̀ къ тропаре́мъ и҆мꙋ́щымъ: * се́й же, сп҃, прохо́дитъ є҆ди́нагѡ коегѡ́ждо неизрече́ннꙋю и҆ска́пая сла́дость. * Прикла́днѡ оу҆́бѡ и҆ подо́бнѡ Вели́кїй се́й Канѡ́нъ, * и҆ вели́ко стяжа́въ оу҆миле́нїе, * тѣ́мже и҆ къ вели́цѣй Четыредеся́тницѣ оу҆чини́ся. * Се́й и҆зра́дный Канѡ́нъ и҆ вели́кїй и҆ преподо́бныя Марїи сло́во, * то́йже ѻ҆́ц҃ъ на́шъ А҆ндре́й, пе́рвый въ Кѡнстанті́нъ гра́дъ принесе́, * є҆гда̀ ѿ патрїа́рха і҆ерли́мскагѡ Ѳеѡ́дѡра въ шесты́й собо́ръ по́сланъ, въ по́мощь прїи́де. * Тогда́ бо и҆зра́днѡ на є҆диново́льники подвиза́вся, * є҆щѐ пребыва́я въ мона́шествꙋющихъ, * кли́рꙋ цр҃кве въ Кѡнстанті́нѣ гра́дѣ причита́ется: * та́же дїа́конъ, и҆ сиротопита́тель къ се́й поставля́ется. * И҆ по ма́лѣ а҆рхїепⷭ҇кпъ кри́тскїй бы́въ: * пото́мъ бли́зъ нѣ́гдѣ ко глаго́лемомꙋ І҆ерїе́ꙋ дости́гъ къ Мѵтѷлі́нѣ, ко Гдⷭ҇ꋋ ѿи́де, * дово́льнѣ своего̀ прⷭ҇то́ла въ прича́стїи бы́въ. * Тогѡ̀ мл҃твами Бж҃е поми́лꙋй на́съ.

items.slavonic_text: Та́же Бл҃же́нны съ покло́ны. Гла́съ ѕ҃: Во Црⷭ҇твїи твое́мъ, є҆гда̀ прїи́деши, помяни́ на́съ Гдⷭ҇и. Разбо́йника Хрⷭ҇тѐ рая̀ жи́теля сотвори́лъ є҆сѝ, * на крⷭ҇тѣ́ тебѣ̀ возопи́вша: * помяни́ мя, * тогѡ̀ покаѧ́нїю сподо́би и҆ менѐ недосто́йнаго. Стíхъ: Бл҃же́ни ни́щїи дх҃омъ, ꙗ҆́кѡ тѣ́хъ є҆́сть Црⷭ҇тво нбⷭ҇ное. Манѡ́а слы́шавши дре́вле дꙋшѐ моя̀, * Бг҃а въ ꙗ҆вле́нїи бы́вша, * и҆ и҆з̾ непло́дове тогда̀ прїе́мша пло́дъ ѡ҆бѣтова́нїя, * тогѡ̀ бл҃гоче́стїе подража́й. Стíхъ: Бл҃же́ни пла́чꙋщїи, ꙗ҆́кѡ тíи оу҆тѣ́шатся. Самѱѡ́новой поревнова́вши лѣ́ности, * главꙋ̀ ѡ҆стри́гла є҆сѝ дꙋшѐ дѣ́лъ твои́хъ, * преда́вши и҆ноплеме́нникѡмъ любосла́стїемъ * цѣломꙋ́дреннꙋю жи́знь и҆ блаже́ннꙋю.
items.english_text: In Thy Kingdom, when Thou comest, remember us, O Lord.

provenance.verbatim_source: In Thy Kingdom, when Thou comest, remember us, O Lord.

items.season_or_tone: FOURTH WEEK OF THE GREAT FAST

items.slavonic_text: === LEAF p372 === (Printed Folio 368) Въ четверто́къ є҃ седми́цы ст҃а́гѡ вели́кагѡ поста̀ [тѯи]
items.english_text: Thou didst make the thief an inhabitant of paradise, O Christ, when he cried unto Thee upon the Cross: "Remember me!" Count me also, an unworthy servant, worthy of his repentance.

provenance.verbatim_source: Thou didst make the thief an inhabitant of paradise, O Christ, when he cried unto Thee upon the Cross: "Remember me!" Count me also, an unworthy servant, worthy of his repentance.

items.office: On Thursday of the Fifth Week of the Great Fast
items.season_or_tone: FOURTH WEEK OF THE GREAT FAST
items.day_or_date: Synaxarion first of the Menaion, then the present one:*[^1085]
items.slavonic_text: Стíхъ: Бл҃же́ни а҆́лчꙋщїи и҆ жа́ждꙋщїи пра́вды, ꙗ҆́кѡ тíи насы́тятся. Вара́къ и҆ І҆ефѳа́й военача́льницы, * сꙋдїи І҆и҃левы предпочте́ни бы́ша, * съ ни́миже Дево́рра мꙋжеꙋ́мная: * тѣ́хъ до́блестьми дꙋшѐ вмꙋжи́вшися оу҆крѣпи́ся.
items.english_text: Having heard of Manoah of old, O my soul, when God appeared, and who then received the fruit of promise from a barren woman, imitate his piety.

provenance.verbatim_source: Having heard of Manoah of old, O my soul, when God appeared, and who then received the fruit of promise from a barren woman, imitate his piety.

items.office: On Thursday of the Fifth Week of the Great Fast
items.season_or_tone: FOURTH WEEK OF THE GREAT FAST
items.day_or_date: Synaxarion first of the Menaion, then the present one:*[^1085]
items.slavonic_text: Стíхъ: Бл҃же́ни чи́стїи се́рдцемъ, ꙗ҆́кѡ тíи Бг҃а оу҆́зрятъ. Пожрѝ дꙋшѐ же́ртвꙋ похва́льнꙋю, * дѣя́нїе ꙗ҆́кѡ дще́рь принесѝ, ѿ І҆ефѳа́евы чистѣ́йшꙋю: * и҆ заколѝ ꙗ҆́кѡ же́ртвꙋ, * стра́сти плотскїа Гдⷭ҇ви твое́мꙋ.
items.english_text: Having rivaled the indolence of Samson, thou hast shorn the head of thy works, O my soul, having surrendered through sensual pleasure unto foreigners thy chaste and blessed life.

provenance.verbatim_source: Having rivaled the indolence of Samson, thou hast shorn the head of thy works, O my soul, having surrendered through sensual pleasure unto foreigners thy chaste and blessed life.

items.english_text: *Verse: Blessed are the meek, for they shall inherit the earth.*[^1088]

items.season_or_tone: FOURTH WEEK OF THE GREAT FAST
items.day_or_date: Synaxarion first of the Menaion, then the present one:*[^1085]
items.english_text: He who of old conquered the foreigners with the jawbone of an ass is now found captive to passionate self-indulgence; but flee, O my soul, such imitation, action, and softness.

provenance.verbatim_source: He who of old conquered the foreigners with the jawbone of an ass is now found captive to passionate self-indulgence; but flee, O my soul, such imitation, action, and softness.

items.office: On Thursday of the Fifth Week of the Great Fast
items.season_or_tone: FOURTH WEEK OF THE GREAT FAST
items.day_or_date: Synaxarion first of the Menaion, then the present one:*[^1085]
items.english_text: Barak and Jephthah the military commanders, judges of Israel, were preferred, with them Deborah of manly mind; being strengthened, O soul, by their valiance, be thou made manly!

provenance.verbatim_source: Barak and Jephthah the military commanders, judges of Israel, were preferred, with them Deborah of manly mind; being strengthened, O soul, by their valiance, be thou made manly!

items.office: On Thursday of the Fifth Week of the Great Fast
items.season_or_tone: FOURTH WEEK OF THE GREAT FAST
items.day_or_date: Synaxarion first of the Menaion, then the present one:*[^1085]
items.english_text: Thou hast known the bravery of Jael, O my soul, who of old pierced Sisera and wrought salvation with a sharp wooden peg—hearest thou?—whereby the Cross is prefigured for thee.

provenance.verbatim_source: Thou hast known the bravery of Jael, O my soul, who of old pierced Sisera and wrought salvation with a sharp wooden peg—hearest thou?—whereby the Cross is prefigured for thee.

items.office: On Thursday of the Fifth Week of the Great Fast
items.season_or_tone: FOURTH WEEK OF THE GREAT FAST
items.day_or_date: Synaxarion first of the Menaion, then the present one:*[^1085]
items.english_text: Offer, O soul, a sacrifice of praise; bring action as a daughter purer than Jephthah's, and slay as a sacrifice the carnal passions unto thy Lord.

provenance.verbatim_source: Offer, O soul, a sacrifice of praise; bring action as a daughter purer than Jephthah's, and slay as a sacrifice the carnal passions unto thy Lord.

items.day_or_date: Synaxarion first of the Menaion, then the present one:*[^1085]
items.english_text: *Verse: Blessed are the peacemakers, for they shall be called sons of God.*[^1089]

items.day_or_date: Synaxarion first of the Menaion, then the present one:*[^1085]
items.english_text: Consider Gideon's fleece, O my soul; receive the dew from heaven, and lap like a dog, and drink the water flowing from the Law by the wringing out of the letter.

provenance.verbatim_source: Consider Gideon's fleece, O my soul; receive the dew from heaven, and lap like a dog, and drink the water flowing from the Law by the wringing out of the letter.

items.office: On Thursday of the Fifth Week of the Great Fast
items.season_or_tone: FOURTH WEEK OF THE GREAT FAST
items.day_or_date: Synaxarion first of the Menaion, then the present one:*[^1085]
items.english_text: Thou hast received the condemnation of Eli the priest, O my soul, through lack of discernment having acquired passions for thyself, just as he his children, to work iniquities.

provenance.verbatim_source: Thou hast received the condemnation of Eli the priest, O my soul, through lack of discernment having acquired passions for thyself, just as he his children, to work iniquities.

items.office: On Thursday of the Fifth Week of the Great Fast
items.season_or_tone: FOURTH WEEK OF THE GREAT FAST
items.day_or_date: Synaxarion first of the Menaion, then the present one:*[^1085]
items.english_text: Among the judges, the Levite through neglect divided his wife unto the twelve tribes, O my soul, that he might expose the unlawful defilement of Benjamin.

provenance.verbatim_source: Among the judges, the Levite through neglect divided his wife unto the twelve tribes, O my soul, that he might expose the unlawful defilement of Benjamin.

items.office: On Thursday of the Fifth Week of the Great Fast
items.season_or_tone: FOURTH WEEK OF THE GREAT FAST
items.day_or_date: Synaxarion first of the Menaion, then the present one:*[^1085]
items.english_text: The wise Hannah while praying moved her lips indeed in praise, but her voice was not heard; yet being barren, she gives birth to a worthy son of prayer.

provenance.verbatim_source: The wise Hannah while praying moved her lips indeed in praise, but her voice was not heard; yet being barren, she gives birth to a worthy son of prayer.

items.office: On Thursday of the Fifth Week of the Great Fast
items.season_or_tone: FOURTH WEEK OF THE GREAT FAST
items.day_or_date: Synaxarion first of the Menaion, then the present one:*[^1085]
items.english_text: *Verse: Remember us, O Lord, when Thou comest into Thy Kingdom.*[^1090]

provenance.verbatim_source: *Verse: Remember us, O Lord, when Thou comest into Thy Kingdom.*[^1090]

items.office: On Thursday of the Fifth Week of the Great Fast
items.season_or_tone: FOURTH WEEK OF THE GREAT FAST
items.day_or_date: Synaxarion first of the Menaion, then the present one:*[^1085]
items.english_text: Among the judges was numbered the offspring of Hannah, the great Samuel, whom Ramah nurtured in the house of the Lord; emulate him, O my soul, and judge thine own works before those of others.

provenance.verbatim_source: Among the judges was numbered the offspring of Hannah, the great Samuel, whom Ramah nurtured in the house of the Lord; emulate him, O my soul, and judge thine own works before those of others.

items.office: On Thursday of the Fifth Week of the Great Fast
items.season_or_tone: FOURTH WEEK OF THE GREAT FAST
items.day_or_date: Synaxarion first of the Menaion, then the present one:*[^1085]
items.english_text: David being chosen for the kingdom was anointed kingly with the horn of divine chrism; thou therefore, O my soul, if thou desirest the Kingdom on high, be anointed with the chrism of tears.

provenance.verbatim_source: David being chosen for the kingdom was anointed kingly with the horn of divine chrism; thou therefore, O my soul, if thou desirest the Kingdom on high, be anointed with the chrism of tears.

items.office: On Thursday of the Fifth Week of the Great Fast
items.season_or_tone: FOURTH WEEK OF THE GREAT FAST
items.day_or_date: Synaxarion first of the Menaion, then the present one:*[^1085]
items.english_text: Have mercy on Thy creation, O Merciful One; show compassion unto the work of Thy hands, and spare all who have sinned, and me above all, who have despised Thy commandments.

provenance.verbatim_source: Have mercy on Thy creation, O Merciful One; show compassion unto the work of Thy hands, and spare all who have sinned, and me above all, who have despised Thy commandments.

items.office: On Thursday of the Fifth Week of the Great Fast
items.season_or_tone: FOURTH WEEK OF THE GREAT FAST
items.day_or_date: Synaxarion first of the Menaion, then the present one:*[^1085]
items.english_text: Unto the unoriginate One, and unto the begetting and proceeding: I worship the Father Who begat, I glorify the Son Who was begotten, and I hymn the Spirit Who shone forth together with the Father and the Son.

provenance.verbatim_source: Unto the unoriginate One, and unto the begetting and proceeding: I worship the Father Who begat, I glorify the Son Who was begotten, and I hymn the Spirit Who shone forth together with the Father and the Son.

items.office: On Thursday of the Fifth Week of the Great Fast
items.season_or_tone: FOURTH WEEK OF THE GREAT FAST
items.day_or_date: Synaxarion first of the Menaion, then the present one:*[^1085]
items.english_text: We worship Thy supernatural childbearing, not dividing according to nature the glory of Thy Child, O Birth-giver of God; for He Who is one in Person is confessed in two natures.

provenance.verbatim_source: We worship Thy supernatural childbearing, not dividing according to nature the glory of Thy Child, O Birth-giver of God; for He Who is one in Person is confessed in two natures.

items.office: On Thursday of the Fifth Week of the Great Fast
items.season_or_tone: FOURTH WEEK OF THE GREAT FAST
items.day_or_date: Synaxarion first of the Menaion, then the present one:*[^1085]
items.english_text: *Ode 7. Heirmos:*[^1091] We have sinned, we have transgressed, we have done unrighteously before Thee, neither have we kept nor done as Thou hast commanded us; but deliver us not up to the end, O God of the fathers.

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Ode 7. Heirmos:*[^1091]  
We have sinned, we have transgressed, we have done unrighteously before Thee, neither have we kept nor done as Thou hast commanded us; but deliver us not up to the end, O God of the fathers.

items.office: On Thursday of the Fifth Week of the Great Fast
items.season_or_tone: FOURTH WEEK OF THE GREAT FAST
items.day_or_date: Synaxarion first of the Menaion, then the present one:*[^1085]
items.english_text: I have sinned, I have transgressed, and I have rejected Thy commandment, for I was brought forth in sins and have added wounds to my sores; but do Thou Thyself have mercy upon me, as Thou art tenderhearted, O God of the fathers.

provenance.verbatim_source: I have sinned, I have transgressed, and I have rejected Thy commandment, for I was brought forth in sins and have added wounds to my sores; but do Thou Thyself have mercy upon me, as Thou art tenderhearted, O God of the fathers.

items.office: On Thursday of the Fifth Week of the Great Fast
items.season_or_tone: FOURTH WEEK OF THE GREAT FAST
items.day_or_date: Synaxarion first of the Menaion, then the present one:*[^1085]
items.english_text: I have confessed the secrets of my heart unto Thee, my Judge; see my humility, see also my affliction, and give heed unto my judgment now; and do Thou Thyself have mercy upon me, as Thou art tenderhearted, O God of the fathers.

provenance.verbatim_source: I have confessed the secrets of my heart unto Thee, my Judge; see my humility, see also my affliction, and give heed unto my judgment now; and do Thou Thyself have mercy upon me, as Thou art tenderhearted, O God of the fathers.

items.office: On Thursday of the Fifth Week of the Great Fast
items.season_or_tone: FOURTH WEEK OF THE GREAT FAST
items.day_or_date: Synaxarion first of the Menaion, then the present one:*[^1085]
items.english_text: Saul of old, when he lost his father's asses, O soul, suddenly found a kingdom for renown;[^1092] but take heed, forget not thyself, having preferred thy brutish lusts over the Kingdom of Christ.

provenance.verbatim_source: Saul of old, when he lost his father's asses, O soul, suddenly found a kingdom for renown;[^1092] but take heed, forget not thyself, having preferred thy brutish lusts over the Kingdom of Christ.

items.office: On Thursday of the Fifth Week of the Great Fast
items.season_or_tone: FOURTH WEEK OF THE GREAT FAST
items.day_or_date: Synaxarion first of the Menaion, then the present one:*[^1085]
items.english_text: David of old, the forefather of God, though he sinned doubly, O my soul, struck by the arrow of adultery and captive to the spear of torment for murder; yet thou art sick with even heavier deeds by thine own voluntary impulses.[^1093]

provenance.verbatim_source: David of old, the forefather of God, though he sinned doubly, O my soul, struck by the arrow of adultery and captive to the spear of torment for murder; yet thou art sick with even heavier deeds by thine own voluntary impulses.[^1093]

items.office: On Thursday of the Fifth Week of the Great Fast
items.season_or_tone: FOURTH WEEK OF THE GREAT FAST
items.day_or_date: Synaxarion first of the Menaion, then the present one:*[^1085]
items.english_text: David of old joined iniquity to iniquity, mingling murder with adultery, yet he immediately showed forth twofold repentance; but thou, O most wicked soul, hast done worse deeds without repenting unto God.

provenance.verbatim_source: David of old joined iniquity to iniquity, mingling murder with adultery, yet he immediately showed forth twofold repentance; but thou, O most wicked soul, hast done worse deeds without repenting unto God.

items.office: On Thursday of the Fifth Week of the Great Fast
items.season_or_tone: FOURTH WEEK OF THE GREAT FAST
items.day_or_date: Synaxarion first of the Menaion, then the present one:*[^1085]
items.english_text: David of old depicted it, composing as on an icon a hymn whereby he exposes the deed he had done, crying: "Have mercy on me, for against Thee only have I sinned, the God of all: do Thou Thyself cleanse me!"

provenance.verbatim_source: David of old depicted it, composing as on an icon a hymn whereby he exposes the deed he had done, crying: "Have mercy on me, for against Thee only have I sinned, the God of all: do Thou Thyself cleanse me!"

items.office: On Thursday of the Fifth Week of the Great Fast
items.season_or_tone: FOURTH WEEK OF THE GREAT FAST
items.day_or_date: Synaxarion first of the Menaion, then the present one:*[^1085]
items.english_text: When the Ark was being carried on a cart, that Uzzah, when the calf turned aside, merely touched it and experienced the wrath of God; but fleeing his presumption, O soul, revere divine things honorably.

provenance.verbatim_source: When the Ark was being carried on a cart, that Uzzah, when the calf turned aside, merely touched it and experienced the wrath of God; but fleeing his presumption, O soul, revere divine things honorably.

items.office: On Thursday of the Fifth Week of the Great Fast
items.season_or_tone: FOURTH WEEK OF THE GREAT FAST
items.day_or_date: Synaxarion first of the Menaion, then the present one:*[^1085]
items.english_text: Thou hast heard of Absalom, how he rose up against nature; thou hast known his foul deeds whereby he defiled the bed of David his father; yet thou hast imitated his passionate and pleasure-loving impulses.

provenance.verbatim_source: Thou hast heard of Absalom, how he rose up against nature; thou hast known his foul deeds whereby he defiled the bed of David his father; yet thou hast imitated his passionate and pleasure-loving impulses.

items.office: On Thursday of the Fifth Week of the Great Fast
items.season_or_tone: FOURTH WEEK OF THE GREAT FAST
items.day_or_date: Synaxarion first of the Menaion, then the present one:*[^1085]
items.english_text: Thou hast subjected thy free dignity unto thy body; for having found another Ahithophel as an enemy, O soul, thou didst condescend to his counsel; but Christ Himself scattered these things, that thou by all means mightest be saved.

provenance.verbatim_source: Thou hast subjected thy free dignity unto thy body; for having found another Ahithophel as an enemy, O soul, thou didst condescend to his counsel; but Christ Himself scattered these things, that thou by all means mightest be saved.

items.office: On Thursday of the Fifth Week of the Great Fast
items.season_or_tone: FOURTH WEEK OF THE GREAT FAST
items.day_or_date: Synaxarion first of the Menaion, then the present one:*[^1085]
items.english_text: Solomon the marvelous, full of the grace of wisdom, having once done evil before God, departed from Him; unto whom thou, O soul, hast become like by thy cursed life.[^1094]

provenance.verbatim_source: Solomon the marvelous, full of the grace of wisdom, having once done evil before God, departed from Him; unto whom thou, O soul, hast become like by thy cursed life.[^1094]

items.office: On Thursday of the Fifth Week of the Great Fast
items.season_or_tone: FOURTH WEEK OF THE GREAT FAST
items.day_or_date: Synaxarion first of the Menaion, then the present one:*[^1085]
items.english_text: Dragged by the pleasures of his passions, he was defiled—woe is me! The lover of wisdom became a lover of wanton women and an alien from God; whom thou hast imitated in mind, O soul, by foul sensual pleasures.

provenance.verbatim_source: Dragged by the pleasures of his passions, he was defiled—woe is me! The lover of wisdom became a lover of wanton women and an alien from God; whom thou hast imitated in mind, O soul, by foul sensual pleasures.

items.office: On Thursday of the Fifth Week of the Great Fast
items.season_or_tone: FOURTH WEEK OF THE GREAT FAST
items.day_or_date: Synaxarion first of the Menaion, then the present one:*[^1085]
items.english_text: Thou hast rivaled Rehoboam, who listened not unto the counsel of his father, and likewise that most wicked servant Jeroboam, the former apostate, O soul; but flee imitation, and cry unto God: "I have sinned, show compassion unto me!"

provenance.verbatim_source: Thou hast rivaled Rehoboam, who listened not unto the counsel of his father, and likewise that most wicked servant Jeroboam, the former apostate, O soul; but flee imitation, and cry unto God: "I have sinned, show compassion unto me!"

items.office: On Thursday of the Fifth Week of the Great Fast
items.season_or_tone: FOURTH WEEK OF THE GREAT FAST
items.day_or_date: Synaxarion first of the Menaion, then the present one:*[^1085]
items.english_text: Thou hast rivaled the defilements of Ahab, O my soul—woe is me! Thou hast become a dwelling-place of carnal defilements and a shameful vessel of passions; but groan from thy depths, and tell thy sins unto God.

provenance.verbatim_source: Thou hast rivaled the defilements of Ahab, O my soul—woe is me! Thou hast become a dwelling-place of carnal defilements and a shameful vessel of passions; but groan from thy depths, and tell thy sins unto God.

items.office: On Thursday of the Fifth Week of the Great Fast
items.season_or_tone: FOURTH WEEK OF THE GREAT FAST
items.day_or_date: Synaxarion first of the Menaion, then the present one:*[^1085]
items.english_text: Elijah of old burned twice fifty of Jezebel's men, when he destroyed the shameful prophets to the rebuke of Ahab; but flee the imitation of both, O soul, and be strengthened.[^1095]

provenance.verbatim_source: Elijah of old burned twice fifty of Jezebel's men, when he destroyed the shameful prophets to the rebuke of Ahab; but flee the imitation of both, O soul, and be strengthened.[^1095]

items.office: On Thursday of the Fifth Week of the Great Fast
items.season_or_tone: FOURTH WEEK OF THE GREAT FAST
items.day_or_date: Synaxarion first of the Menaion, then the present one:*[^1085]
items.english_text: Heaven was shut unto thee, O soul, and a famine from God overtook thee, when like Ahab thou didst not submit of old to the words of Elijah the Tishbite; but become like the woman of Zarephath, feed the prophet's soul!

provenance.verbatim_source: Heaven was shut unto thee, O soul, and a famine from God overtook thee, when like Ahab thou didst not submit of old to the words of Elijah the Tishbite; but become like the woman of Zarephath, feed the prophet's soul!

items.office: On Thursday of the Fifth Week of the Great Fast
items.season_or_tone: FOURTH WEEK OF THE GREAT FAST
items.day_or_date: Synaxarion first of the Menaion, then the present one:*[^1085]
items.english_text: Thou hast gathered the sins of Manasseh by deliberate choice, setting up passions as abominations and multiplying wrath, O soul; but warmly emulating his repentance, acquire compunction.

provenance.verbatim_source: Thou hast gathered the sins of Manasseh by deliberate choice, setting up passions as abominations and multiplying wrath, O soul; but warmly emulating his repentance, acquire compunction.

items.office: On Thursday of the Fifth Week of the Great Fast
items.season_or_tone: FOURTH WEEK OF THE GREAT FAST
items.day_or_date: Synaxarion first of the Menaion, then the present one:*[^1085]
items.english_text: I fall down before Thee, and offer Thee my words like tears: I have sinned as the harlot did not sin, and I have transgressed as no other on earth; but show compassion, O Master, unto Thy creation, and call me back!

provenance.verbatim_source: I fall down before Thee, and offer Thee my words like tears: I have sinned as the harlot did not sin, and I have transgressed as no other on earth; but show compassion, O Master, unto Thy creation, and call me back!

items.office: On Thursday of the Fifth Week of the Great Fast
items.season_or_tone: FOURTH WEEK OF THE GREAT FAST
items.day_or_date: Synaxarion first of the Menaion, then the present one:*[^1085]
items.english_text: I have buried Thine image and corrupted Thy commandment; all my beauty is darkened, and by passions the lamp is quenched, O Savior; but showing compassion, restore unto me, as David sings, joy![^1096]

provenance.verbatim_source: I have buried Thine image and corrupted Thy commandment; all my beauty is darkened, and by passions the lamp is quenched, O Savior; but showing compassion, restore unto me, as David sings, joy![^1096]

items.office: On Thursday of the Fifth Week of the Great Fast
items.season_or_tone: FOURTH WEEK OF THE GREAT FAST
items.day_or_date: Synaxarion first of the Menaion, then the present one:*[^1085]
items.english_text: Turn back, repent, uncover hidden things, say unto God Who knows all things: "Thou knowest my secret things, O only Savior; but do Thou Thyself have mercy upon me, as David sings, according to Thy mercy!"

provenance.verbatim_source: Turn back, repent, uncover hidden things, say unto God Who knows all things: "Thou knowest my secret things, O only Savior; but do Thou Thyself have mercy upon me, as David sings, according to Thy mercy!"

items.office: On Thursday of the Fifth Week of the Great Fast
items.season_or_tone: FOURTH WEEK OF THE GREAT FAST
items.day_or_date: Synaxarion first of the Menaion, then the present one:*[^1085]
items.english_text: My days have vanished like the dream of one who awakens; therefore like Hezekiah I weep upon my bed that years of life may be added unto me; but what Isaiah shall stand before thee, O soul, if not the God of all?

provenance.verbatim_source: My days have vanished like the dream of one who awakens; therefore like Hezekiah I weep upon my bed that years of life may be added unto me; but what Isaiah shall stand before thee, O soul, if not the God of all?

items.office: On Thursday of the Fifth Week of the Great Fast
items.season_or_tone: FOURTH WEEK OF THE GREAT FAST
items.day_or_date: Synaxarion first of the Menaion, then the present one:*[^1085]
items.english_text: Crying aloud unto the all-pure Mother of God, thou didst first cast away the fury of passions that violently afflicted thee, and didst confound the enemy who tripped thee up; but grant help now from affliction unto me also, thy servant!

provenance.verbatim_source: Crying aloud unto the all-pure Mother of God, thou didst first cast away the fury of passions that violently afflicted thee, and didst confound the enemy who tripped thee up; but grant help now from affliction unto me also, thy servant!

items.office: On Thursday of the Fifth Week of the Great Fast
items.season_or_tone: FOURTH WEEK OF THE GREAT FAST
items.day_or_date: Synaxarion first of the Menaion, then the present one:*[^1085]
items.english_text: Whom thou didst love, Whom thou didst desire, for Whose sake thou didst wear out thy flesh, O venerable one: pray now unto Christ for thy servants, that being merciful unto us all, He may grant a peaceful estate unto those who honor Him.

provenance.verbatim_source: Whom thou didst love, Whom thou didst desire, for Whose sake thou didst wear out thy flesh, O venerable one: pray now unto Christ for thy servants, that being merciful unto us all, He may grant a peaceful estate unto those who honor Him.

items.office: On Thursday of the Fifth Week of the Great Fast
items.season_or_tone: FOURTH WEEK OF THE GREAT FAST
items.day_or_date: Synaxarion first of the Menaion, then the present one:*[^1085]
items.english_text: Establish me upon the rock of faith by thy prayers, O father, enclosing me with divine fear; and grant me repentance, O Andrew, I pray thee: deliver me from the snare of the enemies who seek after me!

provenance.verbatim_source: Establish me upon the rock of faith by thy prayers, O father, enclosing me with divine fear; and grant me repentance, O Andrew, I pray thee: deliver me from the snare of the enemies who seek after me!

items.office: On Thursday of the Fifth Week of the Great Fast
items.season_or_tone: FOURTH WEEK OF THE GREAT FAST
items.day_or_date: Synaxarion first of the Menaion, then the present one:*[^1085]
items.english_text: O simple, undivided Trinity, consubstantial and of one nature, Lights and Light, and three Holies, yet one Holy is God the Trinity hymned; sing then, O soul, and glorify Life and Lives, the God of all!

provenance.verbatim_source: O simple, undivided Trinity, consubstantial and of one nature, Lights and Light, and three Holies, yet one Holy is God the Trinity hymned; sing then, O soul, and glorify Life and Lives, the God of all!

items.office: On Thursday of the Fifth Week of the Great Fast
items.season_or_tone: FOURTH WEEK OF THE GREAT FAST
items.day_or_date: Synaxarion first of the Menaion, then the present one:*[^1085]
items.english_text: We hymn thee, we bless thee, we worship thee, O Birth-giver of God, for of the inseparable Trinity thou hast brought forth the one Christ God, and hast opened the heavenly realms unto us who are on earth.

provenance.verbatim_source: We hymn thee, we bless thee, we worship thee, O Birth-giver of God, for of the inseparable Trinity thou hast brought forth the one Christ God, and hast opened the heavenly realms unto us who are on earth.

items.office: On Thursday of the Fifth Week of the Great Fast
items.season_or_tone: FOURTH WEEK OF THE GREAT FAST
items.day_or_date: Synaxarion first of the Menaion, then the present one:*[^1085]
items.english_text: The beginningless King of glory, before Whom the heavenly hosts tremble: praise Him, O priests, and highly exalt Him, O people, unto all ages!

provenance.verbatim_source: The beginningless King of glory, before Whom the heavenly hosts tremble: praise Him, O priests, and highly exalt Him, O people, unto all ages!

items.office: On Thursday of the Fifth Week of the Great Fast
items.season_or_tone: FOURTH WEEK OF THE GREAT FAST
items.day_or_date: Synaxarion first of the Menaion, then the present one:*[^1085]
items.english_text: As coals of immaterial fire, burn up my material passions, O apostles, kindling in me now the desire of divine love!

provenance.verbatim_source: As coals of immaterial fire, burn up my material passions, O apostles, kindling in me now the desire of divine love!

items.office: On Thursday of the Fifth Week of the Great Fast
items.season_or_tone: FOURTH WEEK OF THE GREAT FAST
items.day_or_date: Synaxarion first of the Menaion, then the present one:*[^1085]
items.english_text: Let us honor the sweet-voiced trumpets of the Word, whereby the infirm walls of the enemy fell down, and the ramparts of the knowledge of God were established!

provenance.verbatim_source: Let us honor the sweet-voiced trumpets of the Word, whereby the infirm walls of the enemy fell down, and the ramparts of the knowledge of God were established!

items.office: On Thursday of the Fifth Week of the Great Fast
items.season_or_tone: FOURTH WEEK OF THE GREAT FAST
items.day_or_date: Synaxarion first of the Menaion, then the present one:*[^1085]
items.english_text: Shatter the idols of passion in my soul, O consecrated temples, apostles of the Lord, who shattered the temples and pillars of the enemy!

provenance.verbatim_source: Shatter the idols of passion in my soul, O consecrated temples, apostles of the Lord, who shattered the temples and pillars of the enemy!

items.office: On Thursday of the Fifth Week of the Great Fast
items.season_or_tone: FOURTH WEEK OF THE GREAT FAST
items.day_or_date: Synaxarion first of the Menaion, then the present one:*[^1085]
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* Thou didst contain Him Who is uncontainable by nature; thou didst bear Him Who bears all things; thou didst nurse, O pure Virgin, Him Who feeds creation: Christ the Giver of life.

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Theotokion:*  
Thou didst contain Him Who is uncontainable by nature; thou didst bear Him Who bears all things; thou didst nurse, O pure Virgin, Him Who feeds creation: Christ the Giver of life.

items.office: On Thursday of the Fifth Week of the Great Fast
items.season_or_tone: FOURTH WEEK OF THE GREAT FAST
items.day_or_date: Synaxarion first of the Menaion, then the present one:*[^1085]
items.english_text: Having built the whole Church through the master-craftsmanship of the Spirit, O apostles of Christ, bless Christ within her unto the ages!

provenance.verbatim_source: Having built the whole Church through the master-craftsmanship of the Spirit, O apostles of Christ, bless Christ within her unto the ages!

items.office: On Thursday of the Fifth Week of the Great Fast
items.season_or_tone: FOURTH WEEK OF THE GREAT FAST
items.day_or_date: Synaxarion first of the Menaion, then the present one:*[^1085]
items.english_text: Having sounded the trumpet of teachings, the apostles cast down all idolatrous deception, highly exalting Christ unto all ages!

provenance.verbatim_source: Having sounded the trumpet of teachings, the apostles cast down all idolatrous deception, highly exalting Christ unto all ages!

items.office: On Thursday of the Fifth Week of the Great Fast
items.season_or_tone: FOURTH WEEK OF THE GREAT FAST
items.day_or_date: Synaxarion first of the Menaion, then the present one:*[^1085]
items.english_text: O apostles, noble colony, overseers of the world, and heavenly citizens: deliver from tribulations those who continually praise you!

provenance.verbatim_source: O apostles, noble colony, overseers of the world, and heavenly citizens: deliver from tribulations those who continually praise you!

items.office: On Thursday of the Fifth Week of the Great Fast
items.season_or_tone: FOURTH WEEK OF THE GREAT FAST
items.day_or_date: Synaxarion first of the Menaion, then the present one:*[^1085]
items.english_text: O thrice-radiant, all-bright Godhead, nature of one glory and one throne: O Father Almighty, Son, and Divine Spirit, I hymn Thee unto the ages!

provenance.verbatim_source: O thrice-radiant, all-bright Godhead, nature of one glory and one throne: O Father Almighty, Son, and Divine Spirit, I hymn Thee unto the ages!

items.office: On Thursday of the Fifth Week of the Great Fast
items.season_or_tone: FOURTH WEEK OF THE GREAT FAST
items.day_or_date: Synaxarion first of the Menaion, then the present one:*[^1085]
items.english_text: As an honorable and most exalted throne let us hymn the Mother of God unceasingly, O people, who alone after childbearing remains Mother and Virgin.

provenance.verbatim_source: As an honorable and most exalted throne let us hymn the Mother of God unceasingly, O people, who alone after childbearing remains Mother and Virgin.

items.office: On Thursday of the Fifth Week of the Great Fast
items.season_or_tone: FOURTH WEEK OF THE GREAT FAST
items.day_or_date: Synaxarion first of the Menaion, then the present one:*[^1085]
items.english_text: Him Whom the heavenly hosts glorify, and before Whom the Cherubim and Seraphim tremble, let every breath and creature praise, bless, and highly exalt unto all ages!

provenance.verbatim_source: Him Whom the heavenly hosts glorify, and before Whom the Cherubim and Seraphim tremble, let every breath and creature praise, bless, and highly exalt unto all ages!

items.office: On Thursday of the Fifth Week of the Great Fast
items.season_or_tone: FOURTH WEEK OF THE GREAT FAST
items.day_or_date: Synaxarion first of the Menaion, then the present one:*[^1085]
items.english_text: Have mercy upon me who have sinned, O Savior; raise up my mind unto conversion; receive me who repent; show compassion unto me who cry: "I have sinned against Thee, save me! I have transgressed, have mercy upon me!"

provenance.verbatim_source: Have mercy upon me who have sinned, O Savior; raise up my mind unto conversion; receive me who repent; show compassion unto me who cry: "I have sinned against Thee, save me! I have transgressed, have mercy upon me!"

items.office: On Thursday of the Fifth Week of the Great Fast
items.season_or_tone: FOURTH WEEK OF THE GREAT FAST
items.day_or_date: Synaxarion first of the Menaion, then the present one:*[^1085]
items.english_text: The charioteer Elijah, having ascended into the heavens as upon a chariot of virtues, was once borne high above earthly things; meditate then, O my soul, upon his ascent![^1100]

provenance.verbatim_source: The charioteer Elijah, having ascended into the heavens as upon a chariot of virtues, was once borne high above earthly things; meditate then, O my soul, upon his ascent![^1100]

items.office: On Thursday of the Fifth Week of the Great Fast
items.season_or_tone: FOURTH WEEK OF THE GREAT FAST
items.day_or_date: Synaxarion first of the Menaion, then the present one:*[^1085]
items.english_text: The stream of the Jordan of old, by Elijah's mantle, stood still on this side and on that through Elisha; but thou, O my soul, hast not partaken of this grace because of intemperance.

provenance.verbatim_source: The stream of the Jordan of old, by Elijah's mantle, stood still on this side and on that through Elisha; but thou, O my soul, hast not partaken of this grace because of intemperance.

items.office: On Thursday of the Fifth Week of the Great Fast
items.season_or_tone: FOURTH WEEK OF THE GREAT FAST
items.day_or_date: Synaxarion first of the Menaion, then the present one:*[^1085]
items.english_text: Elisha of old, receiving the mantle of Elijah, received a double portion of grace from the Lord; but thou, O my soul, hast not partaken of this grace because of intemperance.

provenance.verbatim_source: Elisha of old, receiving the mantle of Elijah, received a double portion of grace from the Lord; but thou, O my soul, hast not partaken of this grace because of intemperance.

items.office: On Thursday of the Fifth Week of the Great Fast
items.season_or_tone: FOURTH WEEK OF THE GREAT FAST
items.day_or_date: Synaxarion first of the Menaion, then the present one:*[^1085]
items.english_text: The Shunammite woman of old entertained the righteous man, O soul, with a noble disposition; but thou hast not brought into thy house stranger or traveler; therefore thou shalt be cast out weeping from the bridal chamber!

provenance.verbatim_source: The Shunammite woman of old entertained the righteous man, O soul, with a noble disposition; but thou hast not brought into thy house stranger or traveler; therefore thou shalt be cast out weeping from the bridal chamber!

items.office: On Thursday of the Fifth Week of the Great Fast
items.season_or_tone: FOURTH WEEK OF THE GREAT FAST
items.day_or_date: Synaxarion first of the Menaion, then the present one:*[^1085]
items.english_text: Thou, wretched soul, hast always imitated the foul mind of Gehazi; cast away his love of money, at least in thine old age; flee the fire of Gehenna, departing from thine evil deeds!

provenance.verbatim_source: Thou, wretched soul, hast always imitated the foul mind of Gehazi; cast away his love of money, at least in thine old age; flee the fire of Gehenna, departing from thine evil deeds!

items.office: On Thursday of the Fifth Week of the Great Fast
items.season_or_tone: FOURTH WEEK OF THE GREAT FAST
items.day_or_date: Synaxarion first of the Menaion, then the present one:*[^1085]
items.english_text: Having rivaled Uzziah, O soul, thou hast acquired his leprosy doubly in thyself; for thou thinkest unfitting things and doest unlawful things: leave what thou hast, and run unto repentance!

provenance.verbatim_source: Having rivaled Uzziah, O soul, thou hast acquired his leprosy doubly in thyself; for thou thinkest unfitting things and doest unlawful things: leave what thou hast, and run unto repentance!

items.office: On Thursday of the Fifth Week of the Great Fast
items.season_or_tone: FOURTH WEEK OF THE GREAT FAST
items.day_or_date: Synaxarion first of the Menaion, then the present one:*[^1085]
items.english_text: Thou hast heard, O soul, of the Ninevites who repented before God in sackcloth and ashes; thou hast not imitated them, but hast appeared more wicked than all who have sinned before the Law and after the Law!

provenance.verbatim_source: Thou hast heard, O soul, of the Ninevites who repented before God in sackcloth and ashes; thou hast not imitated them, but hast appeared more wicked than all who have sinned before the Law and after the Law!

items.office: On Thursday of the Fifth Week of the Great Fast
items.season_or_tone: FOURTH WEEK OF THE GREAT FAST
items.day_or_date: Synaxarion first of the Menaion, then the present one:*[^1085]
items.english_text: In the pit of mire thou hast heard Jeremiah, O soul, crying with lamentations for the city of Zion and seeking tears; imitate his lamenting life, and thou shalt be saved![^1101]

provenance.verbatim_source: In the pit of mire thou hast heard Jeremiah, O soul, crying with lamentations for the city of Zion and seeking tears; imitate his lamenting life, and thou shalt be saved![^1101]

items.office: On Thursday of the Fifth Week of the Great Fast
items.season_or_tone: FOURTH WEEK OF THE GREAT FAST
items.day_or_date: Synaxarion first of the Menaion, then the present one:*[^1085]
items.english_text: Jonah fled unto Tarshish, foreseeing the conversion of the Ninevites; for as a prophet he understood the lovingkindness of God, therefore he was zealous that his prophecy should not prove false.

provenance.verbatim_source: Jonah fled unto Tarshish, foreseeing the conversion of the Ninevites; for as a prophet he understood the lovingkindness of God, therefore he was zealous that his prophecy should not prove false.

items.office: On Thursday of the Fifth Week of the Great Fast
items.season_or_tone: FOURTH WEEK OF THE GREAT FAST
items.day_or_date: Synaxarion first of the Menaion, then the present one:*[^1085]
items.english_text: Thou hast heard how Daniel in the lions' den stopped the mouths of the beasts, O soul; thou knowest how the young men with Azariah quenched the burning flame of the furnace through faith.

provenance.verbatim_source: Thou hast heard how Daniel in the lions' den stopped the mouths of the beasts, O soul; thou knowest how the young men with Azariah quenched the burning flame of the furnace through faith.

items.office: On Thursday of the Fifth Week of the Great Fast
items.season_or_tone: FOURTH WEEK OF THE GREAT FAST
items.day_or_date: Synaxarion first of the Menaion, then the present one:*[^1085]
items.english_text: I have brought before thee all of the Old Testament, O soul, as an example; imitate the God-loving deeds of the righteous, and again flee the sins of the wicked!

provenance.verbatim_source: I have brought before thee all of the Old Testament, O soul, as an example; imitate the God-loving deeds of the righteous, and again flee the sins of the wicked!

items.office: On Thursday of the Fifth Week of the Great Fast
items.season_or_tone: FOURTH WEEK OF THE GREAT FAST
items.day_or_date: Synaxarion first of the Menaion, then the present one:*[^1085]
items.english_text: O righteous Judge and Savior, have mercy and deliver me from the fire and the threatening which I must justly endure at the judgment; grant me remission before the end through virtue and repentance!

provenance.verbatim_source: O righteous Judge and Savior, have mercy and deliver me from the fire and the threatening which I must justly endure at the judgment; grant me remission before the end through virtue and repentance!

items.office: On Thursday of the Fifth Week of the Great Fast
items.season_or_tone: FOURTH WEEK OF THE GREAT FAST
items.day_or_date: Synaxarion first of the Menaion, then the present one:*[^1085]
items.english_text: Like the thief I cry unto Thee: "Remember me!"[^1102] Like Peter I weep bitterly: "Pardon me, O Savior!" I call like the publican, I shed tears like the harlot: receive my weeping, as once that of the Canaanite woman!

provenance.verbatim_source: Like the thief I cry unto Thee: "Remember me!"[^1102] Like Peter I weep bitterly: "Pardon me, O Savior!" I call like the publican, I shed tears like the harlot: receive my weeping, as once that of the Canaanite woman!

items.office: On Thursday of the Fifth Week of the Great Fast
items.season_or_tone: FOURTH WEEK OF THE GREAT FAST
items.day_or_date: Synaxarion first of the Menaion, then the present one:*[^1085]
items.english_text: Heal the ulcer of my humble soul, O Savior, the only Physician; apply a plaster unto me, and oil and wine: the deeds of repentance, and compunction with tears!

provenance.verbatim_source: Heal the ulcer of my humble soul, O Savior, the only Physician; apply a plaster unto me, and oil and wine: the deeds of repentance, and compunction with tears!

items.office: On Thursday of the Fifth Week of the Great Fast
items.season_or_tone: FOURTH WEEK OF THE GREAT FAST
items.day_or_date: Synaxarion first of the Menaion, then the present one:*[^1085]
items.english_text: Imitating the Canaanite woman, I also cry: "Have mercy on me, O Son of David!" I touch the border of Thy garment like the woman with the issue of blood; I weep like Martha and Mary over Lazarus.

provenance.verbatim_source: Imitating the Canaanite woman, I also cry: "Have mercy on me, O Son of David!" I touch the border of Thy garment like the woman with the issue of blood; I weep like Martha and Mary over Lazarus.

items.office: On Thursday of the Fifth Week of the Great Fast
items.season_or_tone: FOURTH WEEK OF THE GREAT FAST
items.day_or_date: Synaxarion first of the Menaion, then the present one:*[^1085]
items.english_text: Pouring out an alabaster jar of tears like myrrh upon Thy head, O Savior, I call unto Thee like the harlot seeking mercy; I bring supplication, and ask to receive forgiveness.

provenance.verbatim_source: Pouring out an alabaster jar of tears like myrrh upon Thy head, O Savior, I call unto Thee like the harlot seeking mercy; I bring supplication, and ask to receive forgiveness.

items.office: On Thursday of the Fifth Week of the Great Fast
items.season_or_tone: FOURTH WEEK OF THE GREAT FAST
items.day_or_date: Synaxarion first of the Menaion, then the present one:*[^1085]
items.english_text: Though none has sinned against Thee as I have, yet receive even me, O tenderhearted Savior, repenting in fear and calling in love: "I have sinned against Thee only; have mercy on me, O Merciful One!"

provenance.verbatim_source: Though none has sinned against Thee as I have, yet receive even me, O tenderhearted Savior, repenting in fear and calling in love: "I have sinned against Thee only; have mercy on me, O Merciful One!"

items.office: On Thursday of the Fifth Week of the Great Fast
items.season_or_tone: FOURTH WEEK OF THE GREAT FAST
items.day_or_date: Synaxarion first of the Menaion, then the present one:*[^1085]
items.english_text: Spare Thy creation, O Savior, and seek out what is lost like a shepherd; go before him who has gone astray, snatch him from the wolf, and make me a sheep in the pasture of Thy flock!

provenance.verbatim_source: Spare Thy creation, O Savior, and seek out what is lost like a shepherd; go before him who has gone astray, snatch him from the wolf, and make me a sheep in the pasture of Thy flock!

items.office: On Thursday of the Fifth Week of the Great Fast
items.season_or_tone: FOURTH WEEK OF THE GREAT FAST
items.day_or_date: Synaxarion first of the Menaion, then the present one:*[^1085]
items.english_text: When as Judge Thou shalt sit, as Thou art tenderhearted, and shalt display Thy dread glory, O Savior: oh, what fear will there be then, while the furnace burns, for all who fear Thine unbearable judgment-seat![^1103]

provenance.verbatim_source: When as Judge Thou shalt sit, as Thou art tenderhearted, and shalt display Thy dread glory, O Savior: oh, what fear will there be then, while the furnace burns, for all who fear Thine unbearable judgment-seat![^1103]

items.office: On Thursday of the Fifth Week of the Great Fast
items.season_or_tone: FOURTH WEEK OF THE GREAT FAST
items.day_or_date: Synaxarion first of the Menaion, then the present one:*[^1085]
items.english_text: The Mother of the Unwaning Light, having enlightened thee, loosed thee from the darkening of passions; having therefore entered into spiritual grace, enlighten, O Mary, those who faithfully praise thee!

provenance.verbatim_source: The Mother of the Unwaning Light, having enlightened thee, loosed thee from the darkening of passions; having therefore entered into spiritual grace, enlighten, O Mary, those who faithfully praise thee!

items.office: On Thursday of the Fifth Week of the Great Fast
items.season_or_tone: FOURTH WEEK OF THE GREAT FAST
items.day_or_date: Synaxarion first of the Menaion, then the present one:*[^1085]
items.english_text: Seeing a new wonder, the godly Zosimas was truly astonished in thee, O mother; for he beheld an angel in the flesh and was filled with all wonder, singing unto Christ unto the ages!

provenance.verbatim_source: Seeing a new wonder, the godly Zosimas was truly astonished in thee, O mother; for he beheld an angel in the flesh and was filled with all wonder, singing unto Christ unto the ages!

items.office: On Thursday of the Fifth Week of the Great Fast
items.season_or_tone: FOURTH WEEK OF THE GREAT FAST
items.day_or_date: Synaxarion first of the Menaion, then the present one:*[^1085]
items.english_text: As one who hast boldness before the Lord, O Andrew of Crete, venerable boast: pray, I beseech thee, that I may now find through thy prayers release from the bonds of iniquity, for thou art a teacher of repentance and the glory of the venerable!

provenance.verbatim_source: As one who hast boldness before the Lord, O Andrew of Crete, venerable boast: pray, I beseech thee, that I may now find through thy prayers release from the bonds of iniquity, for thou art a teacher of repentance and the glory of the venerable!

items.office: On Thursday of the Fifth Week of the Great Fast
items.season_or_tone: FOURTH WEEK OF THE GREAT FAST
items.day_or_date: Synaxarion first of the Menaion, then the present one:*[^1085]
items.english_text: O Beginningless Father, co-beginningless Son, O good Comforter, upright Spirit: Begetter of God the Word, Word of the Beginningless Father, Living and Creating Spirit: O Trinity, Unity, have mercy upon me!

provenance.verbatim_source: O Beginningless Father, co-beginningless Son, O good Comforter, upright Spirit: Begetter of God the Word, Word of the Beginningless Father, Living and Creating Spirit: O Trinity, Unity, have mercy upon me!

items.office: On Thursday of the Fifth Week of the Great Fast
items.season_or_tone: FOURTH WEEK OF THE GREAT FAST
items.day_or_date: Synaxarion first of the Menaion, then the present one:*[^1085]
items.english_text: As from the dipping of purple dye, O All-Pure One, the spiritual purple robe of Emmanuel, His flesh, was woven within thy womb; therefore we honor thee as truly the Mother of God!

provenance.verbatim_source: As from the dipping of purple dye, O All-Pure One, the spiritual purple robe of Emmanuel, His flesh, was woven within thy womb; therefore we honor thee as truly the Mother of God!

items.office: On Thursday of the Fifth Week of the Great Fast
items.season_or_tone: FOURTH WEEK OF THE GREAT FAST
items.day_or_date: Synaxarion first of the Menaion, then the present one:*[^1085]
items.english_text: Thee we confess to be truly the Mother of God, who through thee have been saved, O pure Virgin, with the bodiless choirs magnifying thee.

provenance.verbatim_source: Thee we confess to be truly the Mother of God, who through thee have been saved, O pure Virgin, with the bodiless choirs magnifying thee.

items.office: On Thursday of the Fifth Week of the Great Fast
items.season_or_tone: FOURTH WEEK OF THE GREAT FAST
items.day_or_date: Synaxarion first of the Menaion, then the present one:*[^1085]
items.english_text: Having appeared as springs of saving water, O apostles: bedew my soul, withered by sinful thirst!

provenance.verbatim_source: Having appeared as springs of saving water, O apostles: bedew my soul, withered by sinful thirst!

items.office: On Thursday of the Fifth Week of the Great Fast
items.season_or_tone: FOURTH WEEK OF THE GREAT FAST
items.day_or_date: Synaxarion first of the Menaion, then the present one:*[^1085]
items.english_text: Swimming in the abyss of destruction, and already submerged, save me, O Lord, with Thy right hand, as Thou didst Peter!

provenance.verbatim_source: Swimming in the abyss of destruction, and already submerged, save me, O Lord, with Thy right hand, as Thou didst Peter!

items.office: On Thursday of the Fifth Week of the Great Fast
items.season_or_tone: FOURTH WEEK OF THE GREAT FAST
items.day_or_date: Synaxarion first of the Menaion, then the present one:*[^1085]
items.english_text: As salt of delicious teachings, dry up the rottenness of my mind, and drive away the darkness of ignorance!

provenance.verbatim_source: As salt of delicious teachings, dry up the rottenness of my mind, and drive away the darkness of ignorance!

items.office: On Thursday of the Fifth Week of the Great Fast
items.season_or_tone: FOURTH WEEK OF THE GREAT FAST
items.day_or_date: Synaxarion first of the Menaion, then the present one:*[^1085]
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* As thou hast given birth unto Joy, grant me weeping, whereby I may be able to find divine consolation, O Lady, on the coming day!

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Theotokion:*  
As thou hast given birth unto Joy, grant me weeping, whereby I may be able to find divine consolation, O Lady, on the coming day!

items.office: On Thursday of the Fifth Week of the Great Fast
items.season_or_tone: FOURTH WEEK OF THE GREAT FAST
items.day_or_date: Synaxarion first of the Menaion, then the present one:*[^1085]
items.english_text: *Another Triodion. Heirmos: Thee, mediatress of heaven and earth:*[^1105]

provenance.verbatim_source: *Another Triodion. Heirmos: Thee, mediatress of heaven and earth:*[^1105]

items.office: On Thursday of the Fifth Week of the Great Fast
items.season_or_tone: FOURTH WEEK OF THE GREAT FAST
items.day_or_date: Synaxarion first of the Menaion, then the present one:*[^1085]
items.english_text: Thee, glorious apostolic assembly, we magnify with hymns; for ye have appeared unto the universe as bright luminaries, driving away deception!

provenance.verbatim_source: Thee, glorious apostolic assembly, we magnify with hymns; for ye have appeared unto the universe as bright luminaries, driving away deception!

items.office: On Thursday of the Fifth Week of the Great Fast
items.season_or_tone: FOURTH WEEK OF THE GREAT FAST
items.day_or_date: Synaxarion first of the Menaion, then the present one:*[^1085]
items.english_text: Having caught rational fish with your net of the Gospel, ye ever offer these as food unto Christ, O blessed apostles!

provenance.verbatim_source: Having caught rational fish with your net of the Gospel, ye ever offer these as food unto Christ, O blessed apostles!

items.office: On Thursday of the Fifth Week of the Great Fast
items.season_or_tone: FOURTH WEEK OF THE GREAT FAST
items.day_or_date: Synaxarion first of the Menaion, then the present one:*[^1085]
items.english_text: Remember us before God by your supplication, O apostles, that we may be delivered from every temptation, we pray, who hymn you with love!

provenance.verbatim_source: Remember us before God by your supplication, O apostles, that we may be delivered from every temptation, we pray, who hymn you with love!

items.office: On Thursday of the Fifth Week of the Great Fast
items.season_or_tone: FOURTH WEEK OF THE GREAT FAST
items.day_or_date: Synaxarion first of the Menaion, then the present one:*[^1085]
items.english_text: Thee, three-hypostatic Unity—Father, Son, with the Spirit—one consubstantial God, I sing: a Trinity equal in power and beginningless!

provenance.verbatim_source: Thee, three-hypostatic Unity—Father, Son, with the Spirit—one consubstantial God, I sing: a Trinity equal in power and beginningless!

items.office: On Thursday of the Fifth Week of the Great Fast
items.season_or_tone: FOURTH WEEK OF THE GREAT FAST
items.day_or_date: Synaxarion first of the Menaion, then the present one:*[^1085]
items.english_text: Thee, who didst bear a child and remain a virgin, all generations call blessed, for through thee we have been delivered from the curse; for thou hast given birth unto the Lord, our Joy!

provenance.verbatim_source: Thee, who didst bear a child and remain a virgin, all generations call blessed, for through thee we have been delivered from the curse; for thou hast given birth unto the Lord, our Joy!

items.office: On Thursday of the Fifth Week of the Great Fast
items.season_or_tone: FOURTH WEEK OF THE GREAT FAST
items.day_or_date: Synaxarion first of the Menaion, then the present one:*[^1085]
items.english_text: The childbearing of a seedless conception is ineffable, the incorrupt fruit of a husbandless Mother; for the birth of God renovates natures; therefore all generations orthodoxly magnify thee as the Bride of God and Mother.

provenance.verbatim_source: The childbearing of a seedless conception is ineffable, the incorrupt fruit of a husbandless Mother; for the birth of God renovates natures; therefore all generations orthodoxly magnify thee as the Bride of God and Mother.

items.office: On Thursday of the Fifth Week of the Great Fast
items.season_or_tone: FOURTH WEEK OF THE GREAT FAST
items.day_or_date: Synaxarion first of the Menaion, then the present one:*[^1085]
items.english_text: My mind is covered with sores, my body is diseased, my spirit is sick, speech has grown feeble, life is deadened, the end is at the doors; what therefore shalt thou do, O my wretched soul, when the Judge shall come to search out what is thine?[^1107]

provenance.verbatim_source: My mind is covered with sores, my body is diseased, my spirit is sick, speech has grown feeble, life is deadened, the end is at the doors; what therefore shalt thou do, O my wretched soul, when the Judge shall come to search out what is thine?[^1107]

items.office: On Thursday of the Fifth Week of the Great Fast
items.season_or_tone: FOURTH WEEK OF THE GREAT FAST
items.day_or_date: Synaxarion first of the Menaion, then the present one:*[^1085]
items.english_text: I have brought before thee, O soul, Moses' account of the creation of the world, and therefrom all the testamentary Scripture, which tells thee of the righteous and the unrighteous; of whom thou hast imitated the second, O soul, and not the first, having sinned against God!

provenance.verbatim_source: I have brought before thee, O soul, Moses' account of the creation of the world, and therefrom all the testamentary Scripture, which tells thee of the righteous and the unrighteous; of whom thou hast imitated the second, O soul, and not the first, having sinned against God!

items.office: On Thursday of the Fifth Week of the Great Fast
items.season_or_tone: FOURTH WEEK OF THE GREAT FAST
items.day_or_date: Synaxarion first of the Menaion, then the present one:*[^1085]
items.slavonic_text: Но́вагѡ привождꙋ́ ти писа́нїѧ оу҆каза́нїѧ, * вводѧ́щаѧ тѧ̀, дꙋшѐ, ко оу҆миле́нїю: * пра́веднымъ оу҆́бѡ поревнова́й, * грѣ́шныхъ же ѿвраща́йсѧ, * и҆ оу҆ми́лостиви Хрⷭ҇та̀ моли́твами же и҆ поще́ньми, * и҆ чистото́ю и҆ говѣ́нїемъ.
items.english_text: The Law has grown weak, the Gospel is idle, and all the Scripture has been neglected in thee; the prophets have grown feeble, and every word of the righteous; thy wounds, O soul, have multiplied, there being no physician to heal thee.[^1108]

provenance.verbatim_source: The Law has grown weak, the Gospel is idle, and all the Scripture has been neglected in thee; the prophets have grown feeble, and every word of the righteous; thy wounds, O soul, have multiplied, there being no physician to heal thee.[^1108]

items.office: On Thursday of the Fifth Week of the Great Fast
items.season_or_tone: FOURTH WEEK OF THE GREAT FAST
items.day_or_date: Synaxarion first of the Menaion, then the present one:*[^1085]
items.slavonic_text: Хрⷭ҇то́съ вочеловѣ́чисѧ, * призва́въ къ покаѧ́нїю разбо́йники, и҆ блꙋдни́цы, * дꙋшѐ пока́йсѧ, * две́рь ѿве́рзесѧ Црⷭ҇твїѧ оу҆жѐ, * и҆ предвосхища́ютъ є҆̀ фарисе́є и҆ мытарѝ, * и҆ прелюбодѣ́и ка́ющїисѧ.
items.english_text: I bring before thee examples from the New Scripture to lead thee, O soul, unto compunction; emulate therefore the righteous, turn away from sinners, and propitiate Christ by prayers and fastings, and by purity and reverence.

provenance.verbatim_source: I bring before thee examples from the New Scripture to lead thee, O soul, unto compunction; emulate therefore the righteous, turn away from sinners, and propitiate Christ by prayers and fastings, and by purity and reverence.

items.office: On Thursday of the Fifth Week of the Great Fast
items.season_or_tone: FOURTH WEEK OF THE GREAT FAST
items.day_or_date: Synaxarion first of the Menaion, then the present one:*[^1085]
items.slavonic_text: Хрⷭ҇то́съ вочеловѣ́чисѧ, * пло́ти приѡбщи́всѧ мнѣ̀, * и҆ всѧ̑ є҆ли̑ка сꙋ́ть є҆стества̀ хотѣ́нїемъ и҆спо́лни, * грѣха̀ кромѣ̀, * подо́бїе тебѣ̀, Ѽ дꙋшѐ, * и҆ ѻ҆́бразъ предпоказꙋ́ѧ своегѡ̀ снизхожде́нїѧ.
items.english_text: Christ became man, calling robbers and harlots to repentance; repent, O soul; the door of the Kingdom is already opened, and Pharisees, publicans, and repenting adulterers seize it beforehand!

provenance.verbatim_source: Christ became man, calling robbers and harlots to repentance; repent, O soul; the door of the Kingdom is already opened, and Pharisees, publicans, and repenting adulterers seize it beforehand!

items.office: On Thursday of the Fifth Week of the Great Fast
items.season_or_tone: FOURTH WEEK OF THE GREAT FAST
items.day_or_date: Synaxarion first of the Menaion, then the present one:*[^1085]
items.slavonic_text: Хрⷭ҇то́съ волхвы̀ спасѐ, * па́стыри созва̀, * младе́нецъ мно́жества показа̀ мч҃еники, * ста́рцы просла́ви, и҆ ста́рыѧ вдови̑цы, * и҆́хже не поревнова́ла є҆сѝ дꙋшѐ, * ни дѣѧ́нїемъ, ни житїю̀: * но го́ре тебѣ̀, внегда̀ бꙋ́деши сꙋди́тисѧ.
items.english_text: Christ became man, partaking of my flesh, and by His will He fulfilled all things that belong to nature, except sin, showing forth unto thee, O soul, an example and image of His condescension.

provenance.verbatim_source: Christ became man, partaking of my flesh, and by His will He fulfilled all things that belong to nature, except sin, showing forth unto thee, O soul, an example and image of His condescension.

items.office: On Thursday of the Fifth Week of the Great Fast
items.season_or_tone: FOURTH WEEK OF THE GREAT FAST
items.day_or_date: Synaxarion first of the Menaion, then the present one:*[^1085]
items.slavonic_text: Пости́всѧ Гдⷭ҇ь дні́й четы́редесѧть въ пꙋсты́ни, * послѣдѝ взалка̀, * показꙋ́ѧ чл҃вѣ́ческое: * дꙋшѐ да не разлѣни́шисѧ, * а҆́ще тебѣ̀ приложи́тсѧ вра́гъ, * моли́твою же и҆ посто́мъ ѿ но́гъ твои́хъ да ѿрази́тсѧ.
items.english_text: Christ saved the Magi, summoned the shepherds, showed the multitudes of infants as martyrs, glorified elders and aged widows; whom thou hast not emulated, O soul, neither in deed nor in life; but woe unto thee when thou shalt be judged!

provenance.verbatim_source: Christ saved the Magi, summoned the shepherds, showed the multitudes of infants as martyrs, glorified elders and aged widows; whom thou hast not emulated, O soul, neither in deed nor in life; but woe unto thee when thou shalt be judged!

items.office: On Thursday of the Fifth Week of the Great Fast
items.season_or_tone: FOURTH WEEK OF THE GREAT FAST
items.day_or_date: Synaxarion first of the Menaion, then the present one:*[^1085]
items.slavonic_text: Хрⷭ҇то́съ и҆скꙋша́шесѧ, * дїа́волъ и҆скꙋша́ше, * показꙋ́ѧ ка́менїе, да хлѣ́би бꙋ́дꙋтъ: * на го́рꙋ возведѐ ви́дѣти всѧ̑ црⷭ҇твїа мі́ра во мгнове́нїи: * оу҆бо́йсѧ, Ѽ дꙋшѐ, ловле́нїѧ, * трезви́сѧ, моли́сѧ на всѧ́кїй ча́съ Бг҃ꙋ.
items.english_text: Having fasted forty days in the wilderness, the Lord afterward hungered, showing His human nature; be not idle, O soul, if the enemy assault thee; by prayer and fasting let him be repulsed from thy feet!

provenance.verbatim_source: Having fasted forty days in the wilderness, the Lord afterward hungered, showing His human nature; be not idle, O soul, if the enemy assault thee; by prayer and fasting let him be repulsed from thy feet!

items.office: On Thursday of the Fifth Week of the Great Fast
items.season_or_tone: FOURTH WEEK OF THE GREAT FAST
items.day_or_date: Synaxarion first of the Menaion, then the present one:*[^1085]
items.slavonic_text: Го́рлица пꙋстыннолю́бнаѧ, * гла́съ вопїю́щагѡ, возгласѝ Хрⷭ҇то́въ свѣти́льникъ, * проповѣ́дꙋй покаѧ́нїе, * И҆́рѡдъ беззако́ннова со И҆рѡдїа́дою: * зрѝ дꙋшѐ моѧ̀, * да не оу҆вя́знеши въ беззако́нныѧ сѣ́ти, * но ѡ҆блобыза́й покаѧ́нїе.
items.english_text: Christ was tempted, the devil tempted Him, showing stones that they might become bread; he led Him up into a mountain to see all the kingdoms of the world in a moment; fear the snare, O soul; be sober, pray at every hour unto God!

provenance.verbatim_source: Christ was tempted, the devil tempted Him, showing stones that they might become bread; he led Him up into a mountain to see all the kingdoms of the world in a moment; fear the snare, O soul; be sober, pray at every hour unto God!

items.office: On Thursday of the Fifth Week of the Great Fast
items.season_or_tone: FOURTH WEEK OF THE GREAT FAST
items.day_or_date: Synaxarion first of the Menaion, then the present one:*[^1085]
items.slavonic_text: Въ пꙋсты́ню всели́сѧ бл҃года́ти Прⷢ҇те́ча, * и҆ І҆ꙋде́а всѧ̀ и҆ Самарі́а слы́шавше теча́хꙋ, * и҆ и҆сповѣ́дахꙋ грѣхѝ своѧ̑, * креща́ющесѧ оу҆се́рднѡ, * и҆́хже ты̀ не подража́ла є҆сѝ дꙋшѐ.
items.english_text: The wilderness-loving turtle-dove, the voice of one crying, Christ's lamp cried aloud, preaching repentance, while Herod transgressed the law with Herodias; see, O my soul, that thou be not entangled in the snares of lawlessness, but embrace repentance!

provenance.verbatim_source: The wilderness-loving turtle-dove, the voice of one crying, Christ's lamp cried aloud, preaching repentance, while Herod transgressed the law with Herodias; see, O my soul, that thou be not entangled in the snares of lawlessness, but embrace repentance!

items.office: On Thursday of the Fifth Week of the Great Fast
items.season_or_tone: FOURTH WEEK OF THE GREAT FAST
items.day_or_date: Synaxarion first of the Menaion, then the present one:*[^1085]
items.slavonic_text: Бра́къ оу҆́бѡ чтⷭ҇ны́й, и҆ ло́же нескве́рно, * ѻ҆боѧ̀ бо Хрⷭ҇то́съ пре́жде бл҃гвѝ, * пло́тїю ꙗ҆ды́й, * и҆ въ Ка́нѣ же на бра́цѣ, * во́дꙋ въ вїно̀ соверша́ѧ, * и҆ показꙋ́ѧ пе́рвое чꙋ́до: * да ты̀ и҆змѣни́шисѧ, Ѽ дꙋшѐ.
items.english_text: The Forerunner of grace settled in the wilderness, and all Judea and Samaria, having heard, ran and confessed their sins, being eagerly baptized; whom thou, O soul, hast not imitated!

provenance.verbatim_source: The Forerunner of grace settled in the wilderness, and all Judea and Samaria, having heard, ran and confessed their sins, being eagerly baptized; whom thou, O soul, hast not imitated!

items.office: On Thursday of the Fifth Week of the Great Fast
items.season_or_tone: FOURTH WEEK OF THE GREAT FAST
items.day_or_date: Synaxarion first of the Menaion, then the present one:*[^1085]
items.slavonic_text: === LEAF p382 === (Printed Folio 378) Въ четве́ртокъ є҃ седми́цы ст҃а́гѡ вели́кагѡ поста̀ [т҃он]
items.english_text: Marriage is honorable and the bed undefiled, for Christ blessed both beforehand, eating in the flesh, and at the wedding in Cana turning water into wine and displaying His first miracle, that thou mightest be transformed, O soul!

provenance.verbatim_source: Marriage is honorable and the bed undefiled, for Christ blessed both beforehand, eating in the flesh, and at the wedding in Cana turning water into wine and displaying His first miracle, that thou mightest be transformed, O soul!

items.office: On Thursday of the Fifth Week of the Great Fast
items.season_or_tone: FOURTH WEEK OF THE GREAT FAST
items.day_or_date: Synaxarion first of the Menaion, then the present one:*[^1085]
items.english_text: Christ strengthened the paralytic, who took up his bed, and raised the dead youth, the widow's child, and the centurion's servant, and appeared unto the Samaritan woman, prefiguring for thee, O soul, worship in spirit.[^1109]

provenance.verbatim_source: Christ strengthened the paralytic, who took up his bed, and raised the dead youth, the widow's child, and the centurion's servant, and appeared unto the Samaritan woman, prefiguring for thee, O soul, worship in spirit.[^1109]

items.office: On Thursday of the Fifth Week of the Great Fast
items.season_or_tone: FOURTH WEEK OF THE GREAT FAST
items.day_or_date: Synaxarion first of the Menaion, then the present one:*[^1085]
items.english_text: By the touching of the hem of His garment the Lord healed the woman with an issue of blood, cleansed lepers, and having enlightened the blind and straightened the lame, healed with a word the deaf, the dumb, and the bowed down to the earth, that thou mightest be saved, O wretched soul!

items.english_text: Healing infirmities, Christ the Word evangelized the poor, cured the afflicted, ate with publicans, conversed with sinners, and restored the departed soul of Jairus' daughter by the touch of His hand.

provenance.verbatim_source: Healing infirmities, Christ the Word evangelized the poor, cured the afflicted, ate with publicans, conversed with sinners, and restored the departed soul of Jairus' daughter by the touch of His hand.

items.day_or_date: Synaxarion first of the Menaion, then the present one:*[^1085]
items.english_text: The publican was saved, and the harlot was made chaste, while the boasting Pharisee was condemned; for the first said: "Cleanse me"; and the second: "Have mercy upon me"; but the third was magnifying himself, crying: "O God, I thank Thee," and other foolish words.

items.day_or_date: Synaxarion first of the Menaion, then the present one:*[^1085]
items.english_text: Zacchaeus was a publican, yet he was saved; and Simon the Pharisee was scandalized, while the harlot received forgiving release from Him Who has the power to forgive sins; strive to imitate her, O soul!

provenance.verbatim_source: Zacchaeus was a publican, yet he was saved; and Simon the Pharisee was scandalized, while the harlot received forgiving release from Him Who has the power to forgive sins; strive to imitate her, O soul!

items.day_or_date: Synaxarion first of the Menaion, then the present one:*[^1085]
items.english_text: Unto the harlot, O my wretched soul, thou hast not been zealous, who, taking the alabaster jar of myrrh, with tears anointed the Savior's feet, and wiped them with her hair, as He tore up the handwriting of her ancient sins!

items.day_or_date: Synaxarion first of the Menaion, then the present one:*[^1085]
items.english_text: Thou hast learned, O my soul, how the cities unto which Christ gave the Gospel were cursed; fear their example, lest thou become like them, whom the Master, having likened unto the Sodomites, condemned even unto Hades!

provenance.verbatim_source: Thou hast learned, O my soul, how the cities unto which Christ gave the Gospel were cursed; fear their example, lest thou become like them, whom the Master, having likened unto the Sodomites, condemned even unto Hades!

items.day_or_date: Synaxarion first of the Menaion, then the present one:*[^1085]
items.english_text: Mayest thou not appear worse through despair, O my soul, having heard of the faith of the Canaanite woman, whose daughter was healed by the word of God; cry aloud from the depth of thy heart, as she did unto Christ: "O Son of David, save me also!"

items.season_or_tone: FOURTH WEEK OF THE GREAT FAST
items.day_or_date: Synaxarion first of the Menaion, then the present one:*[^1085]
items.english_text: Have compassion, save me; O Son of David, have mercy, Thou Who didst heal by a word those possessed by demons; and speak unto me as unto the robber that compassionate voice: "Amen, I say unto thee, thou shalt be with Me in Paradise when I come in My glory!"

items.day_or_date: Synaxarion first of the Menaion, then the present one:*[^1085]
items.english_text: A robber reviled Thee, a robber confessed Thee as God, for both were hanging upon the cross; but, O Compassionate One, as unto Thy faithful robber who recognized Thee as God, open also unto me the door of Thy glorious Kingdom!

items.day_or_date: Synaxarion first of the Menaion, then the present one:*[^1085]
items.english_text: Creation trembled seeing Thee crucified, mountains and rocks split from fear, and the earth shook, and Hades was stripped bare, and the light darkened at midday, beholding Thee, O Jesus, nailed to the cross!

items.day_or_date: Synaxarion first of the Menaion, then the present one:*[^1085]
items.english_text: Exact not from me worthy fruits of repentance, for my strength has failed within me; grant me ever a contrite heart and spiritual poverty, that I may offer these unto Thee as an acceptable sacrifice, O only Savior!

items.day_or_date: Synaxarion first of the Menaion, then the present one:*[^1085]
items.english_text: My Judge and my Knower, Who art to come again with the angels to judge the whole world, beholding me then with Thy merciful eye, spare me, and have compassion upon me, O Jesus, who have sinned more than all human nature!

items.english_text: Thou didst astonish all by thy marvelous life, the ranks of angels and the assemblies of men, having lived immaterially and transcended nature, whereby with seemingly bodiless feet stepping, O Mary, thou didst cross the Jordan!

items.english_text: *At the table we eat oil and drink wine on account of the labor of the vigil. But in the Studite Typikon it commands to eat dry food the whole of that week, more than others, for they are days of mourning and not of feast; for on these days indeed it is also appointed to sing "Alleluia." But in the Typikon of the Holy Mountain it directs on the holy Forty Martyrs, on the Finding of the Forerunner's Head, on Wednesday of the Cross, on the Great Canon, and on the Akathist to eat two cooked foods with oil, and to drink two cups of wine. These things have we noted for your charity from both, that he who desires to be saved may choose what is most well-pleasing before God.*[^1120]

items.slavonic_text: Со́лнце ꙗ҆́кѡ ви́дѣ тѧ̀ Распина́ема за́йде: * ка́кѡ бо сїѧ́ло бы, оу҆кори́знꙋ ви́дѧ Зижди́телѧ своегѡ̀; * ꙗ҆́кѡ и҆ тва́рь всѧ̀ преклоня́ема, распина́телемъ вопїѧ́ше молча́щи: * ꙗ҆́кѡ ты̀ Бг҃ъ є҆сѝ всѣ́хъ, а҆́ще и҆ пло́тїю стра́ждеши.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* *Ode 9 (continued):* When the sun beheld Thee crucified, it set; for how could it shine, beholding the reproach of its Creator? For all creation also, bowing down, cried out in silence to the crucifiers: Truly Thou art the God of all, though Thou sufferest in the flesh.

items.slavonic_text: И҆ ны́нѣ: Бг҃оро́диченъ: Чꙋ́до Ржⷭ҇тва̀ твоегѡ̀ оу҆дивля́етъ мѧ̀, Всенепоро́чнаѧ, * ка́кѡ зачина́еши безсѣ́меннѡ, Невмѣсти́маго; * рцы̀, ка́кѡ дѣ́вствꙋеши, ро́ждши ꙗ҆́кѡ Мт҃и; * Є҆́же па́че є҆стества̀ вѣ́рою прїе́мъ, Рожде́нномꙋ поклони́сѧ: * є҆ли́ка хо́щетъ бо, и҆ мо́жетъ.
items.english_text: O Father of the Only-begotten Son, Thou Sole Begetter of the One; and O Sole Light of the One, Radiance of the Light; and Thou One, Holy Spirit of the One God, truly being the Lord of the Lord: O Holy Trinity, Unity, save me who theologize Thee.

provenance.verbatim_source: O Father of the Only-begotten Son, Thou Sole Begetter of the One; and O Sole Light of the One, Radiance of the Light; and Thou One, Holy Spirit of the One God, truly being the Lord of the Lord: O Holy Trinity, Unity, save me who theologize Thee.

items.slavonic_text: І҆рмо́съ: Безсѣ́меннагѡ Зача́тїа Ржⷭ҇тво̀ несказа́нное, * Мт҃ре безмꙋ́жныѧ нетлѣ́ненъ пло́дъ: * Бж҃їе бо Рожде́нїе ѡ҆бновля́етъ є҆стества̀, * тѣ́мже тѧ̀ всѝ ро́ди, ꙗ҆́кѡ бг҃оневѣ́стнꙋю Мт҃рь, * правосла́внѡ велича́емъ.
items.english_text: The wonder of thy childbearing amazes me, O All-immaculate one: how dost thou conceive without seed Him Whom naught can contain? Tell me, how art thou a virgin, having given birth as a Mother? Having received with faith that which is beyond nature, bow down before the One Who was born; for whatsoever He wills, He is also able to do.

items.slavonic_text: На стїхо́внѣ самогла́сенъ, два́жды. Гла́съ и҃. Съ разбо́йники на крⷭ҇тѣ̀ пригвозди́выйсѧ Хрⷭ҇тѐ Бж҃е, * и҆ ꙗ҆́звою твое́ю чл҃вѣ́ческое є҆стество̀ и҆сцѣли́вый, * не пре́зри менѐ въ мы́сленныѧ пꙋтедержа́тели и҆ въ разбо́йники безпло́тныѧ впа́дшаго, * и҆ добродѣ́тели ѿ ни́хъ совлече́ннаго, * и҆ лю́тѣ оу҆ѧ́звеннаго, * ни ѿ є҆ди́нагѡ же ѿ преподо́бныхъ и҆сцѣли́тисѧ возмо́гшаго: * и҆сполꙋ̀ бо ме́ртвъ є҆́смь, кратча́йшїй и҆мѣ́ѧ жи́зни ѡ҆ста́нокъ, * на тѧ̀ и҆мѣ́ѧй є҆ди́нꙋ наде́ждꙋ, ме́ртвымъ живо́тъ подаю́щаго: * но ѡ҆бвяжи́ ми стрꙋ̑пы, твою̀ и҆ска́павъ мнѣ̀ бла́гость, * є҆ди́не Человѣколю́бче.
items.english_text: For our sake, each of Thy members underwent suffering: Thy head, blows; Thy cheeks, buffeting; Thy hands, nailing; and Thy ribs, the spear; and above all, the Cross; but glory to Thine ineffable compassion, O our Savior!
