items.season_or_tone: LENTEN OKTOECHOS SUPPLEMENT: TRINITY HYMNS AND COMPUNCTIVE STICHERA
items.day_or_date: On Friday of Palm Week, at Matins
items.slavonic_text: Крⷭ҇та̀ твоегѡ̀ дре́вꙋ покланѧ́емсѧ Человѣколю́бче, ꙗ҆́кѡ на не́мъ пригвозди́лсѧ є҆сѝ Животѐ всѣ́хъ: ра́й ѿве́рзлъ є҆сѝ Сп҃се, вѣ́рою пристꙋпи́вшемꙋ къ тебѣ̀ разбо́йникꙋ, и҆ сла́дости сподо́билъ, и҆сповѣ́далсѧ тебѣ̀: помѧни́ мѧ Гдⷭ҇и, прїимѝ ꙗ҆́коже ѻ҆́наго и҆ на́съ, зовꙋ́щыѧ: согрѣши́хомъ всѝ, бл҃гоꙋтро́бїемъ твои́мъ не пре́зри на́съ.
items.english_text: Before the Tree of Thy Cross do we bow down, O Lover of mankind, for upon it wast Thou nailed, O Life of all; Thou hast opened paradise, O Savior, unto the thief who approached Thee with faith, and hast accounted that penitent worthy of delight, who confessed unto Thee: "Remember me, O Lord!" Receive also us as that thief, who cry aloud: We all have sinned; in Thy tender compassion despise us not!

provenance.verbatim_source: Before the Tree of Thy Cross do we bow down, O Lover of mankind, for upon it wast Thou nailed, O Life of all; Thou hast opened paradise, O Savior, unto the thief who approached Thee with faith, and hast accounted that penitent worthy of delight, who confessed unto Thee: "Remember me, O Lord!" items.slavonic_text: А҆́гница на дре́вѣ А҆́гнца зрѧ́щи, съ разбо́йникома долготерпѣли́внѡ распина́ема тебѐ Сло́ве, и҆ копїе́мъ въ ре́бра пробода́ема, восклица́ше вопїю́щи мт҃рски: что̀ стра́нное и҆ оу҆жа́сное Сп҃се мо́й та́инство; ка́кѡ покрыва́етъ гро́бъ невмѣсти́маго Бг҃а; неизрече́нно є҆́сть соверша́емое: не ѡ҆ста́ви менѐ Ро́ждшїѧ тѧ̀, Сн҃е мо́й сладча́йшїй.
items.english_text: Beholding upon the Tree the Lamb, enduringly crucified with two thieves, Thee, O Word, and pierced in the ribs with a spear, the Ewe-lamb cried out, weeping with motherly voice: What is this strange and terrible mystery, O my Savior? How does a tomb cover the uncontainable God? Unspeakable is that which is accomplished; forsake me not who bore Thee, O my sweetest Son!

provenance.verbatim_source: Beholding upon the Tree the Lamb, enduringly crucified with two thieves, Thee, O Word, and pierced in the ribs with a spear, the Ewe-lamb cried out, weeping with motherly voice: What is this strange and terrible mystery, O my Savior? items.slavonic_text: Болѣ́зньми ст҃ы́хъ, и҆́миже ѡ҆ тебѣ̀ пострада́ша, оу҆моле́нъ бꙋ́ди Гдⷭ҇и, и҆ всѧ̑ на́ша болѣ́зни и҆сцѣлѝ, Чл҃колю́бче, мо́лимтѧ.
items.english_text: By the sufferings of the saints which they endured for Thy sake, be Thou entreated, O Lord, and heal all our sicknesses, O Lover of mankind, we pray Thee!

provenance.verbatim_source: By the sufferings of the saints which they endured for Thy sake, be Thou entreated, O Lord, and heal all our sicknesses, O Lover of mankind, we pray Thee!

items.english_text: By the net of the word, casting apart the rhetorical intricacies of the philosophers with the rod of the Cross, the fishermen enlightened the nations in piety to glorify Thee, the true God; therefore unto Thee Who didst strengthen them do we cry aloud: Glory to the Father, and to the Son, and glory to the consubstantial Spirit; glory unto Him Who through them enlightened the world!

items.english_text: O most wise fishers of the universe, having received mercy from God, pray now for us who cry aloud: O Lord, save the Emperor,[^1249] and Thy city, and deliver our souls through the Apostles from the afflictions that encompass us!

items.day_or_date: On Friday of Palm Week, at Matins
items.english_text: Him Who in heaven is without a mother, beyond thought and hearing, upon earth hast thou borne without a father; Him, O Theotokos, entreat for our souls!

provenance.verbatim_source: Him Who in heaven is without a mother, beyond thought and hearing, upon earth hast thou borne without a father; Him, O Theotokos, entreat for our souls!

items.english_text: O martyrs of Christ, we all entreat you, for they pray for our salvation; and let us all approach unto them with faith; these pour forth the grace of healings, these drive away the legions of demons, as guardians of the faith.

provenance.verbatim_source: O martyrs of Christ, we all entreat you, for they pray for our salvation; and let us all approach unto them with faith; these pour forth the grace of healings, these drive away the legions of demons, as guardians of the faith.

items.english_text: When Thou wast crucified, O Christ, tyranny was destroyed, and the enemy's power was trampled down; for neither an Angel nor a man, but Thou Thyself, O Lord, hast saved us: glory to Thee!

provenance.verbatim_source: When Thou wast crucified, O Christ, tyranny was destroyed, and the enemy's power was trampled down; for neither an Angel nor a man, but Thou Thyself, O Lord, hast saved us: glory to Thee!

items.english_text: Having thine intercession, O Most Pure One, and by thy prayers being delivered from grievous ills, guarded everywhere by the Cross of thy Son, as is our duty we all piously magnify thee!

items.section: At the Praises, Stichera of the Martyrs, Tone 1
items.season_or_tone: LENTEN OKTOECHOS SUPPLEMENT: TRINITY HYMNS AND COMPUNCTIVE STICHERA
items.day_or_date: On Friday of Palm Week, at Matins
items.english_text: Passion-bearers of Christ, come, all ye peoples, let us honor them with songs and spiritual hymns: the luminaries of the world and preachers of the faith, ever-flowing fountains whence healings flow forth unto the faithful; by their prayers, O Christ our God, grant peace unto Thy world, and unto our souls great mercy!

items.office: Trinity Hymns in the Eight Tones
items.section: At the Praises, Stichera of the Martyrs, Tone 1
items.season_or_tone: LENTEN OKTOECHOS SUPPLEMENT: TRINITY HYMNS AND COMPUNCTIVE STICHERA
items.day_or_date: On Friday of Palm Week, at Matins
items.english_text: These soldiers of the Great King resisted the commands of the tyrants, valiantly took no account of tortures, and trampled down all delusion; having been worthily crowned, they ask of the Savior peace for our souls, and great mercy!

provenance.verbatim_source: These soldiers of the Great King resisted the commands of the tyrants, valiantly took no account of tortures, and trampled down all delusion; having been worthily crowned, they ask of the Savior peace for our souls, and great mercy!

items.section: At the Praises, Stichera of the Martyrs, Tone 1
items.season_or_tone: LENTEN OKTOECHOS SUPPLEMENT: TRINITY HYMNS AND COMPUNCTIVE STICHERA
items.day_or_date: On Friday of Palm Week, at Matins
items.english_text: Neither tribulation, nor distress, nor famine, nor persecution, nor wounds, nor rage of wild beasts, nor sword, nor threatening fire were able to separate you from God, O all-praised martyrs; but through love toward Him, having striven as if in bodies not your own, ye forgot nature and despised death; therefore also worthily did ye receive the reward of your labors, having become heirs of the kingdom of heaven: pray ye unto Christ for our souls!

items.office: Trinity Hymns in the Eight Tones
items.section: At the Praises, Stichera of the Martyrs, Tone 1
items.season_or_tone: LENTEN OKTOECHOS SUPPLEMENT: TRINITY HYMNS AND COMPUNCTIVE STICHERA
items.day_or_date: On Friday of Palm Week, at Matins
items.english_text: Rejoice in the Lord, O martyrs, for ye have fought the good fight; ye resisted kings, and vanquished tyrants; ye feared not fire nor sword, nor savage beasts that devoured your bodies; sending up hymnody unto Christ with the Angels, ye received crowns from heaven: ask that peace be granted unto the world, and unto our souls great mercy!

items.day_or_date: On Friday of Palm Week, at Matins
items.english_text: In deed, O my Savior, dost Thou show forth that Thou art the Resurrection of all; by a word, O Word, Thou didst raise Lazarus from the dead, when the dead arose from their tombs, and the gates of Hades were shattered; then unto men death was shown to be sleep; but do Thou Who camest for the salvation of Thy creation and not for condemnation, give rest unto those whom Thou hast chosen, as the Lover of mankind!

items.english_text: Rejoice from us, O holy Theotokos Virgin: pure vessel of the whole universe, unquenchable lamp, tabernacle of the Uncontainable One, undefiled church; rejoice, from whom was born the Lamb of God, Who takes away the sins of the whole world!

provenance.verbatim_source: Rejoice from us, O holy Theotokos Virgin: pure vessel of the whole universe, unquenchable lamp, tabernacle of the Uncontainable One, undefiled church; rejoice, from whom was born the Lamb of God, Who takes away the sins of the whole world!

items.season_or_tone: LENTEN OKTOECHOS SUPPLEMENT: TRINITY HYMNS AND COMPUNCTIVE STICHERA
items.day_or_date: On Friday of Palm Week, at Matins
items.english_text: Unto Thee, O Savior, do we pray: vouchsafe those who have departed to partake of Thy sweetness, and settle them in the mansions of the righteous, together with Thy saints, and in heavenly habitations, in Thy tender compassion overlooking their transgressions, and granting them rest!

provenance.verbatim_source: Unto Thee, O Savior, do we pray: vouchsafe those who have departed to partake of Thy sweetness, and settle them in the mansions of the righteous, together with Thy saints, and in heavenly habitations, in Thy tender compassion overlooking their transgressions, and granting them rest!

items.day_or_date: On Friday of Palm Week, at Matins
items.english_text: *Verse: Blessed are they whom Thou hast chosen and taken to Thyself, O Lord.*[^1251]

items.day_or_date: On Friday of Palm Week, at Matins
items.english_text: Higher than visible things are Thy promises, O Savior, which eye has not seen, nor ear heard, neither have they ever entered into the heart of man;[^1252] we pray Thee therefore, O Master, count those who have departed unto Thee worthy to obtain Thy sweet communion, and grant them life eternal!

items.day_or_date: On Friday of Palm Week, at Matins
items.english_text: *Verse: Their souls shall dwell among good things.*[^1253]

provenance.verbatim_source: *Verse: Their souls shall dwell among good things.*[^1253]

items.day_or_date: On Friday of Palm Week, at Matins
items.english_text: Manifestly rejoicing in Thy Cross, in hope Thy servants have departed unto Thee, O Lover of mankind; unto them do Thou now grant Thy Cross and the Blood poured out for the life of the world as the redemption of their transgressions, in Thy tenderheartedness pardoning their falls into sin, and enlightening them with the light of Thy countenance!

items.day_or_date: On Friday of Palm Week, at Matins
items.english_text: *Verse: And their memory is from generation to generation.*[^1254]

provenance.verbatim_source: *Verse: And their memory is from generation to generation.*[^1254]

items.season_or_tone: LENTEN OKTOECHOS SUPPLEMENT: TRINITY HYMNS AND COMPUNCTIVE STICHERA
items.day_or_date: On Friday of Palm Week, at Matins
items.english_text: No one is sinless, no one among men has ever been, save Thee alone, O Only Immortal One; therefore place Thy servants (as Thou art a compassionate God) in the light, together with Thine angelic choirs, in Thy tender compassion overlooking their iniquities, and granting them forgiveness!

provenance.verbatim_source: No one is sinless, no one among men has ever been, save Thee alone, O Only Immortal One; therefore place Thy servants (as Thou art a compassionate God) in the light, together with Thine angelic choirs, in Thy tender compassion overlooking their iniquities, and granting them forgiveness!

items.office: Trinity Hymns in the Eight Tones
items.section: At the Aposticha, Stichera for the Departed
items.season_or_tone: LENTEN OKTOECHOS SUPPLEMENT: TRINITY HYMNS AND COMPUNCTIVE STICHERA
items.day_or_date: On Friday of Palm Week, at Matins
items.english_text: Entreat Christ, Thine Offspring, O Virgin Mother, to grant forgiveness of transgressions unto thy servants who have piously proclaimed thee as Theotokos and been taught by the true word; account them worthy of the joy of the radiance of the saints in Thy kingdom!

provenance.verbatim_source: Entreat Christ, Thine Offspring, O Virgin Mother, to grant forgiveness of transgressions unto thy servants who have piously proclaimed thee as Theotokos and been taught by the true word; account them worthy of the joy of the radiance of the saints in Thy kingdom!

items.season_or_tone: LENTEN OKTOECHOS SUPPLEMENT: TRINITY HYMNS AND COMPUNCTIVE STICHERA
items.day_or_date: On Friday of Palm Week, at Matins
items.english_text: I have sinned against Thee, O Savior, as the prodigal son; receive me, O Father, as I repent, and have mercy on me, O God!

provenance.verbatim_source: I have sinned against Thee, O Savior, as the prodigal son; receive me, O Father, as I repent, and have mercy on me, O God!

items.season_or_tone: LENTEN OKTOECHOS SUPPLEMENT: TRINITY HYMNS AND COMPUNCTIVE STICHERA
items.day_or_date: On Friday of Palm Week, at Matins
items.english_text: I cry unto Thee, O Christ Savior, with the voice of the publican: Cleanse me as him, and have mercy on me, O God!

provenance.verbatim_source: I cry unto Thee, O Christ Savior, with the voice of the publican: Cleanse me as him, and have mercy on me, O God!

items.office: Trinity Hymns in the Eight Tones
items.section: At the Aposticha, Stichera for the Departed
items.season_or_tone: LENTEN OKTOECHOS SUPPLEMENT: TRINITY HYMNS AND COMPUNCTIVE STICHERA
items.day_or_date: On Friday of Palm Week, at Matins
items.english_text: Thinking upon the improper evils which I have committed, I flee unto Thy compassions, resembling the publican, and the harlot who wept, and the prodigal son; therefore also I fall down before Thee, O Merciful One: before Thou judgest me, spare me, O my God, and have mercy on me!

provenance.verbatim_source: Thinking upon the improper evils which I have committed, I flee unto Thy compassions, resembling the publican, and the harlot who wept, and the prodigal son; therefore also I fall down before Thee, O Merciful One: before Thou judgest me, spare me, O my God, and have mercy on me!

items.office: Trinity Hymns in the Eight Tones
items.section: At the Aposticha, Stichera for the Departed
items.season_or_tone: LENTEN OKTOECHOS SUPPLEMENT: TRINITY HYMNS AND COMPUNCTIVE STICHERA
items.day_or_date: On Friday of Palm Week, at Matins
items.english_text: Overlook mine iniquities, O Lord Who wast born of the Virgin, and cleanse my heart, making it a temple for Thy Holy Spirit; cast me not away from Thy presence, Thou Who hast boundless and great mercy!

provenance.verbatim_source: Overlook mine iniquities, O Lord Who wast born of the Virgin, and cleanse my heart, making it a temple for Thy Holy Spirit; cast me not away from Thy presence, Thou Who hast boundless and great mercy!

items.office: Trinity Hymns in the Eight Tones
items.section: At the Aposticha, Stichera for the Departed
items.season_or_tone: LENTEN OKTOECHOS SUPPLEMENT: TRINITY HYMNS AND COMPUNCTIVE STICHERA
items.day_or_date: On Friday of Palm Week, at Matins
items.english_text: As the waves of the sea have mine iniquities risen up against me, and like a small ship in the deep, I alone am tossed by a tempest of many transgressions; but guide me, O Lord, by repentance into the calm haven, and save me!

provenance.verbatim_source: As the waves of the sea have mine iniquities risen up against me, and like a small ship in the deep, I alone am tossed by a tempest of many transgressions; but guide me, O Lord, by repentance into the calm haven, and save me!

items.day_or_date: On Friday of Palm Week, at Matins
items.english_text: *Verse: O Lord, rebuke me not in Thine anger [nor chasten me in Thy wrath]:*[^1255]

provenance.verbatim_source: *Verse: O Lord, rebuke me not in Thine anger [nor chasten me in Thy wrath]:*[^1255]

items.office: Trinity Hymns in the Eight Tones
items.section: At the Aposticha, Stichera for the Departed
items.season_or_tone: LENTEN OKTOECHOS SUPPLEMENT: TRINITY HYMNS AND COMPUNCTIVE STICHERA
items.day_or_date: On Friday of Palm Week, at Matins
items.english_text: I am a barren tree, O Lord, bringing forth no fruit of compunction whatsoever; and I fear the felling, and am terrified of that unquenchable fire; therefore I pray Thee: before that extremity, turn me and save me!

provenance.verbatim_source: I am a barren tree, O Lord, bringing forth no fruit of compunction whatsoever; and I fear the felling, and am terrified of that unquenchable fire; therefore I pray Thee: before that extremity, turn me and save me!

items.office: Trinity Hymns in the Eight Tones
items.section: At the Aposticha, Stichera for the Departed
items.season_or_tone: LENTEN OKTOECHOS SUPPLEMENT: TRINITY HYMNS AND COMPUNCTIVE STICHERA
items.day_or_date: On Friday of Palm Week, at Matins
items.english_text: Being the Fountain of tenderheartedness, count us worthy of compassion, O all-hymned Theotokos; look down upon a people that has sinned; show forth as ever thy power; for hoping in thee, we cry aloud unto thee: "Rejoice!" even as of old did Gabriel, the supreme commander of the bodiless hosts.

provenance.verbatim_source: Being the Fountain of tenderheartedness, count us worthy of compassion, O all-hymned Theotokos; look down upon a people that has sinned; show forth as ever thy power; for hoping in thee, we cry aloud unto thee: "Rejoice!" even as of old did Gabriel, the supreme commander of the bodiless hosts.

items.office: Trinity Hymns in the Eight Tones
items.section: At the Aposticha, Stichera for the Departed
items.season_or_tone: LENTEN OKTOECHOS SUPPLEMENT: TRINITY HYMNS AND COMPUNCTIVE STICHERA
items.day_or_date: On Friday of Palm Week, at Matins
items.english_text: Having Thee, Who dost clothe heaven with clouds, as their raiment in the world, the holy ones endured the torments of the lawless, and abolished the delusion of idols; by their prayers deliver us also from the invisible foe, O Savior, and save us!

provenance.verbatim_source: Having Thee, Who dost clothe heaven with clouds, as their raiment in the world, the holy ones endured the torments of the lawless, and abolished the delusion of idols; by their prayers deliver us also from the invisible foe, O Savior, and save us!

items.office: Trinity Hymns in the Eight Tones
items.section: At the Aposticha, Stichera for the Departed
items.season_or_tone: LENTEN OKTOECHOS SUPPLEMENT: TRINITY HYMNS AND COMPUNCTIVE STICHERA
items.day_or_date: On Friday of Palm Week, at Matins
items.english_text: "Have mercy on me," said David, and I also cry unto Thee: I have sinned, O Savior; having cleansed my sins by repentance, have mercy on me!

provenance.verbatim_source: "Have mercy on me," said David, and I also cry unto Thee: I have sinned, O Savior; having cleansed my sins by repentance, have mercy on me!

items.office: Trinity Hymns in the Eight Tones
items.section: At the Aposticha, Stichera for the Departed
items.season_or_tone: LENTEN OKTOECHOS SUPPLEMENT: TRINITY HYMNS AND COMPUNCTIVE STICHERA
items.day_or_date: On Friday of Palm Week, at Matins
items.english_text: Have mercy on me, O God, have mercy on me! For two sins did David weep:[^1256] yet for ten thousand transgressions do I cry unto Thee; he drenched his bed with tears, while I have not even a single drop; despairing, I pray: Have mercy on me, O God, according to Thy great mercy!

provenance.verbatim_source: Have mercy on me, O God, have mercy on me! For two sins did David weep:[^1256] yet for ten thousand transgressions do I cry unto Thee; he drenched his bed with tears, while I have not even a single drop; despairing, I pray: Have mercy on me, O God, according to Thy great mercy!

items.office: Trinity Hymns in the Eight Tones
items.section: At the Aposticha, Stichera for the Departed
items.season_or_tone: LENTEN OKTOECHOS SUPPLEMENT: TRINITY HYMNS AND COMPUNCTIVE STICHERA
items.day_or_date: On Friday of Palm Week, at Matins
items.english_text: O Theotokos, despise me not who need thy protection; for in thee has my soul hoped: have mercy on me!

provenance.verbatim_source: O Theotokos, despise me not who need thy protection; for in thee has my soul hoped: have mercy on me!

items.office: Trinity Hymns in the Eight Tones
items.section: At the Aposticha, Stichera for the Departed
items.season_or_tone: LENTEN OKTOECHOS SUPPLEMENT: TRINITY HYMNS AND COMPUNCTIVE STICHERA
items.day_or_date: On Friday of Palm Week, at Matins
items.english_text: Thou Who didst enlighten Thy holy ones more than gold, and didst glorify Thy venerable ones, in that Thou art Good: being entreated by them, O Christ God, bring peace unto our life, as the Lover of mankind, and set forth our prayer as incense, O Thou Who alone restest in the saints!

provenance.verbatim_source: Thou Who didst enlighten Thy holy ones more than gold, and didst glorify Thy venerable ones, in that Thou art Good: being entreated by them, O Christ God, bring peace unto our life, as the Lover of mankind, and set forth our prayer as incense, O Thou Who alone restest in the saints!

items.office: Trinity Hymns in the Eight Tones
items.section: At the Aposticha, Stichera for the Departed
items.season_or_tone: LENTEN OKTOECHOS SUPPLEMENT: TRINITY HYMNS AND COMPUNCTIVE STICHERA
items.day_or_date: On Friday of Palm Week, at Matins
items.english_text: The life-creating Cross of Thy goodness, which Thou hast granted unto us who are unworthy, O Lord, we offer unto Thee in prayer: save the Emperor, and Thy city which prays unto Thee, through the Theotokos, O only Lover of mankind!

provenance.verbatim_source: The life-creating Cross of Thy goodness, which Thou hast granted unto us who are unworthy, O Lord, we offer unto Thee in prayer: save the Emperor, and Thy city which prays unto Thee, through the Theotokos, O only Lover of mankind!

items.office: Trinity Hymns in the Eight Tones
items.section: At the Aposticha, Stichera for the Departed
items.season_or_tone: LENTEN OKTOECHOS SUPPLEMENT: TRINITY HYMNS AND COMPUNCTIVE STICHERA
items.day_or_date: On Friday of Palm Week, at Matins
items.english_text: Even as the enemy took Adam captive through the tree of eating, O Lord, so likewise hast Thou taken captive the enemy through the Tree of the Cross and by Thy Passion; for unto this didst Thou come as the second Adam, to seek out the straying and make alive him that was slain: O God, glory to Thee!

provenance.verbatim_source: Even as the enemy took Adam captive through the tree of eating, O Lord, so likewise hast Thou taken captive the enemy through the Tree of the Cross and by Thy Passion; for unto this didst Thou come as the second Adam, to seek out the straying and make alive him that was slain: O God, glory to Thee!

items.office: Trinity Hymns in the Eight Tones
items.section: At the Aposticha, Stichera for the Departed
items.season_or_tone: LENTEN OKTOECHOS SUPPLEMENT: TRINITY HYMNS AND COMPUNCTIVE STICHERA
items.day_or_date: On Friday of Palm Week, at Matins
items.english_text: Thy Virgin Mother, O Christ, beholding Thee stretched out dead upon the Tree, weeping bitterly, said: What is this fearful mystery, O my Son? Thou Who grantest eternal life unto all, how dost Thou die of Thine own will upon the Cross an ignominious death?

provenance.verbatim_source: Thy Virgin Mother, O Christ, beholding Thee stretched out dead upon the Tree, weeping bitterly, said: What is this fearful mystery, O my Son? Thou Who grantest eternal life unto all, how dost Thou die of Thine own will upon the Cross an ignominious death?

items.office: Trinity Hymns in the Eight Tones
items.section: At the Aposticha, Stichera for the Departed
items.season_or_tone: LENTEN OKTOECHOS SUPPLEMENT: TRINITY HYMNS AND COMPUNCTIVE STICHERA
items.day_or_date: On Friday of Palm Week, at Matins
items.english_text: O passion-bearers of the Lord, blessed is the earth that was watered by your blood, and holy are the dwellings that received your bodies; for in the stadium ye vanquished the enemy, and with boldness proclaimed Christ; entreat Him as the Good One, we pray, that our souls may be saved!

provenance.verbatim_source: O passion-bearers of the Lord, blessed is the earth that was watered by your blood, and holy are the dwellings that received your bodies; for in the stadium ye vanquished the enemy, and with boldness proclaimed Christ; entreat Him as the Good One, we pray, that our souls may be saved!

items.office: Trinity Hymns in the Eight Tones
items.section: At the Aposticha, Stichera for the Departed
items.season_or_tone: LENTEN OKTOECHOS SUPPLEMENT: TRINITY HYMNS AND COMPUNCTIVE STICHERA
items.day_or_date: On Friday of Palm Week, at Matins
items.english_text: Thou Who didst make the fishermen wiser than rhetoricians, and didst send them as preachers unto all the earth by Thine unspeakable love for mankind, O Christ God: through them confirm Thy Church, and send down Thy blessing upon the faithful, O only Merciful One and Lover of mankind!

provenance.verbatim_source: Thou Who didst make the fishermen wiser than rhetoricians, and didst send them as preachers unto all the earth by Thine unspeakable love for mankind, O Christ God: through them confirm Thy Church, and send down Thy blessing upon the faithful, O only Merciful One and Lover of mankind!

items.office: Trinity Hymns in the Eight Tones
items.section: At the Aposticha, Stichera for the Departed
items.season_or_tone: LENTEN OKTOECHOS SUPPLEMENT: TRINITY HYMNS AND COMPUNCTIVE STICHERA
items.day_or_date: On Friday of Palm Week, at Matins
items.english_text: Having caught the nations, the fishermen, and taught the ends of the earth to worship Thee through Thine unspeakable love for mankind, O Christ God: through them confirm Thy Church, and send down Thy blessing upon the faithful, O Thou Who alone restest in the saints!

provenance.verbatim_source: Having caught the nations, the fishermen, and taught the ends of the earth to worship Thee through Thine unspeakable love for mankind, O Christ God: through them confirm Thy Church, and send down Thy blessing upon the faithful, O Thou Who alone restest in the saints!

items.office: Trinity Hymns in the Eight Tones
items.section: At the Aposticha, Stichera for the Departed
items.season_or_tone: LENTEN OKTOECHOS SUPPLEMENT: TRINITY HYMNS AND COMPUNCTIVE STICHERA
items.day_or_date: On Friday of Palm Week, at Matins
items.english_text: Thee do we magnify, O Theotokos, crying aloud: Rejoice, Cloud of the unwaning Light, who didst bear in thy womb the Lord of glory!

provenance.verbatim_source: Thee do we magnify, O Theotokos, crying aloud: Rejoice, Cloud of the unwaning Light, who didst bear in thy womb the Lord of glory!

items.office: Trinity Hymns in the Eight Tones
items.section: At the Aposticha, Stichera for the Departed
items.season_or_tone: LENTEN OKTOECHOS SUPPLEMENT: TRINITY HYMNS AND COMPUNCTIVE STICHERA
items.day_or_date: On Friday of Palm Week, at Matins
items.english_text: Apostles, martyrs, and prophets, hierarchs, venerable ones, and righteous, who have fought the good fight and kept the faith, having boldness toward the Savior, entreat Him as the Good One for us, we pray, that our souls may be saved!

provenance.verbatim_source: Apostles, martyrs, and prophets, hierarchs, venerable ones, and righteous, who have fought the good fight and kept the faith, having boldness toward the Savior, entreat Him as the Good One for us, we pray, that our souls may be saved!

items.office: Trinity Hymns in the Eight Tones
items.section: At the Aposticha, Stichera for the Departed
items.season_or_tone: LENTEN OKTOECHOS SUPPLEMENT: TRINITY HYMNS AND COMPUNCTIVE STICHERA
items.day_or_date: On Friday of Palm Week, at Matins
items.english_text: We worship Thine immaculate icon, O Good One, asking forgiveness of our transgressions, O Christ God; for of Thine own will Thou wast pleased to ascend the Cross in the flesh, that Thou mightest deliver those whom Thou hast created from the bondage of the enemy; therefore with thanksgiving we cry aloud unto Thee: Thou hast filled all things with joy, O our Savior, Who camest to save the world!

provenance.verbatim_source: We worship Thine immaculate icon, O Good One, asking forgiveness of our transgressions, O Christ God; for of Thine own will Thou wast pleased to ascend the Cross in the flesh, that Thou mightest deliver those whom Thou hast created from the bondage of the enemy; therefore with thanksgiving we cry aloud unto Thee: Thou hast filled all things with joy, O our Savior, Who camest to save the world!

items.office: Trinity Hymns in the Eight Tones
items.section: At the Aposticha, Stichera for the Departed
items.season_or_tone: LENTEN OKTOECHOS SUPPLEMENT: TRINITY HYMNS AND COMPUNCTIVE STICHERA
items.day_or_date: On Friday of Palm Week, at Matins
items.english_text: Thou hast worked salvation in the midst of the earth, O Christ God; upon the Cross Thou didst stretch out Thine all-pure hands, gathering together all the nations, who cry: O Lord, glory to Thee!

provenance.verbatim_source: Thou hast worked salvation in the midst of the earth, O Christ God; upon the Cross Thou didst stretch out Thine all-pure hands, gathering together all the nations, who cry: O Lord, glory to Thee!

items.office: Trinity Hymns in the Eight Tones
items.section: At the Aposticha, Stichera for the Departed
items.season_or_tone: LENTEN OKTOECHOS SUPPLEMENT: TRINITY HYMNS AND COMPUNCTIVE STICHERA
items.day_or_date: On Friday of Palm Week, at Matins
items.english_text: Most glorified art thou, O Theotokos Virgin, we hymn thee; for by the Cross of thy Son Hades was overthrown, and death was put to death; we that were dead have risen, and have been accounted worthy of life; we have received paradise, our ancient delight; therefore with thanksgiving we give glory, as unto Christ our mighty God, and the only Plenteous in mercy!

provenance.verbatim_source: Most glorified art thou, O Theotokos Virgin, we hymn thee; for by the Cross of thy Son Hades was overthrown, and death was put to death; we that were dead have risen, and have been accounted worthy of life; we have received paradise, our ancient delight; therefore with thanksgiving we give glory, as unto Christ our mighty God, and the only Plenteous in mercy!

items.office: Trinity Hymns in the Eight Tones
items.section: At the Aposticha, Stichera for the Departed
items.season_or_tone: LENTEN OKTOECHOS SUPPLEMENT: TRINITY HYMNS AND COMPUNCTIVE STICHERA
items.day_or_date: On Friday of Palm Week, at Matins
items.english_text: Having been founded upon the immovable rock, O holy ones, ye fought valiantly against the tyrants, and obtained crowns of martyrdom; through them, O God, save us!

provenance.verbatim_source: Having been founded upon the immovable rock, O holy ones, ye fought valiantly against the tyrants, and obtained crowns of martyrdom; through them, O God, save us!

items.office: Trinity Hymns in the Eight Tones
items.section: At the Praises, Stichera of the Martyrs, Tone 2
items.season_or_tone: LENTEN OKTOECHOS SUPPLEMENT: TRINITY HYMNS AND COMPUNCTIVE STICHERA
items.day_or_date: On Friday of Palm Week, at Matins
items.english_text: Having suffered for Christ even unto death, O passion-bearing martyrs, your souls indeed are in the hand of God in heaven, and throughout all the world your relics are venerated; hierarchs and kings bow down, and all the peoples rejoicing, with one accord cry out: Precious in the sight of the Lord is the death of His venerable ones![^1257]

provenance.verbatim_source: Having suffered for Christ even unto death, O passion-bearing martyrs, your souls indeed are in the hand of God in heaven, and throughout all the world your relics are venerated; hierarchs and kings bow down, and all the peoples rejoicing, with one accord cry out: Precious in the sight of the Lord is the death of His venerable ones![^1257]

items.office: Trinity Hymns in the Eight Tones
items.section: At the Praises, Stichera of the Martyrs, Tone 2
items.season_or_tone: LENTEN OKTOECHOS SUPPLEMENT: TRINITY HYMNS AND COMPUNCTIVE STICHERA
items.day_or_date: On Friday of Palm Week, at Matins
items.english_text: Every city and country honors your relics, O passion-bearing martyrs; for having suffered lawfully, ye received crowns from heaven; and therefore are ye the boast of hierarchs, the victory of kings, and the beauty of the churches.

provenance.verbatim_source: Every city and country honors your relics, O passion-bearing martyrs; for having suffered lawfully, ye received crowns from heaven; and therefore are ye the boast of hierarchs, the victory of kings, and the beauty of the churches.

items.english_text: Having taken up the Cross of Christ as an invincible weapon, the holy martyrs abolished all the power of the devil, and received heavenly crowns; they have become a wall for us, ever praying for us.

items.day_or_date: On Friday of Palm Week, at Matins
items.english_text: Woe is me! What a struggle has the soul when parting from the body! Woe is me, how much it weeps then! And there is none who has mercy on it; lifting up its eyes unto the Angels, it prays in vain; stretching forth its hands unto men, it has none that helps; therefore, my beloved brethren, knowing our brief life, let us ask rest from Christ for the departed, and for our souls great mercy!

items.season_or_tone: LENTEN OKTOECHOS SUPPLEMENT: TRINITY HYMNS AND COMPUNCTIVE STICHERA
items.day_or_date: On Friday of Palm Week, at Matins
items.english_text: Come, all ye, let us with unceasing hymns glorify (crying aloud) the Mother of the Light; for she gave birth unto our salvation; and let us offer unto her: "Rejoice!" as the only one who bore God Who is before the ages, the Sovereign of all; rejoice, thou who hast rebuilt Eve who bore us; rejoice, all-pure Virgin who knewest not wedlock!

items.season_or_tone: LENTEN OKTOECHOS SUPPLEMENT: TRINITY HYMNS AND COMPUNCTIVE STICHERA
items.day_or_date: On Friday of Palm Week, at Matins
items.english_text: The onslaught of death and corruption hast Thou overthrown by Thy life-bearing death, O Master; and unto all hast Thou poured forth eternal life, and granted resurrection unto the dead; therefore we pray Thee, O Savior: give rest unto those who have departed unto Thee in faith, and count them worthy of Thine immortal glory, O Lover of mankind!

items.day_or_date: On Friday of Palm Week, at Matins
items.english_text: That Thou mightest make men partakers of Thy divine kingdom, O Christ, Thou didst endure crucifixion, and of Thine own will accepted death; therefore we pray Thee: in Thy tender compassion show those who have departed unto Thee in faith to be partakers of Thy kingdom,

items.english_text: *Sessional Hymns of the Oktoechos* and account them worthy of Thy sweet beauty, O Lover of mankind!

items.season_or_tone: LENTEN OKTOECHOS SUPPLEMENT: TRINITY HYMNS AND COMPUNCTIVE STICHERA
items.day_or_date: On Friday of Palm Week, at Matins
items.english_text: Desiring to save Thy creation, and the truly fearful mystery of Thine economy, Thou didst accomplish rejoicing, as the All-Good One; and by a price hast Thou redeemed the whole world, even by Thy precious Blood; therefore we pray Thee: count those who have departed unto Thee in faith worthy of redemption together with all the saints!

items.day_or_date: On Friday of Palm Week, at Matins
items.english_text: Standing before Thy terrible, awesome, and fearful throne, O Christ, the dead from the ages await Thy righteous judgment, and receive Thy divine justice; then do Thou, O Savior, give rest unto Thy servants who have departed unto Thee in faith, where are the choirs of the saints, and joy is unspeakable!

items.day_or_date: On Friday of Palm Week, at Matins
items.english_text: When my soul is about to be separated from the bond of the flesh and from life, then do thou stand before me, O Sovereign Lady, and tear asunder the counsels of the bodiless enemies; and shatter their jaws who seek to devour me unsparingly, that I may pass without hindrance past the princes of darkness standing in the air,[^1258] O Bride of God!

items.day_or_date: On Friday of Palm Week, at Matins
items.english_text: An evening hymn do we offer unto Thee, O Christ, with incense and spiritual songs: have mercy and save our souls!

provenance.verbatim_source: An evening hymn do we offer unto Thee, O Christ, with incense and spiritual songs: have mercy and save our souls!

items.season_or_tone: LENTEN OKTOECHOS SUPPLEMENT: TRINITY HYMNS AND COMPUNCTIVE STICHERA
items.day_or_date: On Friday of Palm Week, at Matins
items.english_text: Save me, O Lord my God, for Thou art salvation unto all; the tempest of passions troubles me, and the burden of mine iniquities submerges me; give me a helping hand, and lead me up unto the light of compunction, as Thou alone art merciful and the Lover of mankind!

items.season_or_tone: LENTEN OKTOECHOS SUPPLEMENT: TRINITY HYMNS AND COMPUNCTIVE STICHERA
items.day_or_date: On Friday of Palm Week, at Matins
items.english_text: Gather my scattered mind, O Lord, and cleanse my frozen heart; give me repentance as unto Peter, sighing as unto the publican, and tears as unto the harlot, that with a great voice I may cry unto Thee: O God, save me, as Thou alone art Tenderhearted and the Lover of mankind!

items.day_or_date: On Friday of Palm Week, at Matins
items.english_text: Many a time while performing psalmody, I am found fulfilling sin, uttering hymnody indeed with my tongue, yet pondering improper things in my soul; but amend both, O Christ God, through repentance, and save me!

provenance.verbatim_source: Many a time while performing psalmody, I am found fulfilling sin, uttering hymnody indeed with my tongue, yet pondering improper things in my soul; but amend both, O Christ God, through repentance, and save me!

items.season_or_tone: LENTEN OKTOECHOS SUPPLEMENT: TRINITY HYMNS AND COMPUNCTIVE STICHERA
items.day_or_date: On Friday of Palm Week, at Matins
items.english_text: At the fearful judgment seat, without accusers am I exposed, without witnesses am I condemned; for the books of conscience are unfolded, and hidden deeds are laid bare; before Thou art to examine in that assembly before all the people what has been committed by me, O God, cleanse me and save me!

items.season_or_tone: LENTEN OKTOECHOS SUPPLEMENT: TRINITY HYMNS AND COMPUNCTIVE STICHERA
items.day_or_date: On Friday of Palm Week, at Matins
items.english_text: How long, O my soul, dost thou abide in transgressions? How long dost thou accept the putting off of repentance? Take to mind the judgment to come, and cry aloud unto the Lord: O Knower of hearts, I have sinned; before Thou judgest me, have mercy on me!

items.season_or_tone: LENTEN OKTOECHOS SUPPLEMENT: TRINITY HYMNS AND COMPUNCTIVE STICHERA
items.day_or_date: On Friday of Palm Week, at Matins
items.english_text: Whithersoever one is saved, thither does he rightly flee; and what other refuge is there such as thee, O Theotokos, who shelterest our souls?

provenance.verbatim_source: Whithersoever one is saved, thither does he rightly flee; and what other refuge is there such as thee, O Theotokos, who shelterest our souls?

items.season_or_tone: LENTEN OKTOECHOS SUPPLEMENT: TRINITY HYMNS AND COMPUNCTIVE STICHERA
items.day_or_date: On Friday of Palm Week, at Matins
items.english_text: Who will not marvel at the invincible struggles of the holy martyrs? Who will not be astonished at their continual steadfastness? For by fire and sword, by wild beasts and slaughterings, they vanquished the adversary foe, having abhorred the flatteries of kings and shaken off the threats of tyrants; therefore also they received crowns from Christ God, Who grants unto the world great mercy!

items.day_or_date: On Friday of Palm Week, at Matins
items.english_text: Living upon earth, O my soul, repent! The dust in the grave does not sing praise, nor does it deliver from transgressions; cry aloud unto Christ God: O Knower of hearts, I have sinned; before Thou judgest me, have mercy on me!

items.season_or_tone: LENTEN OKTOECHOS SUPPLEMENT: TRINITY HYMNS AND COMPUNCTIVE STICHERA
items.day_or_date: On Friday of Palm Week, at Matins
items.english_text: At the hour of prayer I promise to repent, yet the enemy diligently suggests improper things to make me sin; but deliver me from this, O God, and have mercy on me!

provenance.verbatim_source: At the hour of prayer I promise to repent, yet the enemy diligently suggests improper things to make me sin; but deliver me from this, O God, and have mercy on me!

items.season_or_tone: LENTEN OKTOECHOS SUPPLEMENT: TRINITY HYMNS AND COMPUNCTIVE STICHERA
items.day_or_date: On Friday of Palm Week, at Matins
items.english_text: Our refuge and strength, O Theotokos, mighty help of the world: by thy prayers shelter thy servants from every necessity, O only Blessed One!

provenance.verbatim_source: Our refuge and strength, O Theotokos, mighty help of the world: by thy prayers shelter thy servants from every necessity, O only Blessed One!

items.office: Trinity Hymns in the Eight Tones
items.section: At the Aposticha, Stichera for the Departed
items.season_or_tone: LENTEN OKTOECHOS SUPPLEMENT: TRINITY HYMNS AND COMPUNCTIVE STICHERA
items.day_or_date: On Friday of Palm Week, at Matins
items.english_text: The courage of your endurance conquered the wiles of the author of evil, the enemy, O all-praised passion-bearers; therefore were ye accounted worthy of eternal blessedness; but pray ye unto the Lord to save the flock of the Christ-loving people, O martyrs of the truth!

provenance.verbatim_source: The courage of your endurance conquered the wiles of the author of evil, the enemy, O all-praised passion-bearers; therefore were ye accounted worthy of eternal blessedness; but pray ye unto the Lord to save the flock of the Christ-loving people, O martyrs of the truth!

items.office: Trinity Hymns in the Eight Tones

items.season_or_tone: LENTEN OKTOECHOS SUPPLEMENT: TRINITY HYMNS AND COMPUNCTIVE STICHERA
items.day_or_date: On Friday of Palm Week, at Matins
items.english_text: At Thine unsearchable power and voluntary crucifixion the angelic hosts marveled, beholding how the Invisible One was wounded in the flesh, wishing to deliver mankind from corruption; therefore as unto the Giver of life do we cry unto Thee: Glory, O Christ, to Thy kingdom!

provenance.verbatim_source: At Thine unsearchable power and voluntary crucifixion the angelic hosts marveled, beholding how the Invisible One was wounded in the flesh, wishing to deliver mankind from corruption; therefore as unto the Giver of life do we cry unto Thee: Glory, O Christ, to Thy kingdom!

items.office: Trinity Hymns in the Eight Tones
items.section: At the Aposticha, Stichera for the Departed
items.season_or_tone: LENTEN OKTOECHOS SUPPLEMENT: TRINITY HYMNS AND COMPUNCTIVE STICHERA
items.day_or_date: On Friday of Palm Week, at Matins
items.english_text: The Cross was planted upon the earth and touched the heavens, not as though a tree had reached that height, but because Thou upon it fillest all things: O Lord, glory to Thee!

provenance.verbatim_source: The Cross was planted upon the earth and touched the heavens, not as though a tree had reached that height, but because Thou upon it fillest all things: O Lord, glory to Thee!

items.office: Trinity Hymns in the Eight Tones
items.section: At the Aposticha, Stichera for the Departed
items.season_or_tone: LENTEN OKTOECHOS SUPPLEMENT: TRINITY HYMNS AND COMPUNCTIVE STICHERA
items.day_or_date: On Friday of Palm Week, at Matins
items.english_text: Having acquired the rod of strength, the Cross of thy Son, O Theotokos, thereby do we overthrow the insolence of the enemies, unceasingly magnifying thee in love.

provenance.verbatim_source: Having acquired the rod of strength, the Cross of thy Son, O Theotokos, thereby do we overthrow the insolence of the enemies, unceasingly magnifying thee in love.

items.office: Trinity Hymns in the Eight Tones
items.section: At the Aposticha, Stichera for the Departed
items.season_or_tone: LENTEN OKTOECHOS SUPPLEMENT: TRINITY HYMNS AND COMPUNCTIVE STICHERA
items.day_or_date: On Friday of Palm Week, at Matins
items.english_text: The memory of Thy passion-bearers, O Lord, hast Thou beforehand revived as Almighty, for Thou didst strengthen them to emulate Thy Sufferings; for manfully did they conquer the power of Beliar; therefore also did they receive the gifts of healings: by their prayers, O Lover of mankind, grant peace unto our souls!

provenance.verbatim_source: The memory of Thy passion-bearers, O Lord, hast Thou beforehand revived as Almighty, for Thou didst strengthen them to emulate Thy Sufferings; for manfully did they conquer the power of Beliar; therefore also did they receive the gifts of healings: by their prayers, O Lover of mankind, grant peace unto our souls!

items.office: Trinity Hymns in the Eight Tones

items.season_or_tone: LENTEN OKTOECHOS SUPPLEMENT: TRINITY HYMNS AND COMPUNCTIVE STICHERA
items.day_or_date: On Friday of Palm Week, at Matins
items.english_text: Divine preachers of the Truth and teachers of the Church were ye shown forth, O eyewitness Apostles; for having trampled down the delusion of idols, ye clearly proclaimed the Trinity; entreat It, O blessed ones, to grant us great mercy!

provenance.verbatim_source: Divine preachers of the Truth and teachers of the Church were ye shown forth, O eyewitness Apostles; for having trampled down the delusion of idols, ye clearly proclaimed the Trinity; entreat It, O blessed ones, to grant us great mercy!

items.office: Trinity Hymns in the Eight Tones
items.section: At the Aposticha, Stichera for the Departed
items.season_or_tone: LENTEN OKTOECHOS SUPPLEMENT: TRINITY HYMNS AND COMPUNCTIVE STICHERA
items.day_or_date: On Friday of Palm Week, at Matins
items.english_text: Come, all ye, let us hymn the Apostles as governors; for they drove away the deceit of idols, and led us up unto the light of life, and taught us to glorify the Trinity; therefore, all we faithful who celebrate their honorable memory, let us glorify the Savior!

provenance.verbatim_source: Come, all ye, let us hymn the Apostles as governors; for they drove away the deceit of idols, and led us up unto the light of life, and taught us to glorify the Trinity; therefore, all we faithful who celebrate their honorable memory, let us glorify the Savior!

items.office: Trinity Hymns in the Eight Tones

items.season_or_tone: LENTEN OKTOECHOS SUPPLEMENT: TRINITY HYMNS AND COMPUNCTIVE STICHERA
items.day_or_date: On Friday of Palm Week, at Matins
items.english_text: As an uncultivated vine, O Virgin, hast thou put forth the most fair cluster of grapes, pouring out for us the saving wine which makes glad all men; therefore blessing thee as the cause of good things, ever with the Angel do we cry aloud: Rejoice, thou Full of Grace!

items.office: Trinity Hymns in the Eight Tones
items.section: At the Aposticha, Stichera for the Departed
items.season_or_tone: LENTEN OKTOECHOS SUPPLEMENT: TRINITY HYMNS AND COMPUNCTIVE STICHERA
items.day_or_date: On Friday of Palm Week, at Matins
items.english_text: Arming yourselves with the whole armor of Christ, and clothing yourselves with the armor of faith, ye suffered and cast down the regiments of the enemy; for eagerly in the hope of life did ye endure of old all the threats and wounds of the tyrants; therefore also did ye receive crowns, O patient-minded martyrs of Christ!

provenance.verbatim_source: Arming yourselves with the whole armor of Christ, and clothing yourselves with the armor of faith, ye suffered and cast down the regiments of the enemy; for eagerly in the hope of life did ye endure of old all the threats and wounds of the tyrants; therefore also did ye receive crowns, O patient-minded martyrs of Christ!

items.office: Trinity Hymns in the Eight Tones

items.season_or_tone: LENTEN OKTOECHOS SUPPLEMENT: TRINITY HYMNS AND COMPUNCTIVE STICHERA
items.day_or_date: On Friday of Palm Week, at Matins
items.english_text: Thou Who wast pleased to suffer the Cross and death, didst plant it in the midst of creation, when Thou wast well pleased, O Savior, that Thy body be nailed thereto; then also the sun hid its rays; beholding these things, the thief confessed Thee to be God, crying unto Thee: "Remember me, O Lord!" and having believed, that penitent received paradise.

items.day_or_date: On Friday of Palm Week, at Matins
items.english_text: Upon the cypress, the pine, and the cedar wast Thou lifted up,[^1259] O Lamb of God, that Thou mightest save those who in faith worship Thy voluntary crucifixion: O Christ God, glory to Thee!

items.day_or_date: On Friday of Palm Week, at Matins
items.slavonic_text: Поно́сную, Ще́дре, сме́рть, распѧ́тїемъ во́лею претерпѣ́лъ є҆сѝ: є҆го́же Ро́ждшаѧ тѧ̀ Хрⷭ҇тѐ, зрѧ́щи ᲂу҆ѧзвлѧ́шесѧ, є҆ѧ́же мольба́ми за бл҃гоꙋтро́бїе ми́лости твоеѧ̀, є҆ди́не пребл҃гїй чл҃колю́бче Гдⷭ҇и, ᲂу҆ще́дри и҆ спасѝ мі́ръ, взе́млѧй мі́ра грѣ́хъ.
items.english_text: A reproachful death, O Compassionate One, didst Thou willingly endure by crucifixion; beholding which, She who bore Thee, O Christ, was wounded; by Her entreaties, in the tender mercy of Thy loving-kindness, O only Most Good Lord and Lover of mankind, have compassion and save the world, Thou Who takest away the sin of the world!

items.slavonic_text: Сїѧ́ете вѣ́рою пресвѣ́тлаѧ свѣти̑ла ст҃і́и, бл҃гоче́стїѧ вра́чеве, ст҃роте́рпцы прехва́льнїи: мꙋчи́телей бо ра́нъ не ᲂу҆боѧ́вшесѧ, і҆́дѡлское ѕлоче́стїе низложи́сте, побѣ́дꙋ и҆мꙋ́ще непобѣди́мꙋ, крⷭ҇тъ и҆́стинный.
items.english_text: Ye shine by faith as most radiant luminaries, O holy ones, physicians of piety, all-praised passion-bearers; for not having feared the wounds of the torturers, ye cast down the impious deceit of idols, having the true Cross as invincible victory.

provenance.verbatim_source: Ye shine by faith as most radiant luminaries, O holy ones, physicians of piety, all-praised passion-bearers; for not having feared the wounds of the torturers, ye cast down the impious deceit of idols, having the true Cross as invincible victory.

items.office: Trinity Hymns in the Eight Tones
items.section: At the Aposticha, Stichera for the Departed
items.season_or_tone: LENTEN OKTOECHOS SUPPLEMENT: TRINITY HYMNS AND COMPUNCTIVE STICHERA
items.day_or_date: On Friday of Palm Week, at Matins
items.slavonic_text: Ве́лїѧ крⷭ҇та̀ твоегѡ̀ Гдⷭ҇и си́ла: водрꙋзи́сѧ бо на мѣ́стѣ, и҆ дѣ́йствꙋетъ въ мі́рѣ, и҆ показа̀ ѿ ры́барей а҆пⷭ҇лы, и҆ ѿ ꙗ҆̀зы̑къ мч҃ники, да мо́лѧтсѧ ѡ҆ дꙋша́хъ на́шихъ.
items.english_text: Great is the power of Thy Cross, O Lord; for it was set up in one place, yet it works in all the world, and made Apostles out of fishermen, and martyrs out of the Gentiles, that they may pray for our souls!

provenance.verbatim_source: Great is the power of Thy Cross, O Lord; for it was set up in one place, yet it works in all the world, and made Apostles out of fishermen, and martyrs out of the Gentiles, that they may pray for our souls!

items.office: Trinity Hymns in the Eight Tones
items.section: At the Aposticha, Stichera for the Departed
items.season_or_tone: LENTEN OKTOECHOS SUPPLEMENT: TRINITY HYMNS AND COMPUNCTIVE STICHERA
items.day_or_date: On Friday of Palm Week, at Matins
items.slavonic_text: Ве́лїѧ мч҃никъ твои́хъ Хрⷭ҇тѐ си́ла: во гробѣ́хъ бо лежа́ще дꙋ́хи прогонѧ́тъ, и҆ ᲂу҆праздни́ша вра́жїю вла́сть, вѣ́рою тр⪫ческою подви́гшесѧ.
items.english_text: Great is the power of Thy martyrs, O Christ; for lying in their tombs they drive away spirits, and have brought to naught the power of the enemy, having fought the good fight through faith in the Trinity!

provenance.verbatim_source: Great is the power of Thy martyrs, O Christ; for lying in their tombs they drive away spirits, and have brought to naught the power of the enemy, having fought the good fight through faith in the Trinity!

items.office: Trinity Hymns in the Eight Tones
items.section: At the Aposticha, Stichera for the Departed
items.season_or_tone: LENTEN OKTOECHOS SUPPLEMENT: TRINITY HYMNS AND COMPUNCTIVE STICHERA
items.day_or_date: On Friday of Palm Week, at Matins
items.slavonic_text: Прⷪ҇ро́цы, и҆ а҆пⷭ҇ли Хрⷭ҇то́вы, и҆ мч҃ницы, навчи́ша ны̀ пѣ́ти Трⷪ҇цꙋ є҆диносꙋ́щнꙋю, и҆ просвѣти́ша ꙗ҆зы́ки прельще́нныѧ, и҆ прича́стники а҆́гг҃лѡмъ сотвори́ша, сы́ны человѣ́ческїѧ.
items.english_text: The Prophets and Apostles of Christ, and the martyrs, taught us to sing of the consubstantial Trinity, and enlightened the deceived nations, and made the sons of men partakers with the Angels!

provenance.verbatim_source: The Prophets and Apostles of Christ, and the martyrs, taught us to sing of the consubstantial Trinity, and enlightened the deceived nations, and made the sons of men partakers with the Angels!

items.office: Trinity Hymns in the Eight Tones
items.section: At the Aposticha, Stichera for the Departed
items.season_or_tone: LENTEN OKTOECHOS SUPPLEMENT: TRINITY HYMNS AND COMPUNCTIVE STICHERA
items.day_or_date: On Friday of Palm Week, at Matins
items.slavonic_text: Мч҃ницы твоѝ Гдⷭ҇и, вѣ́рою ᲂу҆тверди́вшесѧ, и҆ наде́ждею ᲂу҆крѣ́пльшесѧ, любо́вїю крⷭ҇та̀ твоегѡ̀ дꙋше́внѣ соедини́вшесѧ, вра́жїе мꙋчи́телство разрꙋши́ша, и҆ ᲂу҆лꙋчи́ша вѣнцы̀, со безпло́тными мо́лѧтсѧ ѡ҆ дꙋша́хъ на́шихъ.
items.english_text: Thy martyrs, O Lord, established by faith and strengthened by hope, spiritually united in soul by the love of Thy Cross, destroyed the tyranny of the enemy, and having obtained crowns, pray with the bodiless powers for our souls!

provenance.verbatim_source: Thy martyrs, O Lord, established by faith and strengthened by hope, spiritually united in soul by the love of Thy Cross, destroyed the tyranny of the enemy, and having obtained crowns, pray with the bodiless powers for our souls!

items.office: Trinity Hymns in the Eight Tones
items.section: At the Aposticha, Stichera for the Departed
items.season_or_tone: LENTEN OKTOECHOS SUPPLEMENT: TRINITY HYMNS AND COMPUNCTIVE STICHERA
items.day_or_date: On Friday of Palm Week, at Matins
items.slavonic_text: Благоду́шное терпѣ́нїе ва́шегѡ, побѣдѝ кѡ́зни ѕлонача́лнагѡ врага̀, страстоте́рпцы всехва́льнїи: сегѡ̀ ра́ди вѣ́чнагѡ сподо́бистесѧ блаже́нства, но моли́тесѧ Гдⷭ҇ви, Хрⷭ҇толюби́выхъ люде́й спастѝ ста́до, свидѣ́телїе сꙋ́ще и҆́стины.
items.english_text: The courageous endurance of your patience conquered the wiles of the evil-originating enemy, O all-praised passion-bearers; therefore were ye accounted worthy of eternal blessedness; but pray ye unto the Lord to save the flock of the Christ-loving people, being witnesses of the truth!

provenance.verbatim_source: The courageous endurance of your patience conquered the wiles of the evil-originating enemy, O all-praised passion-bearers; therefore were ye accounted worthy of eternal blessedness; but pray ye unto the Lord to save the flock of the Christ-loving people, being witnesses of the truth!

items.office: Trinity Hymns in the Eight Tones
items.section: At the Aposticha, Stichera for the Departed
items.season_or_tone: LENTEN OKTOECHOS SUPPLEMENT: TRINITY HYMNS AND COMPUNCTIVE STICHERA
items.day_or_date: On Friday of Palm Week, at Matins
items.slavonic_text: Стї́хъ: Ди́венъ Бг҃ъ во ст҃ы́хъ свои́хъ, Бг҃ъ І҆и҃левъ.
items.english_text: *Verse: Marvelous is God in His saints, the God of Israel.*[^1260]

provenance.verbatim_source: *Verse: Marvelous is God in His saints, the God of Israel.*[^1260]

items.office: Trinity Hymns in the Eight Tones
items.section: At the Aposticha, Stichera for the Departed
items.season_or_tone: LENTEN OKTOECHOS SUPPLEMENT: TRINITY HYMNS AND COMPUNCTIVE STICHERA
items.day_or_date: On Friday of Palm Week, at Matins
items.slavonic_text: Сїѧ́ете вѣ́рою пресвѣ́тлаѧ свѣти̑ла ст҃і́и, недꙋ́гꙋющихъ вра́чеве, страстоте́рпцы прехва́льнїи: мꙋчи́телей бо ра́нъ не ᲂу҆боѧ́вшесѧ, і҆́дѡлское ѕлоче́стїе низложи́сте, побѣ́дꙋ и҆мꙋ́ще непобѣди́мꙋ, крⷭ҇тъ и҆́стинный.
items.english_text: Ye shine by faith as most radiant luminaries, O holy ones, physicians of the ailing, all-praised passion-bearers; for not having feared the wounds of the torturers, ye cast down the impious deceit of idols, having the true Cross as invincible victory.

provenance.verbatim_source: Ye shine by faith as most radiant luminaries, O holy ones, physicians of the ailing, all-praised passion-bearers; for not having feared the wounds of the torturers, ye cast down the impious deceit of idols, having the true Cross as invincible victory.

items.office: Trinity Hymns in the Eight Tones
items.section: At the Aposticha, Stichera for the Departed
items.season_or_tone: LENTEN OKTOECHOS SUPPLEMENT: TRINITY HYMNS AND COMPUNCTIVE STICHERA
items.day_or_date: On Friday of Palm Week, at Matins
items.slavonic_text: Стї́хъ: Ст҃ы̑мъ, и҆̀же сꙋ́ть на землѝ є҆гѡ̀, ᲂу҆дивѝ Гдⷭ҇ь всѧ̑ хотѣ́нїѧ своѧ̑ въ ни́хъ.
items.english_text: *Verse: Unto the saints that are in His earth, the Lord hath made marvelous all His desires in them.*[^1261]

provenance.verbatim_source: *Verse: Unto the saints that are in His earth, the Lord hath made marvelous all His desires in them.*[^1261]

items.office: Trinity Hymns in the Eight Tones
items.section: At the Aposticha, Stichera for the Departed
items.season_or_tone: LENTEN OKTOECHOS SUPPLEMENT: TRINITY HYMNS AND COMPUNCTIVE STICHERA
items.day_or_date: On Friday of Palm Week, at Matins
items.slavonic_text: Воѡрꙋжи́вшесѧ всеѡрꙋ́жествомъ Хрⷭ҇то́вымъ, и҆ ѡ҆бо́лкшесѧ во ѻ҆рꙋ́жїе вѣ́ры, полкѝ вра́жїѧ страда́льчески низложи́сте, ᲂу҆се́рднѡ ко ᲂу҆пова́нїемъ жи́зни, претерпѣ́сте всѧ̑ мꙋчи́телей преще́нїѧ же и҆ ра́ны, тѣ́мже и҆ вѣнцы̀ прїѧ́сте, мч҃ницы Хрⷭ҇то́вы терпѣливодꙋ́шнїи.
items.english_text: Armed with the whole armor of Christ, and having put on the armor of faith, suffering valiantly ye cast down the regiments of the enemy; zealously in the hope of life ye endured all the threats and wounds of the torturers; therefore also ye received crowns, O long-suffering martyrs of Christ!

provenance.verbatim_source: Armed with the whole armor of Christ, and having put on the armor of faith, suffering valiantly ye cast down the regiments of the enemy; zealously in the hope of life ye endured all the threats and wounds of the torturers; therefore also ye received crowns, O long-suffering martyrs of Christ!

items.office: Trinity Hymns in the Eight Tones
items.section: At the Aposticha, Stichera for the Departed
items.season_or_tone: LENTEN OKTOECHOS SUPPLEMENT: TRINITY HYMNS AND COMPUNCTIVE STICHERA
items.day_or_date: On Friday of Palm Week, at Matins
items.slavonic_text: Є҆гда̀ сло́вомъ твои́мъ предста́немъ безме́здному твоему̀ сꙋди́щꙋ Гдⷭ҇и, не посрамѝ въ тѧ̀ вѣ́ровавшихъ Сп҃се на́шъ: всѝ бо согрѣши́хомъ, но тебѐ не ѿстꙋпи́хомъ, тѣ́мже мо́лимъ
items.english_text: When by Thy word we stand before Thy judgment seat that takes no bribes, O Lord, put not to shame those who have believed in Thee, O our Savior; for we all have sinned, yet from Thee have we not departed; therefore we pray Thee:

provenance.verbatim_source: When by Thy word we stand before Thy judgment seat that takes no bribes, O Lord, put not to shame those who have believed in Thee, O our Savior; for we all have sinned, yet from Thee have we not departed; therefore we pray Thee:

items.office: Trinity Hymns in the Eight Tones
items.section: At the Aposticha, Stichera for the Departed
items.season_or_tone: LENTEN OKTOECHOS SUPPLEMENT: TRINITY HYMNS AND COMPUNCTIVE STICHERA
items.day_or_date: On Friday of Palm Week, at Matins
items.english_text: In the dwellings of Thy righteous ones, O Christ, give rest unto those whom Thou hast received; for Thou alone art without sin.

provenance.verbatim_source: In the dwellings of Thy righteous ones, O Christ, give rest unto those whom Thou hast received; for Thou alone art without sin.

items.office: Trinity Hymns in the Eight Tones
items.section: At the Aposticha, Stichera for the Departed
items.season_or_tone: LENTEN OKTOECHOS SUPPLEMENT: TRINITY HYMNS AND COMPUNCTIVE STICHERA
items.day_or_date: On Friday of Palm Week, at Matins
items.english_text: Thee who didst intercede for the salvation of our race do we hymn, O Virgin Theotokos; for having through the Cross accepted suffering in the flesh taken from thee, Thy Son and our God delivered us from corruption, as the Lover of mankind!

provenance.verbatim_source: Thee who didst intercede for the salvation of our race do we hymn, O Virgin Theotokos; for having through the Cross accepted suffering in the flesh taken from thee, Thy Son and our God delivered us from corruption, as the Lover of mankind!

items.office: Trinity Hymns in the Eight Tones
items.section: At the Praises, Stichera of the Martyrs, Tone 3
items.season_or_tone: LENTEN OKTOECHOS SUPPLEMENT: TRINITY HYMNS AND COMPUNCTIVE STICHERA
items.day_or_date: On Friday of Palm Week, at Matins
items.english_text: The soldiers of Christ cast away the fear of kings and torturers, and with good courage and manfully confessed Him, the Lord God of all and our King, and they pray for our souls!

provenance.verbatim_source: The soldiers of Christ cast away the fear of kings and torturers, and with good courage and manfully confessed Him, the Lord God of all and our King, and they pray for our souls!

items.office: Trinity Hymns in the Eight Tones
items.section: At the Praises, Stichera of the Martyrs, Tone 3
items.season_or_tone: LENTEN OKTOECHOS SUPPLEMENT: TRINITY HYMNS AND COMPUNCTIVE STICHERA
items.day_or_date: On Friday of Palm Week, at Matins
items.english_text: The hosts of the holy Angels were astonished at the suffering of the martyrs; for clothed in mortal flesh, they took no heed of tortures, having become imitators of the Sufferings of Christ the Savior, and they pray for our souls!

provenance.verbatim_source: The hosts of the holy Angels were astonished at the suffering of the martyrs; for clothed in mortal flesh, they took no heed of tortures, having become imitators of the Sufferings of Christ the Savior, and they pray for our souls!

items.office: Trinity Hymns in the Eight Tones
items.section: At the Praises, Stichera of the Martyrs, Tone 3
items.season_or_tone: LENTEN OKTOECHOS SUPPLEMENT: TRINITY HYMNS AND COMPUNCTIVE STICHERA
items.day_or_date: On Friday of Palm Week, at Matins
items.english_text: As luminaries in the world do ye shine even after death, O holy martyrs, having fought the good fight; and having boldness, entreat Christ that our souls may find mercy!

provenance.verbatim_source: As luminaries in the world do ye shine even after death, O holy martyrs, having fought the good fight; and having boldness, entreat Christ that our souls may find mercy!

items.office: Trinity Hymns in the Eight Tones
items.section: At the Praises, Stichera of the Martyrs, Tone 3
items.season_or_tone: LENTEN OKTOECHOS SUPPLEMENT: TRINITY HYMNS AND COMPUNCTIVE STICHERA
items.day_or_date: On Friday of Palm Week, at Matins
items.english_text: O men, why do we trouble ourselves in vain? Short is the path we run: our life is smoke, vapor, dust, and ashes; for a little while it appears, and quickly it perishes;[^1262] therefore unto Christ the immortal King let us cry aloud: Give rest unto those who have departed from us, where is the dwelling of all who rejoice!

provenance.verbatim_source: O men, why do we trouble ourselves in vain? Short is the path we run: our life is smoke, vapor, dust, and ashes; for a little while it appears, and quickly it perishes;[^1262] therefore unto Christ the immortal King let us cry aloud: Give rest unto those who have departed from us, where is the dwelling of all who rejoice!

items.office: Trinity Hymns in the Eight Tones
items.section: At the Praises, Stichera of the Martyrs, Tone 3
items.season_or_tone: LENTEN OKTOECHOS SUPPLEMENT: TRINITY HYMNS AND COMPUNCTIVE STICHERA
items.day_or_date: On Friday of Palm Week, at Matins
items.english_text: Without seed didst thou conceive of the Holy Spirit, and glorifying do we hymn thee: Rejoice, O Most Holy Virgin!

provenance.verbatim_source: Without seed didst thou conceive of the Holy Spirit, and glorifying do we hymn thee: Rejoice, O Most Holy Virgin!

items.office: Trinity Hymns in the Eight Tones
items.section: At the Aposticha, Stichera for the Departed, Tone 3, Podoben: "Great is the power of Thy Cross" (Вели́ѧ крⷭ҇та̀ твоегѡ̀)
items.season_or_tone: LENTEN OKTOECHOS SUPPLEMENT: TRINITY HYMNS AND COMPUNCTIVE STICHERA
items.day_or_date: On Friday of Palm Week, at Matins
items.english_text: I glorify Thy precious Cross, through which life was granted, and the enjoyment of delight unto those who in faith and love hymn Thee, O only Plenteous in mercy; therefore we cry unto Thee, O Christ God: Give rest unto those who have departed from us, where the dwelling of all who rejoice is with Thee!

provenance.verbatim_source: I glorify Thy precious Cross, through which life was granted, and the enjoyment of delight unto those who in faith and love hymn Thee, O only Plenteous in mercy; therefore we cry unto Thee, O Christ God: Give rest unto those who have departed from us, where the dwelling of all who rejoice is with Thee!

items.day_or_date: On Friday of Palm Week, at Matins
items.english_text: *Verse: Blessed are they whom Thou hast chosen and taken to Thyself, O Lord.*[^1263]

provenance.verbatim_source: *Verse: Blessed are they whom Thou hast chosen and taken to Thyself, O Lord.*[^1263]

items.office: Trinity Hymns in the Eight Tones
items.section: At the Aposticha, Stichera for the Departed, Tone 3, Podoben: "Great is the power of Thy Cross" (Вели́ѧ крⷭ҇та̀ твоегѡ̀)
items.season_or_tone: LENTEN OKTOECHOS SUPPLEMENT: TRINITY HYMNS AND COMPUNCTIVE STICHERA
items.day_or_date: On Friday of Palm Week, at Matins
items.english_text: O only Merciful and Tender-hearted One, having an incomprehensible abyss of goodness, knowing human nature which Thou didst fashion: we pray Thee, O Christ God, give rest unto those who have departed from us, where the dwelling of all who rejoice is with Thee!

items.season_or_tone: LENTEN OKTOECHOS SUPPLEMENT: TRINITY HYMNS AND COMPUNCTIVE STICHERA
items.day_or_date: On Friday of Palm Week, at Matins
items.english_text: *Verse: Their souls shall dwell among good things.*[^1264]

provenance.verbatim_source: *Verse: Their souls shall dwell among good things.*[^1264]

items.office: Trinity Hymns in the Eight Tones
items.section: At the Aposticha, Stichera for the Departed, Tone 3, Podoben: "Great is the power of Thy Cross" (Вели́ѧ крⷭ҇та̀ твоегѡ̀)
items.season_or_tone: LENTEN OKTOECHOS SUPPLEMENT: TRINITY HYMNS AND COMPUNCTIVE STICHERA
items.day_or_date: On Friday of Palm Week, at Matins
items.english_text: Thou didst fall asleep in the tomb as man, but by invincible power as God Thou didst raise up those who sleep in the tombs, who offer unceasing songs unto Thee; therefore we pray Thee, O Christ God: Give rest unto those who have departed from us, where the dwelling of all who rejoice is with Thee!

provenance.verbatim_source: Thou didst fall asleep in the tomb as man, but by invincible power as God Thou didst raise up those who sleep in the tombs, who offer unceasing songs unto Thee; therefore we pray Thee, O Christ God: Give rest unto those who have departed from us, where the dwelling of all who rejoice is with Thee!

items.office: Trinity Hymns in the Eight Tones
items.section: At the Aposticha, Stichera for the Departed, Tone 3, Podoben: "Great is the power of Thy Cross" (Вели́ѧ крⷭ҇та̀ твоегѡ̀)
items.season_or_tone: LENTEN OKTOECHOS SUPPLEMENT: TRINITY HYMNS AND COMPUNCTIVE STICHERA
items.day_or_date: On Friday of Palm Week, at Matins
items.english_text: Thee as a noetic lamp bearing the Light of the Godhead, united to the coarseness of human nature, O Theotokos, do we all know: entreat Thy Son and God to give rest unto those who have departed from us, where is the rejoicing of all who are glad!

provenance.verbatim_source: Thee as a noetic lamp bearing the Light of the Godhead, united to the coarseness of human nature, O Theotokos, do we all know: entreat Thy Son and God to give rest unto those who have departed from us, where is the rejoicing of all who are glad!

items.office: Trinity Hymns in the Eight Tones
items.section: At the Aposticha, Stichera for the Departed, Tone 3, Podoben: "Great is the power of Thy Cross" (Вели́ѧ крⷭ҇та̀ твоегѡ̀)
items.season_or_tone: LENTEN OKTOECHOS SUPPLEMENT: TRINITY HYMNS AND COMPUNCTIVE STICHERA
items.day_or_date: On Friday of Palm Week, at Matins
items.english_text: I desired with tears to wash away the handwriting of my transgressions,[^1265] O Lord, and for the rest of my life to be well-pleasing unto Thee through repentance; but the enemy deceives me and wars against my soul: O Lord, before I perish utterly, save me!

items.office: Trinity Hymns in the Eight Tones
items.section: At the Aposticha, Stichera for the Departed, Tone 3, Podoben: "Great is the power of Thy Cross" (Вели́ѧ крⷭ҇та̀ твоегѡ̀)
items.season_or_tone: LENTEN OKTOECHOS SUPPLEMENT: TRINITY HYMNS AND COMPUNCTIVE STICHERA
items.day_or_date: On Friday of Palm Week, at Matins
items.english_text: Who that is tempest-tossed and flees unto Thy haven, O Lord, is not saved? Or who that is ailing and falls down before Thy healing is not cured, O Creator of all and Physician of the sick? O Lord, before I perish utterly, save me!

provenance.verbatim_source: Who that is tempest-tossed and flees unto Thy haven, O Lord, is not saved? Or who that is ailing and falls down before Thy healing is not cured, O Creator of all and Physician of the sick? O Lord, before I perish utterly, save me!

items.section: At the Aposticha, Stichera for the Departed, Tone 3, Podoben: "Great is the power of Thy Cross" (Вели́ѧ крⷭ҇та̀ твоегѡ̀)
items.season_or_tone: LENTEN OKTOECHOS SUPPLEMENT: TRINITY HYMNS AND COMPUNCTIVE STICHERA
items.day_or_date: On Friday of Palm Week, at Matins
items.english_text: Wash me with my tears, O Savior, for I have been defiled by many sins; therefore do I fall down before Thee: I have sinned, O God, have mercy on me!

provenance.verbatim_source: Wash me with my tears, O Savior, for I have been defiled by many sins; therefore do I fall down before Thee: I have sinned, O God, have mercy on me!

items.english_text: Sailing across the deep of this present life, I ponder the abyss of my many evils, and having no helmsman of my thoughts, I utter unto Thee Peter's cry: Save me, O Christ; save me, O God, as the Lover of mankind![^1269]

items.english_text: Unto her who was brought up in the temple in the Holy of Holies, clothed in faith and wisdom, and boundless virginity, the Archistrategos Gabriel brought greeting from heaven, even: "Rejoice, rejoice, O Blessed One; rejoice, O most glorified One: the Lord is with Thee!"[^1270]

items.english_text: Today the angelic hosts have come to enlighten the minds of the faithful in memory of the passion-bearers, and to make radiant the universe with grace; being entreated by them, O God, grant us great mercy!

items.english_text: Quickly let us enter into the bridal chamber of Christ, that we all may hear the blessed voice of Christ our God: "Come, ye who love heavenly glory," having become partakers with the wise virgins, making radiant our lamps through faith![^1271]

items.day_or_date: On Friday of Palm Week, at Matins
items.english_text: Remember, O my soul, how we shall stand before the Judge in the fearful hour: the dread thrones are set, and the deeds of each are exposed; then the Judge is inexorable, and there the fire is sorely prepared for thee like a tempestuous raging sea, as though to cover all things; seeing all these things, O my soul, groan before the end!

provenance.verbatim_source: Remember, O my soul, how we shall stand before the Judge in the fearful hour: the dread thrones are set, and the deeds of each are exposed; then the Judge is inexorable, and there the fire is sorely prepared for thee like a tempestuous raging sea, as though to cover all things; seeing all these things, O my soul, groan before the end!

items.day_or_date: On Friday of Palm Week, at Matins
items.english_text: Truly and in sovereign right, O Theotokos, we pray thee: as Mother possessing boldness before Thy Son and our God, preserve especially this city which flees unto thy protection, which has thee as its strength, which has recourse unto thee as a haven, a wall, the only intercession of the human race!

provenance.verbatim_source: Truly and in sovereign right, O Theotokos, we pray thee: as Mother possessing boldness before Thy Son and our God, preserve especially this city which flees unto thy protection, which has thee as its strength, which has recourse unto thee as a haven, a wall, the only intercession of the human race!

items.day_or_date: On Friday of Palm Week, at Matins
items.english_text: Thy Church, adorned with the blood of Thy martyrs throughout the whole world as with purple and fine linen, cries through them unto Thee, O Christ God: Send down Thy compassions upon Thy people, grant peace unto Thy commonwealth, and unto our souls great mercy!

provenance.verbatim_source: Thy Church, adorned with the blood of Thy martyrs throughout the whole world as with purple and fine linen, cries through them unto Thee, O Christ God: Send down Thy compassions upon Thy people, grant peace unto Thy commonwealth, and unto our souls great mercy!

items.day_or_date: On Friday of Palm Week, at Matins
items.english_text: Thou hast redeemed us from the curse of the law by Thy precious Blood; being nailed to the Cross and pierced with a spear, Thou didst pour forth immortality for mankind, O our Savior: glory to Thee![^1272]

provenance.verbatim_source: Thou hast redeemed us from the curse of the law by Thy precious Blood; being nailed to the Cross and pierced with a spear, Thou didst pour forth immortality for mankind, O our Savior: glory to Thee![^1272]

items.english_text: *Verse: Exalt ye the Lord our God, and worship the footstool of His feet, for He is holy.*[^1273]

provenance.verbatim_source: *Verse: Exalt ye the Lord our God, and worship the footstool of His feet, for He is holy.*[^1273]

items.day_or_date: On Friday of Palm Week, at Matins
items.english_text: Speedily anticipate, before we are enslaved to the enemies who blaspheme Thee and threaten us, O Christ our God; destroy by Thy Cross those who war against us, that they may understand what the faith of the Orthodox can do, by the prayers of the Theotokos, O only Lover of mankind!

items.day_or_date: On Friday of Palm Week, at Matins
items.english_text: O all-immaculate Virgin, Mother of Christ God, a sword pierced thy most holy soul when thou didst see thy Son and God willingly crucified; cease not, O blessed one, to entreat Him to grant us forgiveness of transgressions![^1274]

provenance.verbatim_source: O all-immaculate Virgin, Mother of Christ God, a sword pierced thy most holy soul when thou didst see thy Son and God willingly crucified; cease not, O blessed one, to entreat Him to grant us forgiveness of transgressions![^1274]

items.day_or_date: On Friday of Palm Week, at Matins
items.english_text: Thy martyrs, O Lord, in their sufferings received incorruptible crowns from Thee, our God; for having Thy strength, they cast down the torturers, and shattered the powerless insolence of demons: by their prayers, save our souls!

provenance.verbatim_source: Thy martyrs, O Lord, in their sufferings received incorruptible crowns from Thee, our God; for having Thy strength, they cast down the torturers, and shattered the powerless insolence of demons: by their prayers, save our souls!

items.day_or_date: On Friday of Palm Week, at Matins
items.english_text: As luminaries unto the ends of the earth didst Thou reveal Thy disciples, O Christ, shining Thy understanding unto our souls in darkness, O Master; and having through them darkened the delusion of idols, Thou didst enlighten the world with the teachings of piety: by their entreaties, save our souls!

items.english_text: *Verse: Their sound has gone forth into all the earth, and their words unto the ends of the world.*[^1275]

items.day_or_date: On Friday of Palm Week, at Matins
items.english_text: As Moses guided Israel from bondage through the Red Sea, and by Thy right hand, O Master, drowned Pharaoh; so by miracles Thy most wise disciples parted the sea of bitter godlessness, and guided the people unto Thee, O Word without beginning and only Lover of mankind![^1276]

items.day_or_date: On Friday of Palm Week, at Matins
items.english_text: The Word of the Father, Christ our God, Who became incarnate of thee, have we known, O Virgin Theotokos, only Pure, only Blessed One; therefore unceasingly hymning thee, we magnify thee!

provenance.verbatim_source: The Word of the Father, Christ our God, Who became incarnate of thee, have we known, O Virgin Theotokos, only Pure, only Blessed One; therefore unceasingly hymning thee, we magnify thee!

items.day_or_date: On Friday of Palm Week, at Matins
items.english_text: Arming themselves with the Cross, Thy passion-bearers conquered the wiles of the evil-originating enemy, O Christ our God; they shone forth as luminaries, instructing mankind, and grant healings unto those who ask in faith: by their prayers, save our souls!

provenance.verbatim_source: Arming themselves with the Cross, Thy passion-bearers conquered the wiles of the evil-originating enemy, O Christ our God; they shone forth as luminaries, instructing mankind, and grant healings unto those who ask in faith: by their prayers, save our souls!

items.day_or_date: On Friday of Palm Week, at Matins
items.english_text: The Jews nailed Thee to the Cross, O Savior, whereby Thou didst call us from the Gentiles, O Lord and Lover of mankind; Thou didst stretch out Thy palms upon it of Thine own will, and didst deign Thy ribs to be pierced with a spear: glory to the multitude of Thy compassions, O Long-suffering One!

provenance.verbatim_source: The Jews nailed Thee to the Cross, O Savior, whereby Thou didst call us from the Gentiles, O Lord and Lover of mankind; Thou didst stretch out Thy palms upon it of Thine own will, and didst deign Thy ribs to be pierced with a spear: glory to the multitude of Thy compassions, O Long-suffering One!

items.section: At the Aposticha, Stichera for the Departed, Tone 3, Podoben: "Great is the power of Thy Cross" (Вели́ѧ крⷭ҇та̀ твоегѡ̀)

items.day_or_date: On Friday of Palm Week, at Matins
items.english_text: Beholding now the light of our souls, O Christ, even Thy most pure Cross, and bowing down before it, radiantly do we cry unto Thee: Glory to Thee, Who wast pleased to be lifted up upon it; glory to Thee, Who thereby didst enlighten all creation; therefore unceasingly we glorify Thee with hymns!

provenance.verbatim_source: Beholding now the light of our souls, O Christ, even Thy most pure Cross, and bowing down before it, radiantly do we cry unto Thee: Glory to Thee, Who wast pleased to be lifted up upon it; glory to Thee, Who thereby didst enlighten all creation; therefore unceasingly we glorify Thee with hymns!

items.day_or_date: On Friday of Palm Week, at Matins
items.english_text: When Thy most pure Mother saw Thee lifted up upon the Cross, O Word of God, weeping maternally She said: What is this new and strange wonder, O my Son? How dost Thou, the Life of all, taste of death, desiring to quicken the dead, as Thou art Compassionate?

items.day_or_date: On Friday of Palm Week, at Matins
items.english_text: The honorable triumph of the passion-bearers has shown the Church to be heaven, and Angels dance together with men: by their prayers, O Christ God, save our souls!

provenance.verbatim_source: The honorable triumph of the passion-bearers has shown the Church to be heaven, and Angels dance together with men: by their prayers, O Christ God, save our souls!
