items.day_or_date: On Friday of Palm Week, at Matins
items.english_text: Thou Who art glorified in the memorials of Thy saints, O Christ God, and art entreated by them, send down upon us great mercy!

provenance.verbatim_source: Thou Who art glorified in the memorials of Thy saints, O Christ God, and art entreated by them, send down upon us great mercy!

items.day_or_date: On Friday of Palm Week, at Matins
items.english_text: Thou Who didst accept the endurance of the holy martyrs, accept also from us our hymnody, O Lover of mankind, and grant us through their prayers great mercy!

provenance.verbatim_source: Thou Who didst accept the endurance of the holy martyrs, accept also from us our hymnody, O Lover of mankind, and grant us through their prayers great mercy!

items.day_or_date: On Friday of Palm Week, at Matins
items.english_text: Having boldness before the Savior, O holy ones, pray unceasingly for us sinners, asking remission of transgressions and great mercy for our souls!

provenance.verbatim_source: Having boldness before the Savior, O holy ones, pray unceasingly for us sinners, asking remission of transgressions and great mercy for our souls!

items.english_text: Living sacrifices, rational whole-burnt offerings, martyrs of the Lord, perfect victims unto God, sheep that know God and are known of God, whose sheepfold is inaccessible to wolves: pray ye also for us, that we may be shepherded with you beside the waters of rest![^1277]

items.english_text: Where is attachment to the world? Where is transient fantasy? Where are gold and silver? Where is the multitude of servants, and clamor? All is dust, all is ashes, all is shadow! But come, let us cry aloud unto the immortal King: O Lord, account those who have departed from us worthy of Thine eternal good things, and give them rest in unfading blessedness!

items.season_or_tone: LENTEN OKTOECHOS SUPPLEMENT: TRINITY HYMNS AND COMPUNCTIVE STICHERA
items.day_or_date: On Friday of Palm Week, at Matins
items.english_text: Thy Church, adorned with the blood of Thy martyrs throughout the whole world as with purple and fine linen, cries through them unto Thee, O Christ God: Send down Thy compassions upon Thy people, grant peace unto Thy commonwealth, and unto our souls great mercy!

provenance.verbatim_source: Thy Church, adorned with the blood of Thy martyrs throughout the whole world as with purple and fine linen, cries through them unto Thee, O Christ God: Send down Thy compassions upon Thy people, grant peace unto Thy commonwealth, and unto our souls great mercy!

items.office: Trinity Hymns in the Eight Tones
items.section: At the Aposticha, Stichera for the Departed, Tone 3, Podoben: "Great is the power of Thy Cross" (Вели́ѧ крⷭ҇та̀ твоегѡ̀)
items.season_or_tone: LENTEN OKTOECHOS SUPPLEMENT: TRINITY HYMNS AND COMPUNCTIVE STICHERA
items.day_or_date: On Friday of Palm Week, at Matins
items.english_text: Arming themselves with the Cross, Thy passion-bearers, O Christ our God, conquered the wiles of the evil-originating enemy; they shone forth as luminaries, instructing mankind, and grant healings unto those who ask in faith: by their entreaties, save our souls!

provenance.verbatim_source: Arming themselves with the Cross, Thy passion-bearers, O Christ our God, conquered the wiles of the evil-originating enemy; they shone forth as luminaries, instructing mankind, and grant healings unto those who ask in faith: by their entreaties, save our souls!

items.office: Trinity Hymns in the Eight Tones
items.section: At the Aposticha, Stichera for the Departed, Tone 3, Podoben: "Great is the power of Thy Cross" (Вели́ѧ крⷭ҇та̀ твоегѡ̀)
items.season_or_tone: LENTEN OKTOECHOS SUPPLEMENT: TRINITY HYMNS AND COMPUNCTIVE STICHERA
items.day_or_date: On Friday of Palm Week, at Matins
items.english_text: The souls whom Thou hast translated from temporal things, O Savior, give rest unto them, as Thou art compassionate, almighty, and the only Lover of mankind; as Thou art bountiful, forgive what they have committed; have mercy, O Merciful One, upon the works of Thy hands, by the prayers of the Theotokos, O only Lover of mankind!

provenance.verbatim_source: The souls whom Thou hast translated from temporal things, O Savior, give rest unto them, as Thou art compassionate, almighty, and the only Lover of mankind; as Thou art bountiful, forgive what they have committed; have mercy, O Merciful One, upon the works of Thy hands, by the prayers of the Theotokos, O only Lover of mankind!

items.office: Trinity Hymns in the Eight Tones
items.section: At the Aposticha, Stichera for the Departed, Tone 3, Podoben: "Great is the power of Thy Cross" (Вели́ѧ крⷭ҇та̀ твоегѡ̀)
items.season_or_tone: LENTEN OKTOECHOS SUPPLEMENT: TRINITY HYMNS AND COMPUNCTIVE STICHERA
items.day_or_date: On Friday of Palm Week, at Matins
items.english_text: The mystery hidden from the ages and unknown to Angels, through thee, O Theotokos, has been revealed unto those on earth: God incarnate in unconfused union, willingly accepting the Cross for our sake, whereby having resurrected the first-created, He saved our souls from death![^1278]

provenance.verbatim_source: The mystery hidden from the ages and unknown to Angels, through thee, O Theotokos, has been revealed unto those on earth: God incarnate in unconfused union, willingly accepting the Cross for our sake, whereby having resurrected the first-created, He saved our souls from death![^1278]

items.office: Trinity Hymns in the Eight Tones
items.section: At the Praises, Stichera of the Martyrs, Tone 4
items.season_or_tone: LENTEN OKTOECHOS SUPPLEMENT: TRINITY HYMNS AND COMPUNCTIVE STICHERA
items.day_or_date: On Friday of Palm Week, at Matins
items.english_text: Partakers with the Angels became ye, O holy martyrs, having manfully proclaimed Christ before the judgment seat; for all the fair things in the world ye abandoned as if they were not, and held fast unto faith as a firm anchor of hope; therefore, having driven away deceit, ye pour forth the gifts of healings unto the faithful, unceasingly praying that our souls may be saved!

provenance.verbatim_source: Partakers with the Angels became ye, O holy martyrs, having manfully proclaimed Christ before the judgment seat; for all the fair things in the world ye abandoned as if they were not, and held fast unto faith as a firm anchor of hope; therefore, having driven away deceit, ye pour forth the gifts of healings unto the faithful, unceasingly praying that our souls may be saved!

items.office: Trinity Hymns in the Eight Tones
items.section: At the Praises, Stichera of the Martyrs, Tone 4
items.season_or_tone: LENTEN OKTOECHOS SUPPLEMENT: TRINITY HYMNS AND COMPUNCTIVE STICHERA
items.day_or_date: On Friday of Palm Week, at Matins
items.english_text: How should we not marvel at your struggles, O holy martyrs? For clothed in mortal bodies, ye conquered the bodiless enemies; the threats of the torturers did not frighten you, nor did the assaults of torments terrify you: truly worthily were ye glorified by Christ!

provenance.verbatim_source: How should we not marvel at your struggles, O holy martyrs? For clothed in mortal bodies, ye conquered the bodiless enemies; the threats of the torturers did not frighten you, nor did the assaults of torments terrify you: truly worthily were ye glorified by Christ!

items.office: Trinity Hymns in the Eight Tones
items.section: At the Praises, Stichera of the Martyrs, Tone 4
items.season_or_tone: LENTEN OKTOECHOS SUPPLEMENT: TRINITY HYMNS AND COMPUNCTIVE STICHERA
items.day_or_date: On Friday of Palm Week, at Matins
items.english_text: Precious is the death of Thy saints, O Lord; for by sword and fire and with a contrite soul did they shed their blood, having hope in Thee to receive the reward of their labors; for they endured, and received from Thee, O Savior, great mercy![^1279]

provenance.verbatim_source: Precious is the death of Thy saints, O Lord; for by sword and fire and with a contrite soul did they shed their blood, having hope in Thee to receive the reward of their labors; for they endured, and received from Thee, O Savior, great mercy![^1279]

items.office: Trinity Hymns in the Eight Tones
items.section: At the Praises, Stichera of the Martyrs, Tone 4
items.season_or_tone: LENTEN OKTOECHOS SUPPLEMENT: TRINITY HYMNS AND COMPUNCTIVE STICHERA
items.day_or_date: On Friday of Palm Week, at Matins
items.english_text: Who is not struck with awe, O holy martyrs, beholding the good fight which ye fought: how being in the flesh ye conquered the bodiless foe, confessing Christ and arming yourselves with the Cross? Therefore worthily were ye shown forth as expellers of demons and conquerors of barbarians, unceasingly praying that our souls may be saved!

provenance.verbatim_source: Who is not struck with awe, O holy martyrs, beholding the good fight which ye fought: how being in the flesh ye conquered the bodiless foe, confessing Christ and arming yourselves with the Cross? Therefore worthily were ye shown forth as expellers of demons and conquerors of barbarians, unceasingly praying that our souls may be saved!

items.office: Trinity Hymns in the Eight Tones
items.section: At the Praises, Stichera of the Martyrs, Tone 4
items.season_or_tone: LENTEN OKTOECHOS SUPPLEMENT: TRINITY HYMNS AND COMPUNCTIVE STICHERA
items.day_or_date: On Friday of Palm Week, at Matins
items.english_text: In Thy place of rest, O Lord, where all Thy saints repose, give rest unto Thy departed servants, as Thou alone art the Lover of mankind!

provenance.verbatim_source: In Thy place of rest, O Lord, where all Thy saints repose, give rest unto Thy departed servants, as Thou alone art the Lover of mankind!

items.office: Trinity Hymns in the Eight Tones
items.section: At the Praises, Stichera of the Martyrs, Tone 4
items.season_or_tone: LENTEN OKTOECHOS SUPPLEMENT: TRINITY HYMNS AND COMPUNCTIVE STICHERA
items.day_or_date: On Friday of Palm Week, at Matins
items.english_text: O only pure and most immaculate Virgin, who without seed didst bear God, entreat that our souls may be saved!

provenance.verbatim_source: O only pure and most immaculate Virgin, who without seed didst bear God, entreat that our souls may be saved!

items.office: Trinity Hymns in the Eight Tones
items.section: At the Aposticha, Stichera for the Departed, Tone 4, Podoben: "Thou hast given a sign" (Да́лъ є҆сѝ зна́менїе)
items.season_or_tone: LENTEN OKTOECHOS SUPPLEMENT: TRINITY HYMNS AND COMPUNCTIVE STICHERA
items.day_or_date: On Friday of Palm Week, at Matins
items.english_text: Truly fearful is the mystery of death, how the soul is forcibly separated from the body, torn asunder by divine will from the harmony and jointure of the natural bond; therefore we pray Thee: give rest unto the departed in the tabernacles of Thy righteous ones, O Life-giver and Lover of mankind!

provenance.verbatim_source: Truly fearful is the mystery of death, how the soul is forcibly separated from the body, torn asunder by divine will from the harmony and jointure of the natural bond; therefore we pray Thee: give rest unto the departed in the tabernacles of Thy righteous ones, O Life-giver and Lover of mankind!

items.office: Trinity Hymns in the Eight Tones
items.section: At the Aposticha, Stichera for the Departed, Tone 4, Podoben: "Thou hast given a sign" (Да́лъ є҆сѝ зна́менїе)
items.season_or_tone: LENTEN OKTOECHOS SUPPLEMENT: TRINITY HYMNS AND COMPUNCTIVE STICHERA
items.day_or_date: On Friday of Palm Week, at Matins
items.english_text: Death appears as sleep unto those who believe in Thee, when Thou, Who rulest over all, wast laid in the tomb and didst destroy the dominion of death, bringing to naught its ancient tyranny; therefore we pray Thee: establish the departed in the joy of Thy saints, and in the brightness of the righteous!

provenance.verbatim_source: Death appears as sleep unto those who believe in Thee, when Thou, Who rulest over all, wast laid in the tomb and didst destroy the dominion of death, bringing to naught its ancient tyranny; therefore we pray Thee: establish the departed in the joy of Thy saints, and in the brightness of the righteous!

items.office: Trinity Hymns in the Eight Tones
items.section: At the Aposticha, Stichera for the Departed, Tone 4, Podoben: "Thou hast given a sign" (Да́лъ є҆сѝ зна́менїе)
items.season_or_tone: LENTEN OKTOECHOS SUPPLEMENT: TRINITY HYMNS AND COMPUNCTIVE STICHERA
items.day_or_date: On Friday of Palm Week, at Matins
items.english_text: Thou hast become for us righteousness and sanctification, and redemption for our souls; for having taken upon Thyself the penalty due unto us, Thou didst lead us justified and redeemed unto the Father; and now we pray Thee: give rest unto the departed in the joy and brightness of Thy saints, O Benefactor and Lover of mankind![^1280]

provenance.verbatim_source: Thou hast become for us righteousness and sanctification, and redemption for our souls; for having taken upon Thyself the penalty due unto us, Thou didst lead us justified and redeemed unto the Father; and now we pray Thee: give rest unto the departed in the joy and brightness of Thy saints, O Benefactor and Lover of mankind![^1280]

items.office: Trinity Hymns in the Eight Tones
items.section: At the Aposticha, Stichera for the Departed, Tone 4, Podoben: "Thou hast given a sign" (Да́лъ є҆сѝ зна́менїе)
items.season_or_tone: LENTEN OKTOECHOS SUPPLEMENT: TRINITY HYMNS AND COMPUNCTIVE STICHERA
items.day_or_date: On Friday of Palm Week, at Matins
items.english_text: Following the sayings of the God-proclaiming Prophets, we confess thee to be the Theotokos, O All-immaculate One; for thou didst bear God ineffably incarnate, Who delivered us who were captive from our sins: Him do thou now entreat, O Most Pure One, to enlighten Thy departed servants with His illumination!

provenance.verbatim_source: Following the sayings of the God-proclaiming Prophets, we confess thee to be the Theotokos, O All-immaculate One; for thou didst bear God ineffably incarnate, Who delivered us who were captive from our sins: Him do thou now entreat, O Most Pure One, to enlighten Thy departed servants with His illumination!

items.office: Trinity Hymns in the Eight Tones
items.section: At the Aposticha, Stichera for the Departed, Tone 4, Podoben: "Thou hast given a sign" (Да́лъ є҆сѝ зна́менїе)
items.season_or_tone: LENTEN OKTOECHOS SUPPLEMENT: TRINITY HYMNS AND COMPUNCTIVE STICHERA
items.day_or_date: On Friday of Palm Week, at Matins
items.english_text: O Lord, sinning I cease not; accounted worthy of Thy love for mankind, I understand not: overcome my perplexity, O only Good One, and have mercy on me!

provenance.verbatim_source: O Lord, sinning I cease not; accounted worthy of Thy love for mankind, I understand not: overcome my perplexity, O only Good One, and have mercy on me!

items.office: Trinity Hymns in the Eight Tones
items.section: At the Aposticha, Stichera for the Departed, Tone 4, Podoben: "Thou hast given a sign" (Да́лъ є҆сѝ зна́менїе)
items.season_or_tone: LENTEN OKTOECHOS SUPPLEMENT: TRINITY HYMNS AND COMPUNCTIVE STICHERA
items.day_or_date: On Friday of Palm Week, at Matins
items.english_text: O Lord, I both fear Thy terror and cease not doing evil! Who before the tribunal does not fear the judge? Or who, wishing to be healed, provokes the physician, as I do? O Long-suffering Lord, have compassion on my weakness, and have mercy on me!

provenance.verbatim_source: O Lord, I both fear Thy terror and cease not doing evil! Who before the tribunal does not fear the judge? Or who, wishing to be healed, provokes the physician, as I do? O Long-suffering Lord, have compassion on my weakness, and have mercy on me!

items.office: Trinity Hymns in the Eight Tones
items.section: At the Aposticha, Stichera for the Departed, Tone 4, Podoben: "Thou hast given a sign" (Да́лъ є҆сѝ зна́менїе)
items.season_or_tone: LENTEN OKTOECHOS SUPPLEMENT: TRINITY HYMNS AND COMPUNCTIVE STICHERA
items.day_or_date: On Friday of Palm Week, at Matins
items.english_text: Overlook the multitude of my transgressions, O Lord born of the Virgin, and cleanse all my sins, granting me the thought of turning back, as Thou alone art the Lover of mankind, I pray Thee, and have mercy on me!

provenance.verbatim_source: Overlook the multitude of my transgressions, O Lord born of the Virgin, and cleanse all my sins, granting me the thought of turning back, as Thou alone art the Lover of mankind, I pray Thee, and have mercy on me!

items.office: Trinity Hymns in the Eight Tones
items.section: At the Aposticha, Stichera for the Departed, Tone 4, Podoben: "Thou hast given a sign" (Да́лъ є҆сѝ зна́менїе)
items.season_or_tone: LENTEN OKTOECHOS SUPPLEMENT: TRINITY HYMNS AND COMPUNCTIVE STICHERA
items.day_or_date: On Friday of Palm Week, at Matins
items.english_text: Woe is me! Unto whom have I become like? Unto the barren fig tree,[^1281] and I fear the curse together with the cut of the axe; but O heavenly Husbandman, Christ God, make my frozen soul fruitful, and as the prodigal son, receive me and have mercy on me![^1282]

provenance.verbatim_source: Woe is me! Unto whom have I become like? Unto the barren fig tree,[^1281] and I fear the curse together with the cut of the axe; but O heavenly Husbandman, Christ God, make my frozen soul fruitful, and as the prodigal son, receive me and have mercy on me![^1282]

items.office: Trinity Hymns in the Eight Tones
items.section: At the Aposticha, Stichera for the Departed, Tone 4, Podoben: "Thou hast given a sign" (Да́лъ є҆сѝ зна́менїе)
items.season_or_tone: LENTEN OKTOECHOS SUPPLEMENT: TRINITY HYMNS AND COMPUNCTIVE STICHERA
items.day_or_date: On Friday of Palm Week, at Matins
items.english_text: While the Judge sits, and the Angels stand by, the trumpet sounds, and the flame burns, what wilt thou do, O my soul, being led unto judgment? For then shall thy grievous deeds stand forth, and thy secret transgressions be exposed; therefore before the end cry aloud unto Christ God: O Knower of hearts, I have sinned, have mercy on me!

provenance.verbatim_source: While the Judge sits, and the Angels stand by, the trumpet sounds, and the flame burns, what wilt thou do, O my soul, being led unto judgment? For then shall thy grievous deeds stand forth, and thy secret transgressions be exposed; therefore before the end cry aloud unto Christ God: O Knower of hearts, I have sinned, have mercy on me!

items.office: Trinity Hymns in the Eight Tones
items.section: At the Aposticha, Stichera for the Departed, Tone 4, Podoben: "Thou hast given a sign" (Да́лъ є҆сѝ зна́менїе)
items.season_or_tone: LENTEN OKTOECHOS SUPPLEMENT: TRINITY HYMNS AND COMPUNCTIVE STICHERA
items.day_or_date: On Friday of Palm Week, at Matins
items.english_text: O soul, things here are temporary, but there they are eternal: I behold the tribunal, and the Judge upon the throne, and I tremble at the verdict; therefore, O my soul, turn back: the judgment is without forgiveness!

provenance.verbatim_source: O soul, things here are temporary, but there they are eternal: I behold the tribunal, and the Judge upon the throne, and I tremble at the verdict; therefore, O my soul, turn back: the judgment is without forgiveness!

items.office: Trinity Hymns in the Eight Tones
items.section: At the Aposticha, Stichera for the Departed, Tone 4, Podoben: "Thou hast given a sign" (Да́лъ є҆сѝ зна́менїе)
items.season_or_tone: LENTEN OKTOECHOS SUPPLEMENT: TRINITY HYMNS AND COMPUNCTIVE STICHERA
items.day_or_date: On Friday of Palm Week, at Matins
items.english_text: With the Angels in heaven and with men on earth, with the voice of rejoicing, O Theotokos, do we cry unto thee: Rejoice, gate wider than the heavens; rejoice, sole salvation of the earth-born; rejoice, O Pure One; rejoice, thou Full of Grace, who didst bear God incarnate!

provenance.verbatim_source: With the Angels in heaven and with men on earth, with the voice of rejoicing, O Theotokos, do we cry unto thee: Rejoice, gate wider than the heavens; rejoice, sole salvation of the earth-born; rejoice, O Pure One; rejoice, thou Full of Grace, who didst bear God incarnate!

items.office: Trinity Hymns in the Eight Tones
items.section: At the Aposticha, Stichera for the Departed, Tone 4, Podoben: "Thou hast given a sign" (Да́лъ є҆сѝ зна́менїе)
items.season_or_tone: LENTEN OKTOECHOS SUPPLEMENT: TRINITY HYMNS AND COMPUNCTIVE STICHERA
items.day_or_date: On Friday of Palm Week, at Matins
items.english_text: Zealously emulating the cup of Thy Passion, O Lord, Thy passion-bearers left behind the beauty of this life and became partakers with the Angels: by their entreaties, grant unto our souls cleansing and great mercy![^1283]

provenance.verbatim_source: Zealously emulating the cup of Thy Passion, O Lord, Thy passion-bearers left behind the beauty of this life and became partakers with the Angels: by their entreaties, grant unto our souls cleansing and great mercy![^1283]

items.office: Trinity Hymns in the Eight Tones
items.section: At the Aposticha, Stichera for the Departed, Tone 4, Podoben: "Thou hast given a sign" (Да́лъ є҆сѝ зна́менїе)
items.season_or_tone: LENTEN OKTOECHOS SUPPLEMENT: TRINITY HYMNS AND COMPUNCTIVE STICHERA
items.day_or_date: On Friday of Palm Week, at Matins
items.english_text: Lying upon the bed of my many sins, I am robbed of the hope of my salvation; for the sleep of my slothfulness procures torment for my soul; therefore spare me, O Christ God, as Thou alone art the Lover of mankind!

provenance.verbatim_source: Lying upon the bed of my many sins, I am robbed of the hope of my salvation; for the sleep of my slothfulness procures torment for my soul; therefore spare me, O Christ God, as Thou alone art the Lover of mankind!

items.office: Trinity Hymns in the Eight Tones
items.section: At the Aposticha, Stichera for the Departed, Tone 4, Podoben: "Thou hast given a sign" (Да́лъ є҆сѝ зна́менїе)
items.season_or_tone: LENTEN OKTOECHOS SUPPLEMENT: TRINITY HYMNS AND COMPUNCTIVE STICHERA
items.day_or_date: On Friday of Palm Week, at Matins
items.english_text: Let us all watch and meet Christ with abundance of oil and with bright lamps, that we may be accounted worthy to enter inside the bridal chamber; for he who is caught outside the doors will cry in vain unto God: "Have mercy on me!"[^1284]

provenance.verbatim_source: Let us all watch and meet Christ with abundance of oil and with bright lamps, that we may be accounted worthy to enter inside the bridal chamber; for he who is caught outside the doors will cry in vain unto God: "Have mercy on me!"[^1284]

items.office: Trinity Hymns in the Eight Tones
items.section: At the Aposticha, Stichera for the Departed, Tone 4, Podoben: "Thou hast given a sign" (Да́лъ є҆сѝ зна́менїе)
items.season_or_tone: LENTEN OKTOECHOS SUPPLEMENT: TRINITY HYMNS AND COMPUNCTIVE STICHERA
items.day_or_date: On Friday of Palm Week, at Matins
items.english_text: The strange mystery of the Virgin was shown forth unto the world as saving; for of her wast Thou born without seed, and in flesh wast Thou revealed without corruption, O Joy of all: Lord, glory to Thee!

provenance.verbatim_source: The strange mystery of the Virgin was shown forth unto the world as saving; for of her wast Thou born without seed, and in flesh wast Thou revealed without corruption, O Joy of all: Lord, glory to Thee!

items.office: Trinity Hymns in the Eight Tones
items.section: At the Aposticha, Stichera for the Departed, Tone 4, Podoben: "Thou hast given a sign" (Да́лъ є҆сѝ зна́менїе)
items.season_or_tone: LENTEN OKTOECHOS SUPPLEMENT: TRINITY HYMNS AND COMPUNCTIVE STICHERA
items.day_or_date: On Friday of Palm Week, at Matins
items.english_text: Thou Who hast granted us the wonders of Thy holy martyrs as an impregnable wall, O Christ God: by their prayers destroy the counsels of the heathen, and strengthen the scepters of the realm, as Thou alone art Good and the Lover of mankind!

provenance.verbatim_source: Thou Who hast granted us the wonders of Thy holy martyrs as an impregnable wall, O Christ God: by their prayers destroy the counsels of the heathen, and strengthen the scepters of the realm, as Thou alone art Good and the Lover of mankind!

items.office: Trinity Hymns in the Eight Tones
items.section: At the Aposticha, Stichera for the Departed, Tone 4, Podoben: "Thou hast given a sign" (Да́лъ є҆сѝ зна́менїе)
items.season_or_tone: LENTEN OKTOECHOS SUPPLEMENT: TRINITY HYMNS AND COMPUNCTIVE STICHERA
items.day_or_date: On Friday of Palm Week, at Matins
items.english_text: Let us the faithful sing of and glorify our Savior and Redeemer, Who was willingly crucified as He knew best and as He was well pleased; for He nailed the sins of mankind to the Cross, delivering the human race from deception, and made them worthy of the Kingdom!

provenance.verbatim_source: Let us the faithful sing of and glorify our Savior and Redeemer, Who was willingly crucified as He knew best and as He was well pleased; for He nailed the sins of mankind to the Cross, delivering the human race from deception, and made them worthy of the Kingdom!

items.office: Trinity Hymns in the Eight Tones
items.section: At the Aposticha, Stichera for the Departed, Tone 4, Podoben: "Thou hast given a sign" (Да́лъ є҆сѝ зна́менїе)
items.season_or_tone: LENTEN OKTOECHOS SUPPLEMENT: TRINITY HYMNS AND COMPUNCTIVE STICHERA
items.day_or_date: On Friday of Palm Week, at Matins
items.english_text: Having endured the Cross of Thine own will, Thou didst deliver mankind from corruption, O Savior; we the faithful hymn and worship Thee, for Thou hast enlightened us by the power of the Cross, and all of us glorify Thee, O bountiful Lover of mankind, as the Life-giver and Lord!

provenance.verbatim_source: Having endured the Cross of Thine own will, Thou didst deliver mankind from corruption, O Savior; we the faithful hymn and worship Thee, for Thou hast enlightened us by the power of the Cross, and all of us glorify Thee, O bountiful Lover of mankind, as the Life-giver and Lord!

items.office: Trinity Hymns in the Eight Tones
items.section: At the Aposticha, Stichera for the Departed, Tone 4, Podoben: "Thou hast given a sign" (Да́лъ є҆сѝ зна́менїе)
items.season_or_tone: LENTEN OKTOECHOS SUPPLEMENT: TRINITY HYMNS AND COMPUNCTIVE STICHERA
items.day_or_date: On Friday of Palm Week, at Matins
items.english_text: Standing by the Cross of the Lord, weeping the Theotokos cried aloud: Woe is me, O my Child! Woe is me, Light of mine eyes! How art Thou stretched upon the Cross, Who divinely didst stretch out the heaven as a skin,[^1285] and didst bring up the fountains of waters from the sea by Thy command?[^1286]

provenance.verbatim_source: Standing by the Cross of the Lord, weeping the Theotokos cried aloud: Woe is me, O my Child! Woe is me, Light of mine eyes! How art Thou stretched upon the Cross, Who divinely didst stretch out the heaven as a skin,[^1285] and didst bring up the fountains of waters from the sea by Thy command?[^1286]

items.office: Trinity Hymns in the Eight Tones
items.section: At the Aposticha, Stichera for the Departed, Tone 4, Podoben: "Thou hast given a sign" (Да́лъ є҆сѝ зна́менїе)
items.season_or_tone: LENTEN OKTOECHOS SUPPLEMENT: TRINITY HYMNS AND COMPUNCTIVE STICHERA
items.day_or_date: On Friday of Palm Week, at Matins
items.english_text: Thy passion-bearers, O Lord, hast Thou shown forth unto the universe as great intercessors, O Savior, by whom passions flee away: by their prayers, save our souls!

provenance.verbatim_source: Thy passion-bearers, O Lord, hast Thou shown forth unto the universe as great intercessors, O Savior, by whom passions flee away: by their prayers, save our souls!

items.season_or_tone: LENTEN OKTOECHOS SUPPLEMENT: TRINITY HYMNS AND COMPUNCTIVE STICHERA
items.day_or_date: On Friday of Palm Week, at Matins
items.english_text: As eyewitnesses of the Word and servants of Christ,[^1287] let all us earth-born praise the all-wise Apostles in spiritual songs and hymns; for they diligently entreat Christ for us who sing of their radiant memory and bow before their relics!

provenance.verbatim_source: As eyewitnesses of the Word and servants of Christ,[^1287] let all us earth-born praise the all-wise Apostles in spiritual songs and hymns; for they diligently entreat Christ for us who sing of their radiant memory and bow before their relics!

items.office: Trinity Hymns in the Eight Tones
items.section: At the Aposticha, Stichera for the Departed, Tone 4, Podoben: "Thou hast given a sign" (Да́лъ є҆сѝ зна́менїе)
items.season_or_tone: LENTEN OKTOECHOS SUPPLEMENT: TRINITY HYMNS AND COMPUNCTIVE STICHERA
items.day_or_date: On Friday of Palm Week, at Matins
items.english_text: Harmoniously let us praise the Apostles of the Lord as luminaries revealed unto the universe; for they caught the nations for piety, and having enlightened us, clearly proclaim to honor the Holy Trinity: united in essence, yet divided in Hypostases!

provenance.verbatim_source: Harmoniously let us praise the Apostles of the Lord as luminaries revealed unto the universe; for they caught the nations for piety, and having enlightened us, clearly proclaim to honor the Holy Trinity: united in essence, yet divided in Hypostases!

items.office: Trinity Hymns in the Eight Tones
items.section: At the Aposticha, Stichera for the Departed, Tone 4, Podoben: "Thou hast given a sign" (Да́лъ є҆сѝ зна́менїе)
items.season_or_tone: LENTEN OKTOECHOS SUPPLEMENT: TRINITY HYMNS AND COMPUNCTIVE STICHERA
items.day_or_date: On Friday of Palm Week, at Matins
items.english_text: O unwedded Bride and Ever-Virgin, with the Angels unceasingly do we praise thee, for Thy Son and God has done great things for us through thee;[^1288] He Who before the ages is of the Father was well pleased to be contained in thy womb, to deliver our race from deception!

provenance.verbatim_source: O unwedded Bride and Ever-Virgin, with the Angels unceasingly do we praise thee, for Thy Son and God has done great things for us through thee;[^1288] He Who before the ages is of the Father was well pleased to be contained in thy womb, to deliver our race from deception!

items.office: Trinity Hymns in the Eight Tones
items.section: At the Aposticha, Stichera for the Departed, Tone 4, Podoben: "Thou hast given a sign" (Да́лъ є҆сѝ зна́менїе)
items.season_or_tone: LENTEN OKTOECHOS SUPPLEMENT: TRINITY HYMNS AND COMPUNCTIVE STICHERA
items.day_or_date: On Friday of Palm Week, at Matins
items.english_text: At the righteous achievements of the holy martyrs, the heavenly powers were astonished above measure: how in mortal flesh, having fought valiantly by the power of the Cross, they invisibly conquered the bodiless enemy, and they pray unto the Lord that our souls may find mercy!

provenance.verbatim_source: At the righteous achievements of the holy martyrs, the heavenly powers were astonished above measure: how in mortal flesh, having fought valiantly by the power of the Cross, they invisibly conquered the bodiless enemy, and they pray unto the Lord that our souls may find mercy!

items.office: Trinity Hymns in the Eight Tones
items.section: At the Aposticha, Stichera for the Departed, Tone 4, Podoben: "Thou hast given a sign" (Да́лъ є҆сѝ зна́менїе)
items.season_or_tone: LENTEN OKTOECHOS SUPPLEMENT: TRINITY HYMNS AND COMPUNCTIVE STICHERA
items.day_or_date: On Friday of Palm Week, at Matins
items.english_text: The Place of the Skull has become paradise; for as soon as the Tree of the Cross was planted, straightway it budded forth the living Cluster of grapes, even Thee, O Savior, unto our gladness: glory to Thee!

provenance.verbatim_source: The Place of the Skull has become paradise; for as soon as the Tree of the Cross was planted, straightway it budded forth the living Cluster of grapes, even Thee, O Savior, unto our gladness: glory to Thee!

items.office: Trinity Hymns in the Eight Tones
items.section: At the Aposticha, Stichera for the Departed, Tone 4, Podoben: "Thou hast given a sign" (Да́лъ є҆сѝ зна́менїе)
items.season_or_tone: LENTEN OKTOECHOS SUPPLEMENT: TRINITY HYMNS AND COMPUNCTIVE STICHERA
items.day_or_date: On Friday of Palm Week, at Matins
items.english_text: The Tree of Thy Cross, O our Savior, was shown forth as saving unto the world; for being willingly nailed upon it, Thou didst deliver the earth-born from the curse, O Joy of all: Lord, glory to Thee!

provenance.verbatim_source: The Tree of Thy Cross, O our Savior, was shown forth as saving unto the world; for being willingly nailed upon it, Thou didst deliver the earth-born from the curse, O Joy of all: Lord, glory to Thee!

items.office: Trinity Hymns in the Eight Tones
items.section: At the Aposticha, Stichera for the Departed, Tone 4, Podoben: "Thou hast given a sign" (Да́лъ є҆сѝ зна́менїе)
items.season_or_tone: LENTEN OKTOECHOS SUPPLEMENT: TRINITY HYMNS AND COMPUNCTIVE STICHERA
items.day_or_date: On Friday of Palm Week, at Matins
items.english_text: Beholding Thee upon the Cross, O Christ, willingly hanging between thieves, Thy Mother, torn in maternal compassion, said: O sinless Son, how art Thou wrongfully nailed to the Cross as an evildoer, desiring to quicken the human race, as Thou art Most Good?

provenance.verbatim_source: Beholding Thee upon the Cross, O Christ, willingly hanging between thieves, Thy Mother, torn in maternal compassion, said: O sinless Son, how art Thou wrongfully nailed to the Cross as an evildoer, desiring to quicken the human race, as Thou art Most Good?

items.office: Trinity Hymns in the Eight Tones
items.section: At the Aposticha, Stichera for the Departed, Tone 4, Podoben: "Thou hast given a sign" (Да́лъ є҆сѝ зна́менїе)
items.season_or_tone: LENTEN OKTOECHOS SUPPLEMENT: TRINITY HYMNS AND COMPUNCTIVE STICHERA
items.day_or_date: On Friday of Palm Week, at Matins
items.slavonic_text: Сїѧ́етъ дне́сь па́мѧть страстоте́рпецъ: и҆́матъ бо и҆ ѿ нб҃съ зарю̀: ли́къ а҆́гг҃льскїй торжествꙋ́етъ, и҆ чл҃вѣ́ческїй ро́дъ спра́зднꙋетъ, тѣ́мже мо́лѧтсѧ Гдⷭ҇ви, поми́ловатисѧ дꙋша́мъ на́шымъ.
items.english_text: Today shines the memory of the passion-bearers, for it has radiance from heaven; the angelic choir keeps festival, and the human race celebrates together; therefore they pray unto the Lord that our souls may find mercy!

provenance.verbatim_source: Today shines the memory of the passion-bearers, for it has radiance from heaven; the angelic choir keeps festival, and the human race celebrates together; therefore they pray unto the Lord that our souls may find mercy!

items.office: Trinity Hymns in the Eight Tones
items.section: At the Aposticha, Stichera for the Departed, Tone 4, Podoben: "Thou hast given a sign" (Да́лъ є҆сѝ зна́менїе)
items.season_or_tone: LENTEN OKTOECHOS SUPPLEMENT: TRINITY HYMNS AND COMPUNCTIVE STICHERA
items.day_or_date: On Friday of Palm Week, at Matins
items.slavonic_text: Ѽ земны́хъ всѣ́хъ не бре́гше, и҆ на мꙋ́ки мꙋ́жески дерзнꙋ́вше, блаже́нныхъ наде́ждъ не погрѣши́сте: но нбⷭ҇номꙋ Ца́рствїю наслѣ́дницы бы́сте, прехва́льнїи мч҃еницы, и҆мꙋ́ще дерзнове́нїе къ человѣколю́бцꙋ Бг҃ꙋ, мі́рꙋ ми́ръ и҆спроси́те, и҆ дꙋша́мъ на́шымъ ве́лїю ми́лость.
items.english_text: Taking no heed of all earthly things, and having manfully dared to face torments, ye did not miss your blessed hopes; but ye became heirs of the heavenly Kingdom, O all-praised martyrs; having boldness toward God, the Lover of mankind, ask peace for the world, and great mercy for our souls!

provenance.verbatim_source: Taking no heed of all earthly things, and having manfully dared to face torments, ye did not miss your blessed hopes; but ye became heirs of the heavenly Kingdom, O all-praised martyrs; having boldness toward God, the Lover of mankind, ask peace for the world, and great mercy for our souls!

items.office: Trinity Hymns in the Eight Tones
items.section: At the Aposticha, Stichera for the Departed, Tone 4, Podoben: "Thou hast given a sign" (Да́лъ є҆сѝ зна́менїе)
items.season_or_tone: LENTEN OKTOECHOS SUPPLEMENT: TRINITY HYMNS AND COMPUNCTIVE STICHERA
items.day_or_date: On Friday of Palm Week, at Matins
items.slavonic_text: Щито́мъ вѣ́ры ѡ҆бо́лкшесѧ, и҆ зна́менїемъ крⷭ҇тнымъ себѐ ᲂу҆крѣ́пльше, къ мꙋ́камъ мꙋ́жески вда́шасѧ, и҆ дїа́волю горды́ню и҆ ле́сть ᲂу҆праздни́ша, ст҃і́и твоѝ Гдⷭ҇и, тѣ́хъ моли́твами, ꙗ҆́кѡ всеси́льный Бг҃ъ, мі́рꙋ ми́ръ низпослѝ, и҆ дꙋша́мъ на́шымъ ве́лїю ми́лость.
items.english_text: Clothed with the shield of faith, and having strengthened yourselves with the sign of the Cross, ye manfully gave yourselves over to torments, and abolished the pride and deceit of the devil, O Thy holy ones, O Lord; by their prayers, as Almighty God, send down peace upon the world, and great mercy unto our souls!

provenance.verbatim_source: Clothed with the shield of faith, and having strengthened yourselves with the sign of the Cross, ye manfully gave yourselves over to torments, and abolished the pride and deceit of the devil, O Thy holy ones, O Lord; by their prayers, as Almighty God, send down peace upon the world, and great mercy unto our souls!

items.office: Trinity Hymns in the Eight Tones
items.section: At the Aposticha, Stichera for the Departed, Tone 4, Podoben: "Thou hast given a sign" (Да́лъ є҆сѝ зна́менїе)
items.season_or_tone: LENTEN OKTOECHOS SUPPLEMENT: TRINITY HYMNS AND COMPUNCTIVE STICHERA
items.day_or_date: On Friday of Palm Week, at Matins
items.slavonic_text: Моли́те за ны̀ ст҃і́и мч҃енницы, да и҆зба́вимсѧ ѿ беззако́нїй на́шихъ: ва́мъ бо дана̀ бы́сть благода́ть моли́тисѧ ѡ҆ на́съ.
items.english_text: Pray for us, O holy martyrs, that we may be delivered from our iniquities; for unto you has grace been given to pray for us!

provenance.verbatim_source: Pray for us, O holy martyrs, that we may be delivered from our iniquities; for unto you has grace been given to pray for us!

items.office: Trinity Hymns in the Eight Tones
items.section: At the Aposticha, Stichera for the Departed, Tone 4, Podoben: "Thou hast given a sign" (Да́лъ є҆сѝ зна́менїе)
items.season_or_tone: LENTEN OKTOECHOS SUPPLEMENT: TRINITY HYMNS AND COMPUNCTIVE STICHERA
items.day_or_date: On Friday of Palm Week, at Matins
items.slavonic_text: Несы́тною любо́вїю дꙋшѝ, Хрⷭ҇та̀ не ѿверго́стесѧ ст҃і́и мч҃еницы: лю̑тыѧ и҆ разли̑чныѧ ра́ны страсте́й претерпѣ́сте, мꙋчи́телей горды́ню низложи́сте, непрекло́ннꙋ и҆ невреди́мꙋ вѣ́рꙋ сохра́нше, на нб҃са̀ преста́вистесѧ, тѣ́мже и҆ дерзнове́нїе и҆мꙋ́ще къ немꙋ̀: просѝте дарова́ти на́мъ ве́лїю ми́лость.
items.english_text: With insatiable love of soul, ye did not deny Christ, O holy martyrs; ye endured grievous and diverse wounds of passions, and cast down the pride of the torturers; having preserved the faith unswerving and unharmed, ye were translated unto the heavens; therefore, having boldness toward Him, ask that great mercy be granted unto us!

provenance.verbatim_source: With insatiable love of soul, ye did not deny Christ, O holy martyrs; ye endured grievous and diverse wounds of passions, and cast down the pride of the torturers; having preserved the faith unswerving and unharmed, ye were translated unto the heavens; therefore, having boldness toward Him, ask that great mercy be granted unto us!

items.slavonic_text: Помѧнꙋ́хъ проро́ка вопїю́ща: а҆́зъ є҆́смь землѧ̀ и҆ пе́пелъ, и҆ па́ки разсмотри́хъ во гробѣ́хъ, и҆ ви́дѣхъ кѡ́сти ѡ҆бнаже́нныѧ, и҆ рѣ́хъ ᲂу҆́бѡ: кто̀ є҆́сть, ца́рь, и҆лѝ во́инъ; и҆лѝ бога́тъ, и҆лѝ ни́щъ; и҆лѝ пра́ведникъ, и҆лѝ грѣ́шникъ; но ᲂу҆поко́й Гдⷭ҇и съ пра́ведными рабы̑ твоѧ̑, ꙗ҆́кѡ человѣколю́бецъ.
items.english_text: I remembered the Prophet crying aloud: "I am earth and ashes";[^1289] and again I looked into the graves, and I saw bare bones, and I said then: Who is he? King or soldier? Rich or poor? Righteous man or sinner? But give rest, O Lord, with the righteous unto Thy servants, as the Lover of mankind!

provenance.verbatim_source: I remembered the Prophet crying aloud: "I am earth and ashes";[^1289] and again I looked into the graves, and I saw bare bones, and I said then: Who is he? King or soldier? Rich or poor? Righteous man or sinner? But give rest, O Lord, with the righteous unto Thy servants, as the Lover of mankind!

items.season_or_tone: LENTEN OKTOECHOS SUPPLEMENT: TRINITY HYMNS AND COMPUNCTIVE STICHERA
items.day_or_date: On Friday of Palm Week, at Matins
items.slavonic_text: Гдⷭ҇и, ча́ши Страсте́й твои́хъ, страстоте́рпцы твоѝ поревнова́вше, ѡ҆ста́вльше жите́йскꙋю красотꙋ̀, и҆ бы́ша а҆́гг҃лѡмъ соприча́стницы: тѣ́хъ мольба́ми пода́ждь дꙋша́мъ на́шымъ ми́ръ, Хрⷭ҇тѐ Бж҃е, и҆ ве́лїю ми́лость.
items.english_text: O Lord, having emulated the cup of Thy Passions, Thy passion-bearers left behind the beauty of this life and became partakers with the Angels; by their entreaties grant peace unto our souls, O Christ God, and great mercy!

provenance.verbatim_source: O Lord, having emulated the cup of Thy Passions, Thy passion-bearers left behind the beauty of this life and became partakers with the Angels; by their entreaties grant peace unto our souls, O Christ God, and great mercy!

items.day_or_date: On Friday of Palm Week, at Matins
items.slavonic_text: Стї́хъ: Ди́венъ Бг҃ъ во ст҃ы́хъ свои́хъ, Бг҃ъ І҆и҃левъ.
items.english_text: *Verse: Marvelous is God in His saints, the God of Israel.*[^1290]

provenance.verbatim_source: *Verse: Marvelous is God in His saints, the God of Israel.*[^1290]

items.office: Trinity Hymns in the Eight Tones
items.section: At the Aposticha, Stichera for the Departed, Tone 4, Podoben: "Thou hast given a sign" (Да́лъ є҆сѝ зна́менїе)

items.day_or_date: On Friday of Palm Week, at Matins
items.slavonic_text: Чꙋдеса̀ ст҃ы́хъ твои́хъ мч҃еникъ, стѣ́нꙋ неразори́мꙋ на́мъ дарова́лъ є҆сѝ Хрⷭ҇тѐ Бж҃е: тѣ́хъ моли́твами совѣ́ты ꙗ҆зы́кѡвъ разорѝ, и҆ ца́рствїѧ ски́птры ᲂу҆твердѝ, ꙗ҆́кѡ є҆ди́нъ бла́гъ и҆ человѣколю́бецъ.
items.english_text: The wonders of Thy holy martyrs hast Thou granted unto us as an indestructible rampart, O Christ God; by their prayers destroy the counsels of the nations, and establish the scepters of the kingdom, as the only Good One and Lover of mankind!

provenance.verbatim_source: The wonders of Thy holy martyrs hast Thou granted unto us as an indestructible rampart, O Christ God; by their prayers destroy the counsels of the nations, and establish the scepters of the kingdom, as the only Good One and Lover of mankind!

items.slavonic_text: Стї́хъ: Ст҃ы̑мъ, и҆̀же сꙋ́ть на землѝ є҆гѡ̀, ᲂу҆дивѝ Гдⷭ҇ь всѧ̑ хотѣ́нїѧ своѧ̑ въ ни́хъ.
items.english_text: *Verse: Unto the saints that are in His earth, the Lord hath made marvelous all His desires in them.*[^1291]

provenance.verbatim_source: *Verse: Unto the saints that are in His earth, the Lord hath made marvelous all His desires in them.*[^1291]

items.english_text: Give rest, O our Savior, with the righteous unto Thy servants, and establish them in Thy courts, even as it is written, overlooking all their transgressions, both voluntary and involuntary, and all things done in knowledge and in ignorance, as Thou art good, O Lover of mankind!

items.day_or_date: On Friday of Palm Week, at Matins
items.english_text: Rejoice, impassable gate of the Lord! Rejoice, rampart and protection of those who run to thee! Rejoice, haven unassailed by storms, who knewest not wedlock, who didst bear in the flesh thy Creator and God; cease not to intercede for those who hymn and worship thy childbearing!

provenance.verbatim_source: Rejoice, impassable gate of the Lord! Rejoice, rampart and protection of those who run to thee! Rejoice, haven unassailed by storms, who knewest not wedlock, who didst bear in the flesh thy Creator and God; cease not to intercede for those who hymn and worship thy childbearing!

items.day_or_date: On Friday of Palm Week, at Matins
items.english_text: Blessed is the army of the heavenly King! For even though the passion-bearers were earthly-born, yet they hastened to attain the angelic dignity, taking no heed of bodies; and because of their sufferings they were counted worthy of the honor of the bodiless powers; therefore by their prayers, O Lord, save our souls!

provenance.verbatim_source: Blessed is the army of the heavenly King! For even though the passion-bearers were earthly-born, yet they hastened to attain the angelic dignity, taking no heed of bodies; and because of their sufferings they were counted worthy of the honor of the bodiless powers; therefore by their prayers, O Lord, save our souls!

items.office: Trinity Hymns in the Eight Tones
items.season_or_tone: LENTEN OKTOECHOS SUPPLEMENT: TRINITY HYMNS AND COMPUNCTIVE STICHERA
items.day_or_date: On Friday of Palm Week, at Matins
items.english_text: Thy passion-bearers, O Lord, having made themselves like unto the angelic ranks, endured torments as though they were bodiless; and having unanimous hope, the enjoyment of the promised good things, by their prayers, O Christ God, have mercy on us!

provenance.verbatim_source: Thy passion-bearers, O Lord, having made themselves like unto the angelic ranks, endured torments as though they were bodiless; and having unanimous hope, the enjoyment of the promised good things, by their prayers, O Christ God, have mercy on us!

items.day_or_date: On Friday of Palm Week, at Matins
items.english_text: The holy martyrs, having contended on earth, endured frost, and surrendered themselves to fire; water received them, and theirs is the voice: "We went through fire and water, and Thou broughtest us out into a place of rest";[^1292] by their prayers, O God, have mercy on us!

provenance.verbatim_source: The holy martyrs, having contended on earth, endured frost, and surrendered themselves to fire; water received them, and theirs is the voice: "We went through fire and water, and Thou broughtest us out into a place of rest";[^1292] by their prayers, O God, have mercy on us!

items.day_or_date: On Friday of Palm Week, at Matins
items.english_text: Being in the midst of torments, the holy ones cried aloud rejoicing: These things are our merchandise unto eternity! In place of the wounds inflicted on our bodies, radiant raiment shall blossom forth for us at the resurrection; instead of dishonor, crowns; instead of prison bonds, paradise; and instead of condemnation with evildoers, life with the Angels; by their prayers, O Lord, save our souls!

items.english_text: Thou Who didst create me, O Lord, and didst lay Thy hand upon me, and gavest commandment unto me, saying: "Unto the earth shalt thou go again,"[^1293] direct me into Thy straight path, forgiving me my transgressions; pardon me and save me as I pray, as the Lover of mankind!

items.day_or_date: On Friday of Palm Week, at Matins
items.english_text: We bless thee, O Virgin Theotokos, for from thee shone forth the Sun of righteousness, Christ,[^1294] Who hath great mercy!

provenance.verbatim_source: We bless thee, O Virgin Theotokos, for from thee shone forth the Sun of righteousness, Christ,[^1294] Who hath great mercy!

items.day_or_date: On Friday of Palm Week, at Matins
items.english_text: With the light of Thy countenance, O Christ, as the Compassionate One, enlighten those who have departed; settle them in a green place, beside the waters of Thy pure and divine rest, in the longed-for bosom of Abraham our forefather,[^1295] where Thy light shines purely, and the fountains of goodness pour forth; where the choirs of all the righteous dance clearly, rejoicing in Thy goodness; with them rank Thy servants, granting them great mercy!

items.english_text: *Verse: Blessed are they whom Thou hast chosen and received, O Lord.*[^1296]

provenance.verbatim_source: *Verse: Blessed are they whom Thou hast chosen and received, O Lord.*[^1296]

items.office: Trinity Hymns in the Eight Tones
items.section: At the Aposticha, Stichera for the Departed, Tone 5, Podoben: "Rejoice, O container of ascetics" (Ра́дꙋйсѧ по́стникѡвъ)
items.season_or_tone: LENTEN OKTOECHOS SUPPLEMENT: TRINITY HYMNS AND COMPUNCTIVE STICHERA
items.day_or_date: On Friday of Palm Week, at Matins
items.english_text: Vouchsafe, O Compassionate One, that those who have departed from temporal things unto Thee, the Master of all and our God, may sing with unceasing voices and glorify Thy dominion, granting them to be enlightened by Thy beauty, and to receive and purely enjoy sweet and fair communion with Thee; where Angels dance around Thy throne, and the ranks of the saints stand rejoicing; with them grant rest unto Thy servants, and great mercy!

items.english_text: *Verse: Their souls shall dwell among good things.*[^1297]

provenance.verbatim_source: *Verse: Their souls shall dwell among good things.*[^1297]

items.section: At the Aposticha, Stichera for the Departed, Tone 5, Podoben: "Rejoice, O container of ascetics" (Ра́дꙋйсѧ по́стникѡвъ)
items.season_or_tone: LENTEN OKTOECHOS SUPPLEMENT: TRINITY HYMNS AND COMPUNCTIVE STICHERA
items.day_or_date: On Friday of Palm Week, at Matins
items.english_text: Where is the choir of Prophets, the ranks of Apostles and martyrs, and all who from the beginning have been justified by Thy saving Passion and blood, by which Thou didst redeem captive man; there give rest with faith unto those who have fallen asleep, as the Lover of mankind, forgiving their transgressions; for Thou alone in truth didst live without sin upon earth, Thou alone art free among the dead;[^1298] therefore grant rest unto Thy servants, and great mercy!

provenance.verbatim_source: Where is the choir of Prophets, the ranks of Apostles and martyrs, and all who from the beginning have been justified by Thy saving Passion and blood, by which Thou didst redeem captive man; there give rest with faith unto those who have fallen asleep, as the Lover of mankind, forgiving their transgressions; for Thou alone in truth didst live without sin upon earth, Thou alone art free among the dead;[^1298] therefore grant rest unto Thy servants, and great mercy!

items.office: Trinity Hymns in the Eight Tones
items.section: At the Aposticha, Stichera for the Departed, Tone 5, Podoben: "Rejoice, O container of ascetics" (Ра́дꙋйсѧ по́стникѡвъ)
items.season_or_tone: LENTEN OKTOECHOS SUPPLEMENT: TRINITY HYMNS AND COMPUNCTIVE STICHERA
items.day_or_date: On Friday of Palm Week, at Matins
items.english_text: From the law of sin hast thou freed us who were enslaved, O Lady, having conceived in thy womb Christ the Lawgiver and King, O only Virgin Mother, by Whose gift and grace we are justified; Whom do thou now entreat, that He may write the souls of those who acknowledge thee as the Mother of God in the Book of Life;[^1299] that being saved through thine intercession, O all-immaculate one, we may obtain the beloved redemption of thy Son, worshipping Him Who grants great mercy unto the world!

items.day_or_date: On Friday of Palm Week, at Matins
items.english_text: At Thy dread coming, O Christ, may we not hear: "I know you not";[^1300] for in Thee, O Savior, have we placed our hope; and even though through our negligence we kept not Thy commandments, yet spare our souls, we pray Thee!

provenance.verbatim_source: At Thy dread coming, O Christ, may we not hear: "I know you not";[^1300] for in Thee, O Savior, have we placed our hope; and even though through our negligence we kept not Thy commandments, yet spare our souls, we pray Thee!

items.season_or_tone: LENTEN OKTOECHOS SUPPLEMENT: TRINITY HYMNS AND COMPUNCTIVE STICHERA
items.day_or_date: On Friday of Palm Week, at Matins
items.english_text: I have not acquired repentance, nor yet tears; therefore I pray Thee, O Christ God, before the end turn me, and grant me compunction, that I may be delivered from torment!

provenance.verbatim_source: I have not acquired repentance, nor yet tears; therefore I pray Thee, O Christ God, before the end turn me, and grant me compunction, that I may be delivered from torment!

items.day_or_date: On Friday of Palm Week, at Matins
items.english_text: Finding me stripped of virtues, the enemy wounded me with the arrow of sin; but Thou, as Physician of souls and bodies, heal the wounds of my soul, O God, and have mercy on me!

provenance.verbatim_source: Finding me stripped of virtues, the enemy wounded me with the arrow of sin; but Thou, as Physician of souls and bodies, heal the wounds of my soul, O God, and have mercy on me!

items.day_or_date: On Friday of Palm Week, at Matins
items.english_text: Heal the sores of my heart that have grown within me from many transgressions, O Savior, as Physician of souls and bodies, granting forgiveness of transgressions unto those who ask; ever grant me tears of repentance, and bestow upon me the remission of my debts, O Lord, and have mercy on me!

items.day_or_date: On Friday of Palm Week, at Matins
items.english_text: I consider the dread day, and I weep for my wicked deeds: How shall I answer the immortal King? Or with what boldness shall I, a prodigal, look upon the Judge? O compassionate Father, O only-begotten Son, O Holy Spirit, have mercy on me!

items.day_or_date: On Friday of Palm Week, at Matins
items.english_text: In the valley of weeping, in the place which Thou hast appointed,[^1302] when Thou shalt sit, O Merciful One, to execute righteous judgment, expose not my hidden secrets, neither put me to shame before the Angels; but spare me, O God, and have mercy on me!

items.day_or_date: On Friday of Palm Week, at Matins
items.english_text: The most glorious Mother of God, who is holier than the holy Angels, let us unceasingly hymn with heart and lips, confessing her to be the Theotokos, as having truly given birth unto God incarnate, and praying unceasingly for our souls!

items.day_or_date: On Friday of Palm Week, at Matins
items.english_text: Light is ever with the righteous;[^1303] for the holy ones, having been enlightened by Thee, shine continually as luminaries, having quenched the lamp of the ungodly; by their prayers, O our Savior, Thou dost enlighten my lamp, O Lord, and save me!

items.day_or_date: On Friday of Palm Week, at Matins
items.english_text: Grant me the vigilance of the wise virgins, O Lord, and enlighten the lamp of my soul with the oil of Thy compassions,[^1304] that I may cry unto Thee the angelic hymn: Alleluia!

provenance.verbatim_source: Grant me the vigilance of the wise virgins, O Lord, and enlighten the lamp of my soul with the oil of Thy compassions,[^1304] that I may cry unto Thee the angelic hymn: Alleluia!

items.english_text: Have mercy on us, O Lord, have mercy on us; for being destitute of all defense, this prayer do we sinners offer unto Thee as Master: Have mercy on us!

items.day_or_date: On Friday of Palm Week, at Matins
items.english_text: Open unto us the doors of loving-kindness, O blessed Theotokos, that hoping in thee we may not perish, but may be delivered by thee from tribulations; for thou art the salvation of the Christian race!

items.day_or_date: On Friday of Palm Week, at Matins
items.english_text: Having endured the contest of suffering, O holy ones, and having received from Thee the prizes of victory, they brought to naught the wiles of the lawless, and received incorruptible crowns; through them, O God, grant us great mercy!

provenance.verbatim_source: Having endured the contest of suffering, O holy ones, and having received from Thee the prizes of victory, they brought to naught the wiles of the lawless, and received incorruptible crowns; through them, O God, grant us great mercy!

items.english_text: Today the prophetic word has been fulfilled; for behold, we worship at the place where Thy feet stood, O Lord;[^1305] and having tasted of the Tree of salvation, we have obtained freedom from sinful passions, by the prayers of the Theotokos, O only Lover of mankind!

items.day_or_date: On Friday of Palm Week, at Matins
items.english_text: Thy Cross, O Lord, is sanctified; for in it healings are bestowed upon those ailing in sins; falling down before Thee through it, have mercy on us!

items.english_text: The ever-virgin Maiden who bore Thee, O Christ, beholding Thee lifted up upon the Cross for our sake, had her soul wounded with the sword of sorrow,[^1307] and wept, lamenting as a mother; by her prayers have mercy on us, O Lord of mercy!

items.english_text: Suffering endurance in the contest, the torturers' wounds upon the martyrs, and the ranks of the bodiless stood holding the prizes of victory; they astonished torturers and kings, being most wise; they cast down Belial by the confession of Christ; O Lord Who didst strengthen them, glory to Thee!

items.english_text: As Thou didst come into the midst of Thy disciples, O Savior, giving peace unto them, come also unto us, and save us!
