items.season_or_tone: LENTEN OKTOECHOS SUPPLEMENT: TRINITY HYMNS AND COMPUNCTIVE STICHERA
items.day_or_date: On Friday of Palm Week, at Matins
items.english_text: The memory of Thy passion-bearers, O Lord, has been revealed as the paradise which is in Eden; for all creation rejoices in it; and by their prayers, O Christ, grant us peace and great mercy!

provenance.verbatim_source: The memory of Thy passion-bearers, O Lord, has been revealed as the paradise which is in Eden; for all creation rejoices in it; and by their prayers, O Christ, grant us peace and great mercy!

items.office: Trinity Hymns in the Eight Tones
items.section: At the Aposticha, Stichera for the Departed, Tone 5, Podoben: "Rejoice, O container of ascetics" (Ра́дꙋйсѧ по́стникѡвъ)
items.season_or_tone: LENTEN OKTOECHOS SUPPLEMENT: TRINITY HYMNS AND COMPUNCTIVE STICHERA
items.day_or_date: On Friday of Palm Week, at Matins
items.english_text: No sooner was the wood of Thy Cross set up, O Christ, than the foundations of death were shaken, O Lord; for that which Hades eagerly swallowed down, it cast forth with trembling; Thou hast revealed Thy salvation unto us, O Holy One; and we glorify Thee, O Son of God: have mercy on us!

provenance.verbatim_source: No sooner was the wood of Thy Cross set up, O Christ, than the foundations of death were shaken, O Lord; for that which Hades eagerly swallowed down, it cast forth with trembling; Thou hast revealed Thy salvation unto us, O Holy One; and we glorify Thee, O Son of God: have mercy on us!

items.office: Trinity Hymns in the Eight Tones
items.section: At the Aposticha, Stichera for the Departed, Tone 5, Podoben: "Rejoice, O container of ascetics" (Ра́дꙋйсѧ по́стникѡвъ)
items.season_or_tone: LENTEN OKTOECHOS SUPPLEMENT: TRINITY HYMNS AND COMPUNCTIVE STICHERA
items.day_or_date: On Friday of Palm Week, at Matins
items.english_text: O Lord, the Jews condemned Thee unto death, the Life of all; they who passed through the Red Sea by the rod nailed Thee upon the Cross; and they who sucked honey out of the rock brought gall unto Thee;[^1310] but willingly didst Thou endure it, that Thou mightest deliver us from the bondage of the enemy; O Christ God, glory to Thee!

provenance.verbatim_source: O Lord, the Jews condemned Thee unto death, the Life of all; they who passed through the Red Sea by the rod nailed Thee upon the Cross; and they who sucked honey out of the rock brought gall unto Thee;[^1310] but willingly didst Thou endure it, that Thou mightest deliver us from the bondage of the enemy; O Christ God, glory to Thee!

items.office: Trinity Hymns in the Eight Tones
items.section: At the Aposticha, Stichera for the Departed, Tone 5, Podoben: "Rejoice, O container of ascetics" (Ра́дꙋйсѧ по́стникѡвъ)
items.season_or_tone: LENTEN OKTOECHOS SUPPLEMENT: TRINITY HYMNS AND COMPUNCTIVE STICHERA
items.day_or_date: On Friday of Palm Week, at Matins
items.english_text: O Virgin Theotokos, entreat Thy Son, Who was willingly nailed upon the Cross, and delivered the world from deceit, Christ our God, that He may have mercy on our souls!

provenance.verbatim_source: O Virgin Theotokos, entreat Thy Son, Who was willingly nailed upon the Cross, and delivered the world from deceit, Christ our God, that He may have mercy on our souls!

items.office: Trinity Hymns in the Eight Tones
items.section: At the Aposticha, Stichera for the Departed, Tone 5, Podoben: "Rejoice, O container of ascetics" (Ра́дꙋйсѧ по́стникѡвъ)
items.season_or_tone: LENTEN OKTOECHOS SUPPLEMENT: TRINITY HYMNS AND COMPUNCTIVE STICHERA
items.day_or_date: On Friday of Palm Week, at Matins
items.english_text: Those who proclaimed Christ at the tribunal and feared not the threats of the lawless, the Lord has made marvelous; for by patient suffering they cast down the insolence of the lawless, and worthily received from Christ the grace of healings, unceasingly praying that our souls may be saved!

provenance.verbatim_source: Those who proclaimed Christ at the tribunal and feared not the threats of the lawless, the Lord has made marvelous; for by patient suffering they cast down the insolence of the lawless, and worthily received from Christ the grace of healings, unceasingly praying that our souls may be saved!

items.office: Trinity Hymns in the Eight Tones
items.section: At the Aposticha, Stichera for the Departed, Tone 5, Podoben: "Rejoice, O container of ascetics" (Ра́дꙋйсѧ по́стникѡвъ)
items.season_or_tone: LENTEN OKTOECHOS SUPPLEMENT: TRINITY HYMNS AND COMPUNCTIVE STICHERA
items.day_or_date: On Friday of Palm Week, at Matins
items.english_text: Thy martyrs, O Lord, did not deny Thee, nor did they depart from Thy commandments; by their prayers have mercy on us!

provenance.verbatim_source: Thy martyrs, O Lord, did not deny Thee, nor did they depart from Thy commandments; by their prayers have mercy on us!

items.office: Trinity Hymns in the Eight Tones
items.section: At the Aposticha, Stichera for the Departed, Tone 5, Podoben: "Rejoice, O container of ascetics" (Ра́дꙋйсѧ по́стникѡвъ)
items.season_or_tone: LENTEN OKTOECHOS SUPPLEMENT: TRINITY HYMNS AND COMPUNCTIVE STICHERA
items.day_or_date: On Friday of Palm Week, at Matins
items.english_text: They who suffered for Thy sake, O Christ, endured many torments, and received perfect crowns in the heavens, that they may pray for our souls!

provenance.verbatim_source: They who suffered for Thy sake, O Christ, endured many torments, and received perfect crowns in the heavens, that they may pray for our souls!

items.office: Trinity Hymns in the Eight Tones
items.section: At the Aposticha, Stichera for the Departed, Tone 5, Podoben: "Rejoice, O container of ascetics" (Ра́дꙋйсѧ по́стникѡвъ)
items.season_or_tone: LENTEN OKTOECHOS SUPPLEMENT: TRINITY HYMNS AND COMPUNCTIVE STICHERA
items.day_or_date: On Friday of Palm Week, at Matins
items.english_text: Passion-bearing martyrs, citizens of heaven, having suffered upon earth, ye endured many torments; by their prayers, O Lord, and by their supplication, preserve us all!

provenance.verbatim_source: Passion-bearing martyrs, citizens of heaven, having suffered upon earth, ye endured many torments; by their prayers, O Lord, and by their supplication, preserve us all!

items.office: Trinity Hymns in the Eight Tones
items.section: At the Aposticha, Stichera for the Departed, Tone 5, Podoben: "Rejoice, O container of ascetics" (Ра́дꙋйсѧ по́стникѡвъ)
items.season_or_tone: LENTEN OKTOECHOS SUPPLEMENT: TRINITY HYMNS AND COMPUNCTIVE STICHERA
items.day_or_date: On Friday of Palm Week, at Matins
items.english_text: Thy Cross, O Lord, became an invincible weapon unto the martyrs; for seeing death lying before them, and foreseeing the life to come, they were strengthened by their hope in Thee; by their prayers have mercy on us!

provenance.verbatim_source: Thy Cross, O Lord, became an invincible weapon unto the martyrs; for seeing death lying before them, and foreseeing the life to come, they were strengthened by their hope in Thee; by their prayers have mercy on us!

items.office: Trinity Hymns in the Eight Tones
items.section: At the Aposticha, Stichera for the Departed, Tone 5, Podoben: "Rejoice, O container of ascetics" (Ра́дꙋйсѧ по́стникѡвъ)
items.season_or_tone: LENTEN OKTOECHOS SUPPLEMENT: TRINITY HYMNS AND COMPUNCTIVE STICHERA
items.day_or_date: On Friday of Palm Week, at Matins
items.english_text: Thy creative command was my beginning and foundation; for desiring to compose me as a living creature out of invisible and visible nature, Thou didst fashion my body from the earth, and gavest me a soul by Thy divine and life-creating inbreathing;[^1311] therefore, O Savior, give rest unto Thy servants in the land of the living, and in the tabernacles of the righteous!

provenance.verbatim_source: Thy creative command was my beginning and foundation; for desiring to compose me as a living creature out of invisible and visible nature, Thou didst fashion my body from the earth, and gavest me a soul by Thy divine and life-creating inbreathing;[^1311] therefore, O Savior, give rest unto Thy servants in the land of the living, and in the tabernacles of the righteous!

items.office: Trinity Hymns in the Eight Tones
items.section: At the Aposticha, Stichera for the Departed, Tone 5, Podoben: "Rejoice, O container of ascetics" (Ра́дꙋйсѧ по́стникѡвъ)
items.season_or_tone: LENTEN OKTOECHOS SUPPLEMENT: TRINITY HYMNS AND COMPUNCTIVE STICHERA
items.day_or_date: On Friday of Palm Week, at Matins
items.english_text: Having endured the contest of suffering, O holy ones, ye received from Him the prizes of victory; ye brought to naught the devices of the lawless, and received incorruptible crowns; being entreated by them, O God, grant us great mercy!

provenance.verbatim_source: Having endured the contest of suffering, O holy ones, ye received from Him the prizes of victory; ye brought to naught the devices of the lawless, and received incorruptible crowns; being entreated by them, O God, grant us great mercy!

items.office: Trinity Hymns in the Eight Tones
items.section: At the Aposticha, Stichera for the Departed, Tone 5, Podoben: "Rejoice, O container of ascetics" (Ра́дꙋйсѧ по́стникѡвъ)
items.season_or_tone: LENTEN OKTOECHOS SUPPLEMENT: TRINITY HYMNS AND COMPUNCTIVE STICHERA
items.day_or_date: On Friday of Palm Week, at Matins
items.english_text: The courageous standing in the contest, and the torturers' wounds upon the martyrs; and the ranks of the bodiless stood holding the prizes of victory; the wise astonished the torturers, and kings, being most wise; they cast down the apostate by the confession of Christ; O Lord Who didst strengthen them, glory to Thee!

provenance.verbatim_source: The courageous standing in the contest, and the torturers' wounds upon the martyrs; and the ranks of the bodiless stood holding the prizes of victory; the wise astonished the torturers, and kings, being most wise; they cast down the apostate by the confession of Christ; O Lord Who didst strengthen them, glory to Thee!

items.office: Trinity Hymns in the Eight Tones
items.section: At the Aposticha, Stichera for the Departed, Tone 5, Podoben: "Rejoice, O container of ascetics" (Ра́дꙋйсѧ по́стникѡвъ)
items.season_or_tone: LENTEN OKTOECHOS SUPPLEMENT: TRINITY HYMNS AND COMPUNCTIVE STICHERA
items.day_or_date: On Friday of Palm Week, at Matins
items.english_text: O Lord, the memory of Thy saints has today been revealed as the paradise which is in Eden, for all creation rejoices in it; and by their entreaties Thou dost grant us peace and great mercy!

provenance.verbatim_source: O Lord, the memory of Thy saints has today been revealed as the paradise which is in Eden, for all creation rejoices in it; and by their entreaties Thou dost grant us peace and great mercy!

items.office: Trinity Hymns in the Eight Tones
items.section: At the Aposticha, Stichera for the Departed, Tone 5, Podoben: "Rejoice, O container of ascetics" (Ра́дꙋйсѧ по́стникѡвъ)
items.season_or_tone: LENTEN OKTOECHOS SUPPLEMENT: TRINITY HYMNS AND COMPUNCTIVE STICHERA
items.day_or_date: On Friday of Palm Week, at Matins
items.english_text: Truly all things are vanity, and life is but a shadow and a dream; for in vain does every earthly-born man trouble himself, even as the Scripture said: When we have acquired the world, then do we dwell in the grave, where kings and paupers are together;[^1312] therefore, O Christ God, give rest unto those who have departed, as the Lover of mankind!

provenance.verbatim_source: Truly all things are vanity, and life is but a shadow and a dream; for in vain does every earthly-born man trouble himself, even as the Scripture said: When we have acquired the world, then do we dwell in the grave, where kings and paupers are together;[^1312] therefore, O Christ God, give rest unto those who have departed, as the Lover of mankind!

items.office: Trinity Hymns in the Eight Tones
items.section: At the Aposticha, Stichera for the Departed, Tone 5, Podoben: "Rejoice, O container of ascetics" (Ра́дꙋйсѧ по́стникѡвъ)
items.season_or_tone: LENTEN OKTOECHOS SUPPLEMENT: TRINITY HYMNS AND COMPUNCTIVE STICHERA
items.day_or_date: On Friday of Palm Week, at Matins
items.english_text: Thou Who didst call Thy Mother blessed, didst come unto Thy Passion by voluntary counsel, having shone forth upon the Cross, desiring to seek out Adam, saying unto the Angels: "Rejoice with Me, for the lost drachma is found";[^1313] Thou Who hast wisely ordered all things, O our God, glory to Thee!

provenance.verbatim_source: Thou Who didst call Thy Mother blessed, didst come unto Thy Passion by voluntary counsel, having shone forth upon the Cross, desiring to seek out Adam, saying unto the Angels: "Rejoice with Me, for the lost drachma is found";[^1313] Thou Who hast wisely ordered all things, O our God, glory to Thee!

items.office: Trinity Hymns in the Eight Tones
items.season_or_tone: LENTEN OKTOECHOS SUPPLEMENT: TRINITY HYMNS AND COMPUNCTIVE STICHERA
items.day_or_date: On Friday of Palm Week, at Matins
items.english_text: O Lord, in the memory of Thy saints all creation keeps festival: the heavens rejoice with the Angels, and the earth is glad with men; by their prayers have mercy on us!

provenance.verbatim_source: O Lord, in the memory of Thy saints all creation keeps festival: the heavens rejoice with the Angels, and the earth is glad with men; by their prayers have mercy on us!

items.office: Trinity Hymns in the Eight Tones
items.season_or_tone: LENTEN OKTOECHOS SUPPLEMENT: TRINITY HYMNS AND COMPUNCTIVE STICHERA
items.day_or_date: On Friday of Palm Week, at Matins
items.english_text: O Lord, if we had not Thy saints as intercessors, and Thy goodness showing mercy upon us, how should we dare, O Savior, to hymn Thee, Whom the Angels unceasingly glorify? O Knower of hearts, spare our souls!

provenance.verbatim_source: O Lord, if we had not Thy saints as intercessors, and Thy goodness showing mercy upon us, how should we dare, O Savior, to hymn Thee, Whom the Angels unceasingly glorify? O Knower of hearts, spare our souls!

items.office: Trinity Hymns in the Eight Tones
items.season_or_tone: LENTEN OKTOECHOS SUPPLEMENT: TRINITY HYMNS AND COMPUNCTIVE STICHERA
items.day_or_date: On Friday of Palm Week, at Matins
items.english_text: The memory of the martyrs is joy unto those who fear the Lord; for having suffered for the sake of Christ, they received crowns from Him; and now with boldness they pray for our souls!

provenance.verbatim_source: The memory of the martyrs is joy unto those who fear the Lord; for having suffered for the sake of Christ, they received crowns from Him; and now with boldness they pray for our souls!

items.office: Trinity Hymns in the Eight Tones
items.season_or_tone: LENTEN OKTOECHOS SUPPLEMENT: TRINITY HYMNS AND COMPUNCTIVE STICHERA
items.day_or_date: On Friday of Palm Week, at Matins
items.english_text: Our God hath made marvelous His chosen saints; rejoice and be glad, all ye His servants; for He hath prepared crowns and His Kingdom for you; but we pray you, forget us not!

provenance.verbatim_source: Our God hath made marvelous His chosen saints; rejoice and be glad, all ye His servants; for He hath prepared crowns and His Kingdom for you; but we pray you, forget us not!

items.office: Trinity Hymns in the Eight Tones
items.season_or_tone: LENTEN OKTOECHOS SUPPLEMENT: TRINITY HYMNS AND COMPUNCTIVE STICHERA
items.day_or_date: On Friday of Palm Week, at Matins
items.english_text: Sickness came unto Adam through the tasting of the tree of old in Eden, when the serpent disgorged his venom; for on account of it all-generational death entered, devouring man; but the Master, having come, cast down the serpent, and granted us resurrection;[^1314] unto Him therefore let us cry aloud: Spare, O Savior, and give rest with the saints unto those whom Thou hast received, as the Lover of mankind!

provenance.verbatim_source: Sickness came unto Adam through the tasting of the tree of old in Eden, when the serpent disgorged his venom; for on account of it all-generational death entered, devouring man; but the Master, having come, cast down the serpent, and granted us resurrection;[^1314] unto Him therefore let us cry aloud: Spare, O Savior, and give rest with the saints unto those whom Thou hast received, as the Lover of mankind!

items.office: Trinity Hymns in the Eight Tones
items.season_or_tone: LENTEN OKTOECHOS SUPPLEMENT: TRINITY HYMNS AND COMPUNCTIVE STICHERA
items.day_or_date: On Friday of Palm Week, at Matins
items.english_text: Thou art our God, Who in wisdom hast done all things and dost fulfill them; Thou didst send Prophets, O Christ, to foretell Thy coming, and Apostles to preach Thy mighty acts; and the former indeed prophesied Thy coming, while the latter enlightened the nations by baptism; and the martyrs obtained that which they desired; and the choir of both, together with Her who bore Thee, entreats Thee: Give rest, O Lord, unto the souls which Thou hast received, and make us worthy of Thy Kingdom, O Thou Who didst endure crucifixion for the sake of me who was condemned, O my Redeemer and God!

provenance.verbatim_source: Thou art our God, Who in wisdom hast done all things and dost fulfill them; Thou didst send Prophets, O Christ, to foretell Thy coming, and Apostles to preach Thy mighty acts; and the former indeed prophesied Thy coming, while the latter enlightened the nations by baptism; and the martyrs obtained that which they desired; and the choir of both, together with Her who bore Thee, entreats Thee: Give rest, O Lord, unto the souls which Thou hast received, and make us worthy of Thy Kingdom, O Thou Who didst endure crucifixion for the sake of me who was condemned, O my Redeemer and God!

items.office: Trinity Hymns in the Eight Tones
items.section: At the Aposticha, Stichera for the Departed, Tone 6, Podoben: "Having laid aside all earthly hope" (Всѐ ѿло́жше)
items.season_or_tone: LENTEN OKTOECHOS SUPPLEMENT: TRINITY HYMNS AND COMPUNCTIVE STICHERA
items.day_or_date: On Friday of Palm Week, at Matins
items.english_text: Thou Who hast incomprehensible loving-kindness toward us, and an inexhaustible fountain of divine goodness, O Most Merciful One, settle those who have departed unto Thee in faith in the land of the living, in the beloved and longed-for tabernacles, granting them an abiding possession that endures forever; for Thou, O Savior, didst shed Thy blood for all, and with a life-bearing price didst redeem the world!

provenance.verbatim_source: Thou Who hast incomprehensible loving-kindness toward us, and an inexhaustible fountain of divine goodness, O Most Merciful One, settle those who have departed unto Thee in faith in the land of the living, in the beloved and longed-for tabernacles, granting them an abiding possession that endures forever; for Thou, O Savior, didst shed Thy blood for all, and with a life-bearing price didst redeem the world!

items.office: Trinity Hymns in the Eight Tones
items.section: At the Aposticha, Stichera for the Departed, Tone 6, Podoben: "Having laid aside all earthly hope" (Всѐ ѿло́жше)
items.season_or_tone: LENTEN OKTOECHOS SUPPLEMENT: TRINITY HYMNS AND COMPUNCTIVE STICHERA
items.day_or_date: On Friday of Palm Week, at Matins
items.english_text: Thou didst willingly endure life-creating slaying, and didst pour forth life, and gavest eternal food unto the faithful, wherein do Thou rank those who have fallen asleep in the hope of resurrection, forgiving all their transgressions by Thy grace, as the only Sinless One, and the only Good One and Lover of mankind, that Thy name, O Christ, may be hymned by all, and that we may glorify Thy saving love for mankind!

provenance.verbatim_source: Thou didst willingly endure life-creating slaying, and didst pour forth life, and gavest eternal food unto the faithful, wherein do Thou rank those who have fallen asleep in the hope of resurrection, forgiving all their transgressions by Thy grace, as the only Sinless One, and the only Good One and Lover of mankind, that Thy name, O Christ, may be hymned by all, and that we may glorify Thy saving love for mankind!

items.office: Trinity Hymns in the Eight Tones
items.section: At the Aposticha, Stichera for the Departed, Tone 6, Podoben: "Having laid aside all earthly hope" (Всѐ ѿло́жше)
items.season_or_tone: LENTEN OKTOECHOS SUPPLEMENT: TRINITY HYMNS AND COMPUNCTIVE STICHERA
items.day_or_date: On Friday of Palm Week, at Matins
items.english_text: Knowing Thee, O Christ, Who rulest over the living with God-originating authority, and hast dominion over the dead, we pray Thee: Give rest unto Thy faithful servants who have departed unto Thee, the only Benefactor, with Thine elect, O Lover of mankind, in the place of comfort, in the brightness of the saints; for Thou art a desirer of mercy, and as God Thou savest those whom Thou hast created according to Thine image, O only Most Merciful One!

provenance.verbatim_source: Knowing Thee, O Christ, Who rulest over the living with God-originating authority, and hast dominion over the dead, we pray Thee: Give rest unto Thy faithful servants who have departed unto Thee, the only Benefactor, with Thine elect, O Lover of mankind, in the place of comfort, in the brightness of the saints; for Thou art a desirer of mercy, and as God Thou savest those whom Thou hast created according to Thine image, O only Most Merciful One!

items.office: Trinity Hymns in the Eight Tones
items.section: At the Aposticha, Stichera for the Departed, Tone 6, Podoben: "Having laid aside all earthly hope" (Всѐ ѿло́жше)
items.season_or_tone: LENTEN OKTOECHOS SUPPLEMENT: TRINITY HYMNS AND COMPUNCTIVE STICHERA
items.day_or_date: On Friday of Palm Week, at Matins
items.english_text: Thou wast revealed as a divinely-fitting habitation, O all-pure one; for thou didst contain God, and gavest birth unto Christ, O unwedded Virgin Mother, in two natures, yet in one hypostasis;[^1315] entreat Him, O pure one, the only-begotten Firstborn, Who preserved thee an immaculate Virgin even after childbearing, to give rest in the light and in incorruptible blessedness unto the souls of those who have fallen asleep in faith!

provenance.verbatim_source: Thou wast revealed as a divinely-fitting habitation, O all-pure one; for thou didst contain God, and gavest birth unto Christ, O unwedded Virgin Mother, in two natures, yet in one hypostasis;[^1315] entreat Him, O pure one, the only-begotten Firstborn, Who preserved thee an immaculate Virgin even after childbearing, to give rest in the light and in incorruptible blessedness unto the souls of those who have fallen asleep in faith!

items.office: Trinity Hymns in the Eight Tones
items.section: At the Aposticha, Stichera for the Departed, Tone 6, Podoben: "Having laid aside all earthly hope" (Всѐ ѿло́жше)
items.season_or_tone: LENTEN OKTOECHOS SUPPLEMENT: TRINITY HYMNS AND COMPUNCTIVE STICHERA
items.day_or_date: On Friday of Palm Week, at Matins
items.english_text: As the prodigal son I also come, O Compassionate One; receive me as I fall down before Thee, as one of Thy hired servants, O God, and have mercy on me![^1316]

provenance.verbatim_source: As the prodigal son I also come, O Compassionate One; receive me as I fall down before Thee, as one of Thy hired servants, O God, and have mercy on me![^1316]

items.office: Trinity Hymns in the Eight Tones
items.section: At the Aposticha, Stichera for the Departed, Tone 6, Podoben: "Having laid aside all earthly hope" (Всѐ ѿло́жше)
items.season_or_tone: LENTEN OKTOECHOS SUPPLEMENT: TRINITY HYMNS AND COMPUNCTIVE STICHERA
items.day_or_date: On Friday of Palm Week, at Matins
items.english_text: As one who fell among thieves and was wounded, so have I fallen through my sins, and my soul is wounded; unto whom shall I, the guilty one, flee?[^1317] Only unto Thee, the compassionate Physician of souls: Pour out upon me, O God, Thy great mercy!

provenance.verbatim_source: As one who fell among thieves and was wounded, so have I fallen through my sins, and my soul is wounded; unto whom shall I, the guilty one, flee?[^1317] Only unto Thee, the compassionate Physician of souls: Pour out upon me, O God, Thy great mercy!

items.office: Trinity Hymns in the Eight Tones
items.section: At the Aposticha, Stichera for the Departed, Tone 6, Podoben: "Having laid aside all earthly hope" (Всѐ ѿло́жше)
items.season_or_tone: LENTEN OKTOECHOS SUPPLEMENT: TRINITY HYMNS AND COMPUNCTIVE STICHERA
items.day_or_date: On Friday of Palm Week, at Matins
items.english_text: Like the barren fig tree, cut me not down, O Savior, a sinner; but grant me patience for many years, watering my soul with the tears of repentance, that I may bring forth unto Thee the fruit of almsgiving![^1318]

provenance.verbatim_source: Like the barren fig tree, cut me not down, O Savior, a sinner; but grant me patience for many years, watering my soul with the tears of repentance, that I may bring forth unto Thee the fruit of almsgiving![^1318]

items.office: Trinity Hymns in the Eight Tones
items.section: At the Aposticha, Stichera for the Departed, Tone 6, Podoben: "Having laid aside all earthly hope" (Всѐ ѿло́жше)
items.season_or_tone: LENTEN OKTOECHOS SUPPLEMENT: TRINITY HYMNS AND COMPUNCTIVE STICHERA
items.day_or_date: On Friday of Palm Week, at Matins
items.english_text: Being the Sun of righteousness, enlighten the hearts of those who hymn Thee: O Lord, glory to Thee!

provenance.verbatim_source: Being the Sun of righteousness, enlighten the hearts of those who hymn Thee: O Lord, glory to Thee!

items.office: Trinity Hymns in the Eight Tones
items.section: At the Aposticha, Stichera for the Departed, Tone 6, Podoben: "Having laid aside all earthly hope" (Всѐ ѿло́жше)
items.season_or_tone: LENTEN OKTOECHOS SUPPLEMENT: TRINITY HYMNS AND COMPUNCTIVE STICHERA
items.day_or_date: On Friday of Palm Week, at Matins
items.english_text: Having the medicine of repentance, O my soul, draw near weeping, crying aloud with sighing: O Physician of souls and bodies, free me, O Lover of mankind, from my transgressions; number me with the harlot, the thief, and the publican;[^1319] and grant me, O God, forgiveness of my iniquities, and save me!

provenance.verbatim_source: Having the medicine of repentance, O my soul, draw near weeping, crying aloud with sighing: O Physician of souls and bodies, free me, O Lover of mankind, from my transgressions; number me with the harlot, the thief, and the publican;[^1319] and grant me, O God, forgiveness of my iniquities, and save me!

items.office: Trinity Hymns in the Eight Tones
items.section: At the Aposticha, Stichera for the Departed, Tone 6, Podoben: "Having laid aside all earthly hope" (Всѐ ѿло́жше)
items.season_or_tone: LENTEN OKTOECHOS SUPPLEMENT: TRINITY HYMNS AND COMPUNCTIVE STICHERA
items.day_or_date: On Friday of Palm Week, at Matins
items.english_text: I have not emulated the repentance of the publican, neither have I acquired the tears of the harlot; for I am at a loss concerning remission, regarding such amendment; but in Thy tender compassions, save me, O Christ God, as the Lover of mankind!

provenance.verbatim_source: I have not emulated the repentance of the publican, neither have I acquired the tears of the harlot; for I am at a loss concerning remission, regarding such amendment; but in Thy tender compassions, save me, O Christ God, as the Lover of mankind!

items.office: Trinity Hymns in the Eight Tones
items.section: At the Aposticha, Stichera for the Departed, Tone 6, Podoben: "Having laid aside all earthly hope" (Всѐ ѿло́жше)
items.season_or_tone: LENTEN OKTOECHOS SUPPLEMENT: TRINITY HYMNS AND COMPUNCTIVE STICHERA
items.day_or_date: On Friday of Palm Week, at Matins
items.english_text: More honorable than the glorious Cherubim art thou, O all-pure Virgin; for they, unable to endure the divine radiance, perform their service with their faces covered with wings;[^1320] but thou, beholding Him as an eyewitness, dost bear the incarnate Word; unceasingly entreat Him for our souls!

provenance.verbatim_source: More honorable than the glorious Cherubim art thou, O all-pure Virgin; for they, unable to endure the divine radiance, perform their service with their faces covered with wings;[^1320] but thou, beholding Him as an eyewitness, dost bear the incarnate Word; unceasingly entreat Him for our souls!

items.office: Trinity Hymns in the Eight Tones
items.section: At the Aposticha, Stichera for the Departed, Tone 6, Podoben: "Having laid aside all earthly hope" (Всѐ ѿло́жше)
items.season_or_tone: LENTEN OKTOECHOS SUPPLEMENT: TRINITY HYMNS AND COMPUNCTIVE STICHERA
items.day_or_date: On Friday of Palm Week, at Matins
items.english_text: Thy holy ones, O Lord, having contended on earth, trampled the enemy, and brought to naught the deceit of idols; therefore also they received crowns from Thee, the Master and Lover of mankind, and merciful God, Who grantest us great mercy!

provenance.verbatim_source: Thy holy ones, O Lord, having contended on earth, trampled the enemy, and brought to naught the deceit of idols; therefore also they received crowns from Thee, the Master and Lover of mankind, and merciful God, Who grantest us great mercy!

items.office: Trinity Hymns in the Eight Tones
items.section: At the Aposticha, Stichera for the Departed, Tone 6, Podoben: "Having laid aside all earthly hope" (Всѐ ѿло́жше)
items.season_or_tone: LENTEN OKTOECHOS SUPPLEMENT: TRINITY HYMNS AND COMPUNCTIVE STICHERA
items.day_or_date: On Friday of Palm Week, at Matins
items.english_text: Thou Who didst accept the tears of the harlot and of Peter, O Lord, and didst justify the publican who sighed from the depths;[^1321] have compassion, O Savior, upon me who fall down in compunction, and have mercy on me!

provenance.verbatim_source: Thou Who didst accept the tears of the harlot and of Peter, O Lord, and didst justify the publican who sighed from the depths;[^1321] have compassion, O Savior, upon me who fall down in compunction, and have mercy on me!

items.office: Trinity Hymns in the Eight Tones
items.section: At the Aposticha, Stichera for the Departed, Tone 6, Podoben: "Having laid aside all earthly hope" (Всѐ ѿло́жше)
items.season_or_tone: LENTEN OKTOECHOS SUPPLEMENT: TRINITY HYMNS AND COMPUNCTIVE STICHERA
items.day_or_date: On Friday of Palm Week, at Matins
items.english_text: Having cleansed Peter's denial with tears, and having forgiven the publican's transgressions through sighing, O Lover of mankind, glory to Thee!

provenance.verbatim_source: Having cleansed Peter's denial with tears, and having forgiven the publican's transgressions through sighing, O Lover of mankind, glory to Thee!

items.office: Trinity Hymns in the Eight Tones
items.section: At the Aposticha, Stichera for the Departed, Tone 6, Podoben: "Having laid aside all earthly hope" (Всѐ ѿло́жше)
items.season_or_tone: LENTEN OKTOECHOS SUPPLEMENT: TRINITY HYMNS AND COMPUNCTIVE STICHERA
items.day_or_date: On Friday of Palm Week, at Matins
items.english_text: Thou hast surpassed the heavenly Powers, for thou wast revealed as a divine temple, O blessed Theotokos, as having given birth unto Christ, the Savior of our souls!

provenance.verbatim_source: Thou hast surpassed the heavenly Powers, for thou wast revealed as a divine temple, O blessed Theotokos, as having given birth unto Christ, the Savior of our souls!

items.office: Trinity Hymns in the Eight Tones
items.section: At the Aposticha, Stichera for the Departed, Tone 6, Podoben: "Having laid aside all earthly hope" (Всѐ ѿло́жше)
items.season_or_tone: LENTEN OKTOECHOS SUPPLEMENT: TRINITY HYMNS AND COMPUNCTIVE STICHERA
items.day_or_date: On Friday of Palm Week, at Matins
items.english_text: Rejoice, ye righteous! Let the heavens be glad! For the martyrs, having contended on earth, brought deceit to naught; let the Church leap for joy, celebrating victories unto the Master of the contest, and the only Victor, Christ God, Who grants great mercy unto the world!

provenance.verbatim_source: Rejoice, ye righteous! Let the heavens be glad! For the martyrs, having contended on earth, brought deceit to naught; let the Church leap for joy, celebrating victories unto the Master of the contest, and the only Victor, Christ God, Who grants great mercy unto the world!

items.office: Trinity Hymns in the Eight Tones
items.section: At the Aposticha, Stichera for the Departed, Tone 6, Podoben: "Having laid aside all earthly hope" (Всѐ ѿло́жше)
items.season_or_tone: LENTEN OKTOECHOS SUPPLEMENT: TRINITY HYMNS AND COMPUNCTIVE STICHERA
items.day_or_date: On Friday of Palm Week, at Matins
items.english_text: The Church cries unto Thee, O Christ God, worshipping Thee in cedar, pine, and cypress;[^1322] faithfully grant victories unto our Emperor,[^1323] and have mercy on us!

provenance.verbatim_source: The Church cries unto Thee, O Christ God, worshipping Thee in cedar, pine, and cypress;[^1322] faithfully grant victories unto our Emperor,[^1323] and have mercy on us!

items.office: Trinity Hymns in the Eight Tones
items.section: At the Aposticha, Stichera for the Departed, Tone 6, Podoben: "Having laid aside all earthly hope" (Всѐ ѿло́жше)
items.season_or_tone: LENTEN OKTOECHOS SUPPLEMENT: TRINITY HYMNS AND COMPUNCTIVE STICHERA
items.day_or_date: On Friday of Palm Week, at Matins
items.english_text: Thou Who for my sake didst endure nailing upon the Cross, accept my vigilant praise, O Christ God, as the Lover of mankind!

provenance.verbatim_source: Thou Who for my sake didst endure nailing upon the Cross, accept my vigilant praise, O Christ God, as the Lover of mankind!

items.office: Trinity Hymns in the Eight Tones
items.section: At the Aposticha, Stichera for the Departed, Tone 6, Podoben: "Having laid aside all earthly hope" (Всѐ ѿло́жше)
items.season_or_tone: LENTEN OKTOECHOS SUPPLEMENT: TRINITY HYMNS AND COMPUNCTIVE STICHERA
items.day_or_date: On Friday of Palm Week, at Matins
items.english_text: Unceasingly entreat Christ God, Who was crucified for us and destroyed the dominion of death, O Virgin Theotokos, that He may save our souls!

provenance.verbatim_source: Unceasingly entreat Christ God, Who was crucified for us and destroyed the dominion of death, O Virgin Theotokos, that He may save our souls!

items.office: Trinity Hymns in the Eight Tones
items.section: At the Aposticha, Stichera for the Departed, Tone 6, Podoben: "Having laid aside all earthly hope" (Всѐ ѿло́жше)
items.season_or_tone: LENTEN OKTOECHOS SUPPLEMENT: TRINITY HYMNS AND COMPUNCTIVE STICHERA
items.day_or_date: On Friday of Palm Week, at Matins
items.english_text: Having despised the godlessness of the torturers, and having counted as nothing the pains of torments, O holy ones, ye did not deny the faith in Christ; therefore pray ye unto God, the Lover of mankind, that our souls may be saved!

provenance.verbatim_source: Having despised the godlessness of the torturers, and having counted as nothing the pains of torments, O holy ones, ye did not deny the faith in Christ; therefore pray ye unto God, the Lover of mankind, that our souls may be saved!

items.office: Trinity Hymns in the Eight Tones
items.section: At the Aposticha, Stichera for the Departed, Tone 6, Podoben: "Having laid aside all earthly hope" (Всѐ ѿло́жше)
items.season_or_tone: LENTEN OKTOECHOS SUPPLEMENT: TRINITY HYMNS AND COMPUNCTIVE STICHERA
items.day_or_date: On Friday of Palm Week, at Matins
items.english_text: Thou hast shown Thine Apostles to be laborers in Thy field, O Word,[^1324] who cut down idols; therefore having preached Thee as Master among the nations, they piously magnified Thee!

provenance.verbatim_source: Thou hast shown Thine Apostles to be laborers in Thy field, O Word,[^1324] who cut down idols; therefore having preached Thee as Master among the nations, they piously magnified Thee!

items.office: Trinity Hymns in the Eight Tones
items.section: At the Aposticha, Stichera for the Departed, Tone 6, Podoben: "Having laid aside all earthly hope" (Всѐ ѿло́жше)
items.season_or_tone: LENTEN OKTOECHOS SUPPLEMENT: TRINITY HYMNS AND COMPUNCTIVE STICHERA
items.day_or_date: On Friday of Palm Week, at Matins
items.slavonic_text: === LEAF p491 === (Printed Folio 487) Стї́хъ: Во всю̀ зе́млю и҆зы́де вѣща́нїе и҆́хъ:
items.english_text: *Verse: Their sound hath gone forth into all the earth.*[^1325]

provenance.verbatim_source: *Verse: Their sound hath gone forth into all the earth.*[^1325]

items.office: Trinity Hymns in the Eight Tones
items.section: At the Aposticha, Stichera for the Departed, Tone 6, Podoben: "Having laid aside all earthly hope" (Всѐ ѿло́жше)
items.season_or_tone: LENTEN OKTOECHOS SUPPLEMENT: TRINITY HYMNS AND COMPUNCTIVE STICHERA
items.day_or_date: On Friday of Palm Week, at Matins
items.slavonic_text: Прехва́льныхъ а҆пⷭ҇лѡвъ па́мѧть, Цр҃кве пита́телїе, творѧ́ще, пѣ́сньми пѣ́сней воспои́мъ Хрⷭ҇та̀: ті́и бо пови́нныѧ грѣхꙋ̀ спасо́ша проповѣ́данїемъ покаѧ́нїѧ, пре́лести гони́телїе, и҆ мі́ра стѧжа́телїе, и҆ моли́твенницы вселе́нныѧ.
items.english_text: Celebrating the memory of the all-praised Apostles, O nourishers of the Church, let us hymn Christ with songs of songs;[^1326] for they saved those guilty of sin through the preaching of repentance, expellers of deceit, acquirers of peace, and intercessors for the universe!

provenance.verbatim_source: Celebrating the memory of the all-praised Apostles, O nourishers of the Church, let us hymn Christ with songs of songs;[^1326] for they saved those guilty of sin through the preaching of repentance, expellers of deceit, acquirers of peace, and intercessors for the universe!

items.office: Trinity Hymns in the Eight Tones
items.section: At the Aposticha, Stichera for the Departed, Tone 6, Podoben: "Having laid aside all earthly hope" (Всѐ ѿло́жше)
items.season_or_tone: LENTEN OKTOECHOS SUPPLEMENT: TRINITY HYMNS AND COMPUNCTIVE STICHERA
items.day_or_date: On Friday of Palm Week, at Matins
items.slavonic_text: Ра́дꙋйсѧ, и҆з̾ неѧ́же непрело́жнѡ Сло́во пло́ть бы́сть, и҆ всели́сѧ въ на́съ, ра́дꙋйсѧ Чⷭ҇таѧ, а҆пⷭ҇лѡвъ и҆ мꙋ́ченикѡвъ ра́дованїе, и҆ вѣ́рныхъ спасе́нїе, ра́дꙋйсѧ Мт҃и Хрⷭ҇та̀ Бг҃а.
items.english_text: Rejoice, from whom without change the Word was made flesh and dwelt among us;[^1327] rejoice, O Pure One, rejoicing of the Apostles and the martyrs, and salvation of the faithful; rejoice, O Mother of Christ God!

provenance.verbatim_source: Rejoice, from whom without change the Word was made flesh and dwelt among us;[^1327] rejoice, O Pure One, rejoicing of the Apostles and the martyrs, and salvation of the faithful; rejoice, O Mother of Christ God!

items.office: Trinity Hymns in the Eight Tones
items.section: At the Aposticha, Stichera for the Departed, Tone 6, Podoben: "Having laid aside all earthly hope" (Всѐ ѿло́жше)
items.season_or_tone: LENTEN OKTOECHOS SUPPLEMENT: TRINITY HYMNS AND COMPUNCTIVE STICHERA
items.day_or_date: On Friday of Palm Week, at Matins
items.slavonic_text: Ст҃і́и, моли́те ѡ҆ставле́нїе дарова́ти на́мъ согрѣше́нїй на́шихъ, и҆ ча́емыхъ лю́тыхъ и҆зба́вити на́съ, и҆ го́рькїѧ сме́рти, мо́лимсѧ.
items.english_text: O holy ones, pray that the forgiveness of our transgressions be granted unto us, and that we be delivered from expected evils and from bitter death, we pray!

provenance.verbatim_source: O holy ones, pray that the forgiveness of our transgressions be granted unto us, and that we be delivered from expected evils and from bitter death, we pray!

items.office: Trinity Hymns in the Eight Tones
items.section: At the Aposticha, Stichera for the Departed, Tone 6, Podoben: "Having laid aside all earthly hope" (Всѐ ѿло́жше)
items.season_or_tone: LENTEN OKTOECHOS SUPPLEMENT: TRINITY HYMNS AND COMPUNCTIVE STICHERA
items.day_or_date: On Friday of Palm Week, at Matins
items.slavonic_text: Ѻ҆гнѧ̀ свѣтлѣ́йшее, пла́мене дѣ́йственнѣйшее, дре́во показа́лъ є҆сѝ крⷭ҇та̀ твоегѡ̀, попалѧ́ющее грѣхѝ недꙋ́гꙋющихъ, и҆ просвѣща́ющее сердца̀ пою́щихъ во́льное твоѐ распѧ́тїе, Хрⷭ҇тѐ Бж҃е, сла́ва тебѣ̀.
items.english_text: Brighter than fire, more effective than flame, hast Thou shown forth the Wood of Thy Cross, consuming the sins of the ailing, and enlightening the hearts of those who hymn Thy voluntary crucifixion, O Christ God; glory to Thee!

provenance.verbatim_source: Brighter than fire, more effective than flame, hast Thou shown forth the Wood of Thy Cross, consuming the sins of the ailing, and enlightening the hearts of those who hymn Thy voluntary crucifixion, O Christ God; glory to Thee!

items.office: Trinity Hymns in the Eight Tones
items.section: At the Aposticha, Stichera for the Departed, Tone 6, Podoben: "Having laid aside all earthly hope" (Всѐ ѿло́жше)
items.season_or_tone: LENTEN OKTOECHOS SUPPLEMENT: TRINITY HYMNS AND COMPUNCTIVE STICHERA
items.day_or_date: On Friday of Palm Week, at Matins
items.slavonic_text: Стї́хъ: Возноси́те Гдⷭ҇а Бг҃а на́шего, и҆ покланѧ́йтесѧ подно́жїю но́гъ є҆гѡ̀, ꙗ҆́кѡ ст҃о є҆́сть.
items.english_text: *Verse: Exalt ye the Lord our God, and worship at His footstool; for He is holy.*[^1328]

provenance.verbatim_source: *Verse: Exalt ye the Lord our God, and worship at His footstool; for He is holy.*[^1328]

items.office: Trinity Hymns in the Eight Tones
items.section: At the Aposticha, Stichera for the Departed, Tone 6, Podoben: "Having laid aside all earthly hope" (Всѐ ѿло́жше)
items.season_or_tone: LENTEN OKTOECHOS SUPPLEMENT: TRINITY HYMNS AND COMPUNCTIVE STICHERA
items.day_or_date: On Friday of Palm Week, at Matins
items.slavonic_text: Во́инствꙋй безпло́тными си́лами, и҆ вѣ́дый дꙋшѝ моеѧ̀ лѣ́ностное, крⷭ҇то́мъ твои́мъ спасѝ мѧ Хрⷭ҇тѐ Бж҃е, ꙗ҆́кѡ человѣколю́бецъ.
items.english_text: Encompassed by the bodiless powers, and knowing the indolence of my soul, by Thy Cross save me, O Christ God, as the Lover of mankind!

provenance.verbatim_source: Encompassed by the bodiless powers, and knowing the indolence of my soul, by Thy Cross save me, O Christ God, as the Lover of mankind!

items.office: Trinity Hymns in the Eight Tones
items.section: At the Aposticha, Stichera for the Departed, Tone 6, Podoben: "Having laid aside all earthly hope" (Всѐ ѿло́жше)
items.season_or_tone: LENTEN OKTOECHOS SUPPLEMENT: TRINITY HYMNS AND COMPUNCTIVE STICHERA
items.day_or_date: On Friday of Palm Week, at Matins
items.slavonic_text: Распе́ншагосѧ за ны̀ Хрⷭ҇та̀ Бг҃а, и҆ разрꙋши́вшаго сме́рти держа́вꙋ, непреста́ннѡ молѝ Бцⷤе Дв҃о, да спасе́тъ дꙋ́шы на́шѧ.
items.english_text: Unceasingly pray, O Virgin Theotokos, unto Christ God, Who was crucified for us and destroyed the power of death,[^1329] that He may save our souls!

provenance.verbatim_source: Unceasingly pray, O Virgin Theotokos, unto Christ God, Who was crucified for us and destroyed the power of death,[^1329] that He may save our souls!

items.office: Trinity Hymns in the Eight Tones
items.section: At the Aposticha, Stichera for the Departed, Tone 6, Podoben: "Having laid aside all earthly hope" (Всѐ ѿло́жше)
items.season_or_tone: LENTEN OKTOECHOS SUPPLEMENT: TRINITY HYMNS AND COMPUNCTIVE STICHERA
items.day_or_date: On Friday of Palm Week, at Matins
items.slavonic_text: Мꙋ́ченицы твоѝ Гдⷭ҇и, врага̀ побѣди́ша, и҆ пре́лесть і҆́дѡльскꙋю пограми́ша, воѡрꙋжи́вшесѧ крⷭ҇тною си́лою, тѣ́мже со а҆́гг҃лы воспѣва́юще зовꙋ́тъ побѣ́днꙋю пѣ́снь, славосло́вѧще тѧ̀ Хрⷭ҇тѐ: тѣ́ми тѧ̀ мо́лимъ, спасѝ на́съ.
items.english_text: Thy martyrs, O Lord, overcame the enemy and utterly defeated the deceit of idols, having armed themselves with the power of the Cross; therefore, singing with the Angels, they cry aloud the song of victory, glorifying Thee, O Christ; through them we pray Thee: Save us!

provenance.verbatim_source: Thy martyrs, O Lord, overcame the enemy and utterly defeated the deceit of idols, having armed themselves with the power of the Cross; therefore, singing with the Angels, they cry aloud the song of victory, glorifying Thee, O Christ; through them we pray Thee: Save us!

items.office: Trinity Hymns in the Eight Tones
items.section: At the Aposticha, Stichera for the Departed, Tone 6, Podoben: "Having laid aside all earthly hope" (Всѐ ѿло́жше)
items.season_or_tone: LENTEN OKTOECHOS SUPPLEMENT: TRINITY HYMNS AND COMPUNCTIVE STICHERA
items.day_or_date: On Friday of Palm Week, at Matins
items.slavonic_text: Сла́ва тебѣ̀ Хрⷭ҇тѐ Бж҃е, а҆пⷭ҇лѡвъ похвала̀, и҆ мꙋ́ченикѡвъ весе́лїе, и҆́хже про́повѣдь, Трⷪ҇ца є҆диносꙋ́щнаѧ.
items.english_text: Glory to Thee, O Christ God, the boast of the Apostles and the joy of the martyrs, whose preaching was the Consubstantial Trinity!

provenance.verbatim_source: Glory to Thee, O Christ God, the boast of the Apostles and the joy of the martyrs, whose preaching was the Consubstantial Trinity!

items.office: Trinity Hymns in the Eight Tones
items.section: At the Aposticha, Stichera for the Departed, Tone 6, Podoben: "Having laid aside all earthly hope" (Всѐ ѿло́жше)
items.season_or_tone: LENTEN OKTOECHOS SUPPLEMENT: TRINITY HYMNS AND COMPUNCTIVE STICHERA
items.day_or_date: On Friday of Palm Week, at Matins
items.slavonic_text: Ст҃і́и мꙋ́ченицы, и҆̀же до́брѣ страда́вше и҆ вѣнча́вшесѧ, моли́теся ко Гдⷭ҇у, спасти́ся дꙋша́мъ на́шымъ.
items.english_text: O holy martyrs, who fought the good fight and were crowned, pray unto the Lord that our souls may be saved!

provenance.verbatim_source: O holy martyrs, who fought the good fight and were crowned, pray unto the Lord that our souls may be saved!

items.office: Trinity Hymns in the Eight Tones
items.section: At the Aposticha, Stichera for the Departed, Tone 6, Podoben: "Having laid aside all earthly hope" (Всѐ ѿло́жше)
items.season_or_tone: LENTEN OKTOECHOS SUPPLEMENT: TRINITY HYMNS AND COMPUNCTIVE STICHERA
items.day_or_date: On Friday of Palm Week, at Matins
items.english_text: Taking no heed of all earthly things, O holy martyrs, and having manfully confessed Christ before the judgment seat, ye received from Him the recompense of your torments; but as ye have boldness, entreat Him as Almighty God, we pray, to save our souls who flee unto you!

provenance.verbatim_source: Taking no heed of all earthly things, O holy martyrs, and having manfully confessed Christ before the judgment seat, ye received from Him the recompense of your torments; but as ye have boldness, entreat Him as Almighty God, we pray, to save our souls who flee unto you!

items.office: Trinity Hymns in the Eight Tones
items.section: At the Aposticha, Stichera for the Departed, Tone 6, Podoben: "Having laid aside all earthly hope" (Всѐ ѿло́жше)
items.season_or_tone: LENTEN OKTOECHOS SUPPLEMENT: TRINITY HYMNS AND COMPUNCTIVE STICHERA
items.day_or_date: On Friday of Palm Week, at Matins
items.english_text: O all-praised martyrs, spiritual sheep, rational whole-burnt offerings, a sacrifice acceptable and well-pleasing unto God;[^1330] neither did the earth hide you, but heaven received you, and ye became partakers with the Angels; with them, we pray you, entreat our Savior and God to grant peace unto the world and to save our souls!

provenance.verbatim_source: O all-praised martyrs, spiritual sheep, rational whole-burnt offerings, a sacrifice acceptable and well-pleasing unto God;[^1330] neither did the earth hide you, but heaven received you, and ye became partakers with the Angels; with them, we pray you, entreat our Savior and God to grant peace unto the world and to save our souls!

items.office: Trinity Hymns in the Eight Tones
items.section: At the Aposticha, Stichera for the Departed, Tone 6, Podoben: "Having laid aside all earthly hope" (Всѐ ѿло́жше)
items.season_or_tone: LENTEN OKTOECHOS SUPPLEMENT: TRINITY HYMNS AND COMPUNCTIVE STICHERA
items.day_or_date: On Friday of Palm Week, at Matins
items.english_text: Give rest, O our Savior, Giver of life, unto our brethren whom Thou hast translated from temporal things, who cry aloud: O Lord, glory to Thee!

provenance.verbatim_source: Give rest, O our Savior, Giver of life, unto our brethren whom Thou hast translated from temporal things, who cry aloud: O Lord, glory to Thee!

items.office: Trinity Hymns in the Eight Tones
items.section: At the Aposticha, Stichera for the Departed, Tone 6, Podoben: "Having laid aside all earthly hope" (Всѐ ѿло́жше)
items.season_or_tone: LENTEN OKTOECHOS SUPPLEMENT: TRINITY HYMNS AND COMPUNCTIVE STICHERA
items.day_or_date: On Friday of Palm Week, at Matins
items.english_text: Thou wast known as Mother above nature, O Theotokos, yet didst remain Virgin above word and understanding; and the miracle of thy childbearing no tongue can recount; for since the Conception is most glorious, O Pure One, incomprehensible is the manner of thy giving birth; for where God wills, the order of nature is overcome;[^1331] therefore, knowing thee all to be the Mother of God, we diligently pray thee: Intercede that our souls may be saved!

provenance.verbatim_source: Thou wast known as Mother above nature, O Theotokos, yet didst remain Virgin above word and understanding; and the miracle of thy childbearing no tongue can recount; for since the Conception is most glorious, O Pure One, incomprehensible is the manner of thy giving birth; for where God wills, the order of nature is overcome;[^1331] therefore, knowing thee all to be the Mother of God, we diligently pray thee: Intercede that our souls may be saved!

items.section: At the Aposticha, Stichera for the Departed, Tone 6, Podoben: "Having laid aside all earthly hope" (Всѐ ѿло́жше)
items.season_or_tone: LENTEN OKTOECHOS SUPPLEMENT: TRINITY HYMNS AND COMPUNCTIVE STICHERA
items.day_or_date: On Friday of Palm Week, at Matins
items.english_text: Rejoice, ye righteous, and let the heavens be glad! For the martyrs, having contended on earth, trampled the enemy underfoot and abolished the deceit of idols; let the Church leap for joy, triumphantly celebrating unto the Author of the contest and the only Giver of victory, Christ God, Who grants great mercy unto the world!

items.day_or_date: On Friday of Palm Week, at Matins
items.english_text: Thy martyrs, O Lord, overcame the enemy and destroyed the deceit of idols, having armed themselves with the power of Thy Cross; therefore singing with the Angels, they cry aloud the song of victory, glorifying Thee, O Christ; by their prayers grant cleansing and great mercy unto our souls!

items.day_or_date: On Friday of Palm Week, at Matins
items.english_text: O holy ones, pray that forgiveness of our transgressions be given unto us, and that we be delivered from expected evils and from bitter death, we pray!

provenance.verbatim_source: O holy ones, pray that forgiveness of our transgressions be given unto us, and that we be delivered from expected evils and from bitter death, we pray!

items.day_or_date: On Friday of Palm Week, at Matins
items.english_text: Thy death, O Lord, caused life to blossom forth for the dead; for Thou didst despoil Hades, shielding those that slept in darkness; therefore we pray Thee, O Giver of life, as God: Those whom Thou hast received from us, give them rest with the righteous, that at the judgment they may find great mercy!

items.day_or_date: On Friday of Palm Week, at Matins
items.english_text: As the treasury of our resurrection, O all-hymned Lady, lead up from the pit and depth of transgressions those who place their hope in thee; for thou didst save those guilty of sin, having given birth unto our Salvation, who wast a Virgin before childbearing, and in childbearing a Virgin, and after childbearing again remainest a Virgin![^1335]

items.day_or_date: On Friday of Palm Week, at Matins
items.english_text: Celebrating the memory of Thy holy passion-bearers, we sing unto Thee, O Christ, crying aloud: O Lord, glory to Thee!

provenance.verbatim_source: Celebrating the memory of Thy holy passion-bearers, we sing unto Thee, O Christ, crying aloud: O Lord, glory to Thee!

items.day_or_date: On Friday of Palm Week, at Matins
items.english_text: In the midst of the tribunal of the lawless, rejoicing, the passion-bearers cried aloud unto Christ: O Lord, glory to Thee!

provenance.verbatim_source: In the midst of the tribunal of the lawless, rejoicing, the passion-bearers cried aloud unto Christ: O Lord, glory to Thee!

items.day_or_date: On Friday of Palm Week, at Matins
items.english_text: Luminaries to the universe were the all-praised passion-bearers shown to be, crying unto Christ: O Lord, glory to Thee!

provenance.verbatim_source: Luminaries to the universe were the all-praised passion-bearers shown to be, crying unto Christ: O Lord, glory to Thee!

items.season_or_tone: LENTEN OKTOECHOS SUPPLEMENT: TRINITY HYMNS AND COMPUNCTIVE STICHERA
items.day_or_date: On Friday of Palm Week, at Matins
items.english_text: Being of one mind and looking toward the One, the passion-bearing martyrs found the one path of life, which is death for Christ; vying with one another for the end, O what a wonder! As though snatching up treasures, they seized torments, saying one to another: For if we do not die now, we must die in any case and pay the debt of existence; let us make necessity an honor,[^1336] choosing what is our common lot; through death let us purchase life; by their prayers, O God, have mercy on us!

provenance.verbatim_source: Being of one mind and looking toward the One, the passion-bearing martyrs found the one path of life, which is death for Christ; vying with one another for the end, O what a wonder! items.day_or_date: On Friday of Palm Week, at Matins
items.english_text: In the land of Thy righteous, O Merciful One, rank those who in faith have been translated unto Thee from temporal things, O Lover of mankind!

provenance.verbatim_source: In the land of Thy righteous, O Merciful One, rank those who in faith have been translated unto Thee from temporal things, O Lover of mankind!

items.english_text: Pray, O Virgin, with the Apostles and the martyrs, that those translated may find great mercy at the judgment!

provenance.verbatim_source: Pray, O Virgin, with the Apostles and the martyrs, that those translated may find great mercy at the judgment!

items.section: At the Aposticha, Stichera for the Departed, Tone 7, Podoben: "Taking no heed" (Неради́вше)
items.season_or_tone: LENTEN OKTOECHOS SUPPLEMENT: TRINITY HYMNS AND COMPUNCTIVE STICHERA
items.day_or_date: On Friday of Palm Week, at Matins
items.english_text: Put to death wast Thou seen upon the Cross, O only Immortal One, and in the tomb wast Thou laid as one dead, delivering mankind from death and mortal corruption; but as Thou art an inexhaustible abyss of compassion and a Fountain of goodness, give rest unto the souls of Thy servants translated from us!

items.english_text: *Verse: Blessed are they whom Thou hast chosen and received, O Lord.*[^1337]

items.english_text: By Thine incorruptible goodness, and by the sweetness of Thy beauty, and by the rays of Thy divine light, count those translated unto Thee worthy to be enlightened, O God, in the immaterial radiance of Thy shining light, dancing with the Angels round about Thee, the Master, and King of glory, and Lord!

items.english_text: in the place of refreshment, in the house of Thy glory, in the delight of Paradise, in the bridal chambers of virgins, as Thou art tender-hearted!

items.day_or_date: On Friday of Palm Week, at Matins
items.english_text: Thou didst give birth unto the Fulfillment of the Law, the Redeemer Who became flesh; for there was no justification for those who were formerly under the Law; but Christ was crucified for our sake, and justified us;[^1339] as one who hath boldness, therefore, as Mother, pray unto Thy compassionate Son, O all-hymned Lady, to give rest unto the souls of those who in piety have been translated from us!

items.day_or_date: On Friday of Palm Week, at Matins
items.english_text: Thee, the King and Master, do Angels unceasingly hymn, but I fall down before Thee, crying as the publican: O God, cleanse me and have mercy on me![^1340]

provenance.verbatim_source: Thee, the King and Master, do Angels unceasingly hymn, but I fall down before Thee, crying as the publican: O God, cleanse me and have mercy on me![^1340]

items.day_or_date: On Friday of Palm Week, at Matins
items.english_text: Being immortal, O my soul, be not submerged by the waves of this life; but rise up, crying aloud unto thy Benefactor: O God, cleanse me and save me!

provenance.verbatim_source: Being immortal, O my soul, be not submerged by the waves of this life; but rise up, crying aloud unto thy Benefactor: O God, cleanse me and save me!

items.day_or_date: On Friday of Palm Week, at Matins
items.english_text: When I take into mind the multitude of wicked deeds committed by me, and come to the thought of that dread examination, seized with trembling, I flee unto Thee, God, the Lover of mankind; therefore despise me not, I entreat Thee, O only Sinless One; grant compunction unto my humble soul before the end, and save me!

provenance.verbatim_source: When I take into mind the multitude of wicked deeds committed by me, and come to the thought of that dread examination, seized with trembling, I flee unto Thee, God, the Lover of mankind; therefore despise me not, I entreat Thee, O only Sinless One; grant compunction unto my humble soul before the end, and save me!

items.day_or_date: On Friday of Palm Week, at Matins
items.english_text: Grant me tears, O God, as once unto the sinful woman; and count me worthy to wet Thy feet, which have set me free from the path of deceit; and to offer Thee as fragrant myrrh a pure life, acquired by me through repentance, that I too may hear Thy longed-for voice: "Thy faith hath saved thee, go in peace!"[^1341]

items.day_or_date: On Friday of Palm Week, at Matins
items.english_text: With a compassionate eye, O Lord, behold my lowliness, for little by little my life is spent, and from works there is no salvation for me; therefore I pray: With a compassionate eye, O Lord, behold my lowliness and save me!

provenance.verbatim_source: With a compassionate eye, O Lord, behold my lowliness, for little by little my life is spent, and from works there is no salvation for me; therefore I pray: With a compassionate eye, O Lord, behold my lowliness and save me!

items.english_text: *Verse: O Lord, rebuke me not in Thine anger.*[^1342]

provenance.verbatim_source: *Verse: O Lord, rebuke me not in Thine anger.*[^1342]

items.day_or_date: On Friday of Palm Week, at Matins
items.english_text: As standing before the Judge, take care, O my soul, and consider the hour of that dread day; for judgment is without mercy to those who have shown no mercy;[^1343] cry aloud therefore unto Christ God: O Knower of hearts, I have sinned; before Thou condemnest me, have mercy on me!

items.day_or_date: On Friday of Palm Week, at Matins
items.english_text: O noetic gate of life, all-pure Theotokos, deliver from afflictions those who flee unto thee in faith, that we may glorify thy most holy childbearing, unto the salvation of our souls!

provenance.verbatim_source: O noetic gate of life, all-pure Theotokos, deliver from afflictions those who flee unto thee in faith, that we may glorify thy most holy childbearing, unto the salvation of our souls!

items.day_or_date: On Friday of Palm Week, at Matins
items.english_text: Noetic luminaries were ye shown to be, O holy martyrs, for by faith ye brought to naught the gloom of deceit, and enlightened the lamps of your souls, and with the Bridegroom entered with glory into the heavenly bridal chamber; and now we pray you: Intercede that our souls may be saved!

items.english_text: As the harlot I fall down before Thee, that I may receive forgiveness, and instead of myrrh, tears from the heart do I offer unto Thee, O Christ God; that as upon her Thou mayest have compassion on me, O Savior, and grant cleansing of sins; for as she did, so I cry unto Thee: Deliver me from the mire of my deeds!

items.day_or_date: On Friday of Palm Week, at Matins
items.english_text: Considering that dread day, O my soul, keep vigil, kindling thy lamp, enlightening it with oil; for thou knowest not when the voice shall come unto thee, saying: "Behold, the Bridegroom!" Take heed therefore, O my soul, lest thou slumber, and remain outside knocking, like the five virgins;[^1344] but watchfully wait, that thou mayest meet Christ with rich oil, and He shall give thee the divine bridal chamber of His glory!

items.day_or_date: On Friday of Palm Week, at Matins
items.english_text: As the immovable foundation of the faith, and the precious gift of our souls, let us faithful magnify the Theotokos with hymns: Rejoice, thou who didst contain in thy womb the Rock of life;[^1345] rejoice, hope of the ends of the earth, protection of the afflicted; rejoice, O Bride unwedded!

items.season_or_tone: LENTEN OKTOECHOS SUPPLEMENT: TRINITY HYMNS AND COMPUNCTIVE STICHERA
items.day_or_date: On Friday of Palm Week, at Matins
items.english_text: With heavenly light this tabernacle shines today; for in it the angelic hosts rejoice, with whom the choirs of martyrs make merry at the memory of the passion-bearers; by their prayers send down peace upon Thy world, O Christ, and great mercy!

provenance.verbatim_source: With heavenly light this tabernacle shines today; for in it the angelic hosts rejoice, with whom the choirs of martyrs make merry at the memory of the passion-bearers; by their prayers send down peace upon Thy world, O Christ, and great mercy!

items.english_text: Seeing the Author of life hanging upon the Cross, the thief said: If He were not God incarnate Who is crucified with us, the sun would not have hidden its rays, nor would the earth have shaken trembling; but O Thou Who endurest all things, remember me, O Lord, in Thy Kingdom![^1346]

provenance.verbatim_source: Seeing the Author of life hanging upon the Cross, the thief said: If He were not God incarnate Who is crucified with us, the sun would not have hidden its rays, nor would the earth have shaken trembling; but O Thou Who endurest all things, remember me, O Lord, in Thy Kingdom![^1346]

items.english_text: Between two thieves Thy Cross was found to be a balance of righteousness;[^1347] for the one was dragged down to Hades by the weight of his blasphemy, while the other was lightened of his transgressions unto the knowledge of theology; O Christ God, glory to Thee!

provenance.verbatim_source: Between two thieves Thy Cross was found to be a balance of righteousness;[^1347] for the one was dragged down to Hades by the weight of his blasphemy, while the other was lightened of his transgressions unto the knowledge of theology; O Christ God, glory to Thee!

items.day_or_date: On Friday of Palm Week, at Matins
items.english_text: Beholding upon the Cross the Lamb, and Shepherd, and Savior of the world, she who bore Thee said weeping: "The world truly rejoices, receiving redemption, but my womb is on fire beholding Thy crucifixion, which Thou endurest for all, O my Son and my God!"[^1348]

provenance.verbatim_source: Beholding upon the Cross the Lamb, and Shepherd, and Savior of the world, she who bore Thee said weeping: "The world truly rejoices, receiving redemption, but my womb is on fire beholding Thy crucifixion, which Thou endurest for all, O my Son and my God!"[^1348]

items.day_or_date: On Friday of Palm Week, at Matins
items.english_text: Unswerving wayfarers upon the narrow and sorrowful path were ye, O holy martyrs;[^1349] for ye endured the storm of trials and received the dwelling of the bodiless ministers, shown to be a rock of endurance and the foundations of piety; pray unto Christ God for our souls!

provenance.verbatim_source: Unswerving wayfarers upon the narrow and sorrowful path were ye, O holy martyrs;[^1349] for ye endured the storm of trials and received the dwelling of the bodiless ministers, shown to be a rock of endurance and the foundations of piety; pray unto Christ God for our souls!

items.day_or_date: On Friday of Palm Week, at Matins
items.english_text: Blessed art Thou, O Christ our God, Who hast shown forth the fishermen as all-wise, sending down upon them the Holy Spirit, and through them catching the universe; O Lover of mankind, glory to Thee![^1350]

provenance.verbatim_source: Blessed art Thou, O Christ our God, Who hast shown forth the fishermen as all-wise, sending down upon them the Holy Spirit, and through them catching the universe; O Lover of mankind, glory to Thee![^1350]

items.english_text: *Verse: Their sound hath gone forth into all the earth.*[^1351]

provenance.verbatim_source: *Verse: Their sound hath gone forth into all the earth.*[^1351]

items.day_or_date: On Friday of Palm Week, at Matins
items.english_text: As the luminaries and instructors of the world, the first-fruits of our salvation, let us hymn the divine disciples of our God; for they shone forth upon us as a light unto those in darkness, and proclaimed unto all the Sun of glory; therefore they also cast down the deceit of idols, preaching the Trinity in one Godhead; therefore we pray, O Apostles of Christ God: That forgiveness of transgressions be granted unto those who celebrate your holy memory with love!

provenance.verbatim_source: As the luminaries and instructors of the world, the first-fruits of our salvation, let us hymn the divine disciples of our God; for they shone forth upon us as a light unto those in darkness, and proclaimed unto all the Sun of glory; therefore they also cast down the deceit of idols, preaching the Trinity in one Godhead; therefore we pray, O Apostles of Christ God: That forgiveness of transgressions be granted unto those who celebrate your holy memory with love!

items.day_or_date: On Friday of Palm Week, at Matins
items.english_text: Rejoice, thou who through the Angel didst receive the joy of the world! Rejoice, thou who didst bear thy Creator and Lord! Rejoice, thou who wast accounted worthy to be the Mother of God!

provenance.verbatim_source: Rejoice, thou who through the Angel didst receive the joy of the world! Rejoice, thou who didst bear thy Creator and Lord! Rejoice, thou who wast accounted worthy to be the Mother of God!

items.day_or_date: On Friday of Palm Week, at Matins
items.english_text: Having valiantly finished the course, ye resisted the torturers, O martyrs;[^1352] for having put your bodies to death on earth, ye received the heavenly life, O holy ones!

provenance.verbatim_source: Having valiantly finished the course, ye resisted the torturers, O martyrs;[^1352] for having put your bodies to death on earth, ye received the heavenly life, O holy ones!

items.office: Trinity Hymns in the Eight Tones

items.season_or_tone: LENTEN OKTOECHOS SUPPLEMENT: TRINITY HYMNS AND COMPUNCTIVE STICHERA
items.day_or_date: On Friday of Palm Week, at Matins
items.english_text: In the midst of Eden the tree of death blossomed forth, but in the midst of all the earth the Tree put forth life; for tasting of the first, being incorruptible, we became corruptible; but attaining the second, we enjoyed incorruption; for by the Cross dost Thou save the human race, as God![^1353]

provenance.verbatim_source: In the midst of Eden the tree of death blossomed forth, but in the midst of all the earth the Tree put forth life; for tasting of the first, being incorruptible, we became corruptible; but attaining the second, we enjoyed incorruption; for by the Cross dost Thou save the human race, as God![^1353]

items.office: Trinity Hymns in the Eight Tones

items.season_or_tone: LENTEN OKTOECHOS SUPPLEMENT: TRINITY HYMNS AND COMPUNCTIVE STICHERA
items.day_or_date: On Friday of Palm Week, at Matins
items.english_text: In Paradise the enemy once stripped us naked by the tree through tasting, bringing in death; but the Tree of the Cross, bearing the garment of life for mankind, hath been brought upon the earth, and the whole world is filled with all joy; beholding it exalted, let us, the people, cry aloud with one accord unto God in faith: "The house is full of His glory!"[^1354]

provenance.verbatim_source: In Paradise the enemy once stripped us naked by the tree through tasting, bringing in death; but the Tree of the Cross, bearing the garment of life for mankind, hath been brought upon the earth, and the whole world is filled with all joy; beholding it exalted, let us, the people, cry aloud with one accord unto God in faith: "The house is full of His glory!"[^1354]

items.office: Trinity Hymns in the Eight Tones

items.season_or_tone: LENTEN OKTOECHOS SUPPLEMENT: TRINITY HYMNS AND COMPUNCTIVE STICHERA
items.day_or_date: On Friday of Palm Week, at Matins
items.english_text: Beholding Him Who was incarnate of thy pure blood, and born of thee above thought, O Pure One, hanging upon the Tree in the midst of evildoers, thy womb was in pain, and lamenting as a mother, thou didst cry aloud: "Woe is me, O my Child! What is this Thy divine and ineffable dispensation, whereby Thou hast brought Thy creature to life? I hymn Thy tender-hearted compassion!"

provenance.verbatim_source: Beholding Him Who was incarnate of thy pure blood, and born of thee above thought, O Pure One, hanging upon the Tree in the midst of evildoers, thy womb was in pain, and lamenting as a mother, thou didst cry aloud: "Woe is me, O my Child! items.season_or_tone: LENTEN OKTOECHOS SUPPLEMENT: TRINITY HYMNS AND COMPUNCTIVE STICHERA
items.day_or_date: On Friday of Palm Week, at Matins
items.english_text: Having by abstinence put to death the fiery forms and motions of passions, the martyrs of Christ received grace to drive away ailments from the infirm, both while living and after their end to work wonders; truly a most glorious wonder, that bare bones pour forth healings;[^1355] glory be to God, the only Creator!

provenance.verbatim_source: Having by abstinence put to death the fiery forms and motions of passions, the martyrs of Christ received grace to drive away ailments from the infirm, both while living and after their end to work wonders; truly a most glorious wonder, that bare bones pour forth healings;[^1355] glory be to God, the only Creator!

items.day_or_date: On Friday of Palm Week, at Matins
items.english_text: O martyrs of the Lord, every place do ye sanctify, and every ailment do ye heal; and now we pray you: Intercede that our souls may be delivered from the snares of the enemy!

provenance.verbatim_source: O martyrs of the Lord, every place do ye sanctify, and every ailment do ye heal; and now we pray you: Intercede that our souls may be delivered from the snares of the enemy!

items.season_or_tone: LENTEN OKTOECHOS SUPPLEMENT: TRINITY HYMNS AND COMPUNCTIVE STICHERA
items.day_or_date: On Friday of Palm Week, at Matins
items.english_text: O martyrs of the Lord, entreat our God, and ask for our souls a multitude of compassions and the cleansing of many transgressions, we pray!

provenance.verbatim_source: O martyrs of the Lord, entreat our God, and ask for our souls a multitude of compassions and the cleansing of many transgressions, we pray!

items.office: Trinity Hymns in the Eight Tones

items.season_or_tone: LENTEN OKTOECHOS SUPPLEMENT: TRINITY HYMNS AND COMPUNCTIVE STICHERA
items.day_or_date: On Friday of Palm Week, at Matins
items.english_text: Thy martyrs, O Lord, having forgotten earthly things, and having taken no heed of torments for the sake of the life to come, were shown to be its heirs; therefore they also rejoice with the Angels; by their prayers grant great mercy unto Thy people!

provenance.verbatim_source: Thy martyrs, O Lord, having forgotten earthly things, and having taken no heed of torments for the sake of the life to come, were shown to be its heirs; therefore they also rejoice with the Angels; by their prayers grant great mercy unto Thy people!

items.season_or_tone: LENTEN OKTOECHOS SUPPLEMENT: TRINITY HYMNS AND COMPUNCTIVE STICHERA
items.day_or_date: On Friday of Palm Week, at Matins
items.english_text: If there be any virtue, and if there be any praise that befitts the saints;[^1356] for by the sword they bowed their necks for Thy sake, Who didst bow the heavens and come down; they poured out their blood for Thy sake, Who didst empty Thyself and take the form of a servant; they humbled themselves even unto death, emulating Thy poverty;[^1357] by their prayers, according to the multitude of Thy compassions, O God, have mercy on us!

provenance.verbatim_source: If there be any virtue, and if there be any praise that befitts the saints;[^1356] for by the sword they bowed their necks for Thy sake, Who didst bow the heavens and come down; they poured out their blood for Thy sake, Who didst empty Thyself and take the form of a servant; they humbled themselves even unto death, emulating Thy poverty;[^1357] by their prayers, according to the multitude of Thy compassions, O God, have mercy on us!

items.season_or_tone: LENTEN OKTOECHOS SUPPLEMENT: TRINITY HYMNS AND COMPUNCTIVE STICHERA
items.day_or_date: On Friday of Palm Week, at Matins
items.english_text: I weep and lament when I contemplate death, and behold our beauty created according to the image of God lying in the tombs, formless, inglorious, having no shape; O what a wonder! What is this mystery that hath happened concerning us? How have we been handed over unto corruption? How have we been yoked unto death? Truly by the command of God, even as it is written, Who bestows rest upon those who have been translated![^1358]

provenance.verbatim_source: I weep and lament when I contemplate death, and behold our beauty created according to the image of God lying in the tombs, formless, inglorious, having no shape; O what a wonder! What is this mystery that hath happened concerning us? How have we been handed over unto corruption? How have we been yoked unto death? Truly by the command of God, even as it is written, Who bestows rest upon those who have been translated![^1358]

items.english_text: The King of heaven, through love of mankind, appeared on earth and conversed with men; for receiving flesh from the Pure Virgin, and having come forth from her with the assumption thereof, He is one Son, twofold in nature, but not in hypostasis; therefore, truly proclaiming Him to be perfect God and perfect Man, we confess Christ our God; Whom do thou entreat, O unwedded Mother, that our souls may find mercy![^1359]

items.day_or_date: On Friday of Palm Week, at Matins
items.english_text: Noetic luminaries were ye shown to be, O holy martyrs, for by faith ye brought to naught the gloom of deceit, and enlightened the lamps of your souls, and with the Bridegroom entered with glory into the heavenly bridal chamber; and now we pray you: Intercede that our souls may be saved!

items.english_text: *Verse: Marvelous is God in His saints, the God of Israel.*[^1360]

provenance.verbatim_source: *Verse: Marvelous is God in His saints, the God of Israel.*[^1360]

items.day_or_date: On Friday of Palm Week, at Matins
items.english_text: Ever-shining luminaries to the universe were ye shown to be, by faith martyrically placing all your hope upon the Lord; and with the noetic oil of the Holy Spirit ye enlightened your spiritual lamps; therefore as noetic chalices pouring forth healings unto mankind, even as waters, were ye shown forth, O all-praised passion-bearers; pray unto Christ God that forgiveness of transgressions be granted unto those who honor your holy memory with love!

items.english_text: *Verse: Unto the saints that are in His earth, the Lord hath made marvelous all His desires in them.*[^1361]

items.day_or_date: On Friday of Palm Week, at Matins
items.english_text: O Prophets, martyrs of Christ, and hierarchs, who in pious wisdom lawfully finished the good fight, and received unfading crowns from God, unceasingly entreat His goodness for us, that He may grant us forgiveness of transgressions, as He is a God easily entreated!

items.day_or_date: On Friday of Palm Week, at Matins
items.english_text: Who by the depth of wisdom providently orderest all things out of love for mankind, and bestowest upon all what is profitable, O only Creator, give rest, O Lord, unto the souls of Thy servants; for they have placed their hope in Thee, our Maker, and Builder, and God![^1363]

items.english_text: Thee have we as a rampart, and haven, and an acceptable intercessor before God, Whom thou didst bear, O unwedded Theotokos, the salvation of the faithful!

provenance.verbatim_source: Thee have we as a rampart, and haven, and an acceptable intercessor before God, Whom thou didst bear, O unwedded Theotokos, the salvation of the faithful!

items.day_or_date: On Friday of Palm Week, at Matins
items.english_text: What shall we call you, O holy ones? Cherubim? For upon you Christ rested; Seraphim? For ye unceasingly glorified Him; Angels? For ye turned away from the body; Powers? Ye work in miracles; many are your names, and greater are your gifts; pray that our souls may be saved![^1364]

items.day_or_date: On Friday of Palm Week, at Matins
items.english_text: Great was your contest, O holy ones, having valiantly endured the torments of the lawless, and confessed Christ before kings; and having again departed this life, ye work powers in the world, and heal the infirm from their passions, O holy ones, praying that our souls may be saved!

items.day_or_date: On Friday of Palm Week, at Matins
items.english_text: O invincible martyrs of Christ, having conquered deceit by the power of the Cross, ye enjoy the grace of eternal life; of the threats of the torturers ye were not afraid; wounded by torments, ye made merry; and now your blood has become healings for our souls; pray that our souls may be saved!

items.english_text: Having clothed yourselves well in the breastplate of faith, and armed yourselves with the sign of the Cross, ye appeared as valiant soldiers;[^1365] ye manfully opposed the torturers and cast down the deceit of the devil; having become victors, ye were counted worthy of crowns; pray unceasingly for us, that we may be saved!

items.english_text: Thy death, O Lord, was the mediator of immortality; for if Thou hadst not been laid in the tomb, Paradise would not have been opened; therefore give rest unto those who have been translated, as the Lover of mankind!

provenance.verbatim_source: Thy death, O Lord, was the mediator of immortality; for if Thou hadst not been laid in the tomb, Paradise would not have been opened; therefore give rest unto those who have been translated, as the Lover of mankind!

items.english_text: O Pure Virgin, Gate of the Word, Mother of our God: Pray that we may be saved!

items.english_text: Bestowing upon me royal freedom, having stained Thy fingers with purple ink, O Master, and dipped them in Thine own blood; therefore in faith we pray Thee: Number with Thy firstborn, and count worthy to attain the joy of Thy righteous ones, those who have come unto Thee, the Compassionate One![^1366]

items.english_text: Having served as Priest as Man, and having been slain as a Lamb, Thou didst offer Thyself as an offering unto the Father, rescuing man from corruption; therefore, as the Lover of mankind, rank those who have been translated in the land of the living, where streams of sweetness pour forth, where fountains of everlasting being gush forth![^1367]

items.day_or_date: On Friday of Palm Week, at Matins
items.english_text: By the depth of Thine ineffable wisdom, Thou determinest life and foreseest the future, and translatest unto another life Thy servants whom Thou hast received; rank them therefore by the waters of rest, in the brightness of the saints, O Lord, where is the voice of rejoicing and praise![^1368]

items.english_text: Being the invisible Word, co-originate with the Father, and of one form with the Spirit, for my sake, a man, Thou didst appear in the flesh; as Thou art merciful and the Lover of mankind, enlighten with the beauties of Thy splendor and loveliness those who have come from this life, O Prince and Giver of life!
