items.english_text: At the Praises, 3 stichera of the feast from the aposticha of that day, and 3 of the Fathers. *Glory:* of the Fathers. *Both now:* of the feast. Great Doxology; Troparion of the Fathers. *Glory, both now:* of the feast; the litanies; and the dismissal. And the usual procession into the narthex; and the First Hour.

items.day_or_date: On Friday of Palm Week, at Matins
items.english_text: At the Divine Liturgy: the Beatitudes of the feast, the appointed ode to 4; and of the Fathers, Ode 6. After the Little Entrance, the Troparion of the feast, and of the Fathers, and of the temple of the Saint. Then the Kontakion of the temple of the Saint. *Glory:* of the Fathers. *Both now:* of the feast. Prokeimenon, Alleluia, and Communion Hymn of the feast, and of the Fathers; the Epistle and Gospel of the day, and of the Fathers.

items.english_text: *Instruction concerning the Feast of the Meeting of the Lord, on whatever day the Meeting occurs, or on whatever day its Apodosis occurs:*[^1430]

provenance.verbatim_source: *Instruction concerning the Feast of the Meeting of the Lord, on whatever day the Meeting occurs, or on whatever day its Apodosis occurs:*[^1430]

items.office: Order of the Markian Chapters
items.section: At the Aposticha, Stichera for the Departed, Tone 8, Podoben: "O most marvelous wonder" (Ѽ пресла́внагѡ чꙋдесѐ)
items.season_or_tone: MARKIAN CHAPTERS
items.day_or_date: On Friday of Palm Week, at Matins
items.english_text: If the Feast of the Meeting of the Lord occurs on the Sunday of the Prodigal Son, or on Monday, or on Tuesday of Meatfare Week, the feast is taken leave of on Friday of that same week; for on Meatfare Sunday there is no Apodosis.

provenance.verbatim_source: If the Feast of the Meeting of the Lord occurs on the Sunday of the Prodigal Son, or on Monday, or on Tuesday of Meatfare Week, the feast is taken leave of on Friday of that same week; for on Meatfare Sunday there is no Apodosis.

items.season_or_tone: MARKIAN CHAPTERS
items.day_or_date: On Friday of Palm Week, at Matins
items.english_text: If it occurs on Wednesday, or on Thursday, or on Friday, or on Saturday of Meatfare Week: its Apodosis is observed on Tuesday of Cheesefare Week.

provenance.verbatim_source: If it occurs on Wednesday, or on Thursday, or on Friday, or on Saturday of Meatfare Week: its Apodosis is observed on Tuesday of Cheesefare Week.

items.day_or_date: On Friday of Palm Week, at Matins
items.english_text: If it occurs on Meatfare Sunday, or on Monday of Cheesefare Week: its Apodosis is observed on Thursday of that same week.

provenance.verbatim_source: If it occurs on Meatfare Sunday, or on Monday of Cheesefare Week: its Apodosis is observed on Thursday of that same week.

items.english_text: If it occurs on Tuesday or on Wednesday of Cheesefare Week: its Apodosis is observed on Saturday of that same week.

provenance.verbatim_source: If it occurs on Tuesday or on Wednesday of Cheesefare Week: its Apodosis is observed on Saturday of that same week.

items.english_text: At **"God is the Lord"**, the Resurrection Troparion, twice. *Glory, both now:* of the feast. After the Kathismata, the Resurrection Sessional Hymns and their Theotokia; and the reading. And after the reading we chant the Polyeleos: the Psalm **"Praise ye the Name of the Lord"**, and the other Psalm **"O give thanks unto the Lord"**.

And after the reading we chant the Polyeleos: the Psalm **"Praise ye the Name of the Lord"**, and the other Psalm **"O give thanks unto the Lord"**.

items.section: At the Aposticha, Stichera for the Departed, Tone 8, Podoben: "O most marvelous wonder" (Ѽ пресла́внагѡ чꙋдесѐ)
items.season_or_tone: MARKIAN CHAPTERS
items.day_or_date: On Friday of Palm Week, at Matins
items.slavonic_text: Подоба́етъ вѣ́дати, а҆́ще слꙋчи́тсѧ ѡ҆брѣ́тенїе честны́ѧ Главы̀ І҆ѡа́нна Предте́чи въ недѣ́лю масопꙋ́стнꙋю, и҆лѝ сыропꙋ́стнꙋю: Начина́етсѧ съ среды̀ масопꙋ́стныѧ недѣ́ли, и҆ восхо́дитъ до вто́рника а҃-ѧ недѣ́ли вели́кагѡ поста̀. Въ сꙋббѡ́тꙋ на ма́лѣй вече́рни, стїхи̑ры воскре́сны д҃: и҆ Бг҃оро́диченъ гла́са. На стїхо́внѣ стїхи́ра воскре́сна є҆ди́на, и҆ Предте́чи стїхо́вна. По Нн҃ѣ ѿпꙋща́еши: тропа́рь воскре́сенъ: Сла́ва, Предте́чи: И҆ ны́нѣ, Бг҃оро́диченъ воскре́сенъ. Е҆ктенїа̀ ма́лаѧ, и҆ ѿпꙋ́стъ. На вели́цѣй вече́рни, На Гдⷭ҇и воззва́хъ, стїхи̑ры воскре́сны, трѝ: и҆ Трїѡ́ди д҃, и҆ Предте́чи г҃. А҆́ще ли недѣ́лѧ сыропꙋ́стнаѧ: пое́мъ стїхи̑ры воскре́сны, г҃: и҆ восто́ченъ а҃: и҆ Трїѡ́ди, в҃: и҆ Предте́чи, г҃: Сла́ва, Трїѡ́ди: И҆ ны́нѣ, Бг҃оро́диченъ пе́рвый гла́са. На лїті́и, стїхи́ра хра́ма: И҆ Трїѡ́ди хвали́тны, пе́рвый сті́хъ, гла́съ ѕ҃: Помышля́ю де́нь ѻ҆́нъ: в҃-й, гла́съ то́йже: Ѡ҆ каковы́й ча́съ тогда̀, и҆ де́нь: А҆́ще ли нл҃ѧ сыропꙋ́стнаѧ, глаго́лемъ Трїѡ́ди та́кожде а҃-й сті́хъ, гла́съ є҃: Оу҆вы̀ мнѣ̀, А҆да́мъ рыда́нїемъ возопѝ: в҃-й, гла́съ то́йже: По́прище добродѣ́телей ѿве́рзеся: Сла́ва, Предте́чи, гла́съ ѕ҃: Сокро́вище бж҃е́ственныхъ даро́въ: И҆ ны́нѣ, Трїѡ́ди, пи́санъ на лїті́и Сла́вникъ. На стїхо́внѣ стїхи̑ры воскре́сны: Сла́ва, Предте́чи, гла́съ в҃: Ꙗ҆́коже бж҃е́ственныхъ: И҆ ны́нѣ, Трїѡ́ди. На благослове́ніи хлѣ́бѡвъ тропа́рь, Бцⷣе Дв҃о: три́жды. И҆ чте́нїе въ посла́нїихъ а҆пⷭ҇льскихъ. На ᲂу҆́тренни, На Бг҃ъ Гдⷭ҇ь, тропа́рь воскре́сенъ, два́жды: Сла́ва, Предте́чи: И҆ ны́нѣ, Бг҃оро́диченъ а҃-й, въ то́йже гла́съ. По каѳі́смахъ, сѣда́льны воскре́сны, съ Бг҃оро́дичны и҆́хъ. И҆ чте́нїе по є҆ѵа́лїи толково́мъ. Та́же, Хвали́те и҆́мѧ Гдⷭ҇не: и҆ И҆сповѣ́дайтеся: гле́мъ же и҆ г҃-й ѱало́мъ: На рѣка́хъ вавѷлѡ́нскихъ, со а҆ллилꙋ́їею. Та́же пое́мъ ѱало́мъ и҆збра́нный Предте́чи, и҆ тропарѝ: А҆́гг҃льскїй собо́ръ: и҆ сѣда́льны ѻ҆́ба по є҆ди́ножды. Сла́ва, по полѷеле́и сѣда́ленъ: И҆ ны́нѣ, Бг҃оро́диченъ: И҆ чте́нїе Предте́чи. Степе́нна, и҆ проки́менъ гла́са. Вся́кое дыха́нїе: Е҆ѵа́лїе воскре́сно. Воскрⷭ҇нїе Хрⷭ҇то́во: Канѡ́нъ воскре́сенъ со і҆рмосо́мъ на д҃: и҆ Трїѡ́ди на ѕ҃: и҆ Предте́чи на д҃. Катава́сїа Трїѡ́ди. А҆́ще нл҃ѧ сыропꙋ́стнаѧ: Канѡ́нъ воскрⷭ҇нъ, со і҆рмосо́мъ на д҃: И҆ Бцⷣы на в҃: И҆ Трїѡ́ди на д҃: и҆ Предте́чи на д҃. Катава́сїа Трїѡ́ди. По г҃-й пѣ́сни, конда́къ и҆ і҆́косъ Предте́чи, и҆ сѣда́ленъ є҆гѡ̀, два́жды. Сла́ва, и҆ ны́нѣ, Трїѡ́ди. И҆ чте́нїе Предте́чи. По ѕ҃-й пѣ́сни, конда́къ Трїѡ́ди, и҆ і҆́косъ: И҆ сѷнаѯа́рїй. На ѳ҃-й пѣ́сни пое́мъ Чтⷭ҇нѣ́йшꙋю: свѣти́ленъ воскрⷭ҇нъ. Сла́ва, Предте́чи: И҆ ны́нѣ, Трїѡ́ди. На хвали́техъ стїхи̑ры воскре́сны д҃: и҆ ст҃а́гѡ со Сла́внымъ д҃, съ припѣ̑вы є҆гѡ̀. И҆ по стїхи́рахъ ст҃а́гѡ, гле́мъ: Воскреснѝ Гдⷭ҇и Бж҃е мо́й: И҆ пое́мъ стїхи́рꙋ самогла́снꙋ Трїѡ́ди, гла́съ ѕ҃: Данїи́лъ проро́къ: Сла́ва, гла́съ а҃: Предѡчи́стимъ себѐ бра́тїе: И҆ ны́нѣ, Преблагослове́нна є҆сѝ. А҆́ще недѣ́лѧ сыропꙋ́стнаѧ: гле́мъ та́кожде припѣ́въ: Воскреснѝ Гдⷭ҇и Бж҃е мо́й: и҆ пое́мъ стїхи́рꙋ самогла́снꙋ, Трїѡ́ди, гла́съ є҃: А҆да́мъ и҆зъ раѧ̀: Сла́ва, гла́съ то́йже: Приспѣ̀ вре́мѧ: И҆ ны́нѣ, Преблагослове́нна є҆сѝ: Славосло́вїе вели́кое. По трист҃о́мъ, тропа́рь воскре́сенъ: Е҆ктенїѝ, и҆ ѿпꙋ́стъ, и҆ и҆схожде́нїе ѻ҆бы́чное въ притво́ръ. Сла́ва, и҆ ны́нѣ, стїхи́ра є҆ѵа́льскаѧ, и҆ ча́съ пе́рвый. На часѣ́хъ, тропа́рь воскре́сенъ. Сла́ва, Предте́чи: И҆ ны́нѣ, Бг҃оро́диченъ часѡ́въ. По Ѻ҆́ч҃е на́шъ, конда́къ Трїѡ́ди, и҆ Предте́чи премѣня́юще гле́мъ. На Літургі́и, Блаже́нна гла́са, на д҃: и҆ Трїѡ́ди, пѣ́снь г҃-ѧ на д҃: и҆ Предте́чи ѕ҃-ѧ на д҃. По вхо́дѣ тропа́рь воскрⷭ҇нъ, и҆ Предте́чи. Сла́ва, конда́къ є҆гѡ̀: И҆ ны́нѣ, Трїѡ́ди. Проки́менъ, а҆́пⷭ҇лъ, є҆ѵа́лїе, и҆ прича́стенъ, пре́жде днѐ, и҆ Предте́чи.

items.season_or_tone: MARKIAN CHAPTERS
items.day_or_date: On Friday of Palm Week, at Matins
items.slavonic_text: А҆́ще слꙋчи́тсѧ ѡ҆брѣ́тенїе честны́ѧ Главы̀ І҆ѡа́нна Предте́чи въ понедѣ́льникъ, и҆лѝ во вто́рникъ, сы́рныѧ недѣ́ли. Въ нл҃ю ве́чера пое́мъ, Бл҃же́нъ мꙋ́жъ, а҃-й а҆нтїфѡ́нъ: [въ про́чыѧ же дни̑ седми́цы сы́рныѧ гле́тся каѳі́сма рядова́ѧ.] На Гдⷭ҇и воззва́хъ, стїхи̑ры Предте́чи на ѕ҃. Сла́ва, Предте́чи: И҆ ны́нѣ, Бг҃оро́диченъ воскре́сенъ, въ то́йже гла́съ. Проки́менъ днѐ, и҆ паремїѝ Предте́чи. На стїхо́внѣ Трїѡ́ди самогла́сенъ днѐ, два́жды: и҆ Мч҃нченъ. Сла́ва, Предте́чи: И҆ ны́нѣ, Бг҃оро́диченъ. Тропа́рь Предте́чи: Сла́ва, и҆ ны́нѣ, Бг҃оро́диченъ воскре́сенъ, и҆ є҆ктенїа̀. На ᲂу҆́тренни, на Бг҃ъ Гдⷭ҇ь, тропа́рь Предте́чи, два́жды: Сла́ва, и҆ ны́нѣ, Бг҃оро́диченъ. И҆ ѻ҆бы̑чныѧ каѳі́смы. По а҃-й каѳі́смѣ сѣда́ленъ Трїѡ́ди. И҆ чте́нїе Предте́чи. items.slavonic_text: А҆́ще ли слꙋчи́тсѧ ѡ҆брѣ́тенїе чтны́ѧ Главы̀ І҆ѡа́нна Предте́чи въ средꙋ сы́рныѧ седми́цы. И҆ пое́мъ слꙋ́жбꙋ всю̀ Предте́чи ве́черъ и҆ ᲂу҆́тро во вто́рникъ сы́рныѧ недѣ́ли:
items.english_text: At Matins: At "God is the Lord," the Resurrection troparion, twice; Glory: Of the Forerunner; Both now: The first Theotokion in the same Tone. After the Kathismata: Resurrection sessional hymns, with their Theotokia. And a reading from the Explanatory Gospel. Then: "Praise ye the name of the Lord," and "Give thanks unto the Lord"; we say also the third psalm: "By the rivers of Babylon," with Alleluia. Then we chant the selected psalm of the Forerunner, and the troparia: "The angelic assembly"; and both sessional hymns, once each. Glory: Sessional hymn after the Polyeleos; Both now: Theotokion; and a reading of the Forerunner. The Anabathmoi, and the Prokeimenon of the Tone. "Let every breath"; Resurrection Gospel. "Having seen the Resurrection of Christ"; Resurrection canon with the heirmos on 4; and of the Triodion on 6; and of the Forerunner on 4. Katavasia of the Triodion.

items.slavonic_text: А҆́ще же въ пѧто́къ. И҆ пое́мъ слꙋ́жбꙋ є҆гѡ̀ въ четве́ртокъ.
items.english_text: If it is Cheesefare Sunday: Resurrection canon, with the heirmos on 4; and of the Theotokos on 2; and of the Triodion on 4; and of the Forerunner on 4. Katavasia of the Triodion. After Ode 3: Kontakion and Ikos of the Forerunner, and his sessional hymn, twice. Glory, both now: Of the Triodion. And a reading of the Forerunner. After Ode 6: Kontakion of the Triodion, and the Ikos; and the Synaxarion. At Ode 9 we chant "More honorable"; Resurrection exapostilarion. Glory: Of the Forerunner; Both now: Of the Triodion. At the Praises: Resurrection stichera, 4; and of the saint with the Doxasticon, 4, with his refrains. And after the stichera of the saint, we say: "Arise, O Lord my God"; and we chant the automelon sticheron of the Triodion, Tone 6: "Daniel the prophet"; Glory, Tone 1: "Let us purify ourselves beforehand, brethren"; Both now: "Most blessed art thou."

items.season_or_tone: MARKIAN CHAPTERS
items.day_or_date: On Friday of Palm Week, at Matins
items.slavonic_text: А҆́ще слꙋчи́тсѧ ѡ҆брѣ́тенїе честны́ѧ Главы̀ въ четверто́къ сы́рный. Въ средꙋ на часѣ́хъ, по Ѡ҆сла́би ѡ҆ста́ви, и҆ по покло́нѣхъ быва́етъ зво́нъ по ѻ҆бы́чаю, и҆ а҆́бїе глаго́лемъ: Прїиди́те поклони́мся, три́жды, и҆ ѱало́мъ ѻ҆бы́чный: и҆ є҆ктенїа̀, и҆ стїхи̑ры по предпи́санномꙋ. По вхо́дѣ проки́менъ, паремїѝ днѐ: И҆ по си́хъ, проки́менъ: Да ᲂу҆пова́етъ І҆и҃ль на Гдⷭ҇а. Та́же паремїѝ ст҃а́гѡ г҃. Посе́мъ, Сподо́би Гдⷭ҇и: На стїхо́внѣ Трїѡ́ди самогла́сенъ днѐ, два́жды: и҆ мч҃нченъ. Сла́ва, Предте́чи: И҆ ны́нѣ, Бг҃оро́диченъ. По Нн҃ѣ ѿпꙋща́еши, трист҃о́е. По Ѻ҆́ч҃е на́шъ: тропа́рь Предте́чи. Сла́ва, и҆ ны́нѣ, Бг҃оро́диченъ воскре́сенъ, и҆ є҆ктенїа̀: Поми́лꙋй на́съ Бж҃е: и҆ г҃ покло́ны вели́кїѧ. Посе́мъ м҃тва, Всест҃а́ѧ Трⷪ҇це: и҆ Бꙋ́ди и҆́мѧ Гдⷭ҇не, три́жды: съ покло́ны, и҆ ѱало́мъ л҃г. Та́же, Досто́йно є҆́сть: и҆ ѿпꙋ́стъ. И҆ вхо́димъ въ трапе́зꙋ и҆ разрѣша́емъ на сы́ръ и҆ ꙗ҆́йца.
items.english_text: And if it is Cheesefare Sunday: We likewise say the refrain: "Arise, O Lord my God"; and we chant the automelon sticheron of the Triodion, Tone 5: "Adam sat over against Paradise"; Glory, the same Tone: "The time has drawn near"; Both now: "Most blessed art thou." Great Doxology. After the Trisagion: Resurrection troparion; the litanies, and the dismissal, and the customary departure into the narthex. Glory, both now: Gospel sticheron, and the First Hour. At the Hours: Resurrection troparion; Glory: Of the Forerunner; Both now: Theotokion of the Hours. After the "Our Father": The kontakion of the Triodion and of the Forerunner, alternating, we say. At the Liturgy: The Beatitudes of the Tone, on 4; and of the Triodion, Ode 3, on 4; and of the Forerunner, Ode 6, on 4. After the Entrance: Resurrection troparion, and of the Forerunner. Glory: His kontakion; Both now: Of the Triodion. Prokeimenon, Apostle, Gospel, and Communion verse: First of the day, and of the Forerunner.

Сла́ва, ѻ҆тє́цъ: И҆ ны́нѣ, Хра́ма Бцⷣы: и҆лѝ, Предста́тельство Хрⷭ҇тїа́нъ: Проки́менъ, а҆́пⷭ҇лъ, а҆ллилꙋ́їа, є҆ѵа́лїе, и҆ прича́стенъ, пре́жде Предте́чи, и҆ пото́мъ ѻ҆тє́цъ. items.english_text: At Matins: At "God is the Lord," the troparion of the Forerunner, twice; Glory, both now: Theotokion. And the customary Kathismata. After the first Kathisma: Sessional hymn of the Triodion; and a reading of the Forerunner. Polyeleos, and the sessional hymn of the Forerunner, twice, and his Theotokion; and a reading of the Forerunner. The Anabathmoi, the first antiphon of Tone 4; Prokeimenon of the Forerunner. "Let every breath"; Gospel of the Forerunner. Then Psalm 50; sticheron of the Forerunner. Canon of the Theotokos, with the heirmos on 6; and of the Forerunner on 8. Katavasia: "I will open my mouth." But where there is a triode, we chant the canon of the Forerunner, with the heirmos on 6; and of the Triodion on 8. After Ode 3: Sessional hymn of the Forerunner, twice; Glory, both now: Theotokion, and a reading of the Forerunner. After Ode 6: Kontakion of the Forerunner, and the Ikos, and the Prologue. After Ode 9: Exapostilarion of the Forerunner, twice; Glory, both now: His Theotokion. At the Praises: Stichera of the Forerunner, on 4. Glory: Of the Forerunner; Both now: Theotokion. At the Aposticha: Idiomelon of the day from the Triodion, twice; and the Martyr-hymn. Glory: Of the Forerunner: "He who previously upon a platter"; Both now: Theotokion; and the customary prichal, and the dismissal. And the First Hour: Troparion of the Forerunner; and after the Trisagion, his kontakion. Likewise also at the other Hours. At the Liturgy: The Beatitudes of the Forerunner, Odes 3 and 6; Prokeimenon, Apostle, Alleluia, Gospel, and Communion verse of the day, and of the Forerunner.

items.english_text: On Wednesday at the Hours, after "Remit, forgive," and after the prostrations, there is ringing of the bells according to custom, and immediately we say: "Come, let us worship," three times, and the customary Psalm; and the litany, and the stichera according to what is prescribed. After the Entrance: Prokeimenon and the Old Testament readings of the day; and after these, the Prokeimenon: "Let Israel hope in the Lord." Then the Old Testament readings of the saint, 3. After this: "Vouchsafe, O Lord." At the Aposticha: Idiomelon of the day from the Triodion, twice; and the Martyr-hymn. Glory: Of the Forerunner; Both now: Theotokion. After "Now lettest Thou Thy servant depart," the Trisagion. After the "Our Father": Troparion of the Forerunner; Glory, both now: Resurrection Theotokion, and the litany: "Have mercy on us, O God"; and 3 great prostrations. After this, the prayer: "All-Holy Trinity"; and "Blessed be the name of the Lord," three times, with prostrations, and Psalm 33. Then: "It is truly meet," and the dismissal. And we enter into the refectory and dispense for cheese and eggs.

items.english_text: On Friday evening, we chant: "Blessed is the man," the first antiphon. At "Lord, I have cried": Stichera of the Forerunner, podoben, 3; and of the Fathers, 3. Glory: Of the Forerunner; Both now: Theotokion, the first of the Tone. Entrance, Prokeimenon of the day, and the Old Testament reading; and after it the Prokeimenon, Tone 6: "Let Israel hope in the Lord." Then the Old Testament readings of the Forerunner. "Vouchsafe, O Lord, in this evening"; and the litany: "Let us complete our evening prayer." At the Aposticha: Idiomelon of the day from the Triodion, twice; and the Martyr-hymn. Then the refrain: "The righteous man shall be glad"; and we chant the automelon sticheron of the Forerunner, Tone 6: "He who previously upon a platter"; Glory: Of the Fathers, Tone 8: "The multitudes of monastics"; Both now: Theotokion, in the same Tone. Troparion of the Forerunner; Glory: Of the Fathers; Both now: Theotokion: "The mystery hidden from the ages." We chant the litany: "Have mercy on us, O God"; and 3 great prostrations. Then: "All-Holy Trinity"; and "Blessed be the name of the Lord," three times, and Psalm 33: "I will bless the Lord"; and the dismissal. In the refectory, we dispense for cheese and eggs.

Great Doxology; troparion of the Forerunner; Glory: Of the Fathers; Both now: Theotokion; and the departure into the narthex, and the First Hour. At the Hours: Troparion of the Forerunner; Glory: Of the Fathers; Both now: Theotokion of the Hours. After the "Our Father": The kontakion of the Forerunner and of the Fathers, alternating, we say.

items.english_text: The prayers of Basil the Great after the Hours we say without change, namely: "O Master, God the Father," and "O God and Lord of hosts," and "O Master, Lord Jesus Christ." When we chant the Polyeleos, at the Hours we do not strike the bell. After the Kathisma: Alleluia, three times; then: "Lord, have mercy," three times; and the reader says: "Glory," the troparion of the Forerunner; "Both now," the Theotokion of the Hours. After the "Our Father": Kontakion of the Forerunner. After "More honorable," 3 great prostrations. After the Ninth Hour, the Beatitudes we say quickly without chanting. After "Remit, forgive": Kontakion of the Temple; Glory: Of the Forerunner; Both now: Of the Temple of the Theotokos. But if there is no Temple of the Theotokos: "Both now: Steadfast Protectress of Christians." After this: "Lord, have mercy," 40. Glory, both now: "More honorable than the Cherubim"; and 10 great prostrations. Then the prayer: "All-Holy Trinity." And we begin Vespers according to custom: The superior or reader says: "Come, let us worship," three times. And we chant Vespers with prostrations, according to the Lenten order. After the customary Kathisma, at "Lord, I have cried," stichera on 10: Idiomelon of the day from the Triodion, twice; and the Martyr-hymn; and podoben of the Triodion, 3; and of the Forerunner, 4. Glory: Of the Forerunner; Both now: The customary Theotokion according to the Tone. But if toward Wednesday or Friday, we say the Stavrotheotokion, according to the Tone of the Doxasticon. Entrance with the Gospel. "O Joyful Light"; and the Prokeimenon, and the readings of the day. "Let my prayer be set forth"; and 3 great prostrations. Small litanies we do not say. Prokeimenon, Apostle, Alleluia, Gospel of the Forerunner. Communion verse: "In everlasting remembrance"; and of the Forerunner. The Liturgy of the Presanctified according to custom.

items.english_text: And if, by reason of any great necessity, on the commemoration of great saints having a Polyeleos, it should not happen that the Presanctified Liturgy is celebrated, we chant the Hours as said above.[^1442] After the Ninth Hour, and after the prayer: "O Master, Lord Jesus Christ," we say also the psalm: "Bless the Lord, O my soul"; Glory: "Praise the Lord, O my soul"; Both now: "Only-begotten Son and Word"; and "In Thy Kingdom," quickly without chanting. At the Beatitudes we say of the Forerunner, Odes 3 and 6. Then the Apostle and the Gospel of the Forerunner. After this: "Remember us, O Lord." But if there is no Temple of the Theotokos: "Steadfast Protectress of Christians." Then: "Lord, have mercy," 40. And 3 great prostrations, and at that time the paraecclesiarch tolls two bells.[^1443]

items.english_text: And after the three great prostrations we say: "Come, let us worship." And we chant VESPERS, with prostrations, and the customary Kathisma. At "Lord, I have cried": Stichera of the Triodion, podoben, 3; and of Saint Tarasios, 3.[^1444] Glory, both now: Theotokion. But if toward Wednesday or Friday, we say: Glory, both now: Stavrotheotokion. Then: "O Joyful Light"; Prokeimenon, and the reading of the Triodion of the day. At the Aposticha, of the day from the Triodion. After "Now lettest Thou Thy servant depart," and after the "Our Father": Troparion: "O Theotokos Virgin, rejoice"; and the rest according to the Lenten order. After "More honorable," and after the prostrations, we say the Trisagion; "Lord, have mercy," 12; "All-Holy Trinity." After the dismissal we enter into the refectory, and eat two cooked dishes with oil, and drink wine. On Wednesday and Friday, however, we eat two cooked dishes without oil, and drink wine.

items.section: At the Aposticha, Stichera for the Departed, Tone 8, Podoben: "O most marvelous wonder" (Ѽ пресла́внагѡ чꙋдесѐ)
items.season_or_tone: MARKIAN CHAPTERS

items.english_text: We chant his service thus: At the Hours, after "Remit, forgive," and after the "Our Father": Kontakion according to the Typikon. Then: "Lord, have mercy," 40; Glory, both now: "More honorable than the Cherubim"; and after the prostrations we say the Trisagion; "Lord, have mercy," 12; and "All-Holy Trinity." And immediately we begin Vespers; and the customary Kathisma. Small litanies are said after each antiphon. At "Lord, I have cried": Stichera on 10: Idiomelon of the day, twice; and the Martyr-hymn; and podoben of the Triodion, 3; and of the Forerunner, 4. Glory: Of the Forerunner; Both now: "Who would not call thee blessed." Entrance. Then the Prokeimenon, and the reading of the day; and of the Forerunner, 3 readings. Then we chant: "Let my prayer be set forth"; and 10 prostrations. And in order, the Liturgy of the Presanctified. And where there is no Presanctified, after "Remit, forgive," and after the great prostrations, the reader says: "Come, let us worship," three times, and 3 prostrations. Then the psalm: "Bless the Lord, O my soul"; and we chant Vespers without prostrations. After the customary Kathisma: Stichera on 6: Of the Triodion, podoben, 3; and of the Forerunner, 3. Glory: Of the Forerunner; Both now: Theotokion: "Who would not call thee blessed." Entrance, and "O Joyful Light"; Prokeimenon; and the reading of the day, and of the Forerunner; and immediately: "Vouchsafe, O Lord." Then: "Let us complete our evening prayer." At the Aposticha, of the Triodion; Glory: Of the Forerunner; Both now: Theotokion according to the Tone. "Now lettest Thou Thy servant depart." After the Trisagion: Troparion of the Forerunner; Glory, both now: "The mystery hidden from the ages." Litany: "Have mercy on us, O God." After this, 3 great prostrations, and the prayer: "All-Holy Trinity"; and "I will bless the Lord"; "It is truly meet"; and the dismissal. We chant Great Compline without prostrations. After the first Trisagion: Troparion of the Forerunner; Glory, both now: Resurrection Theotokion according to the Tone. After the second Trisagion: The customary troparia: "Have mercy on us, O Lord." After "It is truly meet," and after the Trisagion: Kontakion of the Forerunner; and "O Lord of hosts, be with us," we do not chant. After "More honorable," three great prostrations; prostrations; the Trisagion we do not say, but the small dismissal. The Midnight Office we chant according to custom, with the Kathisma, as prescribed on Monday of the Second Week of the Fast. Likewise also Matins, and the entire service of the Forerunner.

items.english_text: On Friday evening, the appointed Kathisma. At "Lord, I have cried": Stichera on 10; idiomelon of the Triodion, twice; and of the Octoechos, Martyr-hymns, 4. Glory: Of the Forerunner; Both now: The first Theotokion of the Tone. Entrance, Prokeimenon, and the reading of the day; and of the Forerunner, 3. "Let my prayer be set forth"; and the rest of the Presanctified. But if there is no Presanctified: At "Lord, I have cried," stichera of the Forerunner, on 6; Glory: Of the Forerunner; Both now: The first Theotokion of the Tone. Entrance, Prokeimenon, and reading of the day, and of the saint. Then: "Vouchsafe, O Lord." At the Aposticha: Idiomelon of the Triodion, twice; and the Martyr-hymn of the Octoechos, according to the Tone. Glory: Of the Forerunner; Both now: Theotokion. After "Now lettest Thou Thy servant depart": Troparion of the Forerunner; Glory, both now: Resurrection Theotokion of the current Tone. Litany, and 3 prostrations. Then the prayer: "All-Holy Trinity"; "Blessed be the name of the Lord"; and Psalm 33: "I will bless the Lord"; "It is truly meet"; and the dismissal.

items.english_text: On Saturday evening, at Small Vespers: Resurrection stichera, and of the Theotokos according to custom. At Great Vespers: At "Lord, I have cried," Resurrection stichera, 3; and Anatolian, 1; and of the Forerunner, on 6. Glory: Of the Forerunner; Both now: The first Theotokion of the Tone. Entrance, and the readings of the Forerunner. At the Litiya: The sticheron of the Temple; and the Aposticha of the Forerunner. At the Aposticha: Resurrection stichera, alphabetically. Glory: Of the Forerunner; Both now: Theotokion. At the Blessing of the Loaves: "O Theotokos Virgin," three times. And a reading in the Apostolic Epistles. At "God is the Lord": Resurrection troparion, twice; Glory: Of the Forerunner; Both now: Theotokion, according to the Tone of the troparion. After the Kathismata: Resurrection sessional hymns, and their Theotokia; and a reading in the Gospel. Polyeleos, and the sessional hymns of the Forerunner, both. Glory: Sessional hymn after the Polyeleos; Both now: Theotokion; and a reading of the Forerunner. The Anabathmoi, and the Prokeimenon of the Tone; and the Resurrection Gospel. Psalm 50. Glory: Sticheron, Tone 2: "Open unto me the gates of repentance"; and the rest. Resurrection canon, with the heirmos on 4; and of the Triodion on 4; and of the Forerunner on 6. Katavasia: "I will open my mouth." After Ode 3: Kontakion of the Triodion; then the kontakion of the Forerunner, and the Ikos, and his sessional hymn, twice. Glory, both now: Theotokion; and a reading of the Forerunner. After Ode 6: Kontakion and Ikos of the Forerunner, and the Synaxarion. At Ode 9 we chant "More honorable"; Resurrection exapostilarion; Glory: Of the Forerunner; Both now: Of the Triodion. At the Praises: Resurrection stichera, 4; and of the Forerunner, 4, with the Doxasticon, and his refrains. Then the refrain: "Arise, O Lord my God"; and we chant the automelon sticheron of the Triodion: Tone 6: "Daniel the prophet"; Glory: Of the Forerunner; Both now: "Most blessed art thou." Great Doxology, and the rest according to custom. At the Liturgy: The Beatitudes of the Tone, on 4; and of the Forerunner, Ode 3, on 4; and of the Triodion, Ode 6, on 4. After the Entrance: Resurrection troparion, and of the Forerunner. Glory: His kontakion; Both now: Of the Triodion. Prokeimenon, Apostle, Gospel, and Communion verse: First of the day, and of the Forerunner.

items.english_text: On Saturday at Small Vespers: Resurrection stichera, 4; and of the Theotokos according to custom. At the Aposticha: Resurrection sticheron, 1; and of the Cross, automelon, 3; Glory, both now: Of the Cross. Troparion of the Cross; Glory: Of the Forerunner; Both now: Theotokion of the Tone. At Great Vespers: "Blessed is the man," the entire Kathisma. At "Lord, I have cried": Resurrection stichera, 3; and of the Cross, podoben, 3; and of the Forerunner, podoben, 4. Glory: Of the Cross, Tone 3: "O Christ our God"; Both now: The first Theotokion of the Tone. Entrance, Prokeimenon, and the readings of the Forerunner, 3. At the Litiya: The sticheron of the Temple; and of the Cross, the automelon, Tone 2: "Hail, life-bearing Cross"; and of the Forerunner, 2; Glory: Of the Forerunner; Both now: Of the Cross. At the Aposticha: Resurrection stichera, alphabetically; Glory: Of the Cross; Both now: Theotokion according to the Tone. At the Blessing of the Loaves: Troparion of the Cross, twice; and of the Forerunner, once; and a reading in the Apostolic Epistles.

Polyeleos, and the sessional hymns of the Forerunner, all once each; Glory: Sessional hymn after the Polyeleos; Both now: Theotokion; and a reading of the Forerunner. The Anabathmoi, and the Prokeimenon of the Tone; and the Resurrection Gospel. "Having seen the Resurrection of Christ"; Psalm 50. Glory: "Open unto me the gates of repentance"; and the rest. Resurrection canon on 4; and of the Cross on 4; and of the Forerunner on 6. Katavasia of the Cross: "Moses the divine." After Ode 3: Kontakion of the Forerunner, and the Ikos; and the sessional hymn of the Cross; Glory: Of the Forerunner; Both now: Sessional hymn of the Cross. After Ode 6: Kontakion of the Cross, and the Ikos, and the Synaxarion. At Ode 9 we chant "More honorable"; Resurrection exapostilarion; Glory: Of the Forerunner; Both now: Of the Cross. At the Praises: Resurrection stichera, 4; and of the Cross, 3; and of the Forerunner with the Doxasticon, 4, with his refrains. Glory: Of the Cross; Both now: "Most blessed art thou." Great Doxology, and the procession of the Precious Cross according to custom. At the Liturgy: The Beatitudes of the Tone, on 4; and of the Cross, Ode 3, on 4; and of the Forerunner, Ode 6, on 4. Instead of the Trisagion: "Before Thy Cross." Prokeimenon, Apostle, Gospel, and Communion verse: First of the Sunday, then of the Cross, and of the Forerunner.

items.english_text: On the eve, at the Ninth Hour, we say the troparion and kontakion of the day from the Triodion. After the prayer of Saint Ephrem: "Come, let us worship," three times, with 3 prostrations; and the reader begins the prooemiac Psalm. And we chant Vespers with Kathisma and prostrations. At "Lord, I have cried": Stichera on 10; idiomelon of the day from the Triodion, twice; and the Martyr-hymn; and podoben of the Triodion, 3; and of the forefeast, 4. Glory, both now: Of the forefeast. Entrance, Prokeimenon, and the readings of the day. "Let my prayer be set forth"; and the rest of the Presanctified. But if there is no Presanctified, at "Lord, I have cried," stichera on 6: Podoben of the Triodion, 3; and of the forefeast, 3. Glory, both now: Of the forefeast. Entrance, "O Joyful Light"; Prokeimenon and the readings of the day. Then: "Vouchsafe, O Lord." At the Aposticha: Idiomelon of the day from the Triodion, twice; and the Martyr-hymn. Glory, both now: Of the forefeast. After "Now lettest Thou Thy servant depart": Troparion of the forefeast; and 3 great prostrations, and the dismissal.

items.english_text: And if it is a fast day, we begin Vespers without Kathisma, and without prostrations. At "Lord, I have cried": We set 10 verses, and we chant in the Triodion the idiomelon of the day, twice; and the podoben, 3; and of the feast, 2, repeating two, Tone 6, podoben: "Having set aside all": "The pre-eternal Counsel"; Glory, both now, the same Tone: "The Archangel Gabriel was sent." Entrance. "O Joyful Light"; Prokeimenon. And the readings of the day; and of the feast, 3: First, from Genesis: "Jacob went forth from the well"; second, from the Prophecy of Ezekiel: "It shall come to pass from the eighth day"; third, from Proverbs: "Wisdom has built a house for herself." Then: "Let my prayer be set forth"; and three great prostrations; and the rest of the Presanctified. But if there is no Presanctified: At "Lord, I have cried," stichera: Podoben of the Triodion, 3; and of the feast, 5; Glory, both now: "The Archangel Gabriel was sent." Entrance, Prokeimenon, and readings of the day; and of the feast, 3. Then: "Vouchsafe, O Lord." At the Aposticha: Idiomelon of the day, twice; and the Martyr-hymn; Glory, both now: "Today is the joy." After "Now lettest Thou Thy servant depart": Troparion of the feast. Litany, and three great prostrations, and the dismissal. In the refectory, we dispense for wine and oil, on whatever day it occurs, unto the glory of the Most Holy Theotokos.

items.english_text: The readings are read first of the day, and after these of the feast, 5: First: "Moses went in"; second: "The Lord created Me"; third: "Jacob went forth"; fourth: "It shall come to pass from the eighth day"; fifth: "Wisdom has built a house for herself." Similarly 5 readings of the feast are read if the Annunciation occurs also on a Sunday. But if it is a fast day, 3 are read in the evening, as written above; and at the Liturgy, 2: "Moses went in," and "The Lord created Me." At the first hour of the night, they strike the great bell sufficiently, and then all the bells. And having assembled in the church, the priest having given the blessing, and censing, we chant Great Compline, and "God is with us," with chanting, in Tone 8, by both choirs. And the customary troparia: "The day having passed." After the first Trisagion: Troparion of the feast: "Today is the fountainhead of our salvation"; after the second Trisagion: Kontakion of the feast: "To thee, the Champion Leader." And after the "Glory to God in the highest," we make the departure into the narthex. And the Litiya takes place according to custom, and we chant the idiomela stichera of the feast, 3, Tone 1; Glory, both now, Tone 2: "Gabriel announces the good tidings." Then the priest says the customary prayers of the vigil; and having entered into the church, we chant at the Aposticha the stichera of the feast, Tone 4, with the refrains of the feast: First: "Proclaim the good tidings of the salvation of our God from day to day"; second: "Sing unto the Lord a new song, sing unto the Lord, all the earth." Glory, both now, the same Tone: "Today is the joy of the Annunciation." At the Blessing of the Loaves: Troparion, Tone 4: "Today is the fountainhead of our salvation," three times. And "Blessed be the name of the Lord," with chanting, three times; Psalm 33: "I will bless the Lord," unto "They that seek the Lord shall not want any good thing." And the blessed loaves are distributed to the brethren, according to custom; and a reading of the feast.

items.day_or_date: On Friday of Palm Week, at Matins
items.english_text: At Matins: At "God is the Lord," troparion of the feast, three times; and we say three Kathismata. After the first Kathisma: Sessional hymns of the Triodion, both, without litany; and a reading of the day. After the second Kathisma: Litany, and sessional hymn of the feast, Tone 1, podoben: "Thy tomb": "The great commander"; Glory, both now: The same; and a reading of the feast. After the third Kathisma: Sessional hymn of the feast, Tone 3, podoben: "Awe-struck by the beauty of thy virginity": "Today all creation rejoices"; Glory, both now: The same. And after the reading, candles are given to the brethren. After the Polyeleos: Sessional hymn, Tone 4, podoben: "Joseph was astonished": "Gabriel from heaven"; Glory, both now, the same Tone: "Gabriel was sent unto the Virgin"; and a reading of the feast. The Anabathmoi, the first antiphon of Tone 4; Prokeimenon, Tone 4: "Proclaim the good tidings of the salvation of our God from day to day"; Verse: "Sing unto the Lord a new song." "Let every breath." Gospel of Luke, pericope 4: "Mary arose." After Psalm 50: Sticheron of the feast, Tone 2: "Gabriel announces the good tidings." Canon of the feast: The composition of Kyr Theophanes, Tone 4: The heirmoi twice, troparia on 12. Katavasia of the feast. But where there is a triode: We chant the canon of the feast, with the heirmos on 6, and the triode on 8. Katavasia: Heirmos of the Triodion, both choirs together. After Ode 3: Sessional hymn of the feast, Tone 8: "The Word of God"; Glory, both now, the same Tone: "He was sent." After Ode 6: Kontakion, Tone 8: "To thee, the Champion Leader," and the Ikos; and we read the Prologue. At Ode 9, the brethren again light the candles. "More honorable" we do not chant, but we chant the refrain of the feast: "Proclaim, O earth, glad tidings of great joy; praise, ye heavens, the glory of God." Then the heirmos: "Let no hand of the profane touch"; similarly also the second choir, the refrain and the heirmos; and unto the other troparia of the feast, the same refrain. With the triode, however, unto the troparia, the refrain: "Glory to Thee, our God, glory to Thee." Unto the Theotokia, we chant the refrains of the feast. Then the heirmos of the Triodion, and the refrain of the feast, and the heirmos, both choirs together. Exapostilarion of the feast, twice, podoben: "With the disciples": "Of the angelic hosts"; Glory, both now: "That which from the ages is known today today." At the Praises: "Let every breath"; we set 4 verses, and chant stichera, Tone 1, podoben: "Joy of the heavenly ranks"; Glory, both now, Tone 2: "The mystery which was from eternity." [If it is a Saturday or a Sunday: Great Doxology, and the litanies, and the dismissal.] But if it is a fast day: We chant at the Aposticha of the Triodion, the idiomelon of the day, twice; and the Martyr-hymn. Glory, both now: Of the feast: "Let the heavens rejoice." Then: "It is a good thing to give thanks," once. After the "Our Father": Troparion of the feast. Litany, at the end 10 great prostrations, without dismissal of Matins, and the First Hour with Kathisma. Troparion and kontakion of the feast; and at the end, 10 great prostrations, and the prayer: "O Christ, the true Light." Holy oil is also given to the brethren. The idiomelon sticheron is chanted, and the dismissal. At the Third Hour of the day, we go forth with crosses and with a procession outside the monastery.[^1463] And having returned, we enter into the refectory, and chant the Hour: The Third and the Sixth with Kathismata, without prostrations; troparion and kontakion of the feast. At the Hours, we do not strike the bell. At the Sixth Hour: We chant the troparion, the Old Testament readings of the Triodion, and the rest according to their order, and the reading. And we read the homily whose beginning is: "Again the joy of the Annunciation."[^1464] We join also the Ninth Hour with Kathismata, and a reading. After this: The Beatitudes, quickly without chanting, and without prostrations: "Remember us, O Lord"; "The heavenly choir"; Glory: "The choir of holy angels"; "Remit, forgive." After the "Our Father": Kontakion of the feast; "Lord, have mercy," 40; Glory, both now: "More honorable"; and 3 great prostrations, and the prayer: "All-Holy Trinity"; and the dismissal. And we chant VESPERS without Kathisma, and without prostrations. At "Lord, I have cried": We chant the idiomelon of the Triodion of the day, twice, without the Martyr-hymn; and the podoben of the Triodion, 3; and of the feast, 3, Tone 4, idiomela, which are at the Aposticha. In order, the sixth of May; and of the Archangel, three times, Tone 4, podoben: "O all-praised martyrs." To the eleventh verse, the refrain: "Who makes His angels spirits."[^1465] Glory, both now: Of the feast: "The Archangel Gabriel was sent." The priest performs the Proskomide during the stichera. Entrance with the Gospel. "O Joyful Light"; Prokeimenon, and reading of the day; and of the feast, two: First, from Exodus: "Moses went in"; second, from Proverbs: "The Lord created Me." Then the small litany, and the exclamation of the Trisagion; and the Trisagion. Prokeimenon, Tone 4: "Proclaim the good tidings of the salvation of our God from day to day"; Verse: "Sing unto the Lord a new song." The Apostle to the Hebrews, pericope 306: "He that sanctifies and they who are sanctified."[^1466] Alleluia, Tone 7: "He shall come down like rain upon the fleece"; Verse: "His name shall be blessed unto ages."[^1467] Gospel of Luke, pericope 3: "Elizabeth conceived."[^1468] And the rest of the Divine Liturgy of Chrysostom. In place of "It is truly meet," we chant the heirmos: "Let no hand of the profane touch." Communion verse: "The Lord has chosen Zion, and has desired it for His habitation."[^1469]

items.english_text: We find in certain Typika that on this day of this precious feast there is sung: "Let my prayer be set forth." And this we do not know, in what manner it was determined. For some, out of arbitrary will and lack of instruction, have appended many things. But as for me, I judge that this ought not to be admitted at the complete Liturgy of Chrysostom, both at the Sixth Hour and when the Proskomide has already taken place. For it says: On whatever day the feast of the divine Annunciation occurs, the Liturgy of Chrysostom is celebrated, and at the refectory there is dispensation for fish, on whatever day it occurs. For this we received from the divine Fathers, to eat fish on the day of the divine Annunciation. But "Let my prayer be set forth" began to be sung in the Liturgy of the Presanctified, and at the Sixth Hour; for it is not fitting that any sign of mourning be sung on this day, for we honor it as the fountainhead of our salvation.

Only at "Glory to God in the highest," 3 prostrations; and after the Trisagia, 3 prostrations; and after "More honorable," 10 great prostrations with the prayer: "O Lord and Master"; and the other 12. And at the final Trisagion, 3 prostrations, and the dismissal.

items.english_text: At Matins toward the 26th day: We chant Alleluia, and the Triadica of the Tone.[^1472] But if it is a Saturday or a Sunday, we chant at "God is the Lord," the troparion of the Archangel, Tone 4: "Commanders of the heavenly hosts." After the first Kathisma: Sessional hymn of the Octoechos. After the second Kathisma and after the third: Sessional hymns of the Triodion. Canon of the feast of the Theotokos, with the heirmos on 6, Tone 4; and of the Archangel on 6, Tone 4. When the triode arrives, we chant the canon of the feast of the Theotokos and of the Archangel, with their heirmoi on 6; and the triode on 8. Katavasia: The heirmos of the Triodion. After Ode 3: Sessional hymn, Tone 4; Glory, both now: The same; and a reading. After Ode 6: Kontakion of the Archangel, Tone 2, podoben: "To thee, the Champion Leader": "Of the all-radiant and honorable and all-effecting [Trinity]." After Ode 9: Sessional hymn [exapostilarion], the Trinity Hymn of the Tone. At the Praises: Stichera of the Archangel on 4, Tone 4, podoben: "Thou hast given a sign"; Glory, both now: Of the feast, Tone 2: "Gabriel announces the good tidings." At the Aposticha of the Triodion: Idiomelon of the day, twice; and the Martyr-hymn. Glory, both now: Theotokion; and all the rest we chant with prostrations.

items.english_text: On Friday evening we do not say the Kathisma. At "Lord, I have cried": Stichera on 10: Idiomelon in the Triodion of the day, twice; and of the feast, 8. Glory, both now: Of the feast; and the readings first of the day, and of the feast, 5; and "Let my prayer be set forth"; and the rest of the Presanctified. At the first hour of the night, we chant Great Compline according to custom. After the first Trisagion: Troparion of the feast; after the second: Kontakion of the feast. After "Glory to God in the highest": The departure, as indicated above on a fast day. At Matins, the entire service is of the feast; neither the four-ode canon nor anything else of Saturday is sung, but everything of the feast; we chant also the Great Doxology. The four-ode canon is sung on Thursday at Compline; likewise also at the Liturgy, everything is of the feast. Before the Liturgy, at the second hour of the day, we make the procession outside the monastery according to custom; and having returned, we chant the Liturgy. The Beatitudes from the canon of the feast, Odes 3 and 6.

custom. After the first Trisagion: Troparion of the feast; after the second: Kontakion of the feast. After "Glory to God in the highest": The departure, as indicated above on a fast day. At Matins, the entire service is of the feast; neither the four-ode canon nor anything else of Saturday is sung, but everything of the feast; we chant also the Great Doxology. The four-ode canon is sung on Thursday at Compline; likewise also at the Liturgy, everything is of the feast. Before the Liturgy, at the second hour of the day, we make the procession outside the monastery according to custom; and having returned, we chant the Liturgy. The Beatitudes from the canon of the feast, Odes 3 and 6.

items.english_text: At the second hour of the day, we go forth outside the monastery, as indicated above. And having returned, we chant the Hours, at which is said the Resurrection troparion, and of the feast, and of the Cross, alternating. Likewise also the kontakia. At the Liturgy: The Beatitudes of the Tone, on 4; of the feast, Ode 3, on 4; and of the Cross, Ode 6, on 4. After the Entrance: Resurrection troparion, and of the Cross, and of the feast. Glory: Kontakion of the Cross; Both now: Of the feast. In place of the Trisagion, we chant: "Before Thy Cross we bow down, O Master." Prokeimenon, Apostle, Alleluia, and Gospel, and Communion verse: First of the feast, then of the Cross. In place of "It is truly meet," we chant the heirmos: "Let no hand of the profane touch." The Liturgy of Basil the Great is celebrated; likewise also on all days of the Holy Fasts on which this feast occurs, the Liturgy of Basil the Great is celebrated without exception.[^1475]

items.slavonic_text: Канѡ́нъ воскрⷭ҇нъ со І҆рмосо́мъ на д҃: и҆ Трїѡ́ди на д҃: и҆ пра́здника на ѕ҃. Катава́сїа, І҆рмо́съ пра́здника. По г҃-й пѣ́сни, сѣда́ленъ пра́здника, и҆ чте́нїе пра́здника. По ѕ҃-й пѣ́сни пое́мъ конда́къ пра́здника и҆ І҆́косъ: И҆ чте́мъ про́логъ. На ѳ҃-й пѣ́сни пое́мъ Чтⷭ҇нѣ́йшꙋю: Свѣти́ленъ воскрⷭ҇нъ, и҆ пра́здника. На хвали́техъ стїхи̑ры на и҃: воскрⷭ҇ны д҃: и҆ пра́здника д҃, съ припѣ̑вы и҆́хъ, и҆ со Сла́вою, пое́мъ припѣ́въ: Воскрнѝ Гдⷭ҇и Бж҃е мо́й: И҆ пое́мъ самогла́сенъ стїхи́рꙋ днѐ. Сла́ва, па́ки то́жде: И҆ ны́нѣ: Пребл҃гослове́нна є҆сѝ: Славосло́вїе вели́кое. По трист҃о́мъ, тропа́рь воскрⷭ҇нъ, є҆ктенїѝ, и҆ ѿпꙋ́стъ. Та́же, Сла́ва, и҆ ны́нѣ, стїхи́ра є҆ѵа́льская. И҆ дае́тся бра́тїи ст҃ый є҆ле́й ѿ канди́ла прест҃ы́я Бцⷣы: пою́щымъ на́мъ самогла́снꙋ стїхи́рꙋ пра́здника: И҆схожде́нїе въ притво́ръ, и҆ ча́съ а҃-й. На а҃-мъ часѣ̀ тропа́рь воскрⷭ҇нъ: Сла́ва, пра́здника, И҆ ны́нѣ, Бг҃оро́диченъ часѡ́въ. По трист҃о́мъ конда́къ пра́здника: и҆ прѡ́чая: соверше́нный ѿпꙋ́стъ.

At the 9th Ode, we chant "More honorable..."; Resurrection Exapostilarion, and of the feast. At the First Hour, Resurrection troparion; Glory: Of the feast; Both now: Theotokion of the Hours. After the Trisagion, Kontakion of the feast; and the rest; the complete Dismissal.

items.slavonic_text: А҆́ще слꙋчи́тся Бл҃говѣ́щенїе прест҃ы́я Бцⷣы въ сре́дꙋ пя́тыя недѣ́ли посто́въ. Пое́мъ слꙋ́жбꙋ предпра́зднства Бл҃говѣ́щенїа. Стїхи̑ры и҆ канѡ́нъ въ понедѣ́льникъ на рядꙋ̀: Минє́и же ст҃а́гѡ пое́мъ на повече́рїи: поне́же прелага́ется Вели́кїй Канѡ́нъ, съ четвє́ртка на вто́рникъ тоя́же нл҃и. И҆ пое́мъ Вели́кїй Канѡ́нъ, съ трипѣ́снцемъ вто́рничнымъ, пра́здника ра́ди прест҃ы́я Бцⷣы: поне́же въ сре́дꙋ къ пра́здникъ самы́й, каѳі́смы не гле́тся, и҆ покло́ны не быва́ютъ, и҆ ѿда́нїе пое́мъ пра́здника въ четве́ртокъ, тогѡ̀ ра́ди, въ сре́дꙋ ве́чера, стїхи̑ры съ покло́ны: и҆ Канѡ́нъ Вели́кїй въ четверто́къ не пое́тся: пред̾пѣ́тъ бо є҆́сть во вто́рникъ.

items.slavonic_text: Въ сре́дꙋ же є҃ недѣ́ли посто́въ: пое́мъ всю̀ слꙋ́жбꙋ, ве́черъ, и҆ ᲂу҆́тро пра́здника, съ Трїѡ́дїю по ᲂу҆ста́вꙋ, ꙗ҆́коже пред̾каза́ся къ де́нь по́стенъ. А҆ Ѿда́нїе пое́мъ Бл҃говѣ́щенїа, въ четверто́къ на ᲂу҆́тренни съ трипѣ́снцемъ а҆пⷭ҇льскимъ, ꙗ҆́коже ꙗ҆вле́но є҆́сть въ понедѣ́льника д҃-я и҆ є҃-я недѣ́ли поста̀, на Ѿда́нїе пра́здника Бл҃говѣ́щенїа.
items.english_text: We chant the service of the Forefeast of the Annunciation: The stichera and the canon on Monday in order; while that of the saint from the Menaion we chant at Compline; because the Great Canon is transferred from Thursday to Tuesday of that same week. And we chant the Great Canon with the Tuesday triode, on account of the feast of the Most Holy Theotokos; because on Wednesday, which is the feast itself, the kathismata are not recited, and prostrations do not take place; and we chant the Apodosis of the feast on Thursday; therefore, on Wednesday evening, the stichera are chanted with prostrations, and the Great Canon is not sung on Thursday, for it was sung beforehand on Tuesday.

И҆ чте́нїе а҆ка́ѳїста: и҆ полѷеле́й. И҆ сѣда́льны всѝ пра́здника: и҆ чте́нїе пра́здника. Степе́нна, а҃-й а҆нтїфѡ́нъ д҃-гѡ гла́са, прокі́менъ пра́здника: Вся́кое дыха́нїе: Е҆ѵа́лїе пра́здника,
items.english_text: On Friday evening, at "Lord, I have cried...", stichera on 10: In the Triodion, the idiomelon of the day, twice; and of the feast, on 8; Glory, both now: Of the feast: **"He was sent..."** Entrance; and the readings of the day; and 5 of the feast. After "Let my prayer be set forth...", 3 prostrations; and the rest of the Presanctified Gifts. And at "Blessed be the name of the Lord...", 3 prostrations; and at the Dismissal, prostrations.

items.english_text: And at the fourth hour of the night, the klepalo is sounded for the great bell, and afterwards for all the bells. And having gathered in the temple, when the priest has given the blessing, we chant Great Compline. And the priest censes according to custom, and after "Glory to God in the highest...", we go forth into the narthex and make the customary litiya, and we chant 3 idiomelon stichera of the feast, in Tone 1; Glory, both now: **"Gabriel announces the good tidings..."** And the customary prayers are recited by the priest. And upon the conclusion, we enter again into the temple; and we chant at the Aposticha the idiomelon stichera with their refrains; Glory, both now: **"Today is joy..."** At the blessing of the loaves, troparion of the feast, thrice; and a reading of the feast.

items.slavonic_text: Четверопѣ́снца же здѣ̀ не пое́мъ: но пое́мъ напредѝ, въ четверто́къ на повече́рїи. По г҃-й пѣ́сни, кондакѝ г҃, и҆ І҆́косы г҃: и҆ па́ки конда́къ а҃-й. Посе́мъ сѣда́ленъ: и҆ чте́нїе пра́здника. По ѕ҃-й пѣ́сни кондакѝ г҃, и҆ І҆́косы г҃. Та́же конда́къ: Ѡ҆ Всепѣ́тая Мт҃и: три́жды, и҆ І҆́косъ а҃-й: и҆ конда́къ: Взбра́нной воево́дѣ: И҆ чте́мъ про́логъ, и҆ сѷнаѯа́рїй. На ѳ҃-й пѣ́сни Чтⷭ҇нѣ́йшꙋю не пое́мъ: но пое́мъ припѣ́вы пра́здника: ꙗ҆́коже предписа́ся на самы́й пра́здникъ: канѡ́на же а҆ка́ѳїста къ тропаре́мъ припѣ́въ: Прест҃а́я Бцⷣе спасѝ на́съ. Та́же на схо́дѣ пое́мъ припѣ́въ, и҆ І҆рмо́съ: Ꙗ҆́кѡ ѡ҆дꙋшевленно́мꙋ: и҆ покло́нъ. Свѣти́ленъ пра́здника.
items.english_text: The four-ode canon[^1483] we do not chant here, but we sing it beforehand on Thursday at Compline. After the 3rd Ode, 3 kontakia and 3 ikoi; and again the 1st kontakion. Then the sessional hymn, and a reading of the feast. After the 6th Ode, 3 kontakia and 3 ikoi. Then the kontakion: **"O all-hymned Mother..."**, thrice, and the 1st ikos; and the kontakion: **"To thee, the Champion Leader..."** And we read the Prologue and the Synaxarion. At the 9th Ode, we do not chant "More honorable...", but we sing the refrains of the feast, as indicated on the feast itself; and for the canon of the Akathist, the refrain to the troparia is: "Most Holy Theotokos, save us." Then at the descent[^1484] we chant the refrain and the Heirmos: **"As the living ark of God..."**; and a bow. Exapostilarion of the feast.

items.slavonic_text: На хвали́техъ стїхи̑ры пра́здника на д҃: гла́съ а҃, подо́бенъ: Нб҃ныхъ чинѡ́въ: Сла́ва, и҆ ны́нѣ: Да веселя́тся нб҃са̀: Славосло́вїе вели́кое. Тропа́рь пра́здника, є҆ктені́и, и҆ ѿпꙋ́стъ. И҆ дае́тся бра́тїи ст҃ый є҆ле́й по ѻ҆бы́чаю, и҆ ѡ҆глаше́нїе Стꙋді́тово: и҆ ча́съ а҃-й въ притво́рѣ. На а҃-мъ часѣ̀ тропа́рь пра́здника. По трⷭ҇то́мъ конда́къ пра́здника, и҆ про́чее. И҆ ѿпꙋ́стъ. И҆ и҆схожде́нїе внѣ̀ монастырѧ̀. На Літꙋргі́и блаже́нна пра́здника, пѣ́снь г҃-я, и҆ ѕ҃-я на и҃. прокі́менъ, а҆́пл҃ъ а҆ллилꙋ́їа, є҆ѵа́лїе и҆ прича́стенъ пра́здника.
items.english_text: At the Praises, stichera of the feast, on 4: *Tone 1, Podoben: "Joy of the heavenly ranks" (Небе́сныхъ чино́въ):* Glory, both now: **"Let the heavens rejoice..."** Great Doxology. Troparion of the feast; litanies; and the Dismissal. And holy oil is given to the brethren according to custom; and the Catechesis of Theodore the Studite; and the First Hour in the narthex. At the First Hour, troparion of the feast. After the Trisagion, kontakion of the feast, and the rest; and the Dismissal. And a procession outside the monastery. At the Divine Liturgy, the Beatitudes of the feast, Odes 3 and 6, on 8; Prokeimenon, Epistle, Alleluia, Gospel, and Communion Verse of the feast.
